༄༅/ /bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa rnams// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs// yon tan 'phrin las dpag yas kun// dbyer med gcig du gyur pa yi// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos kyi mdzod// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad cing*// dpag yas gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i// rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// dri med sa la rabs bzhugs shing*// rgyal bas lung bstan theg pa'i mchog /rab du ston pa'i thugs rje can// na ga 'dzu na la phyag 'tshal lo// sing gha la ru sku 'khrungs shing*// rgyal bas lung bstan smon lam can// mu stegs rgol ba bzlog mdzad pa'i// 'phags pa lha la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyangs stobs dpag tu med pa yi// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// de nyid ci bzhin rig pa'i mchog /zla ba grags pa la phyag 'tshal// bla mas byin rlabs dngos grub brnyes// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa'i// ma tang ki la phyag 'tshal lo// bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs rnal 'byor pa// mkha' 'gros byin brlabs dngos grub brnyes// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i 'gro ba 'dul// ḍoṃ bhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo// bla mas byin brlabs dngos grub thob// zag med btub pas tshim gyur cing*// lhan cig skyes pa'i don ston pa// bhi na sa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od gsal thugs su chud gyur cing*// u rgyan gnas su spyod pa mdzad// mkha' 'gros byin brlabs rnal 'byor pa// la ba pa la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa can// rdo rje 'chang gis byin brlabs pa// rgyal srid dang bcas dngos grub brnyes// in tra bho ti la phyag 'tshal// bla mas byin brlabs ri khrod pa// mkha' 'gros lung bstan dngos grub thob// dka' thub mthar phyin rnal 'byor mchog

/lu hi pa la= rigs byed 'don pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'bras bsdud pa yi bsam gtan can// slob ma'i tshogs dang mkha' la gshegs// lding gi pa la= rgyal srid spangs nas spyod pa mdzad// dngos grub mchog brnyes rnal 'byor ba// bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin spyod pa can// dha ri ka la= byin rlabs mchog thob rnal 'byor ma// thabs kyis spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul// lhan cig skyes pa'i don ston ma// su ka dha ri la phyag 'tshal// dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// sna tshogs thabs kyi 'gro ba 'dren// bde ba chen po ster mdzad pa'i// skal ba bzang mo la= ma ha sid dhis byin brlabs pa// dur khrod gnas su spyod pa mdzad// thabs mkhas snying rje'i bdag nyid can// thang lo pa la= lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs cing*// ljon pa'i khrod na bsam gtan mdzad// shing lo pa la= dge slong tshul 'dzin rnal 'byor pa// thabs kyis spyod pa mthar phyin zhing*// kar+ṇa ri la bsam gtan mdzad// dril bu pa la= bka' bzhi rgyud pa'i byin brlabs shing*// dag snang rdo rje 'chang dang 'jal// sa bcu dbang phyug rnal 'byor pa// tai lo pa la= gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// dka' ba spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// na ro pa la= /sa ra ha yis byin brlabs shing*// mtha' bral don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// mai tri pa la= sbyangs stobs dpag tu med pa yi// rgyud don ji bzhin gzigs pa po// yon tan du mas rab rgyan pa'i// lho brag pa la= mkha' 'gro mchog gis byin brlabs shing*// na ro mai tri'i thugs kyi sras// rnal 'byor dbang phyug te phu pa// dri med bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal/ gangs can rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten skyon gyi ma gos pa// rlung gi yon tan mthar phyin pa'i// mi la mchog la= de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung bstan cing*// snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro don mdzad// phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// zla 'od gzhon nu la=

bshes gnyen mchog gis byin brlabs shing*// thabs kyi yon tan gnad du bsnun// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// ras chung zhabs la= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du// thugs rje chen po rab 'byon cing*// yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs pa'i// dus gsum mkhyen la// zag med yon tan rab rgyas shing*// shes bya'i gnas lugs mkhyen pa po// rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung mdzad pa yi// 'gro ba'i mgon la= bla ma'i bka' bzhin snyigs dus su// bsgrub pa snying por len mdzad cing*// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa'i// spungs brag pa la= bsam shing srid par sku 'khrungs shing*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs mnga' ba// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'dzam gling rgyan/ karma pa la= /brtul zhugs spyod pas rab brgyan cing*// snying po don gyi brgyud pa 'dzin// shes bya kun la thogs med pa'i// u rgyan pa la= mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par// deng sang bod yul zhing khams su// thub pa mchog gi bstan pa 'dzin// dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs can// snyigs ma'i dus su skur byon nas// 'gro ba banyen zhing grol mdzad pa'i// rang byung rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// rtsa ba rgyud par bcas pa la= dad cing gus pas gsol btab na// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// rnam pa kun mkhyen thob par shog /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// rtag tu bshes gnyen brten pa dang*// theg pa mchog gis rjes 'dzin cing*/ rtag tu tshe rabs dran par shog /nyon mongs bdun po rab spangs nas// yon tan bdun dang ldan pa dang*// byang chub yan lag bdun po yi// rin chen bdun dang ldan par shog /zhes pa 'di bka' rgyud rin po che la dad pa dang ldan pa'i shākya'i dge sbyong rang byung rdo rjes snyan ngag gi tshig spangs nas// lhas stengs su gsol ba btab pa'o/// / ༈ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na mo/

ma dpe las mi gsal/ stong rang bzhin sku/ ji snyed kun khyab dus 'khor lo// thub dbang nyi ma'i spyan mnga' ba// rtsod dus rgyal ba'i dbang po la// bdag ni gus pas gsol ba 'debs// khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis brlobs// a li ka li dbyer med pa/ 'gog lam don ston sgyu 'drar snang*// brag cha lta bur 'gro la ston// dam pa dang po'i dam chos la// bdag ni/ 'gre/ khyed dang*/ dpal ldan dha na ka ḍa ru// rgyal bas dbang bskur lung bstan pa// rgyal sras lha mo sna tshogs gzung*// tshogs mchog dge 'dun mtshungs med la// bdag ni/ khyed dang*// gsang bdag zla ba bzang po dang*/ lha dbang la sogs sems dpa' drug /sdud mdzad mi dbang grags pa dang*// 'jigs rten dbang phyug pad dkar la// bdag ni/ khyed dang*// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bcu dang*// byang chub sems dpa' bcu'i dngos/ grags pa dag dang 'khor lo cha// seng ge'i gdan dang rigs ldan la// bdag ni/ khyed dang*// bram ze nyi ma'i shing rta dang*// rigs ldan byin rlabs rtse lu pa// dus 'khor don rtogs pu to ba// rgyud don rtogs pa'i dus zhabs che/ bdag ni/ khyed dang*// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dus 'khor zhabs/ mkhas mchog bho dhe bha tra dang*// mkhas pa sangs rgyas grags pa dang*// skad gnyis smra ba'i seng lo la// bdag ni khyed dang rgyu 'dzin gnyon bsgom 'od ma dang*// sbyangs ldan bkra shis rin chen zhabs// mkhas pa byang pa dus 'khor ba// mkhas grub bla ma brgyud pa la= bdag ni khyed dang*// bcom ldan 'das mas byin brlabs shing*/ o rgyan dbang phyug rin chen dpal// bshad bsgrub kun gyi nus pa can/ mkhas pa kun dga' don grub la/ bdag ni khyed dang*// rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma lus shes// khyad par snying po rnal 'byor gsum/ legs par rtogs pa'i nyams shar bas/ rang byung rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyang*/

ye shes sku nyid thob par shog /ces pa 'di rang byung rdo rjes bde chen du sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ bcom ldan thub pa chen po thugs rje can// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir khyed kyi bstan pa la// zhugs pa'i bdag cag dmu long lta bu rnams// thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la drang du gsol/ kye ma ma pham rgyal ba'i sras po khyed/ grangs med smon lam dang gyur te// phyi dus gdul bya khyod kyi zhing yin na// da ltar 'gro rnams thur du gzhol gyur cing*// sdug bsngal rab 'jigs khrod du 'khyams gyur la/ byams pa khyod kyis bzlog par cis mi mdzad// kye ma blo gros dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs// thugs rje'i dbang phyug mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ mthu stobs dpag med rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag /deng sang 'gro ba rnams la gzigs su gsol/ khyed rnams thugs rje dpag tu med gyur ba// 'gro rnams ngan song 'gro las cis mi bzlog /dpa' bo khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul dpag med kyis// sreg pa'i skal pa rab tu zhi mdzad na/ dmyal ba'i me la smos kyang ma 'tshal na// ci'i phyir na 'gro ba tsha bar 'jog /khyed mthus rgya mtsho mer yang nus gyur na// 'gro gzhan rab grang sogs las 'byin mi mdzad/ khyed kyi sbyin pa'i mthun ni dpag med na/ yi dwags 'gro gzhan shin tu dbul gyur rnams// ci'i phyir na rab tu tshim mi mdzad/ khyed kyi thabs mkhas spyod pa dpag med na/ ci phyir ngan par dpyod pa'i 'gro ba rnams// bzang po'i spyod la rab tu 'jug mi bgyid/ khyed kyi 'phrul gyis stong gsum thams cad kun// ba spu gcig gis drangs te 'jig rten khams/ dpag med 'phangs kyang nyams dpa' mi mnga' yang*// 'gro gzhan zhing dag rnams su skyel mi mdzad/ khyed rnams kyi shes rab mthu ni sems can rnams// kun gyi sems yid gnas rnams rab mkhyen na/ 'gro ba rab tu blun la ci mi dgongs// shes rab snang ba sgron par mi mdzad dam// gal te so so'i las mthun yin na ni// mgon po khyed mthus ci zhig mdzad lags grangs/

khyed sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ mthong na dga' bar mi mdzad gnas med la// de la mos pas 'khor lo bsgyur ba yang*// gro bas bde blag thob na ci'i phyir/ khyed zhal 'gro ba rnams la ston mi mdzad// gal te bstan kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur na/ mgon po'i sprul pa'i sku yis ci zhig mdzad// kye ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// 'gro ba 'khor ba'i mun khrod gnas pa la// thugs rje'i 'od zer snang ba skyed du gsol// sdug bsngal mtsho'i gting mthar bying ba la/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ zhes bya ba 'di sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje la bskul ba'i phyir/ rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ ma dpe las mi gsal/ pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rang byung stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// rang gzhan sgrib pa'i brag ri 'joms byed cing*// rang bzhin rtog bral phag mor brtag khyod la// rang gzhan kun mkhyen thob phyir bstod par bgyi// ma rig mtshan ma rnam dag ye shes sku// ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gyur pha rol phyin/ ma ltar rtse bas 'gro la nye ba'i lam/ ma nor ji bzhin ston mdzad khyod la 'dud// rnam dag nyes pa'i skyon bral chus skyes dbus/ rnam g.yeng sgrib sel nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rtog dbyings dang ro gcig bam chen steng*/ rnam shes ye shes gnas gyur khyod la bdud/ sprin bral zla 'dra zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spros pa'i mtshan ma gcod byed gri gug g.yas/ spras pa'i rgyan mchog thod khrag g.yon/ sprul pa'i rnam 'phrul dpag yas la phyag 'tshal/ 'jig byed khro mo'i tshul 'chang gzhon nu ma// 'jam mnyen sku'i dbyibs sdug nu 'bur mdzes/ 'jigs rung thod 'phreng rus pa'i rgyan gyis spud/ 'jo sgeg sgyu ma'i rol gar mdzad la 'dud/ ci snyed ci bzhin gzigs pa brtse ba'i thugs/ gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i sna tshogs skur/

de yis de nyid sgrol ba'i gsung mchog gi /skye ba skye med thob mdzad khyed la 'dud/ 'gro kun 'gro mgon khyod kyi ma slu bar/ gang gis gang 'dod ster na'ang bdag blo yi/ shes rab shes bya 'byed par gsol btab kyang*/ ci ltar ci bzhin thob par ma gyur na/ de gang 'phrin las dus las ma g.yel lam// de ltar min yang ma dpe yig 'bru mi tshang*/ shes rab 'od stong 'bar ba'i dra ba yis/ blun byed mun pa'i tshang tshing kun bsal nas/ blo gsal pad ma'i tshal rab rgyas byed cing*/ blang dor gnyis med ye shes ro gcig pa/ bla med bsgrub mchog srid dang zhi ba'i dpal/ bla ma'i bla ma khyod kyi myur du brtsol/ skye ba skye ba kun tu'ang skye ba na/ 'khor ba 'khor ba'i 'khor los mi skyod cing*/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i 'jig med par/ rgyal bar rgyal ba'i yum gyis rgyal bar mdzod/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed la bstod cing gsol ba blo yis mun sel zhes bya ba rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// mam̐gha lam̐bha wan+tu// shubham̐/// / ༈ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi 'phrin las phyogs cig la bstod pa bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phrin las phyogs gcig la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal dang yon tan kun gyis brgyan/ dpag med shes bya'i gnas lugs mkhyen/ dpa' bo bdud las rnam par rgyal/ dpal ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod/ khyod sku nam mkha'i mtha' 'dra yang*/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba po/ mtshan gyi me tog rab rgyas pa/ dpe byad kyi 'bar phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung 'dzin kyang*/ sems can sgra dang mthun par 'jug /yan lag drug cu snyan pa'i sgra/ mtha' yas ston la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes sku ste rang byung ba/ ye shes gsung nyid 'dzin par mdzad/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/

ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ rgyal ba'i sras po mthu chen 'jam dpal dbyangs/ ye shes sku 'chang gzhon nu'i sku 'dzin pa/ bag chags sgrib pa rgad po rnam bsal cing*// srid dang zhi ba rnam spangs rnam grol sku// khyod gyi sngon gyi dam bcas las// myang ngan 'das 'gyur byang chub mi 'dod de// sems can kun don spyad par bya'o zhes// gsung nas nam mkha' skrag nas mtha' med byed/ khyed thugs nam yang skrag dang zhum med pas/ nam mkha' zhum nas dngos med gyur pa snyam// de bas khyod kyi thugs rje ci dal de// dngos med ma lags 'phrin las 'od stong 'phro// de bas bdag gis khyod kyi mdzad pa rmad byung la/ dad par gyur nas rjes su bsnyags par ma nus pas/ rnam pa kun tu yid ni rtse cig gyur pa yis/ ma mthong gyur kyang khyod kyi rjes su bsnyags/ res 'ga' gser sbyang gur gum mdog dang mtshungs gyur cing*/ cod pan zur phud lnga ldan chus skyes dum 'khrugs pa'i/ phreng mdzes rin chen rgyan 'phreng lhag ger 'dug pa ni/ pra ti se na lta bur snang de khyod yin zhes/ thos kyang khyed sku phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na/ dpal ldan pad ma zla ba kun dha ltar dkar dang*/ pad ma ra ga ban du dzi ba byi ru bzhin/ mar gad dur ba in tra ni la mthon ka che/ sna tshogs kun ldan mkha' 'dra rnam pa kun ldan pa/ lha dang lha min mi dang ltos 'gro che/ lus ngan brgya byin tshangs dang sred med bdag po dang*/ nyi ma zla ba 'og min lha dbang lta bur mthong*/ de bas sems can khams 'di mtha' med lus 'dzin pa/ khyod kyi sku'i rnam 'phrul 'di la 'gran pa snyam/ de ltar min na sems can thams cad mya ngan 'das/ bsnon pa med bzhin 'khor ba stong par cis mi 'gyur/ e ma ho/ rgyal sras mthu chen rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan ldan// ngo mtshar dpal ldan mthu chen dpal mchog kun la brtsol bar mdzad// ya mtshan rmad byung mthu chen rmad byung kun tu ston pa'i dpal// e ma thugs rje'i mthu chen thugs ldan kun brtse 'jam dpal dbyangs// mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor mthun chen dkyil du kun nas ma son med// de slad ye shes mthu chen ye nas mnga' ba kun kyang khyod mtshungs med/

khyod ni sems can bsam pa ci bzhin sna tshogs thabs kyi skur ston mdzad// zhi bas 'dul la rang rgyal dgra bcom gcig du zhi bas rnam grol ston// chags ldan 'dul phyir mdzes pa'i sku ldan mdzes pa'i cha lugs rgyan mang spud/ rin chen khang bzang longs spyod dpag med glu gar mdzes pa can// ro mchog bza' btung sna tshogs gos dang pad char lang long 'du bar ston// drag po 'dul phyir gshin rje mthar byed 'jigs dus char sprin nag po'i mdog dus mtha'am 'bar 'phreng rab tu 'khrug cing mtshon cha 'bar ba du ma can/ sgra chen sngags kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha' 'gral ba lta bu'i hūṃ phaṭa bsgrogs// drag po'i tshogs rnams spu long gyur te mgon po khyod kyis rjes su 'jug /de la sogs pa khyod kyi thugs rje'i sgyu ma su zhig gis brjod par nus// khyod kyis la lar rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// dag pa'i zhing khams nam rin chen bzhi dang sna tshogs ljon pa me tog char ltar 'bebs// yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo chos kyi sgra 'byin zhing du dag pa'i gdul bya la// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed cing mya ngan 'das pa'ang ston// yang dag dpa' bo thabs la mkhas pa sngon gyi skal pa rang rgyal tshul du dpag med bstan// sngon 'das rgyal ba klu dbang gyur cing da ltar byang phyogs rtag par 'dud cing mos pa na// sangs rgyas mos pa rab tu dga' ba'i snying po rin chen nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zhes/ khyed la grags te zhing khams 'di nas gang gi klung ni bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bye ma'i grangs// 'das pa yin zhes thub pa'i dbang pos sor mo'i 'phreng ba'i mdo las gsungs pa mngon sum thos// de'i slad du bdag ni khyod la rgyal la min zhes the tshom ma mchis skyabs su mchis// byang chub lam la ring por mi mnga' bas na skad cig yud la khyod ni byang chub mthar gshegs gyur// gyur kyang phyi ma'i mu mthar thug pa'i sems can don du rgyal sras tshul 'dzin 'khor ba stongs mi mdzad// skal pa grangs med bzhugs par gyur kyang skad cig nyid tsam dngos por mi mdzad rnam par mi rtogs la// nam mkha'i mthar thug rdzu 'phrul ston g.yo ba mi mnga' sku ni gcig pu 'dzin par mdzad// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i mthar son khyod ni dang po'i tshul las g.yos ma lags// skal pa gcig la rgyal ba stong gi mdzad mi myong pa'i sems can khams la khyod kyis sgrol mdzad kyang*// chog shes mi mnga' rgya mtshor chu 'dra dpag med ba yi chos 'dzin mdzad pa de bas ngoms shes/

khyod kyi mthu 'di sa yis theg cing mkha' 'di ral bar ma gyur pa la bdag ni ngo mtshar skyes// e ma'o dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rgyal ba kun kyis rab sngags pa// yon tan rgya mtsho mnga' ba lags// de phyir sngags 'os khyed lags so// ma 'ongs zhing khams rnam dag nor bu brtsegs pa zhes/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'jig rten khams mang bsdus gyur bde ba can gyis ni// skra rtse'i chu tsam lhag ma rgyal mtsho che lta yi// zhing der khyed ni mngon par byang chub ston 'gyur te/ stong gsum bcu phrag gcig gi tshad ldan byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs te/ rgyal ba kun tu gzigs pa zhes byar nam mkha'i mthar gtugs grags/ g.yo ba ma mdzad phyogs bcur gshegs shing sprul pa du ma ston par mdzad/ theg mchog tshul gcig ston par mdzad cing rgyal ba'i dbang por lung yang ston/ de slad rgyal ba'i sras khyod ni/ rnam mi rtog la thams cad mdzad/ phyogs bcur chos kyi rnga bo che/ gzugs med gzugs bzang sgrog par mdzad/ kha dog dang bral kha dog khyad par mdzes par ltar/ 'jig rten sgra min 'jig rten 'das pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrogs/ rnam par mi rtog rnam pa kun mkhyen rmad byung che/ ltar mi snang la lta ba mi ngoms khyod phyag 'tshal// phyogs dus kun nas yon tan bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs dar dir bsgrogs pa yis/ rgyal dang rgyal sras dregs dang zhum pa mi mnga' gyur kyang zhum pa bzhin/ bdud kyi dgra bo khro ba mi mnga' bdud las rnam rgyal rgyal ba'i sras// sgra tshig kun gyis khyod kyis yon tan bstod mi nus kyang khyod la bstod/ khyod kyi thugs rje'i mthu 'di yin// bems pos chos kun sgra 'byin zhes/ thos na rnam par ldan rnams kyang*/ khyod gsungs thos 'di mtshar byas/ rnam grol shes rab mkha' 'dra yang*/ blun po'i snying la son ma gyur/ rang gis rang nyid 'ching byed pa'i/ nyams thag 'gro la mi dgongs sam/

snyigs dus nyams nga'i 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad la/ rgyal sras khyed lha'i thugs rje 'jug par mi 'gyur na/ lhag pa'i rdzu 'phrul mnga' bar gyur kyang ci zhig bgyi/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'byor brtsal du gsol/ las kyi mun pa ye shes mthu yis mi bsal na/ phrin las rdo rje gang du 'tshal bar 'gyur ba lags/ de bas 'gro ba nyon mongs brag ri gzhom pa dang*/ sems kyi rin chen 'od ldan mngon gsum snang bar mdzod/ kye ma 'gro 'di phung po yi/ ri gling brtan ces mi gsung par/ ye shes phung po'i sku yis ni/ log rtog bag chags bzlog du gsol// las dang nyon mongs chu bo 'di// gting dpag bka' zhes mi gsung par// ye shes me chen rab 'bar bas// gtan nas skam par mdzad du gsol// tshul bzhin ma yin rlung 'di ni/ zhi bar bka' zhes mi gsung par/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ 'du byed g.yo ba gzhom du gsol// gal te khyod 'dra'i mthu chen ldan rnams log pa'i sems can brten min zhes// dman pa 'dor na rang rgyal rnams la ci'i phyir na smad pa gsung*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes slang par mi spyod sems can khams la mchis ma lags/ de nas mgon po thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bdag cag 'gro kun skyab du gsol/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes stobs/ gcig gi mtha' yang nam mkha' la/ gzugs can gyur na shong min na/ ci slad srid zhi grol mi mdzad/ gzung 'dzin kun rtog phra mo 'di/ khyod kyi shes rab mtha' yas pa'i/ ral gris gcod par ma mdzad na/ mgon khyod thugs las chung gyur tam// bdag gis lus dang longs spyod kun/ gang yang ma bzung mchod pa'i tshogs/ ltos med khyod la 'bul lags kyis/ bzhes shing bdag la dgongs par mdzod/ sngon gyi las dang bag chags kun/ ltos med rgyal sras kun la bshags/ gang yang phyogs bcu nam mkha' yis/ rgyal ba de dag thams cad la// theg mchog 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/

mya ngan mi 'das gsol ba 'debs// gang yang bdag gis dge ba cung zad bsags pa rnams// rgya mtsho che ltar khyod kyi ye shes ngang nyid du// ro cig gyur te nam mkha' zad par ma gyur bar// 'gro kun phan byed 'bras bu dpag med 'byin par shog /kye ma 'gro ba ma rig pa// rang rig gsal ba'i snang ba 'di/ gnyis 'dzin bdud kyi mdzes byed la// da dung bung ba ltar 'khor byed// mi bsal sred pa'i chu rgyun las/ khams su 'das pa'i chags bral kyang*/ kha med ljon shing chu phrad ltar// ji srid rkang thung kha med bzhin// phyi rol nyan thos de dag kyang*/ gang zag bdag med nga rgyal gyis// rin chen rang gi g.yas g.yogs ltar// rgyal ba'i snying po sgrib par byed// de phyir rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khyed la bdag ni gsol ba 'debs// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di/ dri med sngon du snang ba mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi yon tan phyogs tsam la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa zhes bya ba rgya mtsho'i phreng ba lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dus ring mo nas de nyid kyis rjes su bzung zhing*/ da dung rjes su 'jug pa rang byung rdo rje zhes bya ba bde chen stengs kyi ri khrod du bris pa'o/// / ༈ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yon tan gyi cha shas la bstod pa bzhugs so// na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ hrīḥ dpal ldan yon tan kun gyis rab rgyan dri med zla ba ltar dkar ba/ nag po'i rtsa lag kun nas 'dul mdzad nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer can// gcig nyid na'ang rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs nor bu'i sku 'chang pa// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang khyed la bdag ni gsol ba 'debs// ci slad ce na khyed ni byams dang snying rje'i nam mkha'i mtha' 'dra zhing*// smon lam mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i rgyun gyi 'phro ba bzhin du zad mi mnga'// mnga' ba de ltar mthun pa'i spyod pas rdzu 'phrul brlabs kyis nam mkha' khyab// shes rab mthu yis chags pa mi mnga' 'khor ba ji skad bzhugs ces grags// dmyal ba'i me lce las kyis rab 'bar khrod na tshir tshir sreg pa dag

/khyod kyi ye shes thugs rje'i chu'i brlabs kyis chil chil bsil bar mdzad// mtshon cha'i char drag rab tu 'bab pas lus kun thor thor gcod pa rnams// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag byams pa'i zer gyi pad char long long bsgyur mdzad cing*// ro nye'i rgyu ldeng kha'i nang du lus kun myal myal zhu ba dag /khyed kyi mthu yis bde ldan chur gyur bde ba phril phril ster bar mdzad// gshin rje'i skyes bu mi sdug khros pa'i bzhin ldan rnams kyis khyod mthong nas// brtse ba'i yid gyur zhi ba'i bzhin gyis khyod la bsnyen par bstod par byed// nyams thag 'gro rnams thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyod mthong dbugs kyang phyin gyur nas// thugs rje'i 'od kyis gdong gi chu skyes 'dzum par gyur cing thal mo yis// myu gu sbyar ba'i kha 'bus gyur te bde ba can du 'gro bar mdzad// de'i slad du mgon po khyod kyis dus kun mnyam par gshegs zhes grags// rgyal ba'i sras po rang rgyal tshogs rnams 'khor ba'i bde la skrag ces thos/ khyod ni rtse bas ngan 'gro yi sdug bsngal kun kyang dang du len par gyis// nyams nga'i yi dwags yan lag 'khrul cing me 'bar bkres pas gdungs gyur pas// rgya mtsho las kyis skems par byed cing rang snang 'khrul pas gtses pa dag /khyod kyi byams dang sbyin pa'i rgyu yis ba spu'i sgo nas chu bo'i tshogs// yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun rnams spros nas bkres bskom sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// lha'i lus ltar mdzes par gyur nas khyod sku dri med la dad pas/ bde ba can du skad cig yud kyis 'gro zhing mya ngan rgyun gcod mdzad/ sna tshogs lhan gyi dud 'gro'i tshogs rnams gti mug mun nag ldan pa kun// kun nas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs chags dang phrag dog gi gtses rnams// rnam pa kun du khyod mthong gyur nas shes rab rab tu rnam par gsal// gsal ba'i mthu yis byams shing dga' bas khyab par gyur nas mgon khyod lta/

de slad 'phags mchog pha dang ma dang byams pa'i gnyen gyur pa// khyod la bdag ni rtag tu gsol 'debs ngan 'gro thams cad stongs par mdzad du gsol// gang du skal pa dman par gyur pa'i mi'i 'jig rten kun tu yang*/ khyod kyi mtshan dang rigs sngags sgra thos bde ba can du 'gro zhes grag /gang du skal ldan khyod rjes 'jugs la sna tshogs thabs kyi sku ston cing*// zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ldan cing skar ma'i 'od zer ldan pa nas// bcu gcig zhal ldan bsil zer byed pa brgya stong 'od las lhag pa dang*// 'bum phrag zhal ldan bye ba'i yan lag nyin mor byed pa grangs med tshogs// lha klu dri za 'og min bdag po'i 'od kun zil gnon ston par mdzad// gling bar mun nag skal par bsags pa khyod kyi 'od zer gcig gis gsal// mi rnams 'jigs pa seng ge sbrul chen me dang chu bo 'khrugs pa dang*// mkha' 'gro sha za sa bdag khros dang chom rkun dgra bo ci snyed pa/ khyod zhabs dran pas skad cig gis sel skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi// sdug bsngal gyur la khyod kyis dbugs 'byin bar dor ral pa'i cod pan can// mdzes pa'i gzugs kyis mi 'jigs sgra 'byin bde ba can du khrid par mdzod// e ma'o mtshungs med skyabs mchog khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// gang du lha rnams bde ba'i ros myos bag med gyur pa gzigs nas ni/ khyod kyis sna tshogs 'jigs dang lhung ba'i sdug bsngal bsgrags nas bzlog mdzad cing*/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug mthu bo che ni khyod kyi tshems las sprul zhes thos// nyi ma zla ba gnyis ni spyan la smon lam dbang gis byung par grags/ gzugs khams kun bdag min gnas su dbang phyug khyod kyi thugs las sprul// snyan ngag lha mo dbyangs can khyod kyi zhal gyis mchil ma las byung zhing*// nor gyi dbang phyug mdzes byed gzhon nu mdung thung can dang 'khor lo can/

kla klo mthar byed 'di rnams khyod kyi 'phrin las cha las byung bar thos/ 'di dag 'jig rten khams 'dir sems can don du khyod kyis bstan// de bas dpag med yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' 'dra su zhig gis brjod nus/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nam mkha' mtha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi spyan mnga' na// phyag na pad+mo rgyal ba gnyis pa sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje ni/ bsdus pa'i stobs las grub pa gyur zhes rgyal ba kun gyi bsngags par mdzad/ rgyal sras mthu chen kun gyis yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med zhes// rgyal sras bsgrib pa thams cad sel bas khyod kyi ba spu'i khung cig tu/ skal pa grangs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis song par gyur kyang gting ma mthong*/ bdud rtsi ldan ces bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig na dag pa yi// lhun mo bye ba khrag khrig gnas la re re'ang lha dang dri za dag /dag pa'i sa lam rab dga' nas bzung bcu pa'i bar thob grangs med gnas/ zhes sogs sngags pa thub pa'i dbang pos mngon sum mdor gsungs bdag gis thos// 'on kyang khyod ni bde ba can na rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa'i drung*// lhun po lta bu'i sku ldan rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin bzhugs so zhes// thos par gyur nas skal pa bcu lon da dung skal pa grangs med pa// grangs med dang ni de 'og tu yang grangs med rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin cing*/ zhing de nas ni g.yo ba mi mdzad phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad du// rgyal ba kun mchod chos rnams 'dzin cing sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul du ma yis/ zhing kun rin chen gzhir mdzad nor bu'i bla res rgyun 'chang mdzes pa dag /sna tshogs me tog char du 'bebs shing dri zhim gdug spos ngad ldan zhing*/ kun bzang mchod sprin sprin phung tshogs kyis rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes byed la/ sna tshogs 'gro ba nyams thag rnams la sprul pa du mas dbugs 'byin mdzad/ 'od dpag med drung lhags pa'i rgya mtsho ci snyed 'dus pa rnams// lung ston mdzad de khyed kyi zhu bas rgyal sras de rnams tshim par mdzad/

e ma ngo mtshar khyed kyi mdzad 'di rgyal sras kun pas lhag pa snyam/ sna tshogs rin chen bai ḍūr+ya dang pad ma ra ga an dha snyil/ pad+ma pad+ma pad chen zla bzang a ti mug ta skyar snar dang*// dkar dang dmar po ljang khu sngon po gser mdog kha dog khyad par rnams/ gang yang 'drar snang gang yang ma yin dngos dang dngos med ma yin sku/ sgra dang sgra min yan lag drug bcu grangs med sgra dbyangs sgra min gsungs// thugs rje dpag med thugs ni stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos// rgyal ba'i yon tan thams cad khyod la mi mnga' gang yang mchis ma lags// 'on kyang dus rings rgyal sras tshul ston sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul rmad du byung*/ 'das pa'i dus na rgyal ba me tog las byung rjes su nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ ma 'ongs dus na zhing khams rnam dag rin chen du ma brtsegs pa der// 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes kyang grags par 'gyur// rgyal ba kun pas rgan par gyur kyang rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin cing*// sems yid rnam shes spangs par gyur kyang sems can kun gyi sems la 'jug /spros pa mkha' ltar dag par gyur kyang spros pa thams cad mngon gsum mkhyen// de phyir bdag gis brjod bya min kyang khyod la gus pas mchod cing bstod// sngon byas mi dge thams cad bshags shing dge ba kun la rjes yid rang*/ rtag tu bla med 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// spyan ras gzigs dbang khyed kyi rjes slob sems can thams cad de 'drar 'gyur// de srid bdag kyang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mthu ldan khyod dang mtshungs par shog /rgya mtsho las ni skra rtse'i chu tsam brjod cing bsod nams mthus// sems can thams cad rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med pas lung ston shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yon tan gyi cha shas la bstod pa zhes bya ba// dus yun ring mo nas de nyid kyis rjes su bzung ba rang byung rdo rje zhes bya bas bsnyan ngags kyi tshig med par sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /

༈ dpal kun tu bzang po la bstod cing smon lam btab pa zhes bya ba bzhugs pa lags so ang*// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' chen po dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan gsang ba kun bdag dpal// mkhyen pa'i skad cig shes bya mkhyen/ mtha' med ye shes thugs chud mtha'// mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// zhi ba'i rang bzhin sna tshogs rab tu snang*// dpag yas mkhyen ldan cir yang gzigs mi mdzad// rgyal sras gzhon nu rgyal ba kun pas rgan// kun dang mi mthun kun bzang khyod phyag 'tshal// 'das pa'i mtha' bzhin rnam rtog mya ngan 'das// ma 'ongs mtha' bzhin rgyal sras kun gyi ma// gnas pa'i mtha' bzhin mkha' dbyings kun na gnas// rmad byung khyod kyi rnam thar rgya mtsho'i rmad// nam mkha'i mtha' ni dpag med gcig pu kun stong pa// chos dbyings mtha' ni dpag med gcig pu rab dag pa/ sems can khams ni dpag med gcig du sgyu 'dra ba/ khyod kyi mdzad pa dpag med gcig du ma 'tshal to// bzhin kyang thub dbang rmad byung byang chub shing drung du/ bdud kyi mthu bcom rmad byung mngon par sangs rgyas bstan// dpag med rgyal sras rmad byung 'dus par gyur pa'i tshe/ khyod kyi rnam thar rmad byung dpag med gsal bar grags/ de slad bdag gi khyod la the tshom skyes gyur pas// rab dang sems kyi rnam thar cha la bstod par bgyi// rang byung dpa' bo bdud kyi sgra gcig rgyal ba'i sras po kun gyi dpal// sngon gyi skal pa grangs med rgya mtshor sangs rgyas rgya mtshor bstan gyur kyang*// phyi ma'i mthar thug rgya mtshor 'byung ba'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun mchod cing*// thub pa'i gsang 'dzin rgya mtsho ltar zab phyogs bcu rgya mtsho'i mthar thug pa// rgyal ba kun gyi drung na khyod snang khyod ni gar yang 'gro 'ong bral// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba kun dang thugs kyi dgongs pa rab mnyam zhing*// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung dbyangs ci snyed khyod kyi gsung dang dbyer med 'dres// de rnams sku'i sprul pa ci snyed khyod kyi sprul pa'ang de snyed de// 'on kyang bdag ni lam la slob ces rgyal sras 'dus pa kun la ston/

khyod kyi sgyu ma rab tu 'jigs med nam mkha'i dbyings pas sra ba 'di// rdo rje rin chen dpal ldan dbang po'i spyod yul kun las 'das// skad cig dbang bskur 'od zer chen pos dus gsum rgyal ba kun kyis mdzad// sems can khams kun mthun par 'jug cing rgyal ba rnams dang gcig pa'i 'phrul/ 'di yi tshul mthong sems 'di sgrag nas zhig par ma gyur khyod kyi mthu/ khyod kyi mdzad pa 'di shong gyur pa'i nam mkha' 'di ma ral ba 'jigs// nyan rang rgyal sras dpa' bo stobs ldan kun kyang 'di yis skrag min nam// oṃ ngo mtshar ba spu'i khu bu gcig nas sems kyi skad cig gcig la nam mkha'i khyon// me tog bdug pa sgron me'i tshogs dang dri chab zhal zas ro mchog sil snyan dpag med sprin// gdugs dang bla res na bza' lda ldi rab bkra dri med rin chen khro mchog dpag med sprin// rin chen rgyan mchog dbu rgyan dpung rgyan snang byed do shal yan lag spras pa'i sprin// lha dang lha mo mdzes pa'i gar byed dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs sprin// rab tu spro byed rgyal ba gcig la mchod par byed ltar dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad mchod// sems can khams dang mnyam pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs dpag tu med pa'i phran/ lha dbang tshangs pa 'phrog byed zhi ba lus ngan 'jig rten skyong 'dra dang*// nyi ma zla ba dbang phyug chen po lha min dbang po nam mkha' lding*// 'khor los sgyur dang mdzes pa'i mi mo sna tshogs tshul ldan yid g.yo dang*/ la lar gshin rje mthar byed khro tshogs rab 'bar bzod par bka' ba'i sprin// la lar nyan thos rnam thar zhi ba rang rgyal lta bu dang*// la lar sa bcu'i dbang phyug sna tshogs phyin bcu spyod mdzad cing*// la lar mchog gi sprul pa chen po mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i sprin// sems kyi skad cig re re la yang chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthar khyab ston// dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhing dang 'khor du bcas pa yang*// rang gi ba spu'i khung bu gcig du ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul stobs mnga' ba/

gsung gcig la yang de snyed chos kun tshig gcig ma lus sgra dbyangs ston/ ting 'dzin gcig gis shes bya'i gnas rnams kun dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin 'jug /rtog pa mi mnga' sems can khams kyi rnam rtog kun dang dus gcig mkhyen// smon lam rna thar tshul 'di mthong pa'i rgyal sras dpa' bo ma lus pa/ kun bzang spyod la gnas par shog shes dus gsum kun du dar dir bsgrogs/ khyed kyi mtshan thos skad cig zhag dang zla ba lo dang skal pa dang*/ bskal pa brgya stong grangs med dpag med yongs su smin pa'i sems can khams// skad cig re re stong gsum rdul phran grangs pas mang pa rnam par grol// mchog gi sprul pa rgyal ba kun gyi mdzad mi spyod pa skad cig mdzad// 'on kyang mos dang chog shes mi mnga' 'dod chags 'di 'dra kye ma mtshar// bdud dang log 'dren mthu chen 'joms pa'i zhe sdang 'di 'dra kye ma 'jigs// rtog pa'i mtshan ma rdul tsam mi g.yo gti mug chen por zhugs pa dam// dus gsum rgyal dang 'phrin las mnyam zhes nga rgyal 'di 'dra gsung pa thos// rnam thar 'di 'dra bdag gi ston ces phrag dog chen po srid// 'di 'dra'i ye shes nyon mongs ming can mnyam par 'dzin pa gsang bdag ces// rdo rje theg pa bsdus par byed pa rdo rje zla ba dri med can// rgyal ba kun gyi snyan du gyur pa gsung gi dbang phyug rdo rje chos/ drug pa yid rnams kun dang 'dres gyur kun tu bzang po rgyal ba'i thugs// de la sogs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs sems can kun gyi ming pas mang*// rnam thar tshul 'di thub pa'i dbang pos shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las gsungs// de'i slad du mos pa'i rdul phran 'thor ba'i tshig 'di cha shas tsam// e ma'o rgyal sras kun tu bzang*// sngon gyi skal pa rgya mtsho nas/ dus ring rjes su skyangs gyur kyang*// da dung khyod rjes mi 'jug pa'i// 'gro ba'i kun rtog mthu dang ldan// sangs rgyas kun gyi khyod bsngags kyang*// bstod pa'i tshig gcig ma brjod pa'i// bdag cag sems can shin tu rmongs// 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs sogs kyang*// khyod kyi rnam thar rjes slob na// cha shas tsam yang mi 'jug pa'i/

khams gsum 'gro ba 'di ci zhig /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi mthu bo pa// gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya// mkhas pa de dang mtshungs pa yod min zhes// thub dbang gis gsungs rjes su yid rang sad// de phyir zhing kun mtsho'i mchod sprin dang*// lus dang longs spyod kun gyis khyod rab mchod/ sngon gyi sdig pa mi dge ci yod dang*// ltung ba'i nyes pa las kyi sgrib pa kun// shin tu 'gyod pas khyod drung bshags par bgyi// slad chad nam yang bgyi par ma gyur cig /phyogs dus rgya mtshor bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba la// 'gro ba'i blo mun sel bar bya ba'i phyir// chos tshul rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// skal pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// skal pa rgya mtsho'i dpag tu med pa ru// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab thabs mkhas rmad byung dang*// smon lam stobs dang ye shes rgya mtsho yis// spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /byang chub sems ni nam yang rjed ma gyur// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rtag tu mthong bar shog /chos tshul rgya mtsho rtag tu nyan pa dang*/ tshul khrims rgyal mtsho'i dri bsrung snom pa dang*/ theg chen rgya mtsho'i ro rnams myong ba dang*/ ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i reg bya kun myong nas/ ye shes rgyal mtsho'i rtogs pa thob gyur cig /zhing khams rgya mtsho rtag tu sbyong ba dang*/ rgyal ba rgyal mtsho thams cad mnyes bgyid cing*// sems can rgya mtsho'i sdug bsngal sel ba dang*/ bde mchog rgya mtsho rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /rgyal sras rgya mtsho kun dang 'grogs pa dang*/ theg mchog rgya mtsho'i thabs rnams kun bzung nas// nyon mongs rgya mtsho shin du dag byed cing*// rnam thar rgya mtsho sgyu ma ltar sbyong shog /tshe rabs rgya mtsho skye ba thams cad du// mi khom rgya mtsho thams cad rab spangs nas// dal 'byor rgya mtsho'i yon tan ma lus pa// sems can rgya mtshos rtag tu thob par shog

/bdag ni rtag tu ma sras po dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ kun tu bzang po khyod dang mi 'bral zhing*/ rnam thar tshul la mnyam par 'jug par shog /bdag gis cung zad dang bas gsol ba yis// smon lam 'di la dge ba ci yod pas/ rgyal ba kun gyis spangs pa'i sems can rnams// bdag gis lam la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig sems can gang dag bdag la sdang pa dang*/ chags pa'i rnam rtog tshul min skyes pa dang*// mthong dang thos dang reg dang dran rnams kyang*// myur du phyir mi ldog pa thob gyur cig /bdag gi smon lam shin tu 'grub par shog bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po la bstod cing smon lam btab pa zhes bya ba// kun tu bzang po rnam par thar pa la mos pa lam du byed pa'i rang byung rdo rje'i/ snyan ngag gi sdebs sbyor med par go bde ba'i ngag tu/ nags phu dpal gyi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// rjes 'jug kun gyis 'don pa la brtson par mdzad par zhu/// / ༈ mtshur phu'i bstod pa bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya thub pa phyag 'tshal lo// bde legs dang ldan sum cu'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku// yan lag drug bcu'i chos sgra ma lus ston pa'i gsung*// ji lta ba dang ji snyed ma lus mkhyen pa'i thugs/ mgon po bcom ldan thugs rje can la gus pas 'dud// dus gsum rgyal sras rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// byin rlabs mchog thob bka' brgyud bla ma dang*/ grub thob byon gnas dpal gyi mtshur phu yi// mtshan nyid ji ltar brjod par mi nus kyang*// re shig rten pas mngon du gyur pa dang*// zhing 'di'i yon tan brjod la spro gyur pas// mtshan nyid cha smos bdag gis brjod par bya// stong gsum 'jig rten ya mtshan phul byung pa'i// dri med gnas mchog 'dzam gling 'di nyid dang*// ya mtshan mtshar sdug ldan pa'i snying po 'di// ri rgyal chen po gangs ri'i shar phyogs las// bsil ba'i chu rgyun lo hi ta 'bab cing*// de rgyud dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi// mchod gnas dam pa shākya'i rgyal po'i sku// de dang nye ba'i sa phyogs mtshur gyi phu// gnas 'di'i byin brlabs mdo tsam brjod pa na// shākya'i rgyal po mngon par sangs rgyas nas// stong gsum kun tu zhabs kyis bcags pa na// gnas 'dir bcom ldan rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs// byon cing byin brlabs zhabs kyis bcag par khums// gzhan yang bcom ldan thub chen seng ge yis// lung bstan rgyal sras zla 'od gzhon nu yis// mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bod 'dir mdzad pa'i dus// rgyal sras byin brlabs seng ge sgra de la// lung bstan mdzad cing snang ba 'di ltar mdzad// ri bo rin chen mchog 'dra'i ngos la ni// rgyal bas bzhugs pa'i rgyab yol pad 'dab ltar/

shin tu mdzes gnas byams pa'i sku yod sa// der song dngos grub dam pa mchog thob ces// lung bstan mdzad cing rjes su gnang ba thob// de nas cung zhig lon nas dam pa yis/ gnas 'di byin brlabs dag pa'i snang ba gzigs// de nas gzhan yang dpal ldan rin chen gyis// byon cing byin brlabs yon tan dam pa thob// de ni sngon du byung ba'i gtam rgyud yin// da ni ri rgyal mchog gi bstan tshigs bshad// ya mtshan mtshar sdug ldan pa'i ri bo 'di// lha dbang brgya byin gdan bzhugs lta bur gnas// ri phran rnams ni lha'i dbang po la// nye dbang srid zhu 'dud pa'i tshul du gnas// ri de nyid ni rin chen spungs pa ltar// ya mtshan mtshar sdug ldan pa'i 'od zer can// 'di 'dra gang zhig mthong ba dpal yon can// 'dir gnas brag ri khyung chen lding ba 'dra/ rang byon lha tshogs yig 'bru sna tshogs gnas// rin chen dang mtshungs brag ri 'od 'bar ba// kun nas bltas pas skye dgu'i yid 'phrog byed// skabs skabs dag na shin tu bde yangs pa'i// spang gnas de nas me tog tshogs bskyed pa// ser bus skyed pas dri bsung ngad ldan zhing*/ bde gnas bung ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun// snyan pa'i mdangs chags dang yid 'phrog byed yin// 'dir nas me tog rigs ni brgya phrag gcig /sdug bsngal nad kyi zug rngu sel byed pa// sman gyi mchog gyur rnams kyang brgya phrag ste// sman dang me tog bskyed byed brlan pa/ byed 'gyur chu mig rgya dang rtsa brgyad yod// grub thob rnams kyi bzhugs gnas phug pa brgya// sngo ldum zas kyi bye brag brgya rnams dang*// shing mchog rigs ni bye brag brgya rnams yod// der gnas sems can ri dwags tshogs rnams kyang*// phan tshun 'jigs dang bag tsha'i sems bral zhing*/ mig zum mgrin pa skyogs te der gnas pa/ rtse dgar rol mo'i dpal mchog dpal gyis mdzes// ri 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlab pas// 'dir dus dad ldan lha mir bcas pa kun/

snying rje'i bsam pas 'gro la bu bzhin rtse// gzhan yang ri 'di'i rtse nas bltas pa'i tshe// shar gyi phyogs rol dpag tshad gsum tsam mthong*// bcom ldan rgyal ba nyid kyi byin brlabs pa'i// shākya'i rgyal po bcu gnyis pa dang ni// brgyad pa'i mtshan dang ngo mtshar mchog gyur pa// lha mi'i rin chen sna bdun las grub pa'i// bzo rgyal lha mchog nyid kyis bzhengs pa yi// ya mtshan phul byung shākya'i rgyal po'i sku// bzhugs pa'i lha khang ngo mtshar can de mthong*// gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs// nyid kyi sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po yis// thugs dam rang byon spyan ras gzigs kyi sku// byin rlabs ldan pa'i lha mchog de yang mthong*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i rgyal po yis// byon pa'i pho brang nyid kyang gsal bar mthong*// gzhan yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul gyi// rgyal po chen po bzhugs pa'i ri yang mthong*// gzhan yang mthu stobs gsang ba'i bdag po yi// sprul pa'i rgyal po ral pa can byon pa'i/ pho brang ri bo de yang mthong ba yin// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gsum mkhyen pa'i// rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang sum bcu gnyis// byon dang bzhugs pa'i ri yang mthong ba yin// de sogs ya mtshan phul byung pa// bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi langs ste// mthong tshul mdo tsam 'dir ni bkod pa yin// sa steng ya mtshan ri bo phul byung pa// bsil ba'i mdangs chags gangs ri'i mtha' bskor can// ya mtshan rmad byung dpag tu med pa gnas// de nas mdun gnas ri bo'i mtshan nyid ni// gzhan dag tshul mthun gong dang 'dra gnas shing*/ khyad par du yang ljon pa'i tshogs gnas pa// dpyid dus bzang la lo 'dab lhag 'gyur te/ me tog tshogs kyis yongs su bkra bar gnas// rlung gis bskyod pa'i gar thabs g.yo ba las// me tog rnams mang spung spung 'thor bar byed/

gzhan yang de ltar de gnas phu de na// ku mud dpungs pa'i ri bo dngas bsil ba// rgyal ba'i ming can gnas shing de nas ni// zil dngar ldan pa'i rgyun 'bab byed cing*// 'gro tshogs skom pa'i sdug bsngal sel byed yin// gzhan yang lha tshogs mtshan ma'i khyad par ni// rgyab kyi ri la rta mchog he ru ka /de ltar de 'drar shākya'i rgyal po'i sku// de mdun ri la sgrol ma'i sku nyid dang*// gzhan yang bsam gyi mi khyab gnas bod kyi// rgyas par brjod kyis mi lang grangs las 'das// spyi'i bstan tshigs mdo tsam brjod pa yin// nam zla dus bzhi so so'i khyad par ni// dpyid dus gsum gyi rnam pa 'di lta ste// dus mthun bsil yab rjes mthun rlung bcas zhing*// ljon sogs lo 'dab gser bu rab tu 'khrungs/ sil snyan tshogs rnams sgra snyan rgyun du 'khrol// sprin dkar zhi ba me tog char dkar 'bab// mtho khyad lhun mdzes ldan pa'i ri bo dang*// bde gnas spang tshogs sngo ldum rgyas par byed// dbyar gsum dus kyi rnam pa 'di lta ste// shing mchog me tog sna tshogs bkra ba dang*// ljon tshogs steng na bya skad snyan sgrogs pa// lha'am dri za'i glu dbyangs zil gyis non// sprin dkar zhi ba'i 'ja' 'od tshogs bcas rnams// 'brug sgra chem chem mkha' la sgrogs pa dang*// bsil ba'i char rgyun mkha' la 'bab pa dang*// bsil byed ser bu cung zad bskyod pa yis// me tog dag la dri zhim sna tshogs ldan// bai ḍūr sngo ba'i mdangs gsal nas// ston gsum dus kyi rnam pa 'di lta ste// rtsi shing sngo ldum 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams smin// sa dang ri ngos gser gtso ltar du ser// dngas bsil ku mud char ltar 'bab pa'i dus// ri bo dkar bsil shin tu dngas par byed// gzhan yang dgun gsum rnam pa 'di lta ste// bsil chags zil mngar stong gi ngar ba ltar// 'od chags sprin dkar zhi ba'i gdugs mdzes shing*// nyi ma zla ba'i cod pan gyis mdzes pa// dus mthun mtshar chags ldan pa bsil ba yin// mchog gnas gnas 'di shin tu ngo mtshar gnas// gang gis mthong dang thos dang dran tsam gyis/

yon tan bsam 'das brjod kyis mi lang ba// yod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'di re mtshar// de ltar de dbus dgon pa 'di nyid ni// shākya'i rgyal po ston pa 'di nyid kyi// sku gzugs rin chen mchog las byas pa yis// 'dom pa bdun dang ldan pa'i rten yang yod// dgra bcom nyi ma gung gi tshems kyang bzhugs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mid la'i gsol zhal dang*/ gzhan yang rten tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa// bzhugs shing 'jig rten mchod pa'i gnas gyur yod// 'dom bdun lhun po'i dpal dang ni// byang sems rigs lnga'i sku dag dang*// byams mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// thugs rje ldan pa'i sku yang bzhugs pa yin/ kha sar pā ni'i lha khang dang mtshungs pa'i// mgon po thugs rje ldan pa'i lha khang yod// gzhan yang dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dang ni// rgya gar shar phyogs dbus 'gyur gnas pa yin// dpal ldan 'bras phung nyid dang mtshungs pa yi// mtshar sdug ya mtshan ldan pa'i mchod brten dang*// rten gyur mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med yod/ rgyas par bdag gis brjod kyis mi lang bas// mtshan nyid cung zad tsam cig smos pa yin// gzhan yang ya mtshan dag ni bsam 'das ste// nya dang stong dang tshes brgyad la sogs ste/ tshes gsum la sogs dus bzang thams cad la// nam mkha' 'ja' 'od 'khyil pas gang ba dang*/ gnyis dang gsum la sogs pas bskor ba dang*// lung pa'i rnam pa ma lus khengs pa dang*// shar dang nub dang steng 'og 'phyang ba dang*// me tog char dang 'ja' 'od sna tshogs ldan// gser gyi me tog gser gyi 'od 'byin dang*// dung ltar dkar ba'i dung gi 'od 'byin dang*// bai ḍūr ltar sngo bai ḍūr 'od 'byin dang*// i tra ltar ljang ljang khu 'od 'byin dang*/ khra bor snang dang gnyis pa snang ba dang*// gsum du snang dang de bzhin bzhir snang dang*// bsam gyi mi khyab snang ba'i me tog tshogs// dri zhim yid 'ong sna tshogs mdangs gsal nas// gzhan yang tshul lugs brjod na bsam mi khyab// cung zad bdag yid mos pas brjod pa 'di// snyan ngag sdebs sbyor tshig gis ma 'brel dang*// de sogs skyon la mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod// 'di brtsams dge bas nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i// 'gro ba ma lus byang chub mchog thob shog

/bstod pa dam pa gnas kyi tshul gsal bar byed pa snyan ngag rgyan gyi me tog gsal ba'i sgron me rdzogs so// shubhaṃ// ༈ dben gnas chen po bde chen gyi bstod pa bzhugs so// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dben gnas dben pa'i rkyen gyur nyon mongs rab dben rgyu// ma rig ma lus rkyen gyur chos tshul dag ma lags// rab yangs rab du rkyen bral zhi ba de rab mchog /bde chen bde ldan rkyen gyur bsam gtan bskyed bde ba// phyogs dang phyogs 'tshams rkyen med snyan sgrogs dkar phyogs kyi// tshul ldan tshul min rkyen bral phyogs su grags tshul brjod/ lhun po'i rgyal po glang po che// sa srungs gtsug gi cod pan la// lha dbang 'gying pas brtan ldan zhing*// nye dbang bkram pas bkod pa snyam// rdo rje'i snying po'i brgyan phreng gis/ phyogs rnams kun nas rab tu brgyan/ spang ri 'tshams kyi stod g.yogs la// me tog sna tshogs tshom bus rgyan/ na bun dkar po'i cod pan la// sprin dkar zhi ba'i gdugs kyi mdzes// dngas pa'i chu mig rab dngas pa// mig stong phyogs rnams ltas pa bzhin// ri phran nye dbang lha tshogs la// 'bab chu'i na chung rkang thung gis/ brgyan cing yal ga g.yo bas mdzes// mdzes pa'i bya tshogs du ma dang*// bung ba'i gzhon nu du ma kyang*/ 'khor zhing lding bar byed pa ni// dga' tshal tshul mtshungs 'gran snyam bgyi/ 'di 'dra bsam gtan 'phel ba snyam// rab dkar chos bzang bde chen bdun sa na// bsam gtan mchog ldan dbang po nye dbang bcas// lha min bdud kyi dpungs tshogs gzhom pa'i phyir// rtse cig chos don bgro bar byed pa na// shes rab rnga bo che'i sgra skad kyi// thabs mkhas bskul bar byed la ya mtshan med// rnam rtog nag phyogs klu'i snga sgra dag /dpa' gong byed pa snyigs dus ya mtshan che// 'og gi phyogs kyi lhun po rab brtan pa// brag ri'i mche ba gyen du 'phags pa dang*// sgang sgud sna ljags phyogs su rkyang byas nas// nags tshal rgyan phreng bkod pa'i rgyan gyis spras/

sna tshogs lo thog bskyed tshal rnams kyis bskor// yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo du ma rnams// dngas zhing bsil byed sgra snyan lhung lhung sgrags// pad ma'i mtsho na gnas pa yin nam snyam// 'di ci dga' ba'i tshal khrod na// pad ma lang long ut+pal gyis// 'og phyogs mnyam la rmi nyams bzhin/ bde chen bzhi pa'i de mtshungs lta// chu bran rlung gi sgra dbyangs rnams// sna tshogs rol mo brdungs ba bzhin// nyi ma zla ba skar ma rnams// rin chen phreng ldan lha'i bu// mthu chen mkha' la bskor byed cing*/ dus su lha dbang zhabs drung du// bskor zhing yang yang 'du byed la// phan tshun gsal bar mdzes par byed// kye ma sprin gyi rnga sgra rab grags pa// nam mkha' rgod shing dbugs 'byin byed pa bzhin/ gser 'od rab 'bar glog phran 'gyur ba bzhin// yan lag gar mdzes byed pa'i gzugs ldan zhing*// char phran rin chen phreng ba 'thor ba yis// skabs su bab tshe skye 'gro lha tshogs rnams// mgu bar byed cing ser bu'i ngad ldan pas// dri zhim phyogs kun ldang ba'i rol mo mkhan// rnam g.yeng gnyis bral bsam gtan rjes su mthun// 'di 'dra'i dus tshigs lha'i rol mo mkhan// de'i dus na 'dod lha'i bu mo rnams// la long 'du bar byed pa 'di re mtshar// bde ldan bde byed bde ldan bde// rab mchog rab byung rab mchog rab// bla med bla ma bla med bla// bstod byed bstod pa bstod byed bstod// lha yang yid rab dad byed cing*// lha ma yin ras g.yo ba dang*// mi las gzhan rab phul byung du// lha mo mchog rab mdzes pa bzhin// gnas dang bstod pa'i zlos gar dag /phan tshun bstod pa'i zlos gar gnas// gar gnas bstod kyang bzlos phan tshun// gar gnas bstod pa bzlos pa yin// bris pa dga' byed blun po mos par byed// mkhas pa mgu byed tshig la yi rang byed// bsam gtan bskyed byed rab gsal bar byed// 'di ltar smra byed khyab 'jug las gzhan byad// kye ma khyab 'jug 'phrog byed lha dbang gzhon nu dang*// dbyangs ldan lha ma snyan ngag mkhan ni kho bo la// nam mkha' 'di ni skrag cing phyogs kun 'gran 'dod nas/

mtha' med byas nas sna tshogs 'jig rten bkod pa snyam// dpa' bo zhes byas snyan ngag byas pa bden// rgyal ba'i yon tan tshad med gyur pa bden// deng sang blun po ca co sgrogs pa bden// dben gnas zhi bar chos dang mthun pa bden// 'jig rten sgyu mas brid nas 'khor ba rdzun// mtshan nyid mi ldan bstod pa brjod pa rdzun// mi rtag pa la rtag pa 'dod pa rdzun// sgra la don du byas par byas kyang rdzun// tshul min bzlos nas mkhas grub ldan pa rnams// gnas 'dir yon tan snyan ngag me tog gi /phreng ba du ma 'thor bar mdzad mthong nas// rang byung gis kyang gnas 'di lha dbang dang*// sa bsrungs de dang gzugs can rab rtog dang*/ zung ldan zung ldan chen po khyed 'khor ldan// rang bzhin brjod pa'i srad bus spel ba la/ mkhas mchog rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ bde chen stengs kyi phyogs gcig brjod pa'i ngag rdzogs so/// / ༈ dus bzhi'i gnas la bsngags pa bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal ldan 'gro mgon bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa rin chen mchog tu zab yangs chu gter gyi// yon tan gnas la mngon par phyogs te 'dug pa rnams// dal 'byor grub chen bla ma rnams kyis mnyam pa yis// legs par zin gyur tshe na myur du brtson par mdzod// gang dag tshul gnas thos dang ldan pa de dag kun// bsam gtan gnas mchog rnams su 'bad de bsgrub par bya// rgyal bas bsngags shing yon tan kun gyi gnas su gyur// de bas re shig dben pa'i yon tan mkhyen par mdzod// gang dag dben dang dben pa'i gnas kyi rang dbang myong*// de dag mi khom nyams pa'i khrod du gnas su mnyam// de phyir 'dir ni ngag dang tshig rnams dri med pas// mdo tsam brjod pas 'di la rjes su yi rang gyis// rgyal bas rgyud dang mdo rnams las gsungs spyi dang bye brag khyad par gyi// gnas de rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab 'dir ni rags pa spyir bshad pa/

dgun gyi dus su rdo rje'i brag ri nags tshal tshogs kyis spel byas pa// rin chen 'od 'bar 'bar ba'i phung po 'phro ba lta bu'i 'od gsal zhing*// ud pa la dang dngas pa'i rin chen rdo rje ral gri bsnams pa las// lta bur mdzes shing shing rnams yal ga yan lag gar mdzes byed pa bzhin// lo ma'i lding khang khang mdzes bzhi ltar kun nas gsal ba'i phyogs dag na// tshang tshing nags tshal sprin phungs la lar phreng ba bkod pa 'dra/ dga' dga' ltar snang spos kyi ngad ldang la lar chu gtsang sngon po 'bab// skabs skabs dag na dngas pa'i chu mig la lar shel gyi chun po bzhin// lhang lhang 'tsher ba'i zar bus brgyan cing la lar rlung gis 'phog pa'i sgra/ 'ur 'ur dal bus sgrog par byed cing la lar rol mo brdungs pa 'dra// rtsa ba'i tshogs rnams sna tshogs ro ldan dri rab dang ldan bzar rung pa// sa phyogs de 'dra rtsa rlung gnad rnams sgoms na tshe 'dir dngos grub thob/ sos ka'i dus la bab pa'i tshe na mtsho 'gram rab tu yid 'ong pa/ an dha snyil gyi dum bu 'dra ba rlabs kyi phreng ba 'phro ba dag /pad+ma dkar po lta bu chil chil sgra sgrogs shing*// brag la phog pa'i brlabs phreng rnams ni mu tig phreng ba mthor ba bzhin// myu gu ldum bu gsar pa rnams ni kun nas kha 'bus 'dzum pa 'dra// ljon pa'i lcug phran sna tshogs rin chen dum bu'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa bzhin// sa rlangs g.yos pa lhun po'i rtse mor rab dkar cod pan g.yo ba 'dra// gzhan dag nam mkha' phang phung 'du zhing phyogs kyi tha gras 'jal ba bzhin// kun tu khyab byed sa gzhi bsnum par byed pa bzhin du dga' ba'i gnas/ de 'dra rnams su bsam gtan bde ba rba rlabs med pa thob pa yin// dbyar gyi dus la bab pa'i tshe na phyogs rnams rab tu mdzes pa yi// gangs ri dpal ldan ku mu ta'i 'od dang zla 'od phrad pa bzhin// kun nas bskor zhing spang ljongs rnams ni kun tu lag mthil ltar mnyam pa// rma bya dang ni ne tsho'i mgrin ltar 'tsher la 'jam zhing sngo ba yi// ne sing kun nas me tog sna tshogs bkra zhing 'bar bar byed pa bzhin// dus kyi rlung gi bskyod pa'i sprin rnams sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka 'phyo ba yi// klu rgyal tshogs rnams gus pas 'dud 'dra bla res bres pa bzhin// glog phran 'gyu ba'i gar mdzes byed cing sprin gyi snga sgra rgod pa 'dra/

mdzes pa'i char phran mu tig gtor ba bzhin du 'bab pas ngad ldang zhing*// gshong bu rnams su rang gi sbu bas brgyan pa'i chu rnams 'gran pa bzhin// lhung lhung sgra sgrogs yan lag brgyad kyi sgra snyan 'byin pa lta bus brgyan// bya tshogs du mas bstod par byed cing bung ba'i na chung glu len pa// ri dwags rnams kyis mdzes par spras pa'i dben gnas rnams su rnal 'byor can// rgyal ba'i gsung ltar nyams su blangs na lhag mthong ye shes skye bar 'gyur// ston gyi dus na spang ri mdzes pa rin chen du ma'i phung phung po// cung zad sngo ba dus tshigs rkyen gyis gtso ma'i gser sbyangs phyis pa dang*// mar gad rin chen spel ba bzhi mdzes 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams du ma rnams// g.yo zhing 'dud pa rlung gis g.yos pas sna tshogs spos kyi ngad ldang zhing*// yan lag brgyad ldan chu phran rnams ni rol mo bsil bkrol byed pa bzhin// lteng ka 'bab chus nyi ma'i 'od kyis gnam sngon zhu ba ltar sngo ba// rang gi rlabs kyi yan lag bskyed pas zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba bzhin// la la dag na rlung gis phog pa shel gyi dum bu lta bu yi/ chu rnams nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis phog pas dga' bas sa stengs rgyu ba 'dra// zla ba skar ma'i tshogs rnams 'bar zhing nam mkha' rgod par byed pa bzhin// kun nas bkra zhing ser bu bsil ba rlung yab dal gyi g.yos pa 'dra// de 'dra'i gnas su byang chub sems ldan bsam gtan sngas ni gzhan don byung*// de lta mod kyis 'khor ba 'dir// dpag med dus ring 'khor byas te// da rung skye bar ma gyur pa// kye ma sred pa'i stobs 'di la mtshar// rgyal bas skyob pa de rnams kyi/ thugs rje'i stobs kyang chung ba bzhin// rgyal bas sa stengs snang mdzad che// tshangs dang 'phrog byed la sogs lha// thams cad yan lag thal mo yis// ku mu ta rnams zum gyur cing*// gdong gi chu skyes pad mo las/

bstod pa'i sbrang rtsi ma thon gyur cing*// ma rig mun pa kun gsal nas// de bzhin gshegs pa gshegs bzhin no// mdzad rnams don ldan don rnams mdzad// slad byung gang de gang 'bras slad// 'dis ni don mdzad don ni 'di// gzhan phyir yin pas yin phyir gzhan// mi mdzad de ni mi ldan zhes// bsgrags pa min kyang snyan par bsgrags// de ltar thams cad mkhyen pas rjes bzung tshe// nor 'dod pa dag gter ni mthong ba bzhin// 'phags pa'i rin chen thob par mi byed gang*/ de ni khyu mchog 'khor gyi tshogs yin no// blun po de dag tshe 'di'i dpal la yang*// rtse ba med par myos nas rig rig ltar// bde ba zil mnan sdug bsngal khur chen gyi// 'og nas 'og tu gzhol ba kye hud nyams/ de bas de phyir de la de mthar phyin// dpal ldan dpal mchog dpal snang dpal gyi lam// thob bya thob rgyu thob de thob nas kyang*// tshul min tshul spangs tshul khrims tshul bstan mdzod// de dang nyer ldan bsam gtan gtan byas shing*// dri med lhag mthong shes rab rab spel na// sgrib pa kun zad ye shes shes bya la// mngon sum lta bur chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur// rgyal ba'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor las byung rnam dag chos kyi 'od zer gyis// phog pa'i blo mchog pad mo kun rgyas yon tan mchog gi ze 'bru bkra// de lta mod kyi bdud kyi na chung bzhin mdzes pad ma'i nags tshal dag bdag por lta bas dung dung yang zer gyis phog pa bzhin du 'dzum// de ltar mthong nas dga' byed la sogs yul 'di smad pa mi nus kyang*// mchog gi bla ma mchog tu nyer bstan ro mchog myong nas 'dir bris so// rnam dag ming can dam pa rnams kyis mthong na mig ni mi g.yo par// cung zad dgongs cig bkod pa'i tshul 'di rgyal bas gsungs dang mthun pa mnyam// 'di ltar don med bris pa 'di// rang byung ming kyang rang byung ming*// rdo rje zhes bya rdo rje yi// gnas lugs stong pa nyid don la// kun rdzob tshul dang 'dres mthong pa// de yis re shig bris pa yin// bdag ni snyan ngag mkhan min cing*/

mngon brlom gyis dregs ma yin te// 'on kyang ngag tshig rgya mtsho las// sdebs sbyor sbrang rtsi legs par rnyed// yig ge ma ning pho mo dang*// 'byung ba'i gnas dang yon tan kun// lam dang mthun par bsdud byed par/ blo'i stobs kyis mthong ba yin// slad kyis rtsom pa bzhed rnams kyang*// de rnams tshul bzhin rtogs par mdzod// dus bzhi'i gnas la bsngags pa sdebs sbyor snang ba zhes bya ba'o/// / ༈ rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i bstod pa bzhugs so// gnas kyi mtshan nyid rab tu gsal bar byed pa lhun po'i brgyan zhes bya ba'i bstod pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa dri ma med dang rab bstan nas// ma rig dri bsal dri ma med lam ston// sa lam dri ma kun bcom dri med brnyes// shes bya'i dri ma bral la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' rnams// bsgrub pa'i snying po nyams su len byed pa/ de nyid rkyen gyur dben pa brten bya zhing*// mdo las byung ba de dang mthun gyur pa// ri brag bas mtha' chen por gnas pa rnams// phyogs su bsngags shing nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas// rgyud sde'i mchog las snying por gsungs pa'i phyir// gnas 'di'i yon tan cung zhig brjod par bya// bsil zer 'phro ba'i chu gter pad mo la// ri rab gling bzhir bcas pa'i ze 'bru bkra// khyad par dam chos rtsi bcud legs ldan pa'i// 'dzam gling yon tan tshogs kyis bkra ba'i dbus// rdo rje gdan las byang phyogs gangs ri'i zhol// grub pa'i gnas mchog mkhas grub gyis bsten pa// gangs can po ta wa ri'i shar gyi phyogs// khyad par 'phags pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin// byang phyogs li yi yul zhes grags pa na// rgyal ba'i byin brlabs glang ru'i ri dang bcas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byon pa'i gnas// gh+ri ha de ba'i yul las lho phyogs yin/

shar phyogs gha dha ra zhes grags pa'i yul// klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab kyis bsrungs// rgyal ba'i bstan la dad pa rgyas gyur pa'i// longs spyod ldan pa'i yul gyi nub phyogs yin// dbus 'gyur 'chang las shar gyi phyogs gyur pa// grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis bsten pa'i zhing*/ 'dod pa'i gzugs can lha mo byung ba'i gnas// ka ma ru pa'i gnas kyi byang phyogs yin// de dag rnams kyi dbus kyi char gnas pa// pre ta pu ri'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid ldan// snyigs ma'i dus kyi bsgrub pa'i gnas gyur pa// kun gyi bgrod dka' ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gnas// dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyis lung bstan pa'i// ri 'di'i mtshan nyid mdo tsam brjod pa ni// ri bo dngas bsal shin du dkar ba'i 'od/ ku mu ta dang zla ba spungs pa bzhin// rab dkar lhun mtho mtho khyad lhag par 'phags// sprin dkar zhi ba'i cod pan rnam par mdzes/ 'di'i shar phyogs lha'i khang pa steng*// rdo rje drag 'dul 'khor dang bcas pa gnas// phal gyis bgrod dka' 'jigs pa'i sgra 'byin pa// chu rnams rang gi sbu bas g.yo bar 'bab// ri brag rnams kyang mtshon cha'i rnam pa ltar// rab 'jigs nags tshal tshogs kyis legs par brgyan// de'i dbus na ne'u sing rab mdzes pa// chos kyi 'byung gnas lta bu'i dbyibs ldan pa'i// shin tu mdzes pa'i lteng kas brgyan pa yod/ sngon tshe slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang*// bla ma bhe ro'ang 'di ru byon zhes grags// 'di ni mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gnas mchog ste// bzang po'i dus la 'dus shing tshogs mdzad de// skal ldan rnams la byin gyis brlob ces grags// de'i lho phyogs ngos kyi rgyud la ni// rab 'jigs dur khrod bdag po'i chas ldan pa// lha dmag 'bum gyis bskor ba yod ces grags// 'di na'ang drag po'i mngon spyod grub pa'i gnas// dpag med yod cing khyad par lha'i gnas// de nyid mchog tu gyur par bsngags pa yin// 'di'i nub kyi phyogs dang nye ba na/

dmar mo khrag mdog bse'i lan phran can// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor bar// thun mong las rnams thogs pa med 'grub pa// gnas shing de'i sku dang bcas pa'ang yod// 'di ni rab tu cho 'phrul che ba'i gnas// bgrod par dka' zhes dpal ldan bla mas gsungs// 'di'i byang gi phyogs su gnas pa ni// gnod sbyin drel la dga' ba zhes bya pa// gnod sbyin du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa gnas/ 'di dang nye ba'i gnas kyi phug pa na// bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog chos 'byung gis brgyan pa// cho 'phrul du ma ston pa yod ces grags// de ltar grub pa'i gnas mchog gis bsten pa// 'di ni rong btsan kha ba dkar po zhes// kun tu khyab pa'i ming gis mtshan pa yin// 'di'i phyogs rnams kun nas rab bsal ba'i// chu bo sgra snyan 'byin pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// lta bas mi ngoms shin tu rab mdzes pa// mtsho dang lteng ka'i tshogs kyis bkra bar gnas/ 'di'i 'khor du gangs ri'i phreng ba ni// shar phyogs ghan dha ri'i sa mtshams nas// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gnas kyi bar du yin// gnas 'di'i nye 'khor kho ra khor yug na// dus min 'chi dang mu ge'i 'jigs pa bral// a ka ru dang tsan dhan rgun 'brum shing rtsa sogs/ shing mchog rigs ni dpag tu med pa kun// de dag rnams kyang sman gyi nus par ldan/ nyi ma byang bgrod shin tu dro ba'i dus// 'di ni rab bsil gangs ri'i phreng bar ldan// nyi ma'i lhor bgrod shin tu bsil ba'i tshe// 'di ni myu gu la la 'bras bu'i tshogs/ smin cing in tra'i mdangs can nyid du gnas// rab bsal tshon rnams kun gyis bsgyur 'dra ba'i// dri zhim me tog brgya phrag du ma dang*/ lo ma 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams bsam mi khyab// phyogs rnams kun nas spos kyi ngad ldan pa// lha'i rol mo sgra snyan bsgrogs pa dang*// ngo mtshar che ba'i rnam pa du ma rnams// dag pa'i yid can rnams kyis snang ba yin// 'di'i rnam pa dpag med yod mod kyi// 'dir ni re shig mdo tsam brjod pa yin// rgyas par bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa yi// gsung dang gnas 'di nyid la rtogs par bya// 'di ni re shig gnas la dad pa yi// skyes bu rnams kyis cung zad bskul ba'i ngor// snyan ngag sdebs sbyor tshigs rnams spangs nas ni// nyung bsdus gsal bar sbyar ba'i dge ba de/

'gro rnams nyon mongs g.yeng ba rab spangs nas// bsam gtan nad med bde ba mchog thob shog mthar thug srid zhi gnyis las 'das pa yi// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par shog sprel lo zla ba gsum pa yi/ tshes bcu'i nyin par rang byung rdo rjes gnas sgor sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ mtshur phu'i bstod pa thung ba bzhugs so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhaṃ hūṃ/ rang bzhin don la mnyam med chos kyi rje// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rje sprul pa'i sku// dus gsum mkhyen dang chos rje rin chen gyi// dgongs pa ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa yis// dben gnas chen po mtshur phu de nyid kyi// bstod pa cung zhig bdag gis bkod par bya// dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs mtshur kyi phu// zla 'od gzhon nu nyid kyis lung bstan cing*// bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog khyad 'phags chen po yi// rgyab ri dag ni mchod rten rnam pa la/ bya dang gcan gzan ri dwags tshogs rnams ni// skad snyan bsgrogs shing gar thabs rtse ba'i sa// skabs skabs dag na lha gnas 'dra ba yi// spang ljongs dag la me tog sna tshogs ni// ut+pal spang brgyan shang shang la sogs pa'i// me tog rigs ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de dag kun yang dri zhim ngad dang ldan// de ltar me tog rigs bzhin sman rnams kyang*// bsam gyi mi khyab mtha' yas sna tshogs pa// so so rang rang dri zhim ngad dang ldan// de bzhin me tog sman rnams bskyed byed pa'i// chu'i mchog gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa// gnas shing 'gro ba skom gyis gdungs ba rnams// skom sel dbugs kyang phyin cing mchog dga' thob// de ltar ri'i mchog gyur de la ni// rang byon lha dang yig 'bru bsam mi khyab// de bzhin sems can dbugs srog bskyed byed pa// sngo sdum zas kyi bye brag bsam mi khyab// de ltar mdun gyi ri bo de nyid la// sems can gos kyis gdungs bar gyur pa la/

shing gi rigs ni khri phrag du ma yi// me yis drod ni chen po bskyed nas kyang*// 'khyags pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel bar byed// de bzhin sman dang me tog chu la sogs/ gong dang 'dra zhing ri dwags kun kyang gnas/ bya dang gcan gzan la sogs thams cad kyang*// bde bar 'tsho zhing 'jigs pa kun dang bral// de ltar lung pa de'i phu nyid na// spang gshong dag ni gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'dra// dben zhing nyams dga' lha'i gnas lta bu// de'i rtsa na gangs kyi rgyal po ni// rgyal ba'i ming can gnas shing de nas ni// chu rgyun bsil ba'i ngad ni 'bab byed cing*// sems can mi'i 'gro ba thams cad la/ phan bde sna tshogs 'byung zhing skom pa sel// de lta bu'i gnas mchog de nyid na// nya dang stong dang tshes brgyad la sogs dang*/ tshes gsum la sogs dus bzang thams cad la// nam mkha' la ni 'ja'i gur phub cing*// me tog char pa la sogs 'byung ba'i gnas// de'i dbus na mtshur phu'i dgon pa ni/ ji ltar spang la me tog bkram pa bzhin// ji lta ji bzhin lha nge lham me ba// kun gyi mchog gyur dpal ldan mtshur gyi phu// ya mtshan can gyi gnas mchog de la 'dud// mtshur phu'i bstod pa rang byung rdo rjes bris pa'o/// / ༈ ri chos dngos grub phreng ba bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// dad ldan skyes bu sbyangs stobs can// bsgom chen rnams kyi don du ni// gdams pa cung zhig bri bar bya// chos sku mkha' ltar dag pa yi// don mchog ye shes phyag rgya che// snying po don gyi lta ba mchog /bsgom chen phyag rgya chen po yi/ don rtag bde chen te lo ba// sprul sku de'i yon tan yang*// ri khrod 'grims pa bdag las byung*// de rjes 'jug pa'i skal ldan ni// dbyer med mkha' ltar don rtogs shing*/ bde chen mchog gi rnal 'byor pa// rje btsun na ro chen po yang*// ri khrod 'grims pas rdzogs sangs rgyas// dam pa de'i zhabs drung du// blo gros rin chen rnam par 'phrul// zab mo sngags kyi sgo 'byed cing*/

gdams ngag kun la mkhas pa'i mchog /lho brag pa zhes bya ba yang*/ ri khrod 'grims pa'i byin brlabs kyis// ltar med rnam dag phyag chen rtogs// rje btsun de'i zhabs drung du// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rnam par 'phrul// bsgom chen rnams kyis che ba ston// rje btsun mid la nyid kyang ni// ri khrod 'grims pa'i yon tan gyis// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po rtogs// ras pa de'i zhabs drung du// las dang thugs rjes byon pa yi// zla 'od gzhon nu'i rnal par 'phrul// bla ma dwags po rin chen yang*/ ri khrod 'grims pa'i yon tan gyis// brtags bcu yon tan brgyad la sogs// 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa// ri khrod 'grims pa'i shugs las byung*// rgyal sras de'i zhabs drung du// dgongs pa mchog ldan seng ge sgra// thos bsam lung rigs mthar phyin cing*// lho brag grub pa'i gnas bdun du/ mnyam med grub pa thob tshul bstan// rtogs ldan de'i zhabs drung du// 'gro mgon bla ma rin chen yang*// ri khrod 'grims pas don mchog brnyed// gang zag de'i zhabs drung du// rin chen pun+ya badz+ra yang*// ri khrod 'grims pa'i yon tan gyis// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po rtogs/ de rjes zhugs pa'i skal ldan ni// sbyangs pa mthar phyin rin po che// dka' thub bsam gyis mi khyab pas// shar phyogs spung ri'i gnas mchog tu// bcu gnyis bar du dka' spyad cing*// grub pa thob pa'i tshul bstan nas// sems can kun gyi smin grol mdzad// grub thob de'i zhabs drung du// rang cag bla ma rin chen yang*// ting 'dzin mchog gis byin brlabs shing*// u rgyan la sogs gnas rnams su// bsgom tshun bstan cing phyag chen rtogs// skyes chen de'i zhabs drung du// dus mtha' rnal 'byor rang cag kyang*/ ri khrod 'grims pas yom tan rdzogs// de rjes 'jug pa'i skal ldan rnams// kun kyang ri khrod 'grim bya zhing*/

'jig rten bya ba spangs nas su/ phyogs med pa yi ri khrod du// ltem brkyang med par bsgrub pa bgyis// chags sdang thams cad spang bya zhing*// nags 'dab ri khrod dgon pa ru// gcig pu nyid du bsdad bya zhing*// ltos gos 'khri ba gcad byas nas// zhen med gcig tu ri khrod 'grims// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// dam chos ma lus thams cad kyang*// kun kyang phyag rgya chen po yi// don mchog nyid kyang bsgom par bya// ri khrod bsgoms pa'i lha 'dre dang*// bar du gcod pa'i mi ma yin// de dag ma lus thams cad kyang*// snying rje chen po'i sems kyis ni// thams cad bla mar bsgom bya zhing*// byin gyis brlob pa'i tshul du bsam// rang nyid gcig pur 'dug pa'i tshe// 'khor lo lnga la sogs pa yi// rtsa 'dab rnam pa thams cad du// rlung sems 'dus pa'i rtags su ni// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing khams dang*// gsang sngags lha tshogs la sogs dang*// bar chod byed snyam 'byung ba dang*// de bzhin 'dar dang na ba dang*// rdzu 'phrul ston nus snyam pa yi// gegs dang yon tan cha mang 'byung*// de lta bu nyid byung ba'i tshe// ting 'dzin bsam gyi mi khyab pas// kun kyang bla mar bsgom bya zhing*// zhum pa med pa'i sems bskyed na// rnal 'byor che ba dgra 'dres 'don// de la sogs pa'i yon tan dang*// de bzhin gegs dang skyon la sogs// gdams ngag zab chos nang na gsal// ri khrod 'grims pa'i skyes bu rnams// ri khrod mchog la rab zhugs na// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i// dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur// dper na gangs ri'i rgyal po la// seng ge'i tshogs rnams btsun pa ltar// ri khrod 'grims pa'i skyes bu rnams/ ri la bzhugs na ya mtshan che// mtho gnyan gangs ri'i gzhi bdag rnams// gzhan yang 'byung po mi la sogs// dbang du 'du zhing zhabs rtog byed// bsgom zhing bsgrub pa'i sa la ni// sa mtshams byed pa gal che ste/

khyad par tsa ri tra mchog yin// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog dang*// mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog dang*// brgya dang bcu gsum la sogs kyi// nang nas khyad par tsa ri ste// bod na yod pa'i gnas mchog ni// nyi shu rtsa bzhi gsung gi mchog /ka ma ru pa nyid dang ni/ kam po gnas nang mchog tu bshad// de rjes gnas mchog spung ri dang*/ rong btsang la sogs rnams kyang sngags// khyad par gnas mchog mtshur phu nyid// de la sogs pa'i ri khrod du// bdag nyid gcig pur bsgom bya zhing*/ mos gus rtse cig gsol btab na// yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung*// ri khrod dgon pa nyams dga' bar/ gcig pur bsgom pa'i dus tshod du// bzang dang ngan pa'i rnam rtog sogs// de dag ma lus thams cad kyang*// stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo mchog /'od gsal zung 'jug bsgom bya zhing*// 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad la/ snying rje chen po'i 'du shes bskyed// skyes chen skyes bu dam pa rnams// ri khrod 'grims pas yon tan rdzogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// ri khrod mchog la rab tu zhugs// yi dam lha tshogs ma lus kyang*// ri khrod nyid la bzhugs pa nyid// mkha' 'gro chos skyong ri la bzhugs/ ri khrod 'grims pa'i yon tan ni// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po rtogs// bzang dang ngan pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ dug lnga dug gsum la sogs rnams// thams cad rang bzhin grol nas 'chi// bdag nyid gcig pur 'dug pa'i tshe// nyams dang zhi gnas lhag mthong sogs// 'phra'u yi rnam rtog ma lus dang*// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po gnyis// nor dogs yod pas gzobs las mdzod// 'di nyid gcig pur 'dug pa'i tshe// rtsa gnas 'khor lo rnams lnga ru// bzang ngan rtog par 'khrul pa ni// spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo ru// rlung sems 'dus pa'i rtags su ni/ sangs rgyas dang ni yi dam tshogs// kun kyang dkar po nyid du mthong*// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru// rlung sems 'dus pa'i rtags su ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// kun kyang dmar po mthong mnyam byed// snying kha chos kyis 'khor lo ru// rlung sems 'dus pa'i rtags su ni// byang chub sems pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// de dag bzang po'i 'khrul snang byung ba dag

/sngon po'i snang ba byung ba dag dngos sam rmi lam nyid du mthong*// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru// rlung sems 'dus pa'i rtags su ni/ gsang sngags lha tshogs ma lus kun/ ljang khu nyid du mthong mnyam byed// de dag bzang po'i 'khrul pa ste/ ngan 'khrul rnam pa 'di ltar byung*// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo ru// nyon mongs rlung rnams 'dus pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor lo rnams lnga yi// nang du log pa'i rlung rnams ni// zhugs tshe rnam rtog 'di ltar byung*/ gti mug ri ltar spung pa dang*// 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo ba dang*// zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba dang*// phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshub pa dang*// de la sogs pa'i nga rgyal dag /thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i/ ngang du ma yengs mnyam par zhog /de rnams gegs las grol ba'i tshe// sa bcu lam lnga bgrod tshul dang*// spyan lnga mngon shes drug la sogs// de dag so so'i rtags rnams byung*// de ltar de dag rdzogs pa dang*// 'od gsal zung 'jug phyag rgya che// snying po'i don gyi mthar thug mchog /ma rtogs ma skyes rgyus ma mdzad// gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro// thams cad ngo bo chen po nyid// 'od gsal zung 'jug mngon du gyur// de lta bu la goms lags na// mkha' 'gro dpa' bo chos skyong tshogs// yang yang thams cad kun kyang mthong*/ yon tan 'phrin las 'gro don rnams// rgyal ba rnams dang mnyam par 'gyur/ de lta bu'i gdams ngag 'di// kho bo rang byung rdo rje yis// bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du// nyams la shar nas bkod pa yin// skal ldan kun gyi gdams ngag mdzod// ri chos dngos grub phreng ba zhes bgyi ba/ ri khrod 'grims pa rnams kyi don du bkod pa'o// gdams pa 'di rang byung rdo rjes spre'u lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ mtshur phu'i dben gnas khyung rdzong du gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ ang yig bzhugs so// kye ho dpal ldan 'gro mgon rin po che/

skal ldan bdag la byin gyis brlab du gsol/ bdag 'dra blo dman rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// rang la gros 'debs gsal ba'i me long bri/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje// skal ldan lam sna drang du gsol// rje la gsol ba btab lags pas// snying la gdam ngag gdud rtsi zhugs// dam chos thugs kyi nying khu byung*// snying la gdam ngag byon lags kyang*/ bdag gis bsgrub pa ma byung bas// rang gis rang la khrel lo ang*// da ltar 'jig rten snang ba la// tshul chos gang che chos pa bzang*// shin tu dga' bar 'dod lags kyang*/ yig 'bru mi gsal/ bdag bstod gzhan la smod byed pa/ ma dris tshe na bden bden 'dra/ 'dris nas khrel dgos yod de ang*/ 'di'i bde ba yud tsam la// bltas na khe dang bsog 'jog byed// rtag med sgyu ma lta bu la// gzhan pham rang rgyal ma byed ang*/ da ltar 'jig rten 'di nyid du// mi rtag tsha tsha mi bzod na// rigs drug bar do'i sdug bsngal la// bzod re byed pa 'khrul lo ang*// da ltar bdag gi yid 'di la// tshig ngan tsam yang mi bzod na// gzhan la ngan du smra ba ni// 'khrul pa bas kyang 'khrul lo ang*// 'khor ba pa la bde ba med// srid pa'i mu mthar thug pa yi/ sdug bsngal rnam pa grangs mtha' yas// 'di la zhen par ma byed ang*// phyi'i yul drug dper bzhag nas// nang gi skyon drug rtogs mdzod la// spongs la yon tan drug po long*/ 'bras bu drug po 'byung ngo ang*// bde gshegs bka' dang bla ma'i gsung*// thos nas mtha' ru 'don bya zhing*// nang nub rgyun du skyon brtags te// skyon de spangs shing yon tan 'grub// de la rgyun du 'bad gcig ang*// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dag la// nges shes chen po rgyun du sgom// gsang bsgrubs byang chub thob po ang*// a tsa ma na sems can kun// yi re mug na sems can tsho// ya re cha na 'khrul snang can// rang la zhes khrel bsgoms cig ang*// rtag pa med do 'khor ba yi// mtshan nyid sgrib g.yogs 'thug po yis// sgrib pas da rung 'khor bar 'khyam// rang la yi mug bsgoms cig ang*// 'khor ba don med sdug bsngal ru// snying po med pa yin pa la// da rung rtag pa'i mtha' can zung*// snang sems gnyis ka rul lo ang*// da ltar 'jig rten snang ba la// bdag gzhan gnyis su rtogs pa'i phyir// gcig pas gnyis ka 'dzin pa che// rang la snying nas khrel lo ang*// kun rdzob rgyun du snang ba yi// zhen pa dang bcas rang gi sems// bzang ngan 'khrul pa bsam mi khyab// 'di la bden 'dzin ma che ang*// 'jig rten sgyu ma lta bu la// dngos 'dzin byung na bdud kyi las// yin par shes par gyis mdzod la// bden 'dzin ma byed thong cig ang*// gzhan don ji ltar snang ba de/

bdag la'ang de tsam su yod kyi// gzhan la'ang khrel du ma lta bar// rang la bsam gzhig thong cig ang*// bla ma dam pa'i sku drin gyis// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di// spros bral chos sku'i ngo bo de// brjod yul blo las 'das so ang*// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// lto gos bstan nas med lags kyang*// gtum mo'i drod dang bcud len gyis// chog pa'i mdun bsam yod do ang*// da ltar bsdug bsngal ci byung yang*// sngon gyi dus na bsags pas lan// de phyir rkyen ngan 'phra mos kyang*// sngar gyi las ngan sel lo ang*// ji ltar byas kyang chos las med// chos byas rang rgyud dul las med// nyon mongs dul bar gyis cig ang*// 'jig rten mi rtag 'khor ba 'di// yang dag don la ma 'das kyi// chags 'dzin bden bsam ma byed par// spros med don mchog bsgoms cig ang*// 'jig rten 'di na gnas pa yi// phan gnod lha 'drer ming brtags rnams// don la bden par mi bdog gis/ der 'dzin zhen pa thong cig ang*// pha rol phyin pa'i don mchog nyid// bden med brgyad kyi rnam grangs can// smra brjod blo 'das de rang nyid// bsten med gzags gtad bral lo ang*/ de ltar yin yang rnal 'byor bdag /rgyun du bla ma bsten no ang*// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim mo ang*// las nag phyogs la 'dzem mo ang*// dkar po rims kyis bsgrub pa ang*// blo bskyed rims kyis 'don no ang*// thams cad chos dbyings bsngo'o ang*// bkra shis dam pa 'byung ngo ang*// rang byung rdo rje rang la gros 'debs pa'i phyir sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ ka kha'i tshigs bcad gnyis bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo// bla med bla ma srid zhi kun las rnam grol thugs rje'i stobs mnga' ba// gzung 'dzin gnyis med chos nyid stobs kyi ye shes nyid du ston mdzad pa// gang la rten nas 'gro blo'i ma rig sel mdzad bla ma chos kyi rje/

thub pa'i dbang po sras dang bcas rnams kun la bdag yid dang bas 'dud// gsung rab dri med kun kyi gzhir gyur gyur pa gang des 'gro ba yi// dge legs yon tan thams cad rab ster ster bar mdzad pa gang zhig ni// deng 'dir rtsa ba'i yig ge las spel spel bar byed pa gang yin pa// cung zad tsam zhig rang byung rdo rjes rdo rje'i tshig tu rab spel bya/ ka shi ka zhes grags pa'i yul du ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ kha na ma tho med pa'i chos gsungs kha ba can du legs dar bas// ga la ba der ma rig nad rnams ga pur lta bur rab sel ba/ nga ru 'dzin pa 'joms mdzad de la ngar 'dzin med pas phyag 'tshal lo// ca co'i rang bzhin sems can rnams ni ci bzhin ye shes ma rtogs pas// cha shas tsam gyi 'ching ba 'di las cha'i cha yis rab bcings pa// ja'i ro sogs 'dod yon gyis bcings ja bzhin 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor/ nya sogs ngan song gsum du 'khor zhing nyan rang tsam yang thob mi byed// tak+ṣa ka'i rgyan ltar rang byung ta le rang la gnas pa'i don// tha gru dpag med dpag par rab dkar tha dad bral ba'i ngo bo nyid// da lta ma rig dri ma dang bcas da ni dad pa bla med pas// na sogs srid pa'i 'ching ba bcad nas nad med byang chub brtsal bar bya// pa ba sangs ltar rab dkar chos ni pa la'i dri ltar rab dngas pa// pha rol phyin lnga mchog gyur shes rab pha rol phyin la legs bsten na// ba mchog lta bur yon tan kun 'byung ba spu g.yo ba'i snying rje yis// ma sogs 'gro la theg chen chos kyis ma rig sgrib pa las grol bya// tsa ri'i ri sogs bsam gtan gnas mchog tsan dan dri ltar dngas pa'i gnas// tshang tshing nags tshal rab dben nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi byed lha rnams kyi// dza ḍa'i cod pan gyis gtugs btud nas dza hūṃ sngags kyis bdud btul nas// wa ltar zhum zhing myur du wa sgegs mtshan ma'i sgrib pa sbyong*// zha nye'i khams pas mnyen pa'i sems 'di zha la dga' bar ma byed par/

zang zing las grol rgyal ba'i sras ltar bza' btung la sogs sbyin par bya// 'a zhi'i sbrul sogs gnas pa'i ma 'ongs pa na 'a sgra'i sdug bsngal sel byed pa// yang dang yang du brtson 'grus bskyed nas ya rab dam pa'i tshul gnas bya// ra bas dam bcings 'gro la ye shes rang byung dri med bstan bya'i phyir/ la lar nyan rang theg pa bstan cing la lar byang chub mchog gi lam/ shākya'i gsung la mngon shes rdzu 'phrul shākya'i spyan la sogs pa rnams// sa dang lam mchog thob par bya phyir sa stengs ma nor sbyang par bya// ha cang myur bar tshogs gnyis bsags na ha cang myur bar byang chub thob/ a la la ste 'gro ba'i ded dpon e ma 'di ni shin tu mtshar// de ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rabs gzhir gyur sum cur gyur pa'i bdag nyid de// 'dir ni zab mo gnad kyi gdams pa rab tu zab pa'i sdeb sbyor 'di// dpal
