ldan lha stengs zhes bya ba'i gnas su bris pa'i dge bas 'gro la dpal gyur pa'i// yon tan gang yin de nyid sems can kun la 'byung bar 'gyur// sbrul lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la bris/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog// / ༈ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// ka rgyud bla ma dpal ldan yid bzhin nor bu'i gsung*// mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud zab gdams gnad las legs 'ongs pas// gang de'i 'od zer gdul bya'i snying po legs spros nas// nga sogs ma rig dri ma sbyong mdzad e ma mtshar// ca co'i sgra sogs ci bzhin rnam rtog 'khrul pa 'di// cha shas tsam gyis 'khor ba'i btson rar 'ching byed pa// ja'i ro sogs yul la mngon par chags pas byung*// nya ltar 'dod yon ro la chags par ma byed cig /ta re la sogs bskyed rims lha'i rnal 'byor rnams// tha dad bral ba'i tshul du ma nor legs bsgoms nas// da ni gzung 'dzin lus kyi 'ching ba rab chad nas// na rgas 'chi ba myur du yong bar 'gyur ba yin// pa la'i dri ltar yid 'ong gnad kyi gdams pa yis// pha rol yul snang sgyu ma lta bur dbang bsgyur tshe// ba bzhon lta bur thun mongs dgos 'dod shugs las 'byung*// ma rig 'khor ba 'di las myur du thar bar byed// tsa ri tra sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas mchog tu// tsha reg rang bzhin tsan ḍa li sogs rab bsgom zhing*// dza hūṃ sngags kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i bzlas pa yis// wa bgegs mtshan ma'i rnam rtog 'joms par byed pa yin// zha ltar dpal ldan bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu khur// zag med ting 'dzin rtse cig rgyun du mnyam bzhag bya// 'a zha'i yul sogs gnas pa 'gro la snying rje bsgom// yang dang yang du goms par byas na byang chub thob// rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' brgyad bral ba zab mo'i don/

la la gdul bya'i du mar bstan pa yang*// shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs pas shes rab pha rol phyin// sa lam myur bgrod mthar phyin sku bzhi'i mnga' bdag 'gyur// ha ha 'di ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu e ma mtshar// a la la ste gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po yin/ 'di ltar kun gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge sum bcu yis// spel tshig 'di ni rang byung rdo rjes legs par sbyar// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba dri ma med pa des// nam mkha'i mthas khyab snying po'i don la 'khod par shog /sbrul lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la lha stengs zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du bris pa'o/// / ༈ gsang phu pa la spring yig bzhugs so// bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan bla ma 'jig rten kun la brtse ba can// nyes pa'i skyon bcom 'jig rten kun las 'das pa po// lam bzang dri med 'jig rten kun gyis ma smad pa// phan bde mchog gyur 'jig rten kun la snang mdzad rgyal/ thub bstan zab yangs chu gter gting dpag dka' ba gang*/ ru sbal phra mo nya sogs blo yis ji ltar 'jal/ ded dpon chen pos rgya mtshor kun nas spyod pa gang*// 'jig rten kun la 'di pas grags pa thob// dal 'byor rin chen yon tan kun gyis bsten pa gang*/ tshul khrims rgyan bzang bzod pa'i lhab lhub kyis bkra shis shing*// shes rab 'od stong 'bar bas sa stengs gsal gyur tshe// rdo rje theg pa sna tshogs thabs kyis rgyan la zhon// bsam gtan 'tsho bas lus sems kun tu tshim byed cing*// bshes gnyen grogs kyi phyi bzhin 'gro bar byed pa gang*// shin tu rnyed dka' skal pa du mar bsgrub pa dka'// bsgrubs na bde zhing rgyal ba kun gyi bsngags par mdzad// gang gis dka' spyad dpe med lha dang mi rnams kyis// spyad par mi nus rab spyad rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs// phyi nang snang ba'i grogs bcas bdud rnams mngon du bcom// des mdzad mdzad pa'i 'jig rten kun gyis bgrod pa'i 'os// kye ma thog med bag chags chags pa'i mthu bcom zhing*// log pa'i kun rtog rab 'bar 'bar ba'i me skyod rlungs// 'ur 'ur 'bar bas lhag ma bsal ba rmongs byas nas// ma rabs spyod pa 'jig rten brten pa kyi hud nyams// thos dang bsam pa ting 'dzin bsgom pa mthar phyung ste// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ldan pas gzhan dag dkri bya zhes// 'jig rten gsum gyi bla mas bstan pa mi spyod par// deng sang dus na shākya'i bstan la brtson te zhes// yul gyi sred pa'i zhags pa thogs pa'i sdig can gyis// dbang med bcing nas slob dpon slob ma'i tshul bzung nas/

khe dang grags pas 'jig rten sma babs spyod pa gang*// mkhas pa rnams kyis smad 'tshong bud med bzhin du smod/ dge bcu'i lam sten 'jig rten phan par sems dpa' gang*// bran mo zhig kyang phyi mar mtho ris bde legs spyod// mi dge bcu sten 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan thogs pa spangs// srid pa gzhan du kye ma kyi hud 'bod/ sman pa rnams kyang mkhas shing snying rje'i tshul ldan pas// nad rnams sel bar brtson par byed kyang nad pa de// sman rnams mi bsten rang srog gcod par byed pa gang*// su zhig gis bsten bsten kyang nyams par 'gyur// chos kyi bla ma 'jig rten mthun 'jug bstan pa gang*// srid yul 'thibs por zhugs pa'i rigs ldan skyes bu la// de dang de ltar blo la ston mdzad rigs med rnams// sa bon rul pa lta bur rang gi nyes pas 'dor// de phyir mkhas rnams blang dang dor ba'i tshul shes nas/ bde bar gshegs pas bsngags pa'i lam la gzhol bar mdzod// kye ma sems kyi glang chen smyon pa 'di// dran pa'i lcags kyus dbang du ma byas na// sred pa'i lan tshas brid de ngan 'gro yi// cong rong rtsub mor lhung nas nyams thag 'gyur// yul gyi kun rtog zhen pa ma bcad na// lcags kyu'i zas la zhen pa'i nya bzhin du// dbang med bcings te bdud kyi pho nya yis/ drangs nas thar pa'i rin chen srog dang bral// chos rnams rang gi sems su ma shes na// tshig la rtog pa brag cha'i sgra bzhin du// rkyen ma zad pas zad par 'gyur ba med// des na ming dang tshig gi spros pa chod/ rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis bsten pa'i lam// lam dang lam min blang dang dor ba shes// shes dang shes bya mi rtog rab tu zhi// zhi ba zhi gyur nags su gnas pa bde// mi bsrun mi byed sna tshogs shing dang chung yang spyad// tshul min mi byed sna tshogs ri dwags sdug gu rnams// mi bsnyan mi byed sna tshogs rgyun sgra'i 'bab chu bzhin// rtsub mor mi byed sna tshogs ni'u sing sngon po yin// kye ma mkhas rnams bde ba'i nags khrod rnams spangs nas// bskyed tshal ljon pa ngan ngon khrod la rab zhen pa/

mtshon sngon 'bar bcas kye hud cho nge'i sgra 'byin pa'i// 'gal dum rang rod can la mngon par smon gyur tam/ shin du 'jam 'tsher spang ljong zhi ba rnams spangs nas// khrad khrod zhing rol lja ljin khrod la mngon zhen pa// ro nye mi gtsang mar ko ti yis gang gyur par// me 'bar mtshon chas gtams pa'i lam la dgar 'gyur gtam/ zhi ba'i lha dang zhi ba'i grogs la mi bsten par// mdzem min tshul min spyod pa'i grogs la bsten byed pa// gshin rje'i skyes bu be con lag thogs rab g.yengs pa'i// khrod du mnyam dang shugs nar 'khod par spro gyur tam// e ma mtsho gnas me tog ljon pa rab bkra bar// zhi ba'i bde bas 'jig rten ca co rnams spangs te// chos kyi ro myong dga' bas bskyed pa gang*// de ci 'dres pa'i tshal na bde ba 'di yod dam// sna tshogs bya dang bung ba myos pas sgra 'byin cing*// chab sgra lhung lhung dam bus rlung sgras skyod pa gang*/ rnam g.yeng spangs pa'i rna ba'i dbang po tshim byed pa'i// 'di ci dri za'i glu dbyangs la yang 'di yod dam// dus kyi rlung gis rlan dang bcas pa'i sa phyogs na// sman dang me tog dri zhim ngad ldan la phrogs te/ dal bus dben gnas kun tu khyad par byed pa gang*// 'di ci spos ngad ldan pa'i tshal na 'di yod dam/ bsam gtan ldan pas yul rnams sgyu ma ltar mthong zhing*/ ma brtags gzugs rnams dbang po'i gzugs ltar snang gyur te// rnam par mi g.yeng du mar gsal gyur pa// 'di ci tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang na 'di yod dam// brag cha'i tshul du lha dang lha min mi rnams kyis/ sgra skad thos shing nyin mtshan chos kyi sgra snyan dag /zug rngu med par thos pa dang zhing zhi ba gang*// de ci lha'i rnga bo che la 'di yod dam// 'dod dang rtog dpyod g.yo ba'i sems rab bral ba yi// bsam gtan bde ba zug rngu med pas khyab pa gang*/ de tshe lha dbang thig le mchog la gyes gyur pa// phul du gyur pa gang de la yang 'di yod dam// chos rnams tshul mthong 'gro la brtse bas 'khyud gyur cing*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas yon tan bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor/

'dod pa'i bdud kyis ma 'phrogs shugs kyang nar zhes 'byin// 'di nyan rang dgra bcom la yang 'di yod dam// kye ma chos rnams gcig tu ma rtogs blun po yin// yul snang rkyen rnams sgyu mar ma mthong long ba yin// sna tshogs sgra rnams brag char ma shes 'on pa yin// tshul khrims dri bsung ma tshor sna de zhom pa yin// bsam gtan ro mchog ma myong lca de chad pa yin// shes rab bde ba ma myong lus de rul ba yin// nges 'byung dran pa gtor ba'i sems de smyon pa yin/ khe phyir dam chos spyod par byed pa log 'tsho yin// kye ma phye ma leb khyed mar mes ci zhig byed/ ri dwags khyod la bshugs pa'i sgra yis ci zhig phan// bung ba khyod la me tog dri yis ci zhig bde/ gser mig can la lca gas kyu'i zas kyis ci zhig ltas// rma g.ya' phrugs pa bde bar sems pa ci zhig yin/ 'di ltar 'jig rten spyod pa mkhas rnams bzlog na legs// mun pa'i gdong la zla ba'i zer ldan lha mo de// nyi ma'i khrod du drang pa'i reg pas kar bcol te// lha gcig ngu la gzhan dag 'phrul byed lha rnams rgod// ci'i phyir na dpal ldan shugs kyang nar gyis 'byin// de ltar brjod la cung zad dgos pa'i mthu yod na// bdud kyi stobs bcom g.yeng ba'i dra ba bral byas ste// mkha' mnyam don du zhi ba de mchog tu son pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyon med yun ring rgyas par shog /tshigs su bcad pa sum bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ rang byung rdo rjes snyigs dus kyi spyod pa mthong nas re shig sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgyal ba ye shes la spring yig bzhugs so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag med dus la dpag tu med gzigs shing*// gzhan la phan byed gzhan don kho na dgongs// nyid kyi thugs ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ kun tu gsal mdzad kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rang byung min kyang rang byung la dad pas// rdo rje bzhin du rdo rje'i theg pa bsten// ming la dmigs kyang ming du grags pa yin// mthun 'jug min kyang mthun par gsol ba'i tshig

/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// rjes 'jug rgyal ba'i ye shes la dad cing*/ bsags sbyangs sngon du song ba'i ngang cha can// dam pa khyed kyi snyan du 'di spring ngo*// brtse ba'i thugs ldan zhal gyi pad mo nas// tshig gi ze 'bru'i phreng ba spel legs shing*// sdebs sbyor don gyi sbrang rtsi ldan pa dag /rnam shes skye bo'i yan lag g.yo ba yis/ gtor bar gyur pa 'di ni sngon du babs// bdag gis shar phyogs yul du chos kyi lam/ phyogs tsam byis pa brid pa bzhin du bstan// gnas der sku yangs nyi ma'i snying po de// nub par gyur kyang mtshan mo'i zla 'od bzhin// dag pa'i lam la 'jug 'dod skyes bu la// thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la dkri bya'i phyir// bsam gtan lam gsal mdzad pa bdag yid rang*// e ma'o thub pa'i bstan pa 'di// ngo mtshar rmad du byung pa'i phyir// rgyur gyur shing rta 'khor lo can/ rgyur gyur rdo rje'i theg pa yi// shing rta phyi nang 'khor lo can// zhon pa'i dus la bshad mod kyang*/ kha cig mes po'i dbang du gyur// gzhan dag ji bzhin dgra la zhen// la la gzhi'i steng du lus// de bzhin thabs kyi bsgrog gis bcing*// yul dang yul can tha dad kyi// rtog pa'i 'ching bas legs dkris pa// phal cher bcings pa'i dag nyid gyur// kye ma 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor dal 'byor gru chen bla ma mchog gis mnyan pa yis// legs par bskyed tshe le lo med par mchog gi gdams pa don du gnyer bar bya// dbang po dang ni yul dang shes pa la so sor snang ba legs par bsdus te de yi// rang bzhin sgyu ma lta bur rtags dang rtags can sdud byed rtsa dang gza' rnams bcing*// rtogs dpyod nus dang dga' dang bde ba'i mtha' can zhen pa rab gcad pa// rnam par sbyang nas srog dang rtsol ba'i mthu yi lnga dang lnga po dgag bya zhing*// dus sbyor dang ni stong pa dga' dang dbug kyi sum cu so gnyis cha shas kyi// rang bzhin bstan pas thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dang po'i sgor ni zhugs shing dbang thob pa// de nas bzung ste ba

rgya phrag bco brgyad drug pas zung gyur 'gags shing dag gyur pa// de ni rnam dag dgra gcan dus me'i zla ba'i rang bzhin bcu drug bcu drug gi /dga' dang skad cig cha shas rkang pa rdo rje 'beb pa 'bebs pa chen po yis/ rang bzhin dag byas bha ga'i dbus su rnam par song las spro dang bsdu ba yi// sems kyi gzugs brnyan rjes chags rjes chags min dang ro gcig tshur du 'phro ba'i sprin// dag byas sku dang thig le ye shes dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i mthar son pa// 'di ni rgyal bas bstan pa'i lam bzang dri med yin zhes spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs// des na lam mchog dpal ldan 'di// brtson 'grus zhan la bstan mi bya// gang dag dper brjod pa yi chos// don du rtogs pa srid phyir ro// sems byung rnam par rtogs pa 'dis// srid 'di 'khor ba'i rtsar gyur par// 'das dang ma 'ongs la rtogs pa// kun nas 'jig tshogs bskyed pa'i gzhi// yin phyir 'di nyid rig bya zhing*// de nyid stong las gzhan min pa// sgyu ma la sogs dpe yis ni// gsung bzhin rjes su blta bar bya// de ltar rtogs pa'i gang zag la// bsam gtan gyi ni ro 'di yis// kun 'gro'i rtog pa bcing byas ste/ ro myang med pas bsgoms shig ces/ khyed kyis rjes su bstan par mdzod// gang zhig lha dang rjes 'brel pa'i// sgoms pa g.yos par gyur pa yang*/ spyod pa dang ni bsre bya zhing*// mtha' gnyis med par bstan par bya/ rgyal la chags pa phra mos kyang*// sgrib byed sprin pa'i cha shas kyis// 'bras bur bcas pa'i lam la yang*// 'dod dang ro myang mi bya zhes// rang byung rdo rje smras pa yin// de ltar rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub byed cing*// lhag pa'i bsam dang ldan pas brjod pa 'di// deng sang phal cher skye bo phal pa rnams// don rjes mi 'jug rang gi gzhung lugs smra// chos lam khyad bsad sgrib pa'i gnas la 'jug

/de nas ji bzhin brjod par 'thad min kyang*/ khyed kyi chos kyi tshul bzhin spyod pa dang*// gzhan phan snying rje'i gnas la zhugs pa'i phyir// bdag nyid che ba'i yon tan ldan rig nas// don 'di snyan ngag spangs te gsol ba lags// da yang slad kyi gnas skabs zhu ba'i don// gzhan gyi don du bstan pa'i thugs mdzad nas// rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi sbyin pa dang*// ting 'dzin grags pa phyogs su rgyas par mdzod// de ltar gsol nas yig ge gzigs pa'i rten du/ bdag gis go ba dang nyams su myong ba la brten nas// bris pa'i rtags pa brjod pa'i bstan bcos dang*// bsam gtan gyi man ngag byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa zhes bya ba rang gi rgyud 'dris par bya ba'i don du bkod pa zhig yod pas/ don dang ldan par dgongs nas snod du rung ba rnams la chos kyi dga' ston gyi yan lag mdzad par zhu/ dwags po'i phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i phreng ba dngul gyi rdo rje'i la sogs 'dzin can gcig dang*/ 'jang yul gyi bse sder gcig kyang rten 'brel gyi mtshon pa bgyed pa lags// glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu gsum la/ mtshur phu nas bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog ༈ lha steng pa gzhon nu 'bum la spring yig bzhugs so// sna tshogs shes bya'i gnas lugs nyams dga' ba// bden gnyis rdzun pa spangs pa chu zla 'dra// bden par rtog pa'i byis pa gar mkhan bzhin// zhen pa bral ba sgyu ma mkhan ltar spyod// sems kyi rtsa ba me long dri med 'dra// 'du byed rkyen gyi gzugs brnyan 'brel ba bzhin// bag chags 'jog pa gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs// tshogs drug shes pa phyi rol rkyen snang bzhin// 'on kyang phyi nang gnyis su grub pa med// rang rig pa la mi rtog mar me 'dra// stong dang mi stong sna tshogs gzugs sogs kun// 'od kyi snang ba phyi rol gsal ba bzhin// 'od dang mar me gcig dang tha dad med/

tha dad rtog pa dar gyi srin bu bzhin// bzang ngan zhen pa gser sgrog thag sgrog 'dra// kun gzhi'i rgyal mtsho dngas par gyur pa la// 'du byed rlung gi rnam rtog rba brlabs 'byung*// las dang rnam smin lbu ba'i phreng ba bzhin// lus ngag yid kyi g.yo ba ma dngas par// las mi mdzad cing kun gzhi mthong mi 'gyur// bde gshegs snying po mkha' ltar 'dus ma byas// las dang rnam rtog rkyen gyis mi skyod kyang*/ tshul min yin byed kun rtog rlung dang 'dra// tha dad grub cing rten par byed pa yin// des yi bsgrub pa'i rnam rtog sprin tshogs las// las dang nyon mongs chu yi phung po 'grus// yul dang yul can rtogs pas bkrugs pa las// phung khams skye mched pa yi 'khor lo bzhin// rgyal dang bla mas bstan pa'i man ngag gis// gzung 'dzin gnyis su rtog pa bshig pa'i tshe// ma dag phung khams skye mched gang du zhugs// dag pa phung po'i khams dang skye mched kyang*// sa bcu rgyun mtha' bar du 'dzin mod kyis// zag med las dang bsam mi khyab 'pho ba'i// 'chi ba yod phyir gtsang rtag bde ba min// bla ma'i gdams pas 'du byed rtogs pa'i tshe// phyi ru bltas pas tshogs drug rtsa bar mthong*// nang du bltas pas kun gzhi dbyings nas g.yo// bden zhen skyes na bdag dang ci ma mnyam// gsal la ma 'dres yid kyi mtshang rtogs tshe// las dang nyon mongs chu tshogs gang du song*// de la nyon mongs skyon dang bral ba'i tshe// zag pa med pa'i las zhes rgyal bas gsungs// 'di yang rdo rje lta bus gzhom bya yin// de nyid dag pas bdag gis pha rol phyin// tshul 'di ma shes 'jig rten 'dir gnas pa'i// mkhas grub rnams kyang long ba'i gar stabs yin// kye ma rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub tu nye// dad pa can rnams kha lan rjes su 'breng*// sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas phyi rol 'dod/ tshogs gnyis ma bsags sangs rgyas thob du re// rtog pa'i bzhugs pa ma mthong mkhas par brlom// bu la'ang brtse ba med par sems pa smra// 'di'i dus na gcig pu'i skyon la brtag

/kun la dag pa'i snang ba bskyed par byed// mi khom gnas gzhan mthong ba'i tshe// mi lus thob pa'i bsod nams dpag tu med// dkar po'i las min zhugs pa'i skye bo rnams// mthong tshe thos la 'dun pa bla na med// thos pas nyon mongs dgra rnams ma choms pas// bzod pa'i gos gyon 'dun pa'i rta dang bcas// rnam g.yeng dgra 'joms dben pa'i gnas rten nas// bsam gtan spel byed de bas ya mtshan che// bsam gtan bde bas rang rgyud tshim byas nas// de la ma chags shes rab sgrol ma yis// blo'i mun pa bcom pa bla na med// snying rjes gzhan don byed pa brgya la 'ga'// de phyir chos kyi snang ba rgya chen 'di/ blo gros zhan rnams mos par mi nus kyang*/ bdag gis tshul bzhin khyed kyis spel bar mdzod/ rdzogs so/// / ༈ rab sgang ba grags pa rgyal mtshan la spring yig bzhugs// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib gnyis sprin bral chos dbyings nam mkha' la// gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor 'phrin las 'od stong ba// sgrib pa'i mun sel thar pa'i lam ston cing*// don gnyis grub mdzad bla ma la phyag 'tshal// snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa rnams// le lo ma mdzad kho bo'i tshig la gson// ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i 'gro ba la// ltas na mi lus thob pa srid pa tsam// snyigs dus mi rnams bsod nams dman pa'i dus/ bstan la mos shing zhugs pa ba rgya lam 'ga'// bshes gnyen bzang pos rjes su zin pa dang*// bslab gsum rnam dag rgyud la thob nas kyang*// thos bsam legs par sbyor ba shin tu dkon// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// thogs med sred pa'i bag chags ngan pa yis// bskul nas bdud kyi pho nya rnams pa bzhi// chags byed g.yeng byed 'khrul par byed pa dang*// rmongs par byed pas thar pa'i rin chen 'phrog

/kha zas dug can lta bu'i 'dod yon la// ro myang byed pas ngan 'gro'i gnas su lhung*// log mtsho'i longs spyod ba sog par byed pa gang*/ khrel med dad pas sbyin pa chud gson zhing*// dkor la mi mdzem sha chang bag med spyod// tshul 'chos spyod cing mi dge'i dbang song pas// shi ma thag dang ngan 'gro'i gnas su lhung*// dmyal ba'i gshed po be con lag thogs pa// 'jigs su rung ba las kyi zhags pas khrid// me 'dag spu gri'i char gyis sha rus 'bral// zangs khu 'thung pas lus kyi nang khrol bsregs// skyabs med kye ma kyi hud sgra chen 'byin// 'di 'dra soms la tshe 'di'i mi dge spongs// mi rtag zil pa 'dra ba'i longs spyod la// bden med mngon zhen spongs la sbyin pa thong*// rma g.ya' phrugs pas phyir zhing byed lta yi// tshor ba'i bde la sred par ma byed par// lhag pa'i tshul khrims rin chen brtan por bzung brag cha'i sgra ltar bden pa med pa yi// snyan grags che gtor rjes su ma 'breng pa// rang gi sems la ting 'dzin shes rab bskyed// shin tu brtags kyang lo brgyar bsdad pa med/ skyes nas 'chi ba rjes su 'brang ba ste// dar bar gyur pa gang yin rgyud pa'i mtha'// rtsigs par gyur pa'i mtha' ma 'jig pa ste// kun la dbang byed sa bdag rgyal po yang*// dbang med srid gnan 'gro ba ma mthong ngam// de bas rgyal sras kun gyi rab bsngags pa'i// 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dben gnas zhi ba bsten/ gangs ri dpal ldan zla 'od spungs 'dra dang*// dngas pa'i mtsho 'gram brlabs kyi phreng ba can// gcan gzan med pa'i lhun po nags tshal mdzes// mdzes shing yid 'ong spang ljongs rma bya'i mdangs// mdangs legs 'bab chu'i sgra snyan sgrogs pa'i gnas// zhi ba'i bya dang ri dwags gyis bsten pa// 'jig rten rnam g.yeng ring du gyur par der// bsam gtan byed pa dpal dang ldan/

'di 'dra'i bde ba lha'i na'ang med// de phyir rtse cig bsam gtan bsgom bya zhing*// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i yang dag don la bltar// snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin phyir// blang dor ma byed rang gsal gcig tu zhog /bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyis brgyan pa yi// bsam gtan rgyud la bsten par ma byas na// shes pas mi phan 'jig rten rol mo mkhan// nyams su myong la mtshan mar 'dzin byed pa// mdzes 'dod gser gyi sgrog du bcug pa 'dra/ de phan gang la'ang mngon zhen rab spangs nas/ zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len bya/ nyams len rang don gcig pur ma song par// snying rje rgya chen bsngo bas legs zin bya// thabs dang mi ldan dman pa'i spyod dor zhing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i spyod pa rten// theg dman 'bras bu don du ma gnyer bar// sku gsum lhun grub mthar phyin bsgrub par bya// de ni rgyal ba'i gsung dang mi 'gal bar// snyan ngag sdebs sbyor tshig gis ma slad cing*/ go bde'i ngag tu rang byung rdo rjes bsnyad/ 'gro kun thar pa'i lam la 'jug par shog bskul byed bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa// ma nor tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar mdzod// khyed kyi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas// yi ge gser zho do dang bcas pa bskur 'dug pa 'phrod cing*/ khyed bzhed pa'i bstan bcos rgyas pa brtsom pa'i long ma byung na'ang*// bsdus pa gcig byas nas bskur bdog pas/ sngar bzhin du nyams len la brtson par mdzod/ slad gyi ci myur gyis 'jal ba bgyid// stag lo zla ba drug pa'i tshe lnga la mtshur phu'i ri khrod bde chen nas/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog// / ༈ zhwa lu ba dge bshes rdo rje dpal bzang la spring yig bzhugs pa lags so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rang byung rdo rjes/ dge bshes rdo rje dpal bzang po'i phyag tu spring ba/ nyams len rtse cig ting 'dzin 'phel ba'i ngang*// mos pas longs spyod snying po blang ba'i phyir// dngos po rnam par dag pa'i 'bul ba dang*// chab tshar bcas pa 'phrod pas yid dga'// de yang bla ma'i gdam ngag nyams len la// rang snang tha mal shes pa thug phrad 'di// dran pa'i so pas snang stong rtsal sbyong zhing*// gzung 'dzin dang bral gshis la gnas pa'i ston/

de nyid dbyings su blang dor med par sbyang*// rang gi sems nyid bla ma yin pa la// sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med gcig tu bsre// snang ba sna tshogs gdams pa'i rang bzhin yin// brag cha'i sgra rnams sems kyi rang bzhin te/ gang shar gdams pa yin pas nges shes bskyed/ sangs rgyas zhing khams sems la 'char ba dang*/ chos rnams thams cad nang nas 'char 'gyur zhing*/ sems dang bla ma 'du 'bral med pa ru// 'gyur zhing de don mkhyen pas nyams len mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ dpal 'bum la gdams pa bzhugs so// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus su/ theg chen ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ mos gus bskyed cing bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// gsol ba btab pas byin brlabs sems la 'jug /longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med pa la// phyogs med sbyin pa rgya chen btang nas kyang*// ma chags gzhan don bsngo ba'i rgya yis gdab// mi dge kun spangs dag pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs// smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur thob nas kyang*// rgyun du yi dam bskyed rims bsgom pa dang*// ngag tu gsang sngags bzlas brjod ci nus bya// thog med dus nas 'khor bar khrid byed pa// rnam rtog yin par rang ngo shes par bya// ma yengs rtse cig mnyam par bzhag bya zhing*/ bsam gtan ting 'dzin rtse cig bsgom pa dang*// 'khor 'das thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar// snang stong dbyer med rang gi ngo bor ltos// tha mal shes pa rgyal ba'i snying por ste// de nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas thob pa yin// de nyid nyams len yin pas nyams su longs// yon bdag mo dpal 'bum la gdam pa'o/// / ༈ rmi lam gyi tshig bcad bzhugs pa lags so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// drin can nyid kyis byin gyis brlobs// bdag 'dra 'khos chung ri khrod pas// srod la rje la gsol ba btab// tho rangs mtshan brtas 'di ltar byung*// spyir srod kyi rmi lam bag chags yin// nam phyed kyi rmi lam gdon dbang yin// tho rangs gang byung bden no zhes// bla ma mar pa'i zhal nas gsungs// de phyir rnal 'byor bdag 'dra yang*// cung zad rmi lam yi ger bkod// lar bdag la 'dzin chags yod min kyang*// pha bla ma byang chub sems pa'i tshogs/

lung bstan mdzad pa ngo mtshar che// tho rangs gnyid kyi rmi lam na// ri rin chen mchog 'dra'i ngos la yang*// lha gnas pho brang nyams dga' bar// rnal 'byor bdag nyid phyin pa las// thugs rje ldan pa'i spyan ras gzigs// mi bdag gi mdun du bzhugs nas kyang*// 'khor bas 'jigs pa'i brda gcig bstan// 'di lta'i zang zing g.yeng ba 'dis// cis kyang slu ba'i brda gcig bstan// rjes su dag pa'i gsungs skad kyis// tshig don rnam par krol ba ni// spyir 'gro drug thams cad ma yin pas// khyod snying rje chen po bsgoms gcig gsung*/ 'khor ba dug dang tsher 'dra yin// 'di la bden 'dzin ma byed gsung*// skal ldan slob ma nor bu 'dra// bzang po gang byung skyongs cig gsung*// de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /drung na 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pa// gcig gi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// pha sprul sku te lo chen po yang*// bla ma bsten cing dka' thub nyid// dam pa byas pas phyag chen rtogs// de bzhin bla ma na ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du dka' ba spyad// bla ma te lo chen po bsten// de nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs// de ltar mar pa nyid dang ni// mid la gzhan yang brgyud pa rnams/ bla ma bsten cing ri khrod 'grims// dka' ba chen pos nyams su blangs// de yis phyag rgya chen po rtogs// khyod kyang g.yeng ba ma byed par// khe dang grags pa ma bsgrub par// chos brgyad mgo bo 'bur 'joms gyis// sus kyang mthong tshor med par gyis// mid la rnal 'byor lta bu gyis// de ltar byas na shin du legs// de skad gsung pa rnam par thos// skad cig de la gnyis kyang sad// ma rjed dran pa'i lcags kyus zin// sngar gang byed gang byed bsam pa de// blo yang nga med pa'i phu thag chod// da lta lha dbang byung nas kyang*// man stong du bshol kyang gtad sa med// ri khrod 'grims pa ma byung na/

ci ltar byas kyang gtad sa med// snying nas chos gcig ma byung na// gang ltar byas kyang gtad sa med// dpal ldan bla mas yang yang du// thugs brtse bas bu bzhin skyangs pa'i phyir// rje mi 'bral spyi gtsug brgyan du bzhugs// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis brlobs// khams gsum 'khor ba thugs rjes bzung*// ma rig sgrib pa dang bcas pa'i// khams gsum 'khor ba 'di rnams kun// rje mnyam med bla ma dpa' bo rje// rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha// te lo na ro me tri pa/ grub thob rnams kyis byin brlabs pa// lho brag mar pa lo tsha dang*// zhabs kyis rdul reg gyur pa yi// skyes mchog bzhed pa'i rdo rje dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug lha'i lha// bka' brgyud nor bu rin po che// de'i mdzad pa'i bsgrub pa ltar// dus da lta bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// log rtogs skye bo phrag dog che// dge bshes rnams kyi 'gran pa dang*/ chos byed kun gyi nyon mongs rnang*// 'gro drug rgyud ngan rengs pa la// mi bdag gis dka' ba ma spyad na// bsgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nub// bka' brgyud nor bu rin chen 'cher// de phyir bdag nyid bsgrub pa byed// chos brgyad rta la zhon pa yi// dge bshes gzhan ma rnams kyi mchog /nga che nga bzang zer ba yi// grags pa can ni gzhan gyi mchog /sku bsod zang zing che ba yi// ngo mtshar can kyang gzhan gyis 'chi// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// khe'u bdag gis ma skyungs na// gzhan pa skyungs mkhan mi gda' na// bdag 'dra rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// dka' thub dam pa nus par shog /bsgrub pa mtha' ru thon par shog// / ༈ rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshigs gcad// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis rten cing 'brel 'byung pa// yod dang med dang yod med dag /mtha' las grol bar rab gsungs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe chos rnams thams cad kun// rab tu skye ba rnam dag pa// 'gag pa dmigs par gyur ma yin// ma skyes pa'i dngos bzhin no// gang tshe sems dang sems 'byung dag

/dmigs pa med par rab gyur pa// de tshe gzugs sogs rang bzhin rnams// snang ba ci ltar 'thad par 'gyur// snang ba med cing mthong med pa'i// chos de gang la skye bar 'gyur// ye nas dag pa'i chos nyid de// skye dang 'gag par rtogs byed na// mkha' la mdud pa byas ltar 'gyur// de ltar gnas pa'i don de la// rmi lam dus kyi bde sdug ltar// byis pa rab tu 'khrul gyur pas// bdag dang bdag gir rab tu zhen// 'jig rten rang gi rtog pas brtags/ rtog pa rtog par bden ma yin// 'das pa rtog min ma 'ongs min// dbu ma gang du rnam par rtog /dus gsum las gzhan rtog pa yi// skye ba'i gnas de gang zhig yin// re zhig ming yang gzugs dag las// skye mched de las reg pa dang*/ sred len srid pa 'byung ngo zhes// rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa// dam pa'i don du dag ma yin// ci phyir zhe na kun mkhyen gyis// skye dang 'gag pa ma gzigs phyir// yang dag ma yin kun rtog pa// 'du byed rab tu g.yo med pa/ de tshe rnam shes ci ltar 'gyur/ kun 'gro ba yi 'du byed nyid// gang las rab tu skye bar 'gyur// de'i byed po gang zhig yin// 'di ni rab du zab pa nyid// gang zhig kun gzhi'i rnam par shes// len pa'i cha dang bcas pa 'di// chu dang gser dang nam mkha' ltar// ye nas dag cing 'od gsal ba// 'di 'ong tha dad gcig med pas// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don/ 'di nyid rab tu ma rtogs pas// kun 'byung sdug bsngal rab bskyed do// 'gog lam rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// bden pa gnyis las yang dag rten// dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung nas// sangs rgyas nyid kyi mthar thug pa// 'di ni rab tu zab pa nyid// sems can rab tu mi dmigs phyir// snying rje ji ltar dmigs par 'gyur// des na 'di ni tshad med phyir// rgyal sras rnams kyis sems bskyed do// lus la lus kyis rab dben phyir// gzugs ni lbu ba rdol ba 'dra// tshor ba rab tu dben pa'i phyir// chu bur lta bu'i tshul du shes// smig sgyu chu shing sgyu ma ltar// 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes// gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir// sems dang chos ni rab rtogs 'gyur// 'di yis yang dag spong ba yi/

chos rnams mngon du byed pa'o// 'di la brten nas rdzu 'phrul rkang*// rab tu zab pa thob pa nyid// dad dang dran dang brtson 'grus dang*/ ting 'dzin shes rab dbang po lnga// 'di la brten nas stobs su 'gyur// gzung ba rab tu dben rtogs pas// 'dzin pa gang du gnas par 'gyur// ri bong ra mthong ji bzhin no// 'on kyang sgyu ma'i tshul nyid du// sems can la ni gnas par bya// byang chub yan lag bdun po dang*// mthong bas spangs pa'i chos rnams kun/ rab dben lta bas rnam grol bas// yang dag lta bas 'di rab sbyang*// mtha' bral lta ba 'di rtogs pas// yang dag rtogs pa phun sum tshogs// gang dang 'tsho ba las kyi mtha'// rtsol ba dran dang ting nge 'dzin// 'phags lam mchog rnams thob byed de// stong nyid mtshan med smon pa bral// 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan 'di dag lnga// don 'di la gnas rab spyad pas// pha rol phyin pa'i mang 'thob 'gyur// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin// dmigs med thabs la mkhas pa nyid// 'dir ngos mi zad nam mkha' 'dra// 'di ni stobs ldan go cha mchog /mkha' ltar smon lam tshad med 'gyur// 'di rten ye shes tshad med cing*/ ting 'dzin gzungs dang mi 'jigs dang*/ so so yang dag rig pa dang*/ ma 'dres bco brgyad la sogs pa// sangs rgyas chos kun 'di las byung*/ 'di ni theg pa chen po ste/ srid zhi rnam par spangs pa'o// 'di la skrag pa'i rigs ma yin// gang zhig 'di la mi 'jug pa// gang gis pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs// mi pham rgyal ba'i sras rnams la// dad pas mngon byas tshig 'di ni// rang byung rdo rjes zhes bya bas// 'di ni lha stengs gnas su byas// 'di la nor bar gyur srid ni// nyes pa'i sgrib par ma gyur cig /cung zad dge ba yod pa na// 'gro kun sgrol ba'i gzhir gyur cig// /

༈ theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ji bzhin mkhas pa thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor can// rnam 'phrul mdzad pa'i 'od zer stong 'gyed pa// rin chen gtso bo mchog la gus pas 'dud// dpal ldan mchod 'os kun la mchod pa'i gtso// mchod byed man ngag ji snyed zil gnon pa// sde snod rgyud sde'i pad mo spel legs pa'i// snying po bsgrub pa'i ze 'bru cher bkras mchod// kye ma 'di ltar ma rungs snyigs ma'i dus// gangs can ri bo'i zhol las shar gyi phyogs// zhing 'dir gnas shing theg la blo gzhol ba// skyes bu 'ga' la re shig phan 'gyur ram// 'on kyang rgyal ba'i bstan la sgor zhugs shing*// theg pa'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba rnams// tshig 'di thos nas mngon par spro 'gyur ram// rang gi rgyud la goms byed 'di ltar brjod// snyigs dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'di ru// tshe la long med 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyab// zas nor mi rtag gzhan gyi 'phrog cing spyod// gos ni mi rtag nam mkha'i 'ja' 'od 'dra// bde skyid mi rtag rtsa kha'i zil pa 'dra// snyan grags mi rtag nam mkha'i 'brug sgra 'dra// skyes bu'i tshogs kyis 'di ltar ma dgongs sam// skye bo bsgrib byed stong gis bsgribs pa yi// tshang tshing dang bcas dar gyi srin bu bzhin// bdag dang bdag gir zhen pa'i 'ching ba can// sdug la mngon par zhen pa snying re rje// 'di la thar par 'dod rnams 'di ltar mdzod// yon tan ldan pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rten// yid bzhin nor bus re ba rdzogs pa 'dra// gzugs rnyan chos brgyad can rnams ring du spongs// dug can gzeb la sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur ro// lhag pa'i tshul khrims rin chen brtan por bzung*// thar pa'i them skas legs pa tshugs pa yin// tshul nyams tshul can gzugs la bsten mi bya// chags pa'i dong du gnas nas ci zhig bya// blo yi bang mdzod sde snod nor gyis dgang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i rgud pa sel// ser sna'i rkyal pa rmugs pas dgang mi bya// log pa'i lam la spyad kyang sdug bsngal yin// rgyud sde'i tshig don ji bzhin brtag pa bya// sgra dang sgra min shes na lam gyi mchog

/rmongs pa'i tshig la nges shes bskyed mi bya// smyon pa'i tshig la bden pa yod dam ci// 'du 'dzis skyo na ri khrod bas mtha' brten// dben pa'i gzhi ma legs par tshugs pa yin// gnas dang grogs kyi zhen pas ci zhig bya// nya dag lcags kyu'i zas la zhen pa bzhin// gsang ba'i snying po bskyed rims legs par bsgoms// lus kyi bdag 'dzin legs par spangs bar 'gyur// rang gzugs bden pa'i dngos por lta mi bya/ mkha' rgyu'i tshogs rnams ngan 'gror ltung ba yin// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad rnams kun// legs par bsgoms na thun mong yon tan 'phel// gdams pa bral zhing rtsol bar byed pa gang*/ rlung gi nad la ga pur 'thung ba bzhin// bde ba'i ting 'dzin rtse cig mnyam gnas bya/ gang gi rnam rtog g.yeng ba 'joms pa yin/ de nyid kun tu ru la tshol byed gang*// sa spyod me'i khrod du ci zhig bde// gsal ba'i ting 'dzin rtse cig mnyam bsgom bya// spyan dang mngon par shes pa thob par 'gyur/ rnam rtog 'dzin pa phyogs bcur spro mi bya// rnam g.yeng byang chub lam las ring ba yin// mi rtog stong pa'i ting 'dzin legs bsgom bya// snang grags dngos po'i zhen pa ldog pa yin// chad pa mu med dus ring bsgom byas kyang*// tshe ring po dag 'og ma'i gnas su ltung*// khams gsum ting 'dzin rgyas gdab sres te bsgom/ srid zhi gnyis las 'phags pa'i 'bras bu thob// rgyas gdab dang bral ting 'dzin mang bsgoms kyang*/ 'ching bu'i tshogs la byi dor byed pa 'dra// theg gsum 'bras bu mngon par thob 'dod rnams// lung rigs thur ma blo yis legs bsnoms la// ma rig mig phye shes rab lde mig gis// mtha' brgyad tshig gi sgrol nas don gyi nor// ma nor gus pas spyi bos legs blangs nas// dal 'byor thob pa'i 'bras bu yod par bya/ 'di ltar theg pa'i spyi don rtogs bya'i phyir// rang gi yid la bsgom phyir sdebs pa yin// tshong 'dus chen po'i longs spyod bkod pa bzhin// 'di'i spang dang blang bya brtag par bya// rtogs na don gyi 'bras bu ci snyed pa// mngon gyur chos kyi spyan dang ldan par shog

/zhes bya ba 'di ni theg pa mtha' dag gi don gang zag gcig gis rgyud thog tu nyams su blang ba bya ba dang*/ ma rig pa'i blun po dag bdag tu lta ba du ma dag gis 'ching zhing 'dug pa dag la snying brtse ba'i slad du rang byung rdo rjes 'brug lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu drug gi nyin par lha stengs zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du yongs su sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ u rgyan pa rmi lam du 'jal lugs bzhugs pa lags so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spre'u lo zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nub mo rmi lam 'khrul pa'i snang ba la ya mtshan che ba cung zad tsam snang ba 'di lta ste/ thog med dus nas bag chags rjes 'brengs pa// kun gzhi la gnas yid kyis rjes 'gro ba// rab rib gnyid kyi rmi lam 'khrul pa las// tho rangs dus su sa yi phyogs cig na/ u rgyan pa zhes grags pa'i bla ma de/ mngon gsum lta bur gsal bar bzhugs gyur cing*// gdams pa'i tshig 'di gsal bar bka' stsal to// skyes bu chen po dus kyi snyigs mar gyur// rgyal ba'i bstan la thos bsam bsgom pa nyung*/ dge bshes rang byung 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng bas khyer// rgyal ba'i sku gdung mchod pa byed pa nyung*/ rgyal po rnams kyang chos bzhin mi byed par// skye bo'i tshogs kyis rnam par 'khrul par 'gyur// 'dod lha'i gtso bo dga' mgu skye bar 'gyur/ nag po'i rtsa lag kun tu 'khrugs gyur pas/ dus min nad dang mug ge sna tshogs 'byung*// mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod zhan par gyur// rgyal ba'i bstan la 'bras bu 'dod rnams kyang*// sdig pa'i grogs dang bdud kyi byin gyis ni// nyin re bzhin du le lo'i dbang du gyur// de ltar gyur pas rgyal ba'i bstan 'di yang*// ring por mi thogs gzugs brnyan mtshungs par 'gyur/ 'di'i dus su brtson pa bskyed par bya// 'di dus brtson dang mi brtson khyad par ni/

'di dang mtshungs zhes rma bya'i sgro 'ga' zhig /bdag la byin cing de nas mi snang gyur// brda de bdag gis bsam pas 'di ltar go dug gis 'gro ba thams cad 'ching byed cing*// snyigs dus log par phyogs pa ngan 'gror 'gro// rma byas dug zos mdongs kyi kha dog 'phel// spu mdzes kun gyi lta ba'i 'os su 'gyur// snyigs ma'i dus su brtson pa'i stobs bskyed nas// dben par gnas shing chos la 'bad gyur na// snyigs ma'i dug kyang yon tan gsal byed pa'i// grogs su 'gyur zhing rgyal bas bsngags par 'gyur// brda de mngon du gyur pas rtogs pa yin// rmi lam bag chags 'khrul pa yin mod kyang*/ rgyal ba'i gsungs dang mthun pa'i tshig 'di dag /thos par bka' bas yig ger bris pa yin// skyes bu'i tshogs kyis 'di la legs brtags te// nges 'byung yon tan brtson pa bskyed par bya// ces bya ba 'di ni gnas sgo dpal gyi dgon par bzhugs dus gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ yar la sham por gsungs pa'o// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye kye brtse ba chen pos rab gang ba'i// thugs rje ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thogs med dus nas rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i// bag chags skyon rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol// sems kyi gsar skyes rgyal bas ma gzigs shing*/ thogs med dus can skad cig shes pa'i yul// 'gag pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag gyur pa// 'di dang nye 'brel kun tu g.yo ba'i yid// ma rtogs yun ring 'gro 'dir 'khor byas pas// yul med pa la yul du rab gzung ste// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya tha dad pa'i// bde sdug yul gyi ro la myos gyur pas// skye rgas na 'chi zo chu bzhin du 'khor// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i 'jig rten dang*/ lha dang lha min srid pa gzhan dag tu// dkar nag las kyis so sor 'phangs gyur cing*// so so'i las dang skyid sdug byed pa dag

/myong ba de yang ma rig gis sgribs pas// mi dran bzhin du spyod pa 'di re mtshar// thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal ba dpag med rnams// bgrang las 'das pa mya ngan 'das gyur kyang*// kun gyi thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma zin cing*/ don med rnam rtog ci zhig ltar byol te// da dung 'khor ba'i klong na 'khor ba mtshar// kye ma thugs rje'i mnga' bdag thub pa che// khyed kyi thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis// cung zad tsam zhig phog par gyur mod kyang*/ bdag blo'i shes rab stobs ni zhan gyur cing*// ma rig sgrib pa shin tu 'thug gyur pas/ rang gi blo la shin tu rmongs gyur te// da ni sangs rgyas stobs dang mi 'jig dang*// yon tan dpag med khyed kyi thugs rje yis// skad cig nyid la 'phags pa'i sa lam dang*// ye shes snang ba bskyed par mdzad du gsol// kye ma bdag ni thog med nas// sbyin pa mthu ni chung gyur cing*// tshul khrims stobs kyang rab dman pas// dus 'dir 'gro ba dbul ba rnams// phun tshogs longs spyod kyis tshim zhing*/ chos kyis yongs su bskyang pa dang*// nag nog 'dres mar ma gyur pas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sprin tshogs la// rnam par dag pa'i chos ston cing*/ the tshom gcod par ma gyur te// 'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus su ni// rgyal sras rnams kyi rjes 'jug tu// blo'i stobs kyis 'bad byas shing*// sems can don ni ci grub tu// dam pa'i chos ni bsrung ba'i phyir// lus ngag yid kyis 'bad par bya// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// smon lam chen po'i dbang gis ni// gang gis srid pa ji srid bar// sna tshogs thabs kyi rol pa mdzad// de dag rjes su bslab bya zhing*// sems ni mthu dang ldan par bya// gang zhig dmigs pa can rnams kyis// rgyal sras spyod la 'jug min pa// ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam ltar// dngos rnams zhen pa med pa'i blos// rtag tu rdzas su spyad par bya// dngos rnams kun la chags med pas// bza' ba'ang gzhan don gyur cig ces// blo ni rtag tu goms par bya// ji ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyis// rnam pa gzhan gyi don 'gyur par// nyon mongs bcas kyang blo'i mthu// 'gro la phan par dpyad par bya// ji ltar phyi rol yul sna tshogs// nus ldan nus ldan mi snang yang*/

chos rnams ro gcig nyid yin zhes// stong pa nyid la bzod par bya// brtson pa'i stobs chung nyid gyur kyang*// byang chub 'gyur ram mi 'gyur zhes// the tshom 'gyur ba'i blo spangs nas/ rtag tu rgyal sras rjes su bslab// rtog dpyod la sogs bsam gtan rnams// mngon du thob par ma gyur kyang*// dran rig 'gyu ba sna tshogs 'di// ma yengs shes pa rtse cig bskyangs// shes rab lam la 'jug pa'i sgo// thos bsam rnam par brtson pa yi// rgyal ba'i gsung rabs la sbyang bya// chos rnams gdod nas rnam dag pa// skye 'gag nye bar zhi ba'i don// gzugs sogs 'du mi byed pa yi// don la rtag tu blta bya zhes// 'jam dpal gyis ni gang gsungs pa// dbu ma'i rjes su 'jug par bya// de ltar rgyal sras rnams kyis legs gsungs shing*// bla ma dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa ltar// bsgrub par nus min brtson pa'i mthu chung ba// rang byung ming can gyis ni sbyar ba yin// yar la sham por gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ sems 'khrul tshul brjod pa bzhugs so// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// sems 'khrul pa'i tshul brjod pa'o// sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa rnams// rang bzhin dag cing 'od gsal 'gag pa med// spros bral spros 'dzin sna tshogs 'jug byed pa// gcig dang gnyis gsum drug tu rtog pa can// khyod ni rang gsal gcig tu mi sdod pa// nga zhes kun nas rang gis rang bcings nas/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg byar rtog pa yi// yul dang yul can gnyis su rab brtags te// blang dor byas pas rang la rang gis bslus// gar mkhan bzhin du mi brtan khyod kyi tshul// khams gsum gnas su bzhad rgad gnas su 'gyur// khyod kyi byed lugs cung zad brjod kyi nyon// ming dang gzugs kyis mtshan ma bskyed pas 'khor ba na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rab tu rgyas pa yis// dum bu drug tu skye zhing 'khor bar gar byed pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad rgad ltad mo'i yul du 'gyur// re 'ga' bde 'dod 'dod pa'i khams kyi mir gyur nas// mi gtsang mun khung mngal gnas nag por zhugs gyur te// khu khrag gshang gci srin bu lcigs lcigs 'dug pa'i sa// dri ngan shin du mnam pa'i nang du 'gre ldog cing*/

rlung 'khyims mi gtsang za bar rtsom yang nus pa med// 'khrul 'khor btsir bzhin sha rus myags shing skye ba dang*// sar lhung lpags pa bshus 'dra nyi zer 'bar ba dang*/ rlung gis reg pas kho nas gdungs pas skad 'don kyang*// shin tu bcom chung dran pa stor ba bzhin du gyur// gnas 'di mthong nas skrag par mi 'gyur kye ma mtshar// byis par gyur tshe bya min rnams kyang byed 'gyur zhing*// smra mi nus la smra ba gzhan gyis byed mi 'gyur// dbul po'i lugs bzhin longs spyod rnams kyang spyod mi nus// bran dang khyi bzhin gzhan gyis bsrungs ba'i yul du mthong*// dam bca' zhum zhing rab tu myos par gyur mthong nas/ 'jig rten rnams la su zhig dga' ba'i blo bskyed 'gyur// dar la bab tshe lang mtsho rgyas par gyur pa'i tshe// 'dod pa'i zhags pas sems la bsnun par gyur pa na// lus sems sred pas kun tu bcings te ma rangs spyod// sha khrag mi gtsang srin bus gang ba'i lus mthong nas// rtsog par mi mthong skyes pa bud med 'du shes kyis// 'dod pa'i me 'bar dbang po'i bud shing rab tu bsreg /log par 'khrul te dar gyi srin bzhin 'chi bar 'gyur// kye ma log par rtogs pas bskul ba'i tshe// min la yin par rtog 'di mtshar ba snyam// nag po'i skra 'di bung ba min yang nag /dkar po'i so 'di zla ba min yang dkar// dmar ba'i mchu 'di byi ru min yang dmar// 'jam pa'i lce 'di pad mo min yang 'jam// bzang mo gzugs bzang yon tan bde legs ldan pa mchog /mchog tu mdzes pa dkar zlum zla ba rgyas 'dra'i gdong*// gdong pa 'jam gsal smin tshugs nag cing 'khyog la g.yo// g.yo sgyus 'bri bzhin mig gi bung ba na so 'khor// 'khor lo bzhin du rna che 'khor bar mchu g.yo ma// ma 'dra yid 'jug khyed la dga' zhes 'dod pa rdzun// gang na lpags pa'i nang na chu ser khrag rul shin tu mnam pa dang*// rgyu lto sngon po rnag dang bad kan gshang gci nyal nyil rnams// srid bu rnams kyi lcig lcig gang zhig g.yo bzhin za// dbang med kun nas rul myags dri 'byung 'di mthong tshe// dri bgos gos gyon rin chen brgyan rnams kyis brgyan kyang*// kyi hud 'di ci dga' ba 'di kos da ci bya// kye ma 'khor ba snying po med dang lus la mngon par zhen pas rmongs/

yul la bden par zhen pas bcings/ mi gtsang dong la chags pa mtshar// rmi lam 'dra la rab zhen pa/ rnam dag skye bos smod byed cing*/ gzhan du phyir zhing mi khom skye// log par rtogs pas mtshar cig byas/ sngon gyi smon lam mthu yis ni// tshe 'dir longs spyod phun sum tshogs gyur kyang*// rgyu la rmongs pas ma byin len la sogs// spyad pas phyir zhing sdug bsngal rgyu la 'jug /kye ma rtsa kha'i zil pa g.yo ltar longs spyod tshogs kun g.yo ba yin/ brgya phrag gos kyang gcig gnyis ma rtogs spyad pa'i mthu yang yod ma yin// rta dang glang chen shing rta rnams kyang gcig las gzhon pa'i 'os ma yin// 'on kyang srid pa'i kun rtog gang*/ khyi bzhin kun tu spyod pa yin// bde bar gnas pa'i srog chags rnams// dum bur byas shing zhim bzhin za// pha mar gyur kyang 'dzem pa med// de'i 'bras bu ji ltar 'gyur// ku mu ta dang zla 'od 'dra// mngar zhing zhim pa'i 'o ma rnams// 'thung bar mi byed dug lta bu// dri nga rul pa myos byed pa'i// btung ba 'thung na myos gyur cing*// bya min spyod cing spyod pa nyams// lus gzir nad kyis gtses gyur tshe// dga' bar sems dpa' 'di ci yin// gang dag sngon gyi pha mar gyur pa la// log par rtogs pas dgra bo'i 'du shes kyis// mi snyan tshig rtsub rdzun la sogs pa yi// dge ba'i rtog pa bsregs shing rab 'bar bas// bsod dang 'chi ba sna tshogs mi dge spyod// res 'ga' mal bstan 'jam par 'dug byed cing*// tsher ma gcig mthong skrag nas myur du 'dor// lus la de tsam brtse bar byed pa gang*// mtshon cha 'khrug pa'i g.yul rab mi zad pa'i// sna tshogs go bgos 'od zer 'bar 'bar ltar 'dug cing*// rta dang glang po stobs 'gyed 'ur 'ur sgra 'byin pa// mda' rdo la long thog thog sa rdul 'khrigs pa'i nang*// zhe sdang rlung gyis skyod pas 'jug par byed pa gang*// bde bar 'dod pa'i sems 'di 'khrul pa ma yin nam/

kye ma thog med ma rig 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho che// 'dod chags brlabs g.yo zhe sdang chu srin du mas gang*// srid pa'i klong drag log tshig chil chil sgra sgrogs pa// rtog pa'i rlung gis rnam bskyod lta ngan lbu ba can// bde gshegs snying po'i nor bu'i gting sgribs ni// don gnyer bshes gnyen dag dang ma 'phrad rgyu ngan cing*// sbyin pa'i rgyu ngan tshul khrims bsdams pa ma byas shing*// bzod pa'i skyor ma brtson 'grus zags ldan ngan po gang*// bsam gtan 'khrul 'khor shes rab rlung dar dman pa de// 'bad kyang 'khor zhing phyir phyir skyabs med 'o dod 'bod// rtag dang chad zhugs rgya mtsho'i klong las 'byung mi nus// sgra tshig tsam gyis dus 'das dal 'byor gru zhig nas// ngan 'gro'i khar sing yi chad rigs nyams gyur pa yin// kye ma sna tshogs rnam rtog yis/ goms pa thog ma med dus can/ yul la bden par rtog mi dgos// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa yis// sngar yang lcags kyu'i zas bzhin brid// bde 'dod mun pa'i khrod du nyal// yul snang bye tshan du nang 'gre// thar pa'i rin chen srog dang bral// kye hud rnam rtog khyod ci rung*/ bsod nams can la 'gran sems phrag dog byed pa dang*// gzhan bde ba la sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa dang*// longs spyod ldan la 'dod pa brnab sems bskyed pa dang*// yon tan ldan la log par smod par byed pa gang*// rang la phan med myur du sdug bsngal bskyed pa yin// shin tu rtag kyang lo brgya min// bde ba myong yang mi 'gyur min// dbang che gyur kyang mi 'chi min// long spyod yang yang mi mdzad min// rtsigs par gyur kyang mi 'jig min// skyes par gyur kyang mi 'chi min// 'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba gang*// bde ba cung zad yod ma yin// bdag bde zhi ba thob gyur kyang*// bdag nyid gcig pu khrel med gyur// rgyal dang de sras mchog rnams la// rjes su zhugs na bde ba yin// de ltar rtog pa khyod 'khrul tshul brjod pas// rmongs pa rnams kyang rnam 'byed shes rab skye ba dang*// sgra tshig zhen rnams gnyis med mthong ba dang*// zung 'jug bsgoms rnams myur du rtogs par shog

/sems 'khrul pa'i gtam phyogs tsam brjod pa zhes bya ba re shig bris pa'o// yos lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i zad mtshams su bkod pa'o/// / ༈ bdud ngos 'dzin bco lnga pa bzhugs so// skyabs shākya'i rgyal po bka' drin can// thugs rje'i rnam thar dpag med kyis// mdzad pa ma lus mthar phyung pa// snyigs dus sems can skyabs su gsol// snyigs ma lnga ldan mar 'grib dus// khyed kyis thugs rjes bzung lags kyang*// rnam rtog bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis// phal cher log pa'i lam du khrid// theg chen bla ma rin chen la// sangs rgyas dngos su ma shes pas// dpon g.yog zol 'grogs 'du shes byung*/ 'di rtsa ba 'chugs pa'i bdud gcig yin// bla ma'i rnam thar gzhan don la// dag pa'i sna ba ma skyes pas/ rang gi 'dod pa'i sbar tshod byed// 'di rten 'brel gzhi nas 'chugs pa'i bdud// rgyal ba'i zab don mi zhu bar// zas nor thugs la gang 'dogs snyam// byin nas thob blo bskyed pa 'di// bsod nams zad byed bdud kyis khyer// ci gsung gdams par ma go bar// che gtor btang na rang mthong skye// bka' bkyon byas na log lta bsgom// 'di dmyal bar 'khrid pa'i bdud du gda'// rab byung sdom gsum zhus nas kyang*/ tshul bzhin mi srung ngo lkog can// spyod ngan sna tshogs phag du byed// phyi mar mi khom btung ba'i bdud// pho tshugs chos brgyad bzung nas kyang*// rang skyon bshags bsdams mi byed par// gzhan skyon brjod cing 'char ka gtong*// bstan pa nyams par byed pa'i bdud// dad ldan tshogs bsogs byed pa la// yi rang mi byed chud gson byed// byung na skal ba gnyis 'dab len// yi dwags gnas su skye ba'i bdud// thos pa tshul bzhin mi byed dang*// cung zad tsam gyis nga rgyal skye// nga mkhas gzhan la zur za gtong*// rtag du dud 'gror 'khrid pa'i bdud// 'khor 'das gzhi rtsa ma chod par// yig nag bsags la mkhas par rlom/

dge bshes blun por 'chi ba 'di// chos gting nas ma go ba'i bdud// slob dpon tshul bzung stong skad smra// kha la thams cad bden med zer// lag len khyi dang bong bu 'dra// dpon slob mnar med 'gro ba'i bdud// gdan sa'i srog shing byed do zhes// g.yo rgyu zol khram nor bsog byed// pho rgod smra mkhas tshul chos can// ma tshor sdom pa 'chor ba'i bdud// gsang sngags thabs lam bsgom zer zhing*/ snod min drung du sha chang za// dge btsun sdom ldan khyim par 'bebs// rang gzhan log par sbyor ba'i bdud// ro snyoms spyod pa byed do zhes// ngo tsha btang nas grong yul 'khyams// sdig pa bsog cing dge ba spong*/ 'di phyi gnyis ka log pa'i bdud// chen po'i pho tshugs bzung nas kyang*// dad ldan log pa'i lam du khrid// rang gi rnam thar 'di bzung zhes// ston pa bdud kyi pho nya yin// 'di 'dra dpag med sa steng gang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma nub la khad/ de phyir rang byung phyir med pa/ gzhan gyi kha la mi nyan no// mi tshe mi rtag yud tsam la// sang tsam 'chi'am sus shes kyi// dad ldan kha la nyan pa kun// brtson 'grus bskyed la rgyags phye bsgrub/ zhes bya ba 'di gzhan la zur za ba ma yin pa rang la bskul ba'i phyir nags phu dpal gyi ri khrod du bris pa'i bdud ngos 'dzin bco lnga pa zhes bya ba shu lo ka bco brgyad bdog go// / ༈ bsam gtan gyi skyon ngos 'dzin bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyams su len pa'i gang zag gis// bsam gtan skyon rnams bshad par bya// bya ra g.yeng ba chags pa'i skyon// 'dod pa gtso dang gnod pa'i sems// ting 'dzin ma thob las byed pa// 'di rnams bsam gtan mi mthun phyogs// ri zur lam gyi gzhi mdor bsdad// sna tshogs 'gro 'dug dud 'gro bgrang*// rang gi rnam rtog ngo ma shes/ so pa 'dra la bsgom dang ring*// pho zo mtho la kha rgyu bzang*// rogs la dga' zhing zas la bzang*// mi gsum 'dzom sar lab pa yi// tshong dpon 'dra la bsam gtan ring*// pho mo gzugs bzang yul bzang la/

sems 'phro lo rgyus la sred cing*// gzhan la phrag dog zur za smra// khyi rgan 'dra la ting 'dzin ring*// dkon mchog bla ma'i rdzas la sred// tshong dang khe spogs don du gnyer// za 'dod slu ba'i sems dang ldan// bya rog lta bur bsgom dang mkhon// phyi chis tshe la rtag sems can// mi rtag ma dran rnam g.yeng dga'// khong yangs zhe ba ngan pa yi// gtso bo 'dra de bdud kyi khyer// kha 'jam kho na rgyu dang bcas// cung zad tsam la mkhon du 'dzin// zhe sdang sder mo rno ba yi// mi de bsam gtan rlan dang bral// kha dad che la nga lo yangs// kha la bsgom zer gar yang sleb// col chung zas la gdung ba yi// mi de bsam gtan rlan dang bral// dad blangs mkhan la bsgom dang ring*// de ltar bdun po rab spangs la// bla ma'i bka' bsgrub gdam ngag bsgoms// kun la dag snang bskyed byas na// bsgrub po de la bsam gtan skye// mdo rgyud las bshad rang byung gi// brjod la rjes su yi rang gyis// ces pa'i 'di rang byung rdo rjes nags phu'i ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ bstan bcos 'thor bu ba brgya bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma chen po na ro pa'i gdams pa tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya bar byed pa// gdams ngag thams cad kyi yang rtse/ lho brag mar pa lo ts+tsha'i thugs kyi nying khu khyad par can cig ston par byed pa yin// de la mos gus kyis rgyud chun na byin brlabs rang shugs las 'byung gi /gsol ba phur tshugs su thob cig /lta stangs kyis rig pa stod la non na// phra rags kyi rtog pa rang 'gags su 'gro yis// rlung sems gnad du chun// rnam rtog dum bur gtubs na las la bsags pa med kyis// thugs phrad nyams su long cig /ci dga' chos kyi rgyal po yin gyis// gang dga'i nyams gu yangs su skyongs cig /sangs rgyas sems la yod kyis// re dogs gzhan du mkhyen par rigs pa la rtsal sbyong gyis cig

/snying rje phyogs med du shar na/ 'gro don lhun gyi grub kyis bsgrub pa gdan thog tu srings cig tshogs gnyis kyi nus pa rdzogs na 'phags pa'i sa lam bgrod kyis/ zung 'jug gnad du khyer cig /rje btsun mid la'i nyams len/ rnal 'byor nga'i khyad chos/ la stod glang 'khor du gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bla ma u rgyan pas khyed kyi zhal 'di la nyi ma mi 'ong ba ci lags zhus pas// lan gsungs pa/ bdag don lhun grub gyi zha'u la// gzhan don sna tshogs kyi dar snas brgyan// gnyis med don rtogs kyi mgo la gon// ma rig mun bsil gyi zla ba tshes pas brgyan// sems can 'gro don nyi ma bzod de 'char/ zhes gsungs so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūm̐/ 'dzin pa bdud yin/ rtsol ba nad yin/ dgos pa 'dre yin/ bzhag pa gzhi yin/ cir snang grogs yin/ sangs rgyas sems yin/ sems nam mkha' yin/ lus ro yin/ skyur la zhog /skyur mkhan sems yin// glod la zhog /la stod sbud tra ru gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sid+dhi hūṃ/ lo ngo lnga bzhes nas/ bla ma u rgyan pa'i drung du byon tsam na// skyid par byung ngam gsungs pas/ ja sha thud gsum ri bong ra dang mtshungs/ mar dang bu ram nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ bra'u skyo tsha yul ngan nyi ma 'dra/ 'on kyang lha chos byed pas nga re skyid gsungs/ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ snye nam tshong 'dus su tshems gcig bud nas byung pa la// rgad po gcig gis zhus pas// rin chen dpal 'bar se'u bud pa la/ nga la mi bde ci yang med// dung so 'khor ma bzod de skyes te mchi/ zhes gsungs so// yang snye nam tshong 'dus su/ rtse skyu mdzad pas/ brdab 'gyel ba la gsungs pa// spyod pa ma zo kyu mo bya// goms pa ma zo brdab tshan phog /lus 'di sa rdo bem po gcig /sems 'di stong pa ngos bzung med// de la zug gzer 'dzin pa ngo mtshar che// yang gsungs pa/

bsgom pa ma yengs pa la gyis// spyod pa ma bcos pa la gyis// lta ba ma logs pa la gyis// 'bras bu re dogs med la gyis// dad pa bskyed la sbyin pa thong*// rang byung rdo rjes ba ri ba bde chen seng ge la gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i rtson ra'i ming*// bde ba can zhes bya bar bcug pa'i tshe/ spyod lam gang bde gcig gis 'da' ba/ de ni sdug bsngal kun gyi rtsa bas te// gang zhig rtogs na thar pa'i gling du 'dren// bram ze chen po sa ra ha yis kyang*// bcings pa dag ni phyogs bcur grol bar brtson/ zhes sbud tra ru gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// ja sha thud gsum rdo ba bzhin du rdol// mar dang bu ram chu bo bzhin du 'brug /bra'u skyo tsha rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil// 'on kyang lha chos byas pas nga re skyid/ zhes pa 'di sa skyar gsungs so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ ngas ni skye ba phyogs med blangs// gtsug lag khang sogs dgon pa ni// phyogs med btab cing dgon pa ni// ri khrod rims pa'i yon tan gyis// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po rtogs// yid byed chos rnams thang la skyur// thang ka dngos po can 'di la// yid byed chos 'di skyur ba min// sangs rgyas pa'i thang ga la// de 'dra dgos pa ci zhig yod/ kho bos phyag rgya chen po rtogs// rtog pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin// nga ni phung 'dre chen po yin// gzung 'dzin gnyis ka phung bar byed// des na phung 'dre chen po yin// phung 'dre zer na nga la gyis// nga ni jag pa chen po yin// dug lnga 'joms par gcig pa yi// jag pa chen po yin no ang*// jag pa zer na nga la gyis// nga ni dpa' bo chen po yin// nyon mongs thams cad mnon par byed// des na dpa' bo chen po yin// nga ni grub thob chen po yin// rang tsam pa'i grub thob min// nga yi grub thob de nyid ni// gzugs ni mkha' ltar dag pa la// 'gro don phyogs med byed pa de// nga'i grub thob de yin no// khyed kyi grub thob de nyid ni/

sa la 'dzul dang mkha' la 'phur/ chu la mi bying mi 'chi ba/ grub thob yin zer gda' lags te// de rnams grub thob yin srid na// byi ba dang ni bya rnams dang*// ngang pa dang ni nya rnams ni// chu la mi bying mi 'tshub gda'// byi bas sa la 'dzul shes gda'// bya yis nam 'phur mi lhung gda'// 'o na de rnams grub thob yin// 'on kyang mi yis gnam la 'phur shes dang*// sa la 'dzul na shes pa dang*// chu la mi bying mi 'tshub pa// ma dag snang ngor grub thob yin// nga ni ye shes chen po yin// dug lnga 'joms par byed pa yi// ye shes ngo bo nga la gyis// nga ni dug lnga'i ngo bo yin// dug lnga ye shes lnga'i sku// des na nga ni dug lnga yin/ rigs lnga'ang dug lnga'i ngo bo yin// de ni kun gyis shes par mdzod// dug lnga'i ngo bo'i rgyu mtshan yin// nges don drang gnyis ka shan 'byed ni// 'di'i khog na thams cad 'dus pa yin// 'di ni khyed rnams kun gyis go bar mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar kun mkhyen rgyal po 'gro drug sems can thar pa'i lam la 'god gyur mi nub rgyal mtshan stag gzigs gos dang mdzes pa'i rgyan bzhin 'dzam gling rgyan du shog rang byung rdo rje'i chu pho 'brug gi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu gcig la bkod pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sa ra ha'i lung*/ rang byung rdo rje'i gtam// phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// snang la rang bzhin med pa yin// khams gsum rang grol chen po yin// de'i nang nas mchog gyur pa// rtogs rgyu med pa'i don gcig dgos// de ltar byung bar gyur srid na/ rang sems sangs rgyas yin pa la// gzhan du ma 'tshol bsgom chen tsho// sems can chos skal de la mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar phyag chen rtogs 'bar 'dzam gling rgyal mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje'i gdul byar gyur pa'i bu slob rnams la gdams pa/

phyag rgya chen po skad pa de/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta ba 'dra// bsgom yang phar la mi bsgom la// yengs kyang tshur la mi yengs par// ma bcos gnyug pa'i ngang la 'jog /phyag rgya chen po zer ba yin// skal ldan rnams kyis go bar mdzod// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rtogs na gang gis 'ching ba yin/ sems nyid dngos po ma yin pa// gzhan du rtsal nas 'joms mi nus/ rtogs na nam mkha' lta bu nyid// go bar gyis cig sgom chen rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje'i gtam// sems can 'gro don byed pa la/ sprul pa phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du// 'gyed cing sems can 'gro don byed// sprul pas phyogs bcur khyab lags kyang*// ma dag snang ngo de nyid du// mos gus dad pa ma skyes na// kho bo'i zhal ni ga la mthong*// de phyir mos gus dad pa gces// de ltar go bar gyur srid na/ dmyal bar mi 'gro the tshom med// dmyal bar rang bzhin med pa la// sems can 'khrul pas slad pa yin// go bar gyis shig sems can rnams/ bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar mi nub bstan pa'i bdag por shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ shākya thub pa'i lung*/ thugs rje chen po'i gtam// rang byung rdo rjes bzlo ba// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir// 'gong po sna dgu dar ba'i dus/ sha za la sogs bdud dang lha 'dre rnams kyis/ sems can rnams kyi srog gcod cing*/ bar gcod byed pa la/ thams cad kyis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba thob cig /mos gus gyis shig /de ltar du byas na bar chad zhi ba la the tshom med pas kun gyis go bar gyis/ bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar 'gong po zhi bar 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ ye shes dbyings phyug bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'gro ba mgon po kun mkhyen rgyal ba 'gro drug yongs kyi dpal mgon byang chub thar lam thob mdzad thub po sa lam yongs bgrod 'dzam gling skyes mchog thub chen sangs rgyas la bstod/

tsheg bar bzhi bcu zhe lnga pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la rang byung rdo rjes bstod pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sems can 'gro don byed pa'i dpal// rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha/ shākya thub dang kho bo nyid// de bzhi la ni zer ba yin// de'i rjes su 'brang ba yi// bla med byang chub thob 'dod pa'i// sdig pa mi dge thams cad kyang*// rang bzhin nyid kyi dag par byed// de 'dra'i rnal 'byor de nyid ni// thams cad 'gro don byed pa'i dpal// de min bsgom chen de nyid ni// kha bsgom bsgom mo zer nas kyang*// lhan cig 'tshogs nas chags sdang byed// nub mo gti mug gnyid la re// tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye mi 'thag par// khas phyag chen rtogs so zer// de 'dra'i bsgom chen a re 'khrul// chags sdang log kyog byed pa de// de 'dra'i bsgom chen a re 'khrul// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sems can 'gro don byed lags kyang*/ rang sems dngos med bya ba 'di/ dge sdig rnams la rtogs pa yin/ rtog pa ma rtogs bar la ni/ lag pa lto rgyab bar tsam yin/ phyag rgya chen po ma rtogs na/ rtogs dang ma rtogs 'khrul pa yin/ mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i bsgom chen la/ 'khrul pa ma 'khrul gnyis su med/ gnyis med ngang la bsgom mkhan stor/ de 'dra'i bsgom che a re skyid/ go bar gyis zhig 'gro drug sems can rnams/ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūm̐/ kho bo la stod phyogs su skye ba blangs// chos kyi skyab par ming yang grags// nga btsun pa byang rgyu ma bdog te/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang las yang*// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sdom pa blangs// ming yang rang byung rdo rje grags// kun rdzob tsam du de skad lags// ma dag snang ngo de nyid du// btsun pa byed lugs de nyid ni// sdom pa len no zer nas kyang*// kha thon slob pa kha skad zer/ chos ni slob po zer nas kyang*// yig nag bsags shing rdzun rnams zer// chags sdang byed pa a re 'khrul/

bdag 'dzin rnams ni ma thongs spar// sems can ser sna'i rdzong la zhen// thongs pa'i thabs ni 'di 'dra bdog /zhen chags med pa phul nas ni// ngar 'dzin grol na de la phan// 'gro drug kun gyi go bar gyis/ kha phyar kha 'khyil yongs la bsgrogs// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'i gdul byar gyur pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i bu slob rnams la gdams pa// rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i// bka' lung bstan chos thams cad kyang*// ma dag snang ngor so sor go /dag pa'i snang ngor gcig tu snang*/ snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// khams gsum rang grol chen por gyur// 'gro dang nyal dang za ba dang*// na dang skye dang rgas pas dang*// de rnams thams cad rang gi sems// so sor 'dzin na 'khrul pa yin/ 'dzin pa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// dngos por 'dzin na 'khrul pa yin// rnam rtog chos skur ngo shes na/ dug lnga bya ba'i ming yang med// ming med bsgom chen de nyid ni// na ba'i dus su 'di skad zer// a tsa ma zhes brjod pa yin// a ni skye ba med pa yin// tsa ni 'gags pa med pa yin// ma ni sems can kun gyi ma// ma dag snang ngo de nyid lags// dag pa'i snang ngo de nyid lags// dag pa'i snang ngor na rgyu med// kho bo na ba'i dus tshod su// ma dag 'khrul snang na bas thebs// sems la 'chi rgyu yod ma yin/ lus 'di 'pho ba kun gyi lugs// gdul bya rnams kyis go bar mdzod// kha phyar kha 'khyil yongs la bsgrogs// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'jig rten rgyas 'bar stong gsum rab brtan rgyal ba nyid du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rjes/ gdul byar gyur pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i bsgom chen rnams la gdams pa/ rdo rje 'chang te lo na ro bka' bzhi'i rgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gnad bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad par bsgoms na rlung sems kyi rtsal rdzogs shing phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa la skad cig tsam yang mi 'gor zhing sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa'i dpal du 'gyur ro/

kho bo yang gnad gzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun par bsgoms pas rlung sems la rtsal rdzogs shing skyo dub med pas sems can gyi don nus pa byung ba yin/ de'i phyir na thams cad kyis rlung sems kyi rtsol ba drag du gyis/ kha phyar kha 'khyil yongs la bsgrogs/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// rgyud lung thams cad 'khrul par snang*// rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad ni/ sems nyid ye shes phyag rgya che// snying po don gyi mthar thug tu// snang ba kun khyab sems can 'dren// sems can dag pa sangs rgyas te// sems can ma dag rgyud 'dzin pa// kha bshad rgyud 'dzin mang lags kyang*/ mthar thug rgyud 'dzin rtogs pa nyung*/ sems tshad gzhal med mang lags kyang*// tshad ni gzhal ba cung tsam dka'// tshad med sems can de nyid ni// rang byung ye shes chos kyi sku// kun khyab rgyal ba'i rtogs pa 'dzin// go'am thos sam skal ldan kun// mi lus thob pa kun gyi mchog /bya dang byol song khyi rnams ni// lus ni thob kyang don med yin// mi lus sa bzhin bzang dang mtshungs// bla ma bzang po nas 'bru ste// ri la phyin nas myu gu skye// rtogs pa rnyed na tshad du rgyas/ sems can 'gro don byed pa'i ni// nas ni za ba'i dpe dang mtshungs// go bar gyis cig skal ldan rnams// 'di 'dra'i don cig ma rtogs par// 'khrul rgyud mang pos ci zhig bya// go bar gyis cig 'gro drug rnams/ bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar don rtogs 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /mtshur phur gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rtogs pa'i don ldan rnal 'byor pa// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po yi// snying po'i don gyi rgyud pa 'dzin// grub thob kun khyab chos kyi sku// rdo rje 'chang sogs bka' brgyud kyi// bstan pa bsrung ba'i chos skyong dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro don mdzad// de rjes rgyud pa'i skal ldan rnams// chos skyong bsrungs ma yid dam la// gsol ba thob cing mos gus gyis// de ltar byas par gyur srid na// 'gro don 'byung zhing dgra tshogs rnams// nyi mas skar ma zil mnon ltar// dgra bgegs thams cad 'byung mi srid/

go bar gyis cig bsgom chen rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar bdud tshogs zhi 'bar rang byung ye shes 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bdud tshogs 'dre tshogs ma lus pa// 'joms byed khro bo mang lags kyang*// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong ltar/ gyur pa dpal chen phyag rdor yin// sems can 'dren par byed pa yin// thugs rje che ba mang lags kyang*// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong ltar// don mdzad thugs rje chen po yin// don bsgrub chos skyong mang lags kyang*// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong ltar// dpal ldan ma mgon lcam dral yin// bar chad sel zhing thugs rjes 'dren// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// gsol ba thob cing mos gus gyis// de ltar byas par gyur srid na// sems can bde bar the tshom med// go bar gyis cig 'gro drug rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar bdud tshogs zhi 'bar thugs rje che 'bar bar chad sel bar 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /rang byung rdo rjes sbrul lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum la bkra shis gsar mar sbyar ba'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen de lus kyis sras// ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'di las kyi rkyen// de la rgyud 'khrul 'khor ba mang po 'byung*// 'khrul 'khor de nyid ma rig pa'i rgyu// ma rig de nyid rtogs sangs rgyas te/ ma rtogs pa yis sems can byung ba yin// sems can 'di nyid rgyu dang rkyen las ni/ rgyu rkyen de nyid shes pa gang yang med// shes pa yod na sangs rgyas mngon sum pa// mngon sum zhes grags de nyid gang las byung*// byung ba de nyid rgyu rkyen gang las byung*// sangs rgyas la ni rgyu rkyen med pa yin// rgyu rkyen yod na sangs rgyas med// sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de nyid gang las byung*// gang las byung ste su yis shes pa yin// shes pa yod na bar snang lag pas bzung*/

de nyid rtogs nas sangs rgyas mngon sum pa// mngon sum zhes grags de nyid gang las byung*// sems nyid 'di la rgyu rkyen yod pa sems nyid min// de ltar gyur pa sems dpa' rang byung ste// gcig shes kun la mkhas pa de nyid yin// de nyid zer ba de rang gang las byung*/ gang las byung de phu thag gcod mi 'dod/ gnod du 'dod pa de nyid gang las yong*/ gang las yong ba de yang gang yin pa// ma rtogs logs rtogs de nyid gang las byung*/ de ltar kun gyi go bar mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar rab brtan rgyal ba'i rgyan du shog /mtshur phur sbrul lo dpyid zla ra ba la bris pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha// bka' rgyud bla ma thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlobs// kho bo rnam 'byor 'dug pa 'di// 'dug pa mnyam nyid ngang la 'dug /ltad mo chos nyid ngang la lta// rtsed mo phyag chen ngang la byed// za ba bden pa'i ngang du za// 'gro ba don dam ngang la 'gro// 'chi ba lta ba'i ngang la 'chi// kun rdzob sems can thams cad kyi// e ma karma pa zhes ni// je ngan je ngan 'gro lo skad// ci yin byas nas ngan pa na// sprang po'i bu ru skyes so skad/ sems can rmongs pas de skad zer/ de min pa la gtugs tsam na// bzang po yin par go ba yin// gtan tshigs ci yin byas pa la// dper na rgyal po lta bu yin// bu ru skyes par gyur srid na// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis// mig kyang lta bar mi rnyed do// de phyir sprang po'i bu ru skyes// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis// zhal nyid blta dang byin brlabs dang*// thams cad ci bder 'grub par 'gyur/ de'i phyir na bzang bar bshad// go bar gyis cig 'gro drug rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ nga ni ngan pa ngan pa yin// rdo rje 'chang gi ngan pa yin// bka' brgyud bla ma'i ngan pa yin// yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyi// ngan pa'i gtan tshigs kho bo yin// chos skyong bsrungs ma thams cad kyi// ngan pa'i mtshan nyid kho bo yin/

ngan pa'i bstan tshigs 'di lta bu// brag cha tsam du phyung pa yin/ go bar gyis cig 'gro drug rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /nga ni chung chung chung chung yin// rdo rje 'chang gi chung chung yin// te lo pa yi yang chung yin// na ro pa yi de chung yin/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i yang chung yin// chung chung rgyud la 'di ltar bshad// bsgom du med pa'i sems nyid 'di// rnam rtog 'dzin zhing bsgom pa la// zhen chags med na 'khrul pa yin// 'khrul pa'i ngang nas chung ba yin/ zhen chags med pas chung ba yin// chung ba bdun gyi dbyangs chung 'di// don dam gyi ngang nas de skad lo// bkra shis dpal 'bar rtogs pa'i don dang ldan par shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// nga ni chen po chen po yin/ sems nyid che bas chen po yin// rtogs pa che bas chen po yin// kun che rgyal po de nyid ni// ma shes mi shes shes mi 'gyur// shes pa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// chen po yin par go bar bya/ kun la che ba'i dbyangs chung 'di// don dam ngang nas de skad lo// go bar gyis cig skal ldan kun// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ kho bo'i spyi bo'i gtsug rum na// bya mgo 'dod chags rang bzhin skyes// dpung pa g.yas phyogs mgo bo na// gti mug phag gi mgo bo skyes// dpung pa g.yon pa'i mgo bo na// zhe sdang sbrul gyi mgo bo skyes// mgo bo gsum po ral gris gcad// spyi bor bya mgo gcod pa de/ 'dod chags ma dag gcad pa'i brda// g.yas su phag mgo gcad pa de// gti mug rtsad nas gcad pa'i brda// g.yon pa sbrul mgo gcad pa de// zhe sdang rang bzhin gcad pa'i brda// nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas gcad// go bar gyis cig 'gro drug rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar dug gsum zhi 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog

/ces pa 'di rnams sbrul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum la sbyar ba'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sku bzhi lhun grub rdzogs pa yi// mnyam rjes med pa'i chu bo'i gzhung*/ gzugs sku bzhi ru byung ba yin// rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs bshad par bya// gnyis med sku nyid sa ra ha/ sangs rgyas sems can med par yang*// gnyis su med pa'i sku ru bshad// rtag chad lta ba ma grub pas// gnyis su med pa'i sku ru bstan/ gnyis med ye shes chen po nyid// snang ba dang bcas ma grub pa'i// chos kyi sku'i gtan tshigs su// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa ni// chos kyi sku'i mtshan nyid ni// gnyis med kun la 'gag med pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru bshad// don dam chos sku smra brjod pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin no// kun la snang bzhin 'gro don byed// sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid do// 'gro ba 'dren cing chos kyang ston// sprul sku rang byung rdo rje ni// sku bzhi rdzogs pa'i yon tan bshad// bkra shis dpal 'bar sku bzhi rab 'byam 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /sku bzhi'i gtan tshigs bstan pa 'di sbrul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la mtshur phur sbyar ba'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rjes yis/ kun mkhyen sems dpa' chen po la// gdams ngag ngo sprod 'di ltar phog /sems can rgyud nyid sangs rgyas te// dri ma byung bas sems can nyid// dag dang ma dag so 'tshams na// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis gnyis byung*// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis po yi// gtan tshigs rgyu mtshan bshad par bya// 'khrul pa'i don ni 'di lta bu// nga rgyal ri ltar spungs pa dang*// zhe sdang rlung ltar 'tshub pa dang*// 'dod chags me ltar 'bar ba dang*// de la sogs te sems can rnams// 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog yin par bshad// ma 'khrul don ni 'di lta bu// kun la snying rje che ba dang*// phan pa'i blo ni kho na gtong*// de nyid ma 'khrul yin par bshad// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi bu// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog

/oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ don dam chos nyid bden pa la// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste// lus 'di bems po yin pa la/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs tshul bstan// thams cad nam mkha' lta bu nyid// go bar gyis cig skal ldan kun// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// don dam chos nyid bden pa la// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste// 'byung ba bzhi'i rtson rar tshud pa de// 'o na gang yin byas tsam na// rtog pa 'dus pas lan pa yin// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi bu// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// phyag rgya chen po bsgom du med// bsgom du yod na phyag chen min// sems nyid dngos por rtog rgyu med// rtog rgyu byung na sems nyid min// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi bu// rta lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// thugs rje chen po'i lung*// rang byung rdo rje'i gtam/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// nam mkha' 'dra dang mi 'dra ba'i// dmigs med rang grol chen po yi// don dam dmigs med 'gro ba kun// dag pa'i snang ba phyag rgya che// ma dag dngos po snang ba can// gang yang med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// thams cad chos nyid ngang la sdod// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi bu// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti si sidhi hūṃ// nga rgyal rtsongs pas rdza dug bu ru skyes// 'di nas shi 'phos dga' ldan gnas su 'gro// 'gro la sems rtse gdul bya gar yod 'byung*/ bdag la gzhan don min pa bya blo med// ye shes rtogs pas gzung 'dzin rtsad nas dag dpal ldan sku gsum rgyal sras thob par shog /gnas skabs bzhi pos sku bzhi lhun gyi grub// de ltar bdag gi 'grub par shog /la stod byang du gsungs// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// 'dzin med rang grol chen po yin// rtogs pas khyad 'phags dam chos la// rgyud sde 'bum dang stong gi ni// man ngag thams bcad bsdu lags kyang*// 'di las khyad par 'phags pa ni// chos nyid gzhan du yong mi srid/

'on kyang nga rgyal chen ba min// rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha// bka' rgyud bla ma thams cad kyi// don dam chos nyid bsdus pa yin// snying po 'di ni go bar gyis// bsgom chen gra pa bu slob dang*// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis// snying po mthar thug thams cad ni// rims kyis pa'i dam chos yin// gcig char ba'i dam chos ni// 'di lta bu'i don gcig yin// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po ni// blo dang tshig dang sgra dang ni/ yul dang gnyen po kha zas dang*// de rnams thams cad ma yin pa// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// chu la chu bzhag lta bu yang*// de ni rtogs pa'i ye shes min// rtogs pa'i ye shes bya ba de// dpe don tshad du med pa yi// stong pa nam mkha' lta bu nyid// de yang 'gro drug sems can gyis// chad par lta bar 'dod lags kyang*// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// phyag rgya chen po bsgom du med// bsgom du yod na phyag chen min// go yul rtogs yul blo yul min// go yul blo yul byung srid na// nyams ni rtse mo rtogs tsam yin// rtogs rgyu med pa'i don rtogs na// don dam bden pa snang srid kyis// snod bcud thams cad gcig tu snang*// thams cad thams cad gcig tu snang*// gcig kyang mi snang phyag rgya che// snang la rang bzhin med pa yin// don ni de ltar shes par gyis// go'am thos sam skal ldan kun// 'di 'dra'i don chen 'di nyid ni/ skal med rnams kyi blor mi shong*// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin// 'on kyang sems can thams cad la// gor chug thos chug bri ru chug /klog chug mos chug byed du chug/ de ltar byas par gyur srid na// thams cad rang grol chen por 'gyur// go bar gyis cig 'gro drug rnams// de rnams thams cad bsdus pa ni// phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// nam mkha' rang bzhin lta ba 'dra// bsgom yang phar la mi bsgom par// yengs kyang phar la ma yengs par// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang nyid do// go bar gyis cig skal ldan kun// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/

oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// bya ba'i don ni 'og ma rnams kyi tshig 'di 'dra ba gcig yod zer ba yin// 'dzin med rang grol ces bya ba'i don ni 'dzin pa med par rang sar grol ba snang srid thams cad don dam chos kyi skur 'char ba gcig la zer ba yin// rtogs pa khyad 'phags dam chos la zhes pa'i don ni// khyad par du 'phags pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa'o// rgyud sde 'bum dang stong gi ni// zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang nga rgyal che ba min zhes pa'i bar gyis bka' rgyud sde la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung thams cad kyi don shes kyang rtsa ba 'di la thug pa yin bya ba'i don no// rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha snying po'i don ni go bar gyis/ zhes pa'i bar gyis/ rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha dang bka' brgyud bla ma thams cad kyi don dam chos nyid phyag rgya chen po bsdus pa'i ngo bo yin pas go bar gyis cig /bya ba'i don no// bsgom chen grwa pa bu slob dang*/ zhes pa nas rim gyis pa'i dam chos yin zhes pa'i bar la/ de yang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi btsun sha dang*/ phyag brdar dang*/ 'don pa byed pa dang*/ ma ṇi bgrang ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi nag pa gang dga' byed pa de ma zer ba yin no// gcig char ba'i dam chos ni zhes bya ba ni/ gcig char ba'i gdam ngag go bar byed pa'i mgo yin no// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po ni/ zhes pa nas/ de rnams thams cad ma yin pa zhes pa'i bar ni gong du rgyas par bstan pa'o// snang la rang bzhin med pa zhes pa ni nam mkha' lta bu des 'jog te gzung rgyu med gang nas kyang ma 'ongs/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ 'dus ma byas pa de lta bu la zer ba yin te/ chu la chu bzhag lta bu yang*/ de ni rtog pa'i ye shes min/ zhes pa'i don ni/ 'og nas rgyas par 'chad do// rtogs pa'i ye shes shes bya ba de/
