dpe don tshad med zhes pa/ nam mkha' la dpe 'jog te gong du bstan no// de yang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis/ chad par lta bar 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ stong pa rang dngas su song zer te/ de yang ma yin pa de'i don la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// phyag rgya chen po bsgom du med// bsgom du yod na phyag chen min/ zhes bstan no// go yul rtog yul zhes pa ni// nyams ni rtse mo rtogs tsam yin/ zhes pa dang*/ gong gi rtogs pa'i ye shes min pa'i don ston/ de yang nyams ting nge 'dzin chu bzhag pa lta bu/ mar la mar bzhag pa lta bu/ de lta bu'i nyams byung yang nyams kyi cha tsam rtse mo tsam gcig ston yin pas/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog la sogs pa ma nyan zhes pa'o// rtogs rgyu med pa'i don rtogs na/ zhes pa nas/ don ni de ltar shes pa yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis// snang srid snod bcud thams cad/ sems mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ du ma ro gcig tu ngo shes bya ba'i 'dzin pa de rtogs dgos/ 'dzin pa de ma rtogs na/ dug lnga'i rgyu yin pas ci yang mi btub/ de'i phyir na bsgom ci tsam skyes kyang gzung dang 'dzin pa dang*/ nga rgyal gyi sems mi bya'o// des phyag rgya chen po'i don bstan no// de'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par shog shig /de nas de rnams thams cad du ma ro gcig tu ngo shes kyang du ma ro gcig tu snang la rang bzhin med par ngo ma shes na dug lngar 'khrul 'gro ste/ 'khrul pa de yang ngo mi shes ste/ 'khrul pa de ngo mi shes pa de shes pa'i thabs ston/ sngar med pa'i bag tsha ba/ zhe sdang che ba/ phrag dog che ba/ phyag rgya chen po 'di yin bsam nas gnyid log pa la dga' ba/ de lta bu byung na dug lngar 'khrul pa yin pas ngos zin par byas la tshig pa za mkhan gyi sems ltas nas lhod kyi klod nas rlung bzung*/ de ltar gti mug dang 'dod chags dang nga rgyal dang phrag dog la sogs pa gang byung yang de ltar du bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i gegs sel bden ngo shes pa 'di 'ong ba tsam mi 'ong*/

brgya la gegs byung yang byung ba kha skad mi zer/ de lta byas pas sel lo// gzhan la ston dgos byung na yang mos gus dang ldan pa dam tshig dang ldan pa/ tshe phyi ma dang du len pa/ snying dang 'dra ba re re la bstan par bya'o// kun la spel ba dang bcos pa la sogs pa byung na/ dpal ma mgon lcam dral gyis de'i snying phyung lce chod/ rta lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun la bkra shis gsar mar gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// pad ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum mkhyen pas byin gyis brlob// rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba la// 'di ltar shar ba'i dbyangs chung 'di// skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su myong*/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// 'dzin pa med pa chos kyis sku// snang stong dbyer med chu zla 'dra/ zung 'jug bsgom bya bsgom byed med// 'dzin bya med cing 'du shes med// thams cad chos dbyings chen por gsal/ gnyis med ye shes ngo bo la// rtogs dang ma rtogs gang yang med// sems can 'gro drug gang yang med// thams cad stong pa chos kyi sku// 'dzin med chen po'i ngang la bzhag /thams cad chos kyi dbyings su bsngo// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*/ kun kyang phyag chen rtogs par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar rtogs pa rab 'byams 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dang sogs bka' brgyud rnams/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// phyag chen snang ba 'di nyid ni// gang du ma 'dres chos kyi sku// ci yang bsam byed thogs pa med/ gang du 'dzin med phyogs bcur rgyug /gcig med gnyis min gang yang min/ thams cad min pa'i ngo bo la/ don du mi 'gyur gang yang med// thams cad chos dbyings chen po yi// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang*// rtogs ldan grub thob thams cad kyis/

rtogs dang man ngag thams cad kyang*// rtsa ba gcig las med pa yin// thams cad de'i ngo bo nyid// rab 'byams rtogs pa thob par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ shākya thub sogs sangs rgyas dang*/ nyan thos chen po brgyad la sogs// dus gsum dbye ru med pa yi// thams cad byin gyis brlab du gsol// tshad ma pa zhes grags pa yang*// rang gi sems nyid chen po de// snang ba dbye ru med pa yi// don chen de nyid ma shes pas// tha mal rig pa 'khrul pa yin// de bas phyag rgya chen po ni// bsgom du med pa'i ngang gnas pas// rtogs dang ma rtogs 'dzin pa med// chos dbyings rab 'byams kun gyi gzhi// rtogs pa mthar thug mang lags kyang*// don du bsdus na gcig las med// snang stong dbyer med nam mkha' 'dra// 'pho 'gyur med pas chos kyi sku// rang gi sems 'di yin par gsungs// thams cad sems la thug pa yin// stong pa rang dngas su shor na yang*// mi nyan pa ru gsungs pa yin// gang yin byas na 'di nyid yin// dngos po yang ni ma yin zhing*// stongs pa yang ni ma spel zhing*// gnyis med ye shes chen po'i ngang*// rtogs dang ma rtogs thams cad kyang*// rang gi sems la dris shing mdzod// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas rdzogs pa gnyis med ye shes chen po thob par shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba'i ston pa thams cad mkhyen// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dbu ma pa zhes grags pa yang*// rang rig don gyi snang ba la// chos la chags pa chen po yis// ma rtogs rgyu nyid byed pa yin// dbu ma chen po'i don rtogs nas// 'khor bar mi ltung sangs rgyas 'thob/ phyag rgya chen po thob pa la/

gang gis kyang ni mi phan te// rang bzhin nyid la 'char ba'o// 'on kyang ma dag snang ngo la// khrid dang dam chos zhu ba dgos// rim gyis bgrod pas sangs rgyas 'byung*// 'on kyang phyag rgya chen po des// rims kyis kyang ni mi 'byung ste// cig char rtogs pa'i sems las 'byung*// sems nyid kun gyis go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha// te lo na ro mar pa dang*// mid la chos rje sgam po ba// dus gsum mkhyen dang 'gro ba'i mgon// pu n+ya badz+ra rin po che// bka' brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzin pa phyag rgya chen po de/ sems can kun gyi spyod yul min// gang zag re re gnyis gnyis kyis// rtsod med phyag rgya chen po rtogs// 'on kyang sems can thams cad la// sangs rgyas rgyu nyid yod lags kyang*// 'khrul pa'i snang ngos bsgribs pa yin// thams cad kun la 'char mi 'gyur// de yang kye'i rdo rje las// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid// de skad ces ni gsungs pa'i don// thams cad kyis ni go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid du 'dus pa ste/ chos kyi sku thams cad kyang don du mi 'gyur ba gang yang med pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi 'gro ba'i 'dren par 'gyur ba yin/ sems can thams cad kyang rgyu sangs rgyas las ma grub pa gcig kyang med pa'i phyir na sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas dang sems nyid la ma sprul pa gang yang med pa'i phyir thams cad kun kyang gcig gis gcig la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// de lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed na ni yon tan dpag du med pa dang ldan zhing*/

skyon thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba yin pas na// thams cad kyi de ltar mkhyen par mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ dus gsum mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs// karma pa la skyabs su mchi// rin po che yis byin gyis brlob// ma dag snang ngo de nyid du// btsun pa byed dang bsgom pa dang*// nyan dang 'chad dang brtsom pa la/ klog dang kha ton byed pa sogs// thams cad dag dag bden bden 'dra// dbyer med phyag rgya chen po la// thams cad 'dzin med ngang la zhog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rang byung ye shes gsungs pa'i chos nyid 'di// sems can kun gyis go bar mdzod// rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po nyid// gsang ba snying po de nyid las// ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs// dgongs pa 'dul ba gsar pa dang*// phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs// don dam 'di la the tshom za// zhes ni gsungs pa'i don 'di yang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug mu stegs la// nyan rang pa la sogs pa dang*// de rnams la ni dgongs pa yin// cig char rtogs pa'i snang ngo la// mu stegs sangs rgyas gnyis med cing*// bsgom bya bsgom byed gnyis med cing*// snang ba dag bya gnyis kyang med// stong med dngos po yod ma yin// thams cad med pa'i rang bzhin las/ yod pa de nyid yang dag gnas// sangs rgyas mu stegs gnyis kyang yod// thegs pa che chung gnyis kyang yod// don dam kun rdzob gnyis kyang yod// dgag bya bsgrub pa gnyis kyang yod// thams cad yod pa'i ngang nyid yin// yod dang med pa'i so mtshams na// de la chags par gyur srid na// yod min med min skye mched du// rgyal bas gol bar gsungs pa yin// gang yang ma yin stong pa'i ngang*// snang ba thams cad dgag bsgrub med// thams cad chos kyi ngang nyid yin// yin zhes bya ba tha snyad med// tha snyad byas kyang don nyid yin// don nyid byas kyang tha snyad yin// gang yang yin pa'i snang ba la/

thams cad min pa'i ngo bor shes// snang ba dgag bsgrub thams cad kyang*// gnyis med chos kyi sku ru shes// shes rgyu med pa'i ngang nyid la// thams cad chos dbyings chen por bsngo// spros bral ye shes ngo bo nyid/ rtog pa rab 'byams khyad 'phags mchog /bdag gis 'di bkod dge ba yis// thams cad phyag chen rtogs par shog /rang byung rdo rje'i gdams ngag rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la gdams pa bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs// grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rtogs ldan rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs// dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med na yang*// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung rnams// 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde dang*// gsang sngags phyi nang thams cad kyang*// mngon du bsdus na phyag chen yin// de ltar kun gyi go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /'di ni rang byung rdo rjes lug lo zla ba dang po la'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// mnyam nyid rab 'byams rtogs pa yi// ye shes ngo bo phyag chen nyid/ rtogs pa don gyi rnal 'byor pa// rang byung rdo rjes dbyangs cig len// sa ra ha dang rdo rje 'chang*// grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs// bdag nyid rnal 'byor 'dug pa 'di// mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings na 'dug /rnam dag 'od gsal ngo bo'i ngang*// mnyam med ye shes don la gnas// rtogs pa rab 'byams mtha' dbus med// bsgom bya bsgom byed dbyings las grol// rang byung ye shes ngo bo gcig /'gro don shugs las 'byung ba yi// gnyis med ye shes chen po yod// de ltar kun gyis go bar mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog rje rang byung rdo rjes lug lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum la mtshur phur gsungs/

oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnam 'byor pa// grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'dzin med phyag rgya chen po de// rnam grol rang gsal dgag pa med// zhi ba lhun grub 'dus ma byas// rang rig snang stong chu zla 'dra /'dzin med rang grol chen po yi// phyag rgya chen po go bar gyis// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /rang byung rdo rjes lug lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum la bris pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// bla ma bka' brgyud yi dam bcas/ skyobs pa dam chos dge 'dun sogs// thams cad kun la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro drug sems can thams cad ni/ 'khor ba'i gnas na 'khyam pa yang*// mnyam nyid chen po'i thugs rjes yis// myur du bde ba'i gnas su drongs// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// phyag rgya chen po ston pa dang*// bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// grub thob bka' brgyud thams cad kyis/ 'gro drug kun gyi lam sna drongs/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad kyis thos shing bsgoms pa dang*/ nyan zhing 'chad pa la sogs pa mang na yang gang dang gang gis skal pa grangs med rnams su tshogs bsags nas smon lam dpag tu med pa btab pa rnams kyis ni tshe gcig lus gcig gis phyag rgya chen po mngon par 'thob cing*/ tshe 'di la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin/ dbang po yang rab gcig char ba rnams ni// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa bde ba chen po/ rgyu 'bras/ rgyu rkyen gang la yang ma rten par phyag rgya chen po'i don skad cig gis mthong zhing*/ 'gro ba mang po la don byed pa dang*/ sems can gyi don gyi phyir/ lus dang srog dang dbang po dang*/ don snying la sogs pa thams cad sbyin par gtong zhing*/ skad cig ma gcig kyang sems can gyi don ma rtogs pa mi byed cing*/

snying rje byams pa byang chub kyi sems rgyun ma chad par bsgom zhing dbang po lnga yang gcig char ba'i lta ba'o// de ma yin pa ni sems can thams cad dge ba bsgrub cing sdig pa spong*/ sems can thams cad la bzod pa bsgom/ tshul khrims bsrungs ba la sogs pa thams cad ni kun rdzob tsam du ni bden pa/ mtho ris mi dang lha'i go 'phangs thob cing*/ rims kyis rgyud nas sangs rgyas so// gcig char ba dang rims kyis pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi snang ngor nyi ma grib ma lta bur 'byung zhing*/ yod pa thams cad ni sems can thams cad kyi snang ngor gcig car rims kyis pa gnyis su 'byung zhing*/ rang gis rang ngo ma shes pa 'dra ba'i dpe bzhin du gcig char ba dang rim gyis pa la sogs su ngos bzung bas sems can khams gsum 'khor ba na 'khyam pa yin/ de rnams gang dang gang med pa// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// nyams la shar ba'i lta ba 'di// thams cad kun gyis mkhyen mdzod// phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// rig dang ma rig gnyis dang ni/ don dam kun rdzob gnyis dang ni/ thams cad kun kyang ma yin zhing*/ snang ba thams cad dgag sgrub bral// 'dzin dang mi 'dzin rang sar grol// grol bas stong nyid mnyam pa'i ngang*// nam mkha' lta bu chos kyi sku/ gsal dang 'dzin la rnyog pa med// snang stong dbyer med dam chos 'dis/ sems can kun gyis go bar mdzod// yang 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul dang ma 'khrul pa'i snang ba thams cad bden med du shes pa'i gdam ngag 'di shes par mdzod// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam du grub la/ mngon sum du ma grub cing*/ snang ba 'di dgag bsgrub thams cad dang bral ba/ 'dzin pa med pa ngo bo mtshan nyid thams cad ni ma grub cing*/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal gang yang ma grub pa'i gdams ngag 'di kun gyis shes par mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog

lug lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes lnga la mtshur phur sbyar ba'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// sa ra ha yis byin gyis brlabs// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje ni// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// snang ngor sprul pa'i sku nyid du// byung zhing kun gyi phyag chen gyi// don nyid rtogs par byed pa yin// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*/ kun kyang rnam rtog bcom nas ni// zhi ba chen po ye shes kyi// ting 'dzin gcig tu gsan par zhu// phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa yi// dngos po rnam rtog stong pa nyid/ thams cad ma yin ma grub pa// cig char ba'i 'dod lugs yin// te lo chen po'i zhal snga nas// zhal nas don chen gsungs pa yi// ngo bo'i mtshan nyid 'di ltar gsungs// phyag rgya chen po bstan du med kyis kyang*/ dper na nam mkha' gang la gang gis bsten// de bzhin rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la glod la zhog /ces gsungs pa dang*/ sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang*/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa la sogs pa// rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal mthong bas sgribs// zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa yang don 'di la dgongs pa'o// yang phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba mtshan nyid 'gags pa med pa dang*/ ngo bo kun la khyab pa ste/ bden dang rdzun pa gang med pa// gnyis med rnam grol chos kyi sku/ 'gag med 'dzin med ngang la zhog /thams cad rig pa stong gsal du/ rtogs par gyis cig sems can rnams// de yang sems nyid 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di/ kun rdzob don dam ma grub cing*/ snang ba thams cad ma grub pa/ sems nyid gcig pu'i ngang la zhog /de yang rje btsun na ro pa'i/ zhal nas gdam ngag 'di skad gsungs// snang zhing srid pa'i chos 'di rnams// rang gi sems las gud na med// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

gzhan yang phyag na rdo rje'i// gsang rgyud le'u bcu pa nas/ 'di skad gsungs zhing 'di skad du// sems nyid rig pa stong gsal du/ rtogs na rdo rje gtum po 'grub// zhes kyang gsungs pa yin pa'o// de ltar du'ang ma rtogs na/ sems nyid rang bzhin snang ba 'di/ blo yis bcos su mi 'dod de/ rang gi sems nyid rtogs las byung*/ de yang bram ze chen po yi/ zhal nas snyan rgyud 'di skad gsungs/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster mdzad pa'i// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems yin te/ rtogs nas bsgom du med pas ma bcos lhug par zhog /rang la bzhag nas gzhan du 'tshol ba a re 'khrul/ 'di yin 'di min med de thams cad gnyug ma'i ngang*/ zhes gsungs so// de'i don gyis na phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ni rtsa ba rang gi sems la rag las pa yin no// yang de ltar na phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yang*/ 'khor ba snang sems rgyu 'bras dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu gzhi sogs rnams// thams cad ma grub grub pa rnams// sangs rgyas dang ni sems can dang*// 'khor ba myang ngan 'das pa rnams// sems kyi bye brag yin par gsungs// sems nyid sangs rgyas yin pa ste/ sems nyid nyid kyang sems las byung*// sangs rgyas nyid kyang sems las byung*// de yang dgyes pa rdo rje las// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid// zhes ni gsungs pa'i don nyid do// go bar gyis zhig sems can rnams// yang ni sems can kun nyid la// 'khrul pa dug lnga yod pa yin// de phyir sems kyang yod pa yin// de dang phyag rgya chen po nyid// dus mtshungs yin par rgyal bas gsungs// de phyir sems can thams cad nyid// rang gi sngon gyi las 'phro dang*/

bla ma nyid kyi lung bstan dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam chos kyis// 'brel nas sangs rgyas thob par bshad// rims kyis pa yi bzhed lugs yin/ de ltar sems can thams cad kyang*// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// gnyis nyid dus mtshungs bsags nas kyang*// kun kyang rim gyis sangs rgyas shog bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /lug lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ mtshur phu dgon pa 'di nyid me tog bzhin du mdzes// me tog nang na lha tshogs rnams ni rma bya'i mdongs bzhin mdzes// mdzes pa'i nang nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro// shākya thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ma ṇi 'brug sgra bsgrogs phyir bkra shis byed// dgon pa rnams kyi mgo ni mtshur phu yin// chu mig brgya rtsa'i mgo bzhin mdzes pa yin// shākya thub pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig sems can 'gro don byed pa'i dpal/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa yin// shākya thub pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab du gsol/ bkra shis dpal 'bar rab 'bar mi nub rgyal mtshan bzhin du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ mnyam nyid dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ bdag gzhan dgos 'dod 'byung ba yi// mnyam med bla med spros pa yi// mtha' bral gnyug ma don gyi ngang*/ stong nyid gsal ba nam mkha'i dbyings// dgag bya dgag byed bral ba yi// rang byung ye shes mngon du gyur// mtha' bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las// bsgom bya bsgom byed med pa yi// rtogs pa rab 'byams mtha' yas pa// 'khor ba'i blo yi khyad par las// ma byung ye nas rdzogs pa yi// rab 'byams ngo bo phyag chen nyid// ma rtogs yang dag rtogs pa'i ngang*/ don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// ma byung rang byung ye shes rdzogs// kun gzhi 'khor bar sgrib mi nus// ma rig log pa'i phung po 'joms// ye shes don gyi rnal 'byor gyis// ma rig 'khrul pa 'joms pa yi// rang bzhin ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings// rtogs pa rab 'byams mtha' yas pa// rang byung ye shes thugs la gsal// 'gro ba'i don la sgrib pa med// bla med snying po dam pa'i mchog

'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// rgyud la ye shes thob par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ spros dang bral ba'i mtha' nyid ni// ma rtogs rgyu dang rtogs pa'i rgyu// sems can dngos po ma yin pa// gang yang mtha' bral yod pa min// de ltar kun gyis go bar mdzod// mtha' bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ brtson 'grus dkar po'i sa bon rnams// rim gyis bsags nas chen por spel/ de bzhin nag po'i sa bon rnams// ji ltar bya sgro me sregs bzhin/ je chung je chung nyams par gyis// gnyis med mtha' dang bral ba yi// phyag rgya chen po rtogs par gyis// mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang la zhog /de ltar kun gyis go bar mdzod// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ chos kyi rje rang byung rdo rje la/ bsgom chen grags pa rin chen gyis lta ba yang dag pa de ji lags ces zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ lta ba zhes bya ba ngo bo la mu dang mtha' dang rtag pa dang chad pa dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i yul med par gsungs pa yin te/ de yang te lo pa'i zhal nas/ mu mtha' yongs grol lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /zhes gsungs pas na/ de lta bu la dpe tsam du 'jog pa yin te/ de yang yang dag pa'i lta ba de nyid ni lta ba dang lta byed la sogs pa gang yang yod pa ma yin te/ rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ lta ba lta bya'i yul dang bral/ lta rgyu byung na gol ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ lta ba zhes bya ba ming tsam ma rtogs pa don la lta ba zhes bya ba yod pa ma gsung yang zhus pa/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang ma bzhag pa la khyad par yod dam med/ zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa de mthar phyin pa'i dus su/ dran pas yang yang zin dgos pa yin te/ de yang dwags po lha rje'i zhal nas/ ma yengs rgyun gyi dran pa de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gzhung lam yin/ zhes gsungs/ rtogs pa de mthar phyin na gcig shes pa kun grol ba yin te/

de yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ gcig shes kun grol mkhyen pa yod/ ces gsungs so// yang rtogs pa de nyid mthar phyin pa'i dus su/ dran pa de ye shes yin nam min zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems nyid de rtogs pa'i dus su rnam rtog gang byung yang ye shes kyi cho 'phrul yin pas bkag mi dgos shing*/ bkag pas kyang mi khegs te/ khegs na sems nyid rgyun chags su 'gyur zhing*/ rtag par lta ba'i sar gol ba'i skyon yod/ de yang te lo pa'i zhal nas/ blo'i chos kyis blo 'das don ma mthong*/ byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don ma rtogs// zhes bya ba dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod gsung rnam rtog de nyid bkag na byas pa'i chos yin zhing*/ ma bkag na rang bzhin gyi phyag rgya chen po yin/ de yang bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems yin te/ rtogs na bsgom du med pas ma bcos lhug par zhog /rang la bzhag nas gzhan du 'tshol ba a re 'khrul/ 'di yin 'di min med do gnyug ma'i ngang*/ zhes gsungs so// yang te lo pa'i zhal nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil ltas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur/ de bzhin rang gi sems la lta byas na// rnam rtog tshogs 'gag bla med byang chub 'thob/ zhes gsungs pas rtog pa bkag pas khegs zhes bya ba dang*/ bkag dgos zhes bya ba ma gsungs pa yin pas na/ bsgom chen pa kun gyis go bar mdzod gsung*/ yang spyod pa zhes bya ba'i don ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyod pa zhes bya ba gnyis yin/ don dam pa'i spyod pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi spyod pa dang*/ de la kun rdzob gyis spyod pa ni/ bya ba dang*/ bya ba'i yul dang*/ byed pa po dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ de rnams gang yang mi byed cing*/ nyams la shar ba de nyid mi 'gog pa de nyid spyod pa yin par gsungs te/ de yang te lo pa'i zhal nas/ bya rtsol med na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin/

gsung*/ don dam pa'i spyod pa ni sems nyid rnal ma'i don de nyid kyi ngang la spyod pa zhes bya ba yin gsungs/ yang 'bras bu yang dag pa bya ba ci la zer ba lags zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'bras bu zhes bya ba 'di/ lta ba dang*/ bsgom pa dang*/ spyod pa gsum ka'i mtha' dang bral ba 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad la re ba dang dogs pa gang yang med pa'i 'bras bu'i mchog yin te/ de yang te lo pa'i zhal nas/ re dogs med na 'bras bu mngon du gyur/ zhes gsungs so// de ltar 'bras bu rims kyis bslab dgos te/ de yang te lo pa'i zhal nas/ las ni dang po cong rong chu dang 'dra/ bar du chu bo gang ga dal gyi g.yo/ tha ma chu rnams ma bu phrad pa 'dra// zhes pa dang mtshungs pa bzhin du/ dang po ma bslobs na 'bras bu mi 'byung*/ rim gyis bslob pa'i thabs ji ltar du slob na/ theg pa chu ngu nas chen po'i bar du rim gyis slob dgos te/ de yang theg pa chen po de mngon du gyur na 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'o// zhes gsungs so// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang dang tha dad med pa ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rtsa ba rang gi sems su 'dus par gsungs te/ de yang bram ze chen po'i zhal nas kyang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster mdzad pa// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa yang rtsa ba rang gi sems su 'dus pa ste/ 'khor ba yang sems las byung zhing mya ngan las 'das pa yang sems la byung ba'i don no// de ltar yang sems nyid ces bya ba yang*/ stong zhing 'od gsal ba/ 'dus ma byas pa/ lhun gyis grub pa ste/ sku gsum sku bzhi sku lnga de rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/

de lta bu'i don de nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas// ma rtogs na 'gro ba rigs drug ste/ rtogs ma rtogs gnyis kyi so 'tshams na/ nyi ma dang gri ma'i so 'tshams lag pa'i lto rgyab tsam yang med pa yin te/ de sems can rnams kyis ma rtogs shing 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin no// rtogs par byed pa'i thabs la ni bla ma byin brlab dang ldan pa dang rang gi dad pa'i stobs kyis phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'o// dbang po yang rab gcig char ba'i lugs kyis rgyu rkyen rgyu 'bras gang la yang ma rten par skad cig tsam gyi rtogs pa'o// rang nyid kyis de ltar rtogs kyang sems can gdul bya mtha' dag gi snang ngor gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don byed dgos pa yin te/ de lta bu 'byung ba la bsgom dgos pa yin pas/ gdul bya thams cad kyis bsgoms shing phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par zhog dang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing*/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol nus pa yin pa'i phyir na kun gyi phyag rgya che na po bsgoms shing*/ thams cad la ston cig shod cig mtshur phur lug lo la bkod pa bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ 'gro drug sems can rnams la thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad// bla med byang chub thob mdzad thugs rje can la bstod/ 'khor ba dang myang ngan las 'das pa'i chos ngo bo gdod ma nas ma grub pa/ mtshan nyid 'gags pa med pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ dbyings kun la khyab bo// rang sems thugs rje chen po dang tha dad med pa ste/ de'i phyir na kun gyis thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob/ mos gus gyis cig de ltar byas na dmyal bar mi ltung 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'o// de'i phyir na thams cad kyis thugs rje chen po bsgoms shig /ma ṇi pad+me bgrongs shig

/de ltar kun gyis nyams su long shig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir chos thams cad ni so so ma yin zhing gcig yin pa'i phyir na/ gang zag so so'i sems rgyud la rtogs tshul gyis snang ba mang po tha dad du byung ba ste/ de ltar yin kyang chos la 'jug pa'i tshul ni theg pa chung ngu nas rim gyis 'jug dgos pa yin/ nyams su len pa ni rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mas gsungs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos nyams su len dgos pa yin/ thams cad kyi 'bras bu ni skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i sems nyid 'od gsal ba de la 'dus pa yin/ chos byed pa'i skal ba sems can kun la yod par gsungs te/ de yang rgyud kyi nang nas/ sems yod pas ni de rtogs shing*// sems med pas ni de mi rtogs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na sems yod tshad lus yod tshad/ sna khung nas dbugs rgyu tshad/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga yod tshad kyis 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po de nyid rtogs pa yin pas na/ de ltar du shes par gyis shig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus mthar phyin cing*/ snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba'i mgon/ chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// dgongs pa'i mthar thug phyag rgya che// snying po don gyi sems nyid de/ ma rtogs rgyu dang rtogs pa'i rgyu// thams cad byed cing 'khor ba yi/ gnas dang de bzhin bden pa'i gnas// thams cad kun kyang sems nyid de// sems nyid de nyid nam mkha'i dbyings// stong gsal 'od gsal mtha' dbus med// spros dang bral ba phyag rgya che/ snying po don gyi phyag rgya che// 'gro ba kun gyi sems nyid la// de nyid ye nas gnas mod kyang*// 'phral snang rkyen gyi bag chags kyis// sgribs shing ma rtogs rgyu nyid byed// de'ang kye'i rdo rje las/

sems can thams cad sangs rgyas te// 'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid// ston pa nyid kyis de skad gsungs// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// don rnams ma lus thams cad kyang*/ rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid de// 'khor 'das gnyis med phyag chen nyid// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// rgyud la de nyid thob par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /spre'u yi lo la mtshur phur gsungs/ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa thams cad ni 'khrul zhing rang gi sems nyid ngo ma shes shing*/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad byung zhing 'khrul pa yin kyang de las grol bar byed pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong*/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por gsungs shing*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang rtsa ba stong pa nyid du gtan la phab te/ thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang la zhog cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang*/ bcom ldan 'das jo bo thugs rje chen po nyid la gsol ba thob cig /mos gus gyis dang*/ byin brlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing*/ 'og min gyi gnas bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /mtshur phur gsungs// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje 'chang la skyabs su mchi/ sa ra ha yis byin gyis brlobs/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kyang*/ de nyid ye shes mthar phyin cing*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur// bsgom bya bsgom byed med pa yi// rang byung ye shes mthar phyin cing*// bde chen nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// mtha' bral chos sku'i nam mkha'i dbyings// zag pa med pa spros dang bral// bde chen ye shes mtha' dbus med// nam mkha' lta bur spros dang bral// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das med cing*/

sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med de/ 'gro drug bar do kun kyang med// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// dam chos ma lus thams cad kun// rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid de// thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*// yin par kun gyis mkhyen par mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /mtshur phur gsungs/ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūm̐/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par rtog pa gang du yang mi 'phro ba de zhi gnas kyang yin la/ nyams kyi cha yang yin/ de rgyun du gnas na phyi snang ba'i yul gyi rnam rtog mtshon bya mtshon byed gang la yang chags pa dang zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa med cing*/ rgya mtsho gting gi chu lta bur mi g.yo ba de nyams yin pas de la sbyangs shing mthar phyin na lhag mthong 'byung ba yin// dang po bar skabs su gnas pa la chags pa dang*/ zhen pa gang yang mi bya/ chags zhen byas na 'gag pa'i rgyu yin/ de'i phyir na na tsha la sogs pa gang byung yang*/ na tshar 'dzin pa de la ltas nas mnyam par bzhag pas rang grol la 'gro ba yin/ de ltar du shes par bya'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog mtshur phur gsungs so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rnam 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// kun byed rgyal po de nyid ni// 'di ltar bu ru gdams pa'o// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas te// 'on kyang blo bur dri mas sgribs/ de bsal nas ni kun gyi dpal// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*// 'di lta'i don 'di ma rtogs par// mkhas par 'dod pa a re mtshar// 'di 'dra'i don zhig rtogs par mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /mtshur phur gsungs so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūm̐/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje yis// gdul byar gyur pa'i bu slob rnams la gdams pa// rgya gar dang 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na grub chen gnas thams cad dang*/

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nas gsungs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pa tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo yin pa ste/ de yang gsang ba rin po che bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i rgyud las/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams kyi gtso bo 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyis bzhed pa'i sa/ gnas brgyad dur khrod chen po rngam pa'i mgo /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thams cad kyang ster zhing mkha' 'gros byin brlabs pa'i sa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lor zhag gcig phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pa dang*/ gzhan dag tu lo gcig bsgoms pa gnyis kyang tsa ri trar zhag gcig bsgoms pa yon tan che ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'gro 'dod pa thams cad tsa rir song dang mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad tshe 'di nyid la thob nas sems can gyi don 'byung zhing mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong thams cad kyis sdong grogs byed pa yin pa'i phyir na/ tsa rir phyin pa thams cad kyis kyang*/ tha mar gyur na'ang lo drug dang bdun la sogs pa bsgom zhing rlung sems kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mos gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa gyis shig dang*/ yon tan dang rtogs pa bram ze chen po dang mnyam par 'gro ba rnams kyi dpal mgon dang bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing dam par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i phyir na tsa ri tra ye shes 'khor lor 'gro 'dod pa thams cad der song zhing bsgoms dang tsa ri'i phyogs su bsgom pa la sems nas goms pa bdun bor nas shi bar gyur na'ang ngan song du mi lhung zhing snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /mtshur phur gsungs/ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can nyon mong pa'i rang bzhin can rnams la byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ bde gshegs sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/

snyigs ma'i dus kyi gdul bka' ba// ma dag pa yi sems can kun/ mkhyen pa'i spyan gyi gzigs su gsol// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yis// dam chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa// thams cad kun kyang sems nyid de// zab mo spros dang bral ba'i don// mtha' bral phyag rgya chen po nyid/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ rgyud la de nyid gnas mod kyang*// glo bur dri mas sgrib pa yi// ma rtogs rgyu dang rtogs pa'i rgyu// gnyis ka byed cing 'dzin par zhen// de las grol bar byed pa'i thabs// brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang*// bag chags dri ma sel ba'i don// don de mtha' ru 'don 'dod na// rang sems rtsa ba bcad nas kyang*// rtogs pa'i dri ma dngas su chug /des na don mchog thob par nges// don ni phyag rgya chen po'i don// phyag chen don la 'gyur med sems nyid phyag rgya che// phyag chen don de rtogs par gyis// don de rtogs nas goms par gyis// goms shing 'dris na 'gro don 'byung*// 'gro drug kun gyi dpal du shar/ sems can chos bskal de la mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar thugs rje che 'bar na/ 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūm̐/ snyigs ma'i dus su thugs rje'i bdag /spyan ras gzigs kyi 'gro don mdzad/ de rjes 'jug pa'i skal ldan rnams/ kun kyang thugs rje chen po bsgom// sangs rgyas 'byung bar the tshom med// 'gro dang nyal dang za ba dang*// na dang rgas dang sdug bsngal sogs// gang rung dus rnams kun du yang*// thugs rje'i bdag po dran par gyis/ byin gyis brlob par the tshom med// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// thugs rje'i mngag bdag spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas khyab par/ sprul dang yang sprul bsam mi khyab/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni// sems can 'dren par zhal bzhes pa// thugs rje'i bdag po khyed yin pas// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// bde ba'i gnas su drangs du gsol/

'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*/ spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob// thugs rjes gzigs par the tshom med// de ltar kun gyis mkhyen par mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar bde chen ye shes 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rgyal ba nyid du shog /spre'u lo'i cho 'phrul chen po'i tshes lnga la bkra shis gsar mar bkod pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// spyan ras gzigs kyi 'od zer gyis// sems can kun la khyab pa ste// nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas khyab pa'i/ rigs drug bar dor bcas pa rnams// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs// kun kyang byin gyis brlab du gsol// kho bo rang byung rdo rje dang*// mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ bzang dang ngan 'brel gang yod pa// snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams su// spyan ras gzigs kyi 'od zer gyis// bde ba'i gnas su 'dren pa yin// thams cad kun kyang dga' ba bsgoms// de ltar kun gyis shes par mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i rgyud las/ 'od zer 'gro drug bar do dang bcas pa'i grangs dang mnyam par rnam par 'phrul zhing*/ sems can re re'i rtsa na yang thugs rje chen po re re bzhugs// dgos su yang sems can thugs rje chen po la mos pa rnams kyi rtsa na sprul pa'am dngos kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa yin kyang*/ snang ba ma dag cing 'khrul pas ngo ma shes pas te/ de ltar du ngo ma shes kyang dad pa yod pa tsam gyis thams cad 'dren nus pa yin zhing byin gyis brlob pa'o// de'i phyir na thams cad kun gyi thugs rje chen po bsgom zhing ma ṇi pad+mai grongs dang tshe 'di dang a cang che ste/ tshe phyi ma la yang nad dang gnod pa dang rkyen ngan zhi byed byin gyis brlobs pa'o// de'i phyir na thams cad kyi sems rgyud la thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer bkye zhing byin gyi brlabs nas/

dgra dang bgegs dang gnod pa gang yang mi 'byung zhing*/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi sems rgyud la thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer bkye zhing thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'o// de'i phyir na sems can thams cad kyis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs ma lus pa la gsol ba thob cig /mos gus drag du gyis/ thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob ma ṇi grongs thugs rje chen po'i gzungs thon/ de ltar byas na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing*/ byin gyis brlob par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang thugs rje chen po'i mdo las/ gang dag thugs rje chen po'i gzungs dang snying po 'don pa de yis chu klong ngam rgya tsho chen por zhugs te khrus byas pa'i chu de dag sems can chu'i nang na gnas pa'i sems can gyi rigs kyi lus la chu de dag phog par gyur na sems can de dag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa ma lus par dag nas skye gnas bzhi'i lus ngan mi len cing*/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na pad+mo la rdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na thams cad kyis thugs rje chen po bsgoms ma ṇi pad+me grongs/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo za ma tog bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ rkang pa bzhi pa'i rigs ba glang dang*/ ma he dang*/ rta dang*/ glang dang*/ rnga mong dang*/ khyi dang*/ 'phar ba dang*/ sram dang*/ ri bong la sogs pa de dag thams cad kyi spu'i tshad bgrang bar nus kyi/ yig ge drug pa'i rigs sngags 'di 'don cing 'dzin pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni bgrang bar mi nus so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ thams cad kyis thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho bsgoms shig /ma ṇi pad+me grongs dang ngan song gsum las thar zhing bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa phyir yin pa'i phyir na/ thams cad sems rtse cig par bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs ma lus dang bas phyag 'tshal zhing*/

sems dang bas mchod pa 'bul/ ngag dang bas skyabs su mchi/ zhes brjod nas skyabs 'gro bya zhing ma ṇi pad+me 'don par bya'o// de ltar bgrangs pa'i phan yon ni/ bsam gyi mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang kyang*/ thugs rje chen po'i rgyud sgo drug pa las/ bsod nams tshogs gnyis las ni byung ba'i sku// rgyal ba'i ba spu gcig gi bu ga yang*/ skal pa stong du ltas kyang chog mi shes/ de la mkhas pa su zhig dang mi 'dren/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcom gyur pa'i// rmi lam na yang rdzun gyi tshig mi mnga'// de la skye bu su zhig yid mi ches// rnam par rtog pa kun bcom dri ma spangs/ ye shes kyis ni chos rnams thugs su chud// shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu mnga' brnyes pa/ skye bu de'i thugs la su zhig skyob// 'di ni cang pa'i bsam pa rab ldan pa/ 'bri dang nyan dang yon tan 'chad pa dang*// gang du skyabs su 'gro ba byed pa ni/ mi skyo the tshom med par myur du 'grub/ zhes gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir na/ thams cad kyis thugs rje chen po bsgoms shing*/ ma ṇi pad+me grongs dang*/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum du thugs rje chen po nyid kyis 'dren zhing byin gyis brlob pa yin gyis/ thams cad kyis shin tu snying gi dkyil na bsgoms shing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes brjod na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di lta ste/ thugs chen po'i rgyud las 'di skad du rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po ni thigs pa re re nas bgrang bar nus gyi/ yig ge drug pa'i gsang sngags chen po lan gcig bgrangs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni bgrang bar mi nus so// zhes gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir// da snyigs ma'i dus su thugs rje chen po nyid ma gtogs pa sangs rgyas kun kyi thugs rje'i stobs ci tsam rgya chen pos gzigs kyang*/ sems can rnams kyi las zad nas/

thugs rje chen po nyid ma gtogs pas sems can mi thul zhing byin gyis brlob mi nus pa yin pa'i phyir na thams cad kyis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad la dngos sam yid kyis mchod pa rgya chen po phul zhing gsol ba btab na/ thugs rje chen po nyid kyi 'dren zhing byin gyis brlob pa yin pa'i phyir na/ thugs rje chen po la dad pa mos gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas ma ṇi pad+me grongs/ thugs rje chen po bsgoms/ de ltar du thams cad kyis go bar gyis shig /thugs rje chen po'i yon tan dang 'phrin las brjod na skal pa'i bar du yang brjod kyis mi lang pa yin pas mkhyen par mdzod cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub bsgrub pa'i gang zag gis/ ri khrod dgon par phyin nas kyang*/ thun drug bcad la srog rtsol bsgom/ gsang sngags bzlas brjod bsgom pa dang*/ ting 'dzin gtor ma la sogs dang*/ sdig sbyangs bsod nams tshogs bsags pa// 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par bya// ci tsam 'dug kyang ri khrod 'grims// gang ltar byas kyang bla ma bsten// bsdus na de las med pa'o// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pas// gdams pa cung zhig bkod par bya// bsgom chen rnams tsho snyan gsan 'tshal// dben zhing nyams dga'i sa phyogs su// bdag nyid gcig pus nyams su blang*// ci nyan tsam gyi spyil bu ru// bdag dros tsam gyi gos gyon cing*// mi bkres tsam gyi zas la rten// de nas 'di nyid rtsam par bya/ de la nyams su blang ba 'di la/ dang po kho nar chu shing 'dzom pa'i ri khrod du/ rdzas 'tshogs par byas la/ mdun du bdag gi mos gus kyi rten dang*// dpe cha nyung zad bzhugs su bcug nas/ de nas dge sbyor thun drug du bcad la snga dro kho nar lus sbyong rlung bzung*/

de nas gro kha'i dus su lus sbyong yang mi bya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing sems kyi ngo bo ye gdod ma nas gnas pa de'i ngo bo lta zhing sa le sang nge hrig ge ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing de nas nyi ma rgas gyi bar du lus sbyong bya/ rlung rtsol ci nus kyi bar bya'o// de nas srod la yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sngags bzlas pa dang*/ sngags kyi gtor ma la sogs pa bya'o// de nas gung la 'od gsal sbyang nga ngo*// de nas tho rangs kyi dus su sdig pa sbyang ba'i yan lag dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i yan lag dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing de kho na nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// de ma gtogs pa thun mtshams su gtor ma la sogs pa bya'o// de ni thun mtshams dang bcas pa'o// yang bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin du bdag gis gdams pa cung zad cig bgyi na/ ma shi'i bar du ri khrod 'grim/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyed// spyod lam rnam bzhi ci byed kyang*/ lha dang bla ma dang mi bral bar bsgoms/ gzung dang 'dzin pa thams cad spongs/ de kho na nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de lta bur chos thams cad nyams su blangs na de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po rang gi rgyud la skye ba yin/ de ltar nyams su ma blangs na/ ji ltar byas kyang byang chub mi thob pas/ ci nas kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub dgos snyam pa cig byas ri khrod dgon par bsdad nas nyams su len dgos pa lags so// de ltar du thams cad kyi nyams su long cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /e ma ho dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlob/ bka' rgyud bla ma thams cad kyis/ kha ba can ljongs byin gyis brlabs// gang na 'dug kyang bde ba thob// nga ni rang byung chen po ste// ca co'i 'dzin pa mi gda' 'o// cha shas 'dzin pa gtan nas grol// ja sogs bza' btung thams cad kun// nya sogs sbyin pa bgyi lags pas// ta re lta bu'i ye shes rtogs// tha dad 'dzin pa med lags pas// da ni mnyam med lta ba rtogs// nā ro paṇa chen gyi rjes zhugs pas// pa ma bal bu'i nags gseb du// pha rol gyi sems rgyud bskul lam snyam// ba spu yan chod thams cad kyang*// ma rig ye shes nyid du shar// tsa rlung gi gdams ngag nyams su len// tsha reg rang bzhin shugs la skye// dza hūṃ ye shes chen po yis// wa bgegs kyi bsam rtog kun dang bral/

zha bo la sogs sems can kun// za rgyu'i re bas nyams thag pa// 'a sgra'i sdug skad dang bcas la// ya rabs kun sbyin btong bya re ran// ra gan 'khar ba thams cad la// la las sdig pa byas nas kyang*// sha mar la 'tshong ba 'o brgyal// sa stengs na de 'dra byed pa mang*// ha ha shin tu rgod re bro// a skye ba med pa'i don rtogs shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ dka' ba spyad pa'i skyes bu mchog /kha ba can du sprul pa'i sku/ gang nas bltas kyang sprul pa'i sku// nga sogs 'gro ba thams cad la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// cis kyang mi phan chos cig mdzod// chos byas gnad du bsnun par mdzod// ji ltar byas kyang bla ma bsten/ nyams myong bzang po skyes te mchi// te lo bzang po ji bzhin du// thogs babs phyag chen gdam ngag bsgoms/ de nas bla ma'i byin brlabs kyis/ na ro paṇa chen lta bu 'byung*// bas mtha' la sogs nags gseb du// pha bla ma ma yengs bsgoms byas nas// bod khams 'di ni 'gran zla med// ma rig mun sel chen por 'gyur// tsa rlung thabs lam bsgom lags na// tsha reg rang bzhin shugs las skyes// dza hūm̐ ting 'dzin bsgoms lags na/ wa bgegs lha 'dres gnod mi tshugs// zhen pa gtan nas bzlog byas na// za rgyu thams cad shugs las 'byung*// 'o na skal ldan bsgom chen rnams// yang na bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// rang bzhin med par shes par mdzod// lar cis kyang rtsa rlung ma bsgoms na// sha chang zos kyang dgos pa chung*/ sems nyid gtan la phob mdzod cig /he he rang gi brtsan sa bzung*// a tsa ma ni sems can rnams// chos sku nyid dang mtshungs par shog /tshul 'di rang byung rdo rje byi ba lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad gyi nyin par bsgrub gnas dpal gyi khyung rdzong du gsungs pa'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis ming yongs su grags pa karma pa dang tha dad med pa'i sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje yis// bsgom zhing bsgrub pa la gzhol ba rnams la gdams pa// chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/

mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i yan lag yin te/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i las ci nus la 'bungs/ de ltar slob pa'i lam byams pa dang snying rje la rtsal sbyong*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bcom ldan 'das jo bo thugs rje chen po dus rgyun du bsgom/ gzugs mthong ba thams cad bcom ldan jo bo thugs rje chen po'i skur bsgom zhing nges shes bskyed sgra thos pa thams cad gsung yig ge drug ma yin ang snyam du bsgom zhing nges shes skye/ bdag gis spyod lam rnams bzhi gang byed kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das jo bo thugs rje chen po dang ma bral bar bsgom zhing rtsal sbyangs na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba yin pas/ de yang thugs rje chen po'i rgyud las// thangs cig mos pa byas pas brjod pa na/ sems can dmyal ba'i nad las thar// thangs gnyis brjod na yi dwags kyi// 'gro ba'i sgo yang 'gag par byed// gsum brjod dud 'gro'i sgo yang 'gag /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang gzungs las/ 'di'i yon tan rgyas brjod na/ skal par brjod kyang brjod mi lang*/ zhes gsungs pas thugs rje chen po bsgom/ ma ṇi pad+mai grongs/ don dam par thugs rje chen po bsgom zhes brjod kyang*/ snying rje chen po bsgom pa yin pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa thams cad la snying rje chen po dang*/ tshe 'di la yang bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar kun gyis nyams su long cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor bdag gi gdams pa ni/ rtag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms/ nyin mtshan kun tu gsol ba thob// rang rgyud grol ba'i dngos grub 'byung*// rgyu 'bras rnams la nges shes bskyed/ sems can rnams la snying rje bsgoms// rang dbang med pa'i rtogs pa skye// bya cha'i chos la brtson par gyis// dam pa'i chos la yid ches bskyed// gzung 'dzin spongs la ri khrod 'grims// gdam pa rnams la yid ches mdzod// bka' thub nyid la rtag tu 'bad// gtum mo'i gdam ngag bsgom par mdzod// de ltar kun gyis nyams su longs/

bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor ri khrod pa bdag gis/ bsgom chen pa rnams la gros 'debs kyi gdams pa gcig bgyi'o// de la da res mi lus rin po che thob cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor rab tu byung nas/ sngon du bshad pa dang*/ bsgom pa dang nyan pa'i las byed pa thams cad hril gyis dril nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyi steng du 'dus ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang*/ bsgom pa nyid yin pas bsgom pa gal che ste/ de yang bsgom pa'i mtha' nyon mongs pa'i dbang du ma song pa sems can la snying rje che ba bla ma la dad pa che ba/ brtson 'grus dang zhe bcad che ba/ mi chos dang 'jig rten don du mi gnyer/ phyi ma la bsam pa yang dag pa'i don la mos pa/ de lta bu gcig gis bla ma'i gdams ngag la brten nas ri khrod dben zhing nyams dga' bar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i don nyams su blang nga ngo*// de yang nyams su len pa ci 'dra ba cig dgos na/ 'di 'dra ba cig dgos te/ dam pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa bzang po bya ba 'phrin pa'i lce chod/ bang chen pa'i rkang pa khyigs/ phyag tshang ba'i lag pa bcad// khyi'i snying phyung na za bar mchi/ zhes gsungs pa/ ngag smra brjod nyung ba/ 'gro bdug dang tsab tsub mi mang pa/ lag pas las mi byed cing*/ gang la yang gtsang gtsog mi byed pa/ de lta bu cig 'tshal/ mi dge ba lus dang srog gi phyir yang mi byed pa cig 'tshal/ byams pa snying rje khang bzang la me shor ba'i nang du tshud kyang mi 'chor na cig 'tshal/ bla ma la dad pa ji ltar du gyur kyang mi ldog pa cig 'tshal/ gos dang zas med kyang bla ma'i gdam ngag gis chog pa gcig 'tshal/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal ci byung rkyen ngan grogs su 'gro ba cig 'tshal/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la pha dang mar 'du shes pa cig 'tshal lo// de la yang dam pa'i zhal nas/

bod kyi chos pa 'di tsho la rgod bro gsung*/ de tsug lags zhus pas/ nyams su mi len par 'bras bu 'dod/ bsgrub pa med par nyams myong 'dod/ byas pa med par ngo so 'dod// ri phug tu zla ba re bsdad kyang mis thos su re/ 'phral gyi dge sbyor bag re byas kyang gzhan dga' la re/ gzhan gyis thos su re/ ngas mi la ji ltar byas nas bstan snyam nas byed pa de chos ga na mchi gsung nga ngo*// da dus kyi dbang du song bas gsha' mar zhe thag pa nas chos byed mkhan mi gda'/ a tsa ma na/ yi re mug deng sang dus la bab pa'i skabs 'dir/ chos mi byed pa'i byed na/ tshul 'chos kyi chos pa/ yon bdag pho mo'i ngo srungs/ mi tshe 'di'i byas lo/ da ltar gyi so nam/ phyi ma'i rgyags phye yin no zer nas /'du 'dzi dang 'jig rten spangs po ngan pa la mtshams byed/ bzang po la di ring 'dir yongs sam/ sang yang byon cig de min yang skabs su byon cig zhes zer ba des chos pa mi mchi/ chos gsha' ma cig byed na bzang ngan rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas gang gi yang rtog pa med cing thams cad la phyogs cha dang zhe 'dzin med pa/ 'khor ba'i chos 'di dag thams cad la bde ba med par shes pa cig gis bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag bsgom zhing rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo bskor na/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de nyid rtogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das jo bo thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi ba'i ngang nas zhi ba'i ngang tshul can/ gang gi mtshungs med mgon po skyabs gcig pu// bla med mgon po ston pa bcom ldan 'das// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag chen po phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid dam pa nyid/ gser mdog can la sogs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang sems kun la 'dud// kun tu bzang dang rdo rje 'chang*// sa ra ha dang bka' brgyud rnams// snying po ma nor ston pa brtse// sems can rjes su bzung re ran/

snyigs ma'i dus mchog 'di nyid du// rnam pa lnga dag 'byung dus 'dir// sangs rgyas rnams kyang mi bzhugs shing*// dam chos rnams kyang zad pa na// dge 'dun phyogs ni ga la bzhugs// de phyir snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// snying po'i don mchog ma nor ba// ston pa'i bla ma mi bzhugs na// kye ma sems can sdug re bsngal// sangs rgyas rnams kyang thugs rje chung*// dam chos rnams kyis 'dren pa zad// phal cher snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// rtags tsam 'dzin kyang cung zad tsam// theg pa che la bskur pa 'debs// wa khengs seng ge'i cha byad can// gang yin de dag snying re rje// kye ma kyi hud sems can rnams/ sdug bsngal chu las sgrol 'dod na// thos dang bsam pa sngon song cing*/ 'dzin dang zhen chags bral byas nas// bsgom pa med par gyur pa dang*// thos dang zhen cing 'dzin pa rnams// nam yang mi grol chos nyid yin/ gser mdog can gyis chos gsungs pa// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar dag tu// stong pa nyid du gtan la phab// de la mi bsgom goms par bya// de phyir bsgom pa'i mtshan nyid do// 'gro mgon ston pa bcom ldan 'das// bla med ma nor ston pa nyid// bsam dang bsgom dang thos pa sogs// rang rang ma nor blo bzhin nyon// da ltar snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// de bzhin gshegs pa lung bstan ltar// ji lta ba yi cha byad can// rnam pa 'di dag snying re rje// de ltar ting 'dzin mdo las kyang*// snyigs ma'i sems can ma dag pa// sbyin pa'i sngags pa brjod byed cing*// sbyin pa don du gnyer ba nyung*// tshul khrims bsngags pa brjod byed cing*/ tshul khrims don du gnyer ba nyung*// bzod pa'i bsngags pa brjod byed cing*// bzod pa don du gnyer ba nyung*// brtson 'grus bsngags pa brjod byed cing*// brtson 'grus don du gnyer ba nyung*/ bsam gtan bsngags pa brjod byed cing*/

bsam gtan don du gnyer ba nyung*// shes rab bsngags pa brjod byed cing*// shes rab don du gnyer ba nyung*/ de ltar ma nor ston pa po// mgon po sems can 'dren re ran// snyigs ma'i sems can 'di dag kun// bla med ston pas drang du gsol// da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// bsgom chen pa dag bshad pa rems// bshad pa ba dag bsgom la rem// de ltar dam chos 'chol ba'i dus// da lta byung ba a tsa ma// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can// de dang dbyer med rin po che/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir thugs rje chung*// kye ma 'gro ba drang du gsol// 'di lta'i dus kyi sems can rnams// ma dag pa yi zhing bzhin du// bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur na// de bas bdag nyid bsgom par rigs/ gang dag bsgom par gyur pa la// gshe bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams// mnar med pa dang mi khom brgyad// 'byung 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ji ltar gzhan la bskul ba dag /pha bong byis pas byas ltar 'gyur/ de bas bdag nyid bsgom par rigs// ji ltar bdag nyid bsgom pa la// gzhan gyi gegs su byed pa dag /lha byin de la the tshom med// ji ltar ston pa bcom ldan gyis// sku la bya bar ma nus pas// 'gyur med gcig tu gyur pa na// de ni shin tu e ma ho// ji ltar gyur zhing mi brtan pa/ gong bu'i 'chi ba ltar gyur na// de ni rnam bzhi bzung bar rigs// ji ltar bsgoms pa'i nga rgyal gyis// rgyags shing dregs par gyur pa de/ snyigs ma'i dus su gyur pas lan// ji ltar gyur kyang snga ma dang*// ma chags mi 'bral gyur pa legs// kye ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje yis// sems can rnams kyang drang du gsol// 'di lta'i dus nyid byung ba'i tshe// bla ma rnams kyi byin brlabs kyis// bdag 'dra yi rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// nyan dang bsam pa ma byung yang*/

gcig shes kun grol mkhyen pa rgyas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rnams la// sems nyid 'di ru gtan la phebs// gsum dang brgyad khri bzhi dang dgu// kun gyis de nyid khong du chud// nyi shu rtsa bzhi gtan la phebs// de ltar gyur pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /spros dang bral ba e ma ho// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang*// ji ltar ma zhig bar du yang*// bde chen ngang la bkod par gyis// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang*// myur ba nyid du sangs rgyas shog /de lta bu ru rtogs lags kyang*// gzhan dang mthun zhing drang ba'i phyir// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim bya zhing*// gcig pur zhen pa bzlog byas nas// phyogs ris med pa'i ri khrod du// ltem kyang med pa'i bsgrub pa byed// 'khri ba brtsad nas bcad bya zhing*// phyag chen man ngag bsgom byas na// phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba rtogs// ji ltar byas kyang bla ma brten// ngan 'gro de dag ga la yod// bden pa med par shes lags na// 'di phyi bya ba'i ming yang med// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// dam chos 'di dag thams cad kun// bdag gi sems nyid 'di nyid dang*// 'khrul pa med pa'i lta ba 'di// bde ba chen po e ma ho// khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /byi ba lo zla ba dang po'i tshes lnga la khyung rdzong du bkod pa'o/// / ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ chos kyi rtsa ba hril gyis dril nas bsgom par byed pa la// bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis su 'dus te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs la rnam pa gsum yin/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa gsum yin/ sbyin pa nyams su len par byed pa ni gsum las/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum las/ de yang sbyin pa ni chung ngu nas bslab dgos te/ de skad du yang*/ sbyin pa dang po chu la bslab/

de nas zan kham tsam la bslab/ de nas bre phul tsam la bslab/ tha mar mgo dang rkang lag sogs// gtong yang dka' ba ma yin te// dper na rgyal po zla 'od bzhin/ zhes bshad pas/ rim gyis sbyin pa la bslab par bya'o// de bzhin du/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa la yang 'bad de bslab par bya'o// de dag thams cad brtson 'grus chen pos dang du blang bar bya'o// de yang gtso bo ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas/ de skye bar byed pa la bsam gtan bsgom dgos te/ de yang bla ma dam pa'i gdam ngag gis/ rtsa rlung la sogs pa sems rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs pas/ ci zhig ltar la bdag med pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas kyang ma 'ongs/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ snga phyi med cing 'dus ma byas lhun gyis grub pa de lta bu'i don la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rang byung rdo rje yis// gdul bya rnams la gdams pa 'di sta ste/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems snying rje chen po bsgom dgos pa yin pas// dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du snying rje chen po bsgom pa la 'bad pa 'don par bya'o// gzhan yang gang dang gang du 'gro ba la sogs pa byed pa'i dus su yang bla ma dam pa bsgom zhing bya ba dang spyod lam ci byed kyang chos su 'gyur ba byed pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong ba dang*/ de la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs la 'bad cing mthar ye shes kyi tshogs dmigs pa med pas rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos kyi bya ba la bkod cing*/ rang yang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du chos kyi bya ba ma gtogs pa skad kyang mi byed par 'bad na yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// gang gi brten cing 'brel 'byung ba// rnam par dmigs pa mi mdzad cing*// dmigs med nyid kyang dmigs mi mdzad// gdod nas ma skyes 'di phyag 'tshal// chos rnams bden par ma grub kyang*// kun rdzob don dam dbang gis su// rnam par zhen pa spang ba'i phyir// rim gyis sbyin pa la goms bya// de ltar tshul khrims bzod pa yang*// brtson pas rnam par goms par bya// de bzhin bsam gtan nyid kyang bsgom/

mthar thug shes rab pha rol phyin/ dngos po ma yin stong ma yin// gnyis ka ma yin gnyis med min// des na spros pa rnam bzhi bral// skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong dang*// don cig don ni mang po dag dmigs par mi 'gyur mtha' brgyad bral// de ni mthar thug don dam 'dod/ tshig yin don dam spros dang bral// 'di don rig cing sus rtogs pa// sa bcu las 'das thob par 'gyur// rnam pa 'di ni ma shes pa'i/ dmigs pa can rnams rab tu brlag /'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis// 'di don legs par rtogs par shog /shubhāṃ// rang byung rdo rjes yis/ gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gdams pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid/ spros dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir// gang la bden pa yod ma yin// bden pa med kyang kun rdzob tu// byang chub sems dang ma bral bar// bsod nams tshogs chen bsags par bya// rgyun du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms// gdung bas rtag tu gsol ba gdab// dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du// 'gro 'chag spyod lam thams cad du// snying rje chen po'i 'du shes bsgom/ rgyun du bdag med don la lta// phyogs ris med pa'i ri khrod du// ltem brkyang med pa'i bsgrub pa mdzod// snying po'i don mchog ma rtogs par// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim bya zhing*// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs/ rgyun chad med par chu rgyun ltar// dar drag yun du bsgrub par bya// de ltar mdzod cig bsgom chen kun/ shubhāṃ// oṃ sarba swa sti sid dhi hūṃ/ rang byung rdo rje yis/ dge bshes gzhon nu rin chen la gdams pa/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par gang yin// rgyud la gang skyes snga/ mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob kyi khyad par gang lags// chos rnams bsdus na gang du 'dus// nyams su len pa'i tshul gang lags// zhes zhus pa'i lan legs par bshad kyis gzu ba'i blos legs par spyod cig

/kye ho/ ma lus don dam snying po'i don// rtogs pa nyid kyis rab dga'i sa zhes grags// nyams zhes bya ba tshogs sbyor rnams gnyis kyis/ bzang ngan rtog pa yin gyis go bar gyis// rgyud la skye lugs de'i shugs la gsal// mnyam gzhag rjes thob 'di la 'ga' zhig snang*// so so'i skye bo nyan thos rang rgyal dang*/ 'phags pa rnams dang de dag gang la zer// chos rnams mtha' dag bsdus na snying po'i don// nyams su len pa'i tshe na byang chub sems// theg gsum bdag nyid bshig pa'i cha yis mthong*// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams de skad gsung*/ gzhan yang nyams su len par byed pa la// snying rje rnam pa gsum la sbyang bar bya// thabs kyi rtsal sbyong rdo rje theg par dril// rgyas gdab pha rol phyin pa drug la mdzod// lam snga sa bcu'i bgrod lugs ji lta bar// bgrod par gyur na thub dbang nyid ltar gyur// dri ba gzhan dag rang gi sems la gyis// 'dab ldan pad tshogs rgyas pa'i ge sar la// shin tu 'jam mdzes rnam pa kha dog ldan// ro mchog legs par rtogs pa gzhan gyi gnyen// shin tu gyur pa bdag gis rnam par spel// 'di don bka' lung rgyud rnams thams cad dang*// sa ra ha dang klu grub thogs med sogs// mkhas grub legs par rtogs pa thams cad kyis// gsung mi 'gal rang gzo spangs pa yin// 'di mthong thos dran pa'i gdul bya rnams// tshe 'di la sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rang byung rdo rjes/ bsgom chen yon tan 'od la gdams pa/ yang dag pa'i don rtogs par byed pa la sngon du sgyu ma lta bu bsgom pa gal che bas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i don la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ de ltar bden pa med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de lta bu'i don la mnyam par bzhag cing bsgom par bya'o// spyir yang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bla ma dam pa bsgom zhing mos gus phun sum tshogs pa bya ba dang*/

bla ma dang dus gsum sangs rgyas yi dam la sogs pa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum yang yang bsre bar bya'o// de ltar du byas na yon tan phun sum tshogs pa skye bar 'gyur ro// de ltar mkhyen par mdzod cig /oṃ sarba swa sti sid dhi hūṃ/ mi yongs su grags pa karma pa dang tha dad med pa'i sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje yis/ bsgom chen bkra shis ye shes la gdams pa ni 'di lta ste/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu ste/ bden pa'i snying po gang yang med// med bzhin snang ba'i dngos po la// bden par 'dzin pa ma byed dang*// chos rnams thams cad rnams gnyis te// kun rdzob dang ni don dam mo// kun rdzob bden pa med pa la// bden med sgyu ma lta bu bsgoms// don dam nyid ni spros bral yang*// rtogs par byed pa'i thabs la ni// 'bad pa dpag med byed pa dang*// sgyu ma lta bu bsgom par bya// gang la'ang zhen pa med pa dang*// spang blang med pa'i ting 'dzin bsgoms// rgyun du bla ma dam pa dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs thams cad dang*// rang gi sems nyid rgyun du bsre// de ltar byas na yon tan thob// bsgom chen rnams la phan gyur cig /shubhāṃ// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje chen so dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// skye med bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' la/ 'gag med nyi ma'i snying po khyad par can// gnyis med bsdu dngos bzhi'i 'od zer dpal// zag med blta ba phyogs bcur bstan mdzad ma// bdag med don gyi dbyings nas mchod pa 'bul// rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i ma rig rmu rgod 'di// pha rol phyin pa'i don du bskyed mdzad gsol// e ma sangs rgyas bstan pa la// nyams len mdzad pa'i skyes bu rnams// bdag gi tshig 'di gsan par zhu// ye nas gnas pa'i sems nyid 'di// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i don// 'on kyang glo bur rkyen gyis ni// rnam rtog dri ma nyon mongs te// chu dang gser gyi dpe ltar du// dag dang ma dag gnas skabs yin// ma dag ma rig pa yi dus// lus can 'gro ba du mar rnams// de las mchog tu gyur pa ni// mi'i lus 'di yin par gsungs// skyon bral dbang por ldan pa yin// skyes bu rnams kyi 'di ltar bya// thog mar bstan pa 'di la ni// 'jug pa'i tshul ni shes bya zhing*// de las nyams su blang pa yi// thabs ni 'di ltar bya ba yin// sangs rgyas kyis ni gsungs pa bzhin// sbyin pa la ni 'jug pa'i tshul// de nas brtsams te shes rab kyi// don mthong bya phyir bla ma ces// de la yang dag log pa yi// bshes gnyen rim na shes par bya// ji bzhin stong pa nyid blta zhing*/

kun rdzob rgyu 'bras mi spong zhing*// theg pa'i rims la 'jug tshul mkhas/ de ltar gzhan las dpag med brjod// de las gzhan du gyur pa ni// log pa bshes gnyen yin rig bya// de ltar mtshan nyid shes byas nas// yang dag bla ma de bsten cing*// gdams pa'i tshul ni legs thob ste// brtson 'grus ldan pas dman pa'i thabs/ de la thog mar sbyin pa'i tshul// sbyin pa'i gnas dang de'i rang bzhin ni// thabs la mkhas pas de tsam bya// drug dang ldan pas nyams su blang*// de ltar tshul khrims la'ang ni// rim pa bzhin du shes par bya// bzod pa'i tshul kyang 'gro ba la// 'gras pa med pa de bsgom bya// de ltar rnam pa gsum po lo// brtson 'grus ldan pa shin tu gces// de nas mchog tu gyur pa la// bsam gtan la ni 'di ltar brjod// de la thog mar bsam gtan gyi// mtshan nyid rim pa shes par bya// dman pa'i bsam gtan dpag med kyang*// mnyam byed yid kyi 'dzin par bcas// mchog gi bsam gtan dmigs pa yi// yul dang bral bar shes par bya// de la thog mar bsam gtan gyi// gnas ni ri khrod dgon pa'am// dben zhing 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas// de ru nyams su blang bar bya// nyams su blang ba'i tshul la ni// thog mar bla ma lung bstan gyi// byin brlabs 'jug pa shin tu gces// de nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje 'chang du bsgom pa gces// de'ang 'dzin pa'i yul dang bral// bsre ba'i gnad dang ldan lags na// bla ma'i byin brlabs 'jug par nges// de nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi// snang ba 'di dag sgyu ma ltar// bslab cing bsgom par bya ba yin// de ltar bsam gtan dpag med tshogs// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi// mig dang mi ldan gyur pa rnams// mig med pha rol phyin lnga pos// thar pa'i lam mchog rnyed ma yin// de phyir shes rab pha rol phyin// gtso bo nyid du shes par bya// de las pha rol phyin pa ni// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te// nam mkha'i khams ni ji bzhin du// mtha' las 'das shing gzung ba bral// 'jig rten rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs// yang dag don la grub pa med// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi// thugs kyi ye shes de nyid yin// phyag rgya che zhes de la brjod// yod pa'i mtha' rnams ma grub pas// med pa grub par ga la 'gyur// so sor bkag pa'i rang bzhin gyis// gnyis ka yod pa ma yin no// yod med dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir// des na spros pa rnam bzhi bral// 'di don gang gis rtogs gyur pa// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin/

'di ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul// rgyal ba'i gsung dang mi 'gal bar// snying po lta bur bsdus pa 'di/ tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs bsod nams ldan// kun gyi mchog du gyur pa yi// mkhan pos legs par bskul nas su// karma pa zhes bya ba yis// rnam par bsdus nas sbyar ba'o// gang zag khyad par can rnams kyi nyams su blang ba'i tshul pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang sbyar ba 'di/ rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis/ byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bsgrub gnas jo mo gangs la sbyar ba'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ mgur 'bum bzhugs pa lags so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje bkra shis gsar mar bzhugs pa'i dus su// nub gcig gi rmi lam la/ rang cag dang gzhan yang rogs gnyis dang gsum gyis lho phyogs dpal gyi ri yin bya ba gcig tu/ bla ma bram ze chen po 'tshol du phyin pas/ gzhan rogs gnyis ni ri'i lho phyogs su tshol du song zhing*/ bdag shar phyogs de nyid du spang thang yangs shing*/ bde ba gcig tu sdad tsa na/ me tog gi char dpag tu med pa bab/ de nas rang cag gis thor mang po brtsigs shing*/ de rnams dkyil du mnyam par bzhag cing 'dug pa las/ nam mkha' nas dbyangs kyi sgra cung zad gcig 'di ltar grags so// rigs kyi bu khyod yar nyon dang*/ bla ma bram ze chen po ni// rang gi sems nyid yin pa la// gzhan du 'tshol ba a re 'khrul// de skad du grag pa las/ rang cag gis kyang sgra de la 'di skad ces smras so// e ma ho/ bla ma bram ze chen po ni// rang gi sems nyid yin lags kyang*// du ma ro gcig dkyil 'khor du// tshol bya tshol byed bral ba la// grogs po rnams gnyis tshol du thal// rang cag gcig pur bsdad pa la// bram ze chen pos brda yis bstan// e ma ngo mtshar shin du che// zhes smras pas/

nam mkha' nas bram ze chen po'i gsung gi sgra 'di skad ces grag go /e ma ho/ bla ma bram ze chen po ni// rang gi sems nyid yin lags pas// du ma ro gcig dkyil 'khor du// bsgom bya bsgom byed bral ba yi// smras bsam brjod las 'das pa yi// do ha'i gdam ngag bsgoms cig bu// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po phyag chen yin lags pas// spros med ngang du zhog cig bu// 'bad brtsol med pa gnyug ma'i don// mtha' gcig bral ba'i ngang nyid du// rang gi ye shes rtogs lags na// sems nyid 'gro don 'byung lags kyis// ma yengs mnyam par zhog gcig bu// e ma ho spros dang bral ba'i sems nyid 'di// gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro// smyon pa lta bu'i sems nyid 'di// chu rnams rgya mtshor thim pa bzhin// skye 'gag med pa yin lags na// phyag chen ngang du zhog cig bu// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rang cag gis brtsigs pa'i tho dang sa rdo ri brag thams cad bram ze chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas 'dug cing*/ rang cag gi sems rgyud la gnyug ma'i don skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ rgya ma chad pa/ phyogs su ma lhung pa/ zang tha le/ lhang nge lham mer 'dug pa'i dus su gnyid sad pa dang ma sad pa la khyad mi 'dug nas/ nyams dga' nas yid la 'di ltar du dran zhing 'di skad du dbyangs su blang ngo*// e ma ho/ bla ma bram ze chen po yin// sems nyid skye 'gag med pa yin/ gdam ngag du ma ro cig yin// snang ba thams cad dpe cha yin// 'khor 'das med pa e ma ho/ zhes gsungs so// 'di lta bu'i gdam ngag dam pa 'di// ri khrod 'grim pa'i bsgom chen rnams// gdam ngag mdzod cing nyams su slong*// dbyangs 'di la bla ma'i byin brlab chags// gsung yin ngo shes so the tshom med// shin tu zab mo nyams su long*// spre'u lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la bkra shis gsar ma na bzhugs pa'i dus su rmi lam du bla ma bram ze chen po dang 'jal zhing zhus lan du gsungs pa'o// shubhāṃ/

༈ e ma ho/ ri khrod dgon pa nyams dga' bar// phyi nang zhen pa bzlog bya zhing*// gcig pur ri khrod 'grim par bya// phyag chen bsgom pa ma byung yang*// dug lnga'i rnam rtog mi bgyid 'tshal// bya ba chos spyod ma grub kyang*// gti mug ro nyal mi bgyid 'tshal// gsang sngags bzlas brjod ma grub kyang*// tsab tsub bya ba mi bgyid 'tshal// gtum mo bsgom pa ma byung yang*// bem dug gsum brtseg mi gon 'tshal// bcud len byed pa ma byung yang*// mi tshe sprang ldom mi bgyid 'tshal// gong ma'i brgyud pa ma zin yang*// sgyu lus tha mal mi sdod 'tshal// rang bsod nams bsog pa ma byung yang*// gzhan gyi kha 'gog mi bgyid 'tshal// rang gcig pur sdod pa ma byung yang*// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba mi bgyid 'tshal// lar snying po'i don mchog ma rtogs par// shi khar mi 'tsher tsam cig 'tshal// 'jig rten snang ba 'di dag kun// sgyu ma'i dpe ru ma shes kyang*// mi rtag thun re bsgom pa 'tshal// 'khor ba g.yang sa chen po la// ltung dogs mi dgos tsam cig 'tshal// 'tshal ba bcu gcig gi mgur 'di shing bu spre'u lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la rang byung rdo rjes bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du/ ri khrod 'grim pa rnams kyi don du gsungs pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// ri khrod dgon par sdad lags kyang*// g.yeng ba je cher 'gro yis gda'// gdams pa bsgoms par 'dod lags te// tsab tsub mang bas mi yong gda'// de lta bu ru gyur lags kyang*// ci nus kyi ri khrod 'grim yang 'tshal// gzhan yang de ltar mkhyen par mdzod/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// bka' brgyud rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// nyams la shar ba'i dbyangs chung 'di// skal ldan rnams kyi nyams su long*// phyi snod dang ni nang bcud dang*// 'dzin sems rig dang ma rig pa// gang la 'dzin pa'i sems nyid kyis// phyag chen mthong bar mi 'gyur zhes// sa ra ha'i zhal nas kyang*// ma shes gol sar song ba la// thar pa nam yang yod min zer// de'i rtog pa spangs nas su// rgyun du mnyam par bzhag par bya// de ltar kun gyis go ba mdzod/

shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rdo rje 'chang sogs bka' rgyud rnams// byin gyis brlob par mdzad du gsol// rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba la// 'di ltar shar ba'i dbyangs chung 'di// skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de/ 'dzin pa med pa chos kyi sku/ snang stong dbyer med 'du shes med// thams cad stong nyid ngang la zhog /shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru/ bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// grub thob rnams kyi byin gyis brlobs// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// mtshan ldan rje dang 'jal lags pas// rang sems grol la ma phan zin// gdam ngag mang po thob lags kyang*// nyams su len la ma phan zin/ ri khrod dgon par 'dug lags kyang*/ gcig pur bsgom la ma phan zin/ spros pa med pa bsgoms lags kyang*// gcig kyang med la ma phan zin// phyogs med rgyal khams 'grim lags kyang*// snang ba spangs la ma phan zin/ dpe cha'i 'phying khug sogs lags kyang*// snang ba bde ba ma phan zin// da rung bla ma rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlobs// kye ma de ltar yin lags kyang*// ci nus nyams su len yang 'tshal// pha bla ma'i rjes 'dzin ma byung yang*// snying rje chen pos mi gtong 'tshal// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po'i don dam phyag chen la// goms 'dris mtha' ru ma phyin yang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mi gtong 'tshal// gnas ri khrod dgon pa ma 'grims shing*// dka' thub byed pa ma byung yang*// a hūṃ gi dmigs pa mi brjed 'tshal// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs rabs la/ klong du gyur pa ma byung yang*/ dam chos rgyab tu mi kyur 'tshal/ 'od gsal zung 'jug phyag chen la// spyir de rnams kun dang bral ba'i phyir// da rung dga' brod kyi dbyangs gcig len// sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa thams cad rtogs// zhen 'dzin gyi 'dud pa thams cad grol/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa sems la shar// da ces kyang 'gyod pa mi gda' 'o// bsgom chen rnal 'byor thams cad kun// phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la zhog

/de ltar kun gyis go bar mdzod// rje karma pa'i dbyangs dang 'dra// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru// pha rje btsun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ho sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// gdam ngag zab mo dbyangs su len// skal ldan rnams tsho dbyangs gson mdzod// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// nam mkha'i dbyings la phar bltas pas// stong pa 'od gsal tur gyis dran// skye 'gag med pa mngon du gyur// chu bo'i gzhung la mar ltas pas// rgyun chad med pa tur gyis dran// brjod du bral ba mngon du gyur// ri bo 'di la phar ltas pas// 'gyur ba med pa tur gyis dran// g.yo 'gul med pa mngon tu gyur// glu ngo mtshar dpe gsum don dang drug /bsgom chen rnams la gdams pa lags// de ltar kun gyis go bar mdzod// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba la// 'di ltar shar bar dbyangs chung 'di// skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su long*/ lar cig kyang dam chos byed pa la// yul 'khor nye 'brel ma chags par// gcig chod kyi sems la ltos cig ang*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyal mtsho la/ 'dis chog go bsnyam pa ma byed par// phyogs med kyi ri khrod 'grim cig ang*// nam 'chi'i dus tshod cha med par// zang zing khe pogs tshong las sogs// ma byed sems la ltos cig ang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rab 'byams la// gzu lum phod tshod ma byed par// phyogs med kyi chos la ltos cig ang*// lar nam 'chi tshod gcig med lags pas// mang po la bsam blo ma gtong par// gcig chod kyi gdams pa ltos cig ang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bsam yas la// pho tshod chog tshod ma 'dzin par// 'dzin med kyi lta ba gyis cig ang*// theg pa rang sar bden pa la// nga rgyal dang chags 'dzin ma byed par// phyogs med la dag snang gyis cig ang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes la// tshig gi sgro bkur ma 'debs ang*/

phyag chen nam mkha' lta bu lta// mtshan nyid gyi rtog gzhig ma gzhug par// ma yengs rang sar zhog cig ang*// de yan chad lta ba'i glu chung yin/ da rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i glu gcig len// bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi// thugs dgongs kyi mthar thug bsgom pa yin// lar de la sems la bsgom cig ang*// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dam chos rtsa ba bsgom pa yin// lar de la soms la bsgoms cig ang*// gnyis med kyi ye shes chen po la/ bsgom bzang ngan du song ba ma byed par/ lar rnam rtog chod la bsgoms cig ang*// tshe 'dir bsgoms cig ma byas na// 'chi khar 'gyod pa 'byung lags pas// zhen bral gyis la bsgoms cig ang*// zab don smra brjod dang bral ba la// tha snyad mang po ma byed par// 'dzin med yengs med du bsgoms cig ang*// bde gshegs kyi bka' lung thams cad kyang*// mthar thugs bsgom las med lags kyis// zhen 'dzin med par bsgoms cig ang*// sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'di rnams ni// dbu ma'i rang bzhin yin lags pas// mtha' gnyis med par sgoms cig ang*// ri khrod kyi dgon pa 'di rnams la// lus sems bde las med lags kyis// ri khrod dben par bsgoms cig ang*// lar bsgom rgyu gtan nas med pa la// kun rdzob tu brjod pa yin lags kyi// bsgom med ngang la bsgoms cig ang*// ngar 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'di rnams kun// ye nas rtog bral yin pa'i phyir// de rang la ltos las bsgoms cig ang*// lar sangs rgyas kyi dam chos thams cad kyi// rtsa ba ye shes phyag rgya che// ma rtogs bar du bsgoms cig ang*// de yan chod bsgom pa'i glu cig yin// da rnal 'byor spyod pa'i glu cig len// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ma yengs spyod pa'i mthar thug yin// ma yengs don la spyod cig ang*// grub thob kyi bla ma thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i mthar thug phyag rgya che// mtha' bral gyi ngang la spyod cig ang*// nyams su len pa'i rtsa ba la// dam chos dgos ngo shes lags pas// zab mo'i don la spyod cig ang*// bde gshegs kyi dgongs pa rab 'byams la// smra bsam brjod las 'das lags kyi// brjod med gyi don la spyod cig ang*/

'dus byas kyi dam chos 'di rnams kun// thams cad 'jig pa yin lags kyi// 'jig med kyi don la spyod cig ang*// 'jig rten gyi zas nor nye 'brel la// 'chi khar 'bral ba yin lags kyi// 'bral med kyi don la spyo da cig ang*/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre phra mo rnams// rten na 'chi ba'i srog gcod byed// de bas zab don spyod cig ang*/ 'od gsal zung 'jug bsgoms lags na// yi dam lha tshogs mthong lags kyi// 'od gsal zung 'jug spyod cig ang*// lar spyod rgyu gtan nas med pa las/ spyod cig zer ba 'khrul pa yin// 'khrul med kyi don la spyod cig ang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rab 'byams la// 'dzin byed dang chags sdang med lags kyi// mtha' bral gyi spyod pa la spyod cig ang*// de yan chad spyod pa'i glu cig yin// da rnal 'byor 'bras bu'i glu cig len// bla ma rnams kyi byin brlabs kyis// mthar thug bde chen phyag rgya che// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// gong ma'i thugs rje chen po yis// 'og ma kun la ngo sprod pa// 'bras bu de las med de ang*// zab mo'i don mchog thams cad la// mtha' dang bral ba'i ngo bo yin// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// dam chos kyi mthar thug bsgom du med/ yengs med kyi ngo bo yin lags pas// 'bras bu de las med do ang*/ 'khor ba myang 'das rtsa ba rnams// 'dzin med kyi ngo bo yin lags pas// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// 'khor ba'i bya ba de dag la// re dogs med par shes lags pas// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// phyi rol yul snang 'di rnams kun// ngos bzung med par shes lags pas// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// phyi rol gyi sgra snang 'di dag la// brag cha bden med du shes lags na/ 'bras bu de las med do ang*// gzugs rnams snang stong rang bzhin la// mthong tshad chos skur shar lags na// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// 'dzin med rang grol lta ba la// 'pho 'gyur med par goms lags na// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// zang zing gi bsam pa 'di dag kun// kun kyang grol du shes
