lags na// 'bras bu de las med do ang*// de yan chod 'bras bu'i glu cig yin// lar ces kyang dam chos mdzod cig ang*// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten cig ang*// ri khrod dgon pa 'grims gcig ang*// mnyam med lta ba bsgoms cig ang*// lar dril na de las med lags kyi// nyams su long cig skal ldan kun// ces pa'i mgur 'di chos rje rang byung rdo rjes bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du gsungs pa'o/// /shubhāṃ//

༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ri khrod dgon pa'i gnas 'di na/ che med chung med spyil po brtsigs// rnal 'byor bdag kyang spyil po brtsigs// gzhi skye ba med pa'i ri bo la// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i spyil po brtsig /lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo ba dang*// gnyis su med pa'i 'dam pa gnyis// rig pa'i ye shes skyes bus brtsigs// phyag rgya chen po'i lam mas phub// de rnal 'byor pa yi spyil bu yin// da spyil bu de la skyes bu gcig 'tshal// spros dang bral ba'i ye shes la// ma 'ongs ma byung de rang de bzhin// mtha' dang bral ba gnyug ma'i don// de nyid mngon gyur skyes bu bzhugs// skyes bu de la lha gcig 'tshal// skye med lhan cig skyes pa'i lha// da de la 'bul ba'i mchod pa 'tshal// phyi dang nang gi mchod pa 'di ltar ro// rgya mtsho chen po'i yon chab la// nyi ma zla ba'i mar me ste// ri rab de bzhin me tog te// mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa// ye nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub// nang gi mchod pa 'di ltar ro// lhan cig skyes pa'i lha de la// bde ba chen po mchod pa 'bum// rang lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du// 'khor lo lnga'i pho brang na// zag med bde chen thig le'i rgyun// ngo bo de'i mchod pa 'bul// da de la bsgom pa'i gdams pa 'tshal// 'khor lo lnga'i pho brang du// a shad haṃ gi thig le la// byang chub sems dang ye shes rlung*// gnyis med cig tu ye shes bsgoms// de nyid ngo bo phyag chen nyid// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgoms// da bsgom pa de la 'bras bu 'tshal// 'bras bu dmigs su med pa yin// med kyang ku re bgyis pa yin// bsgom pa mthar phyin bsgom chen dang*// mkhas pa'i ston pa ma lus pa/ bdag gi tshig 'di bzod par gsol// zhes pa'i mgur 'di bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du sbyar ba'o/// /shubhāṃ//

༈ na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dam chos rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mnyam med phyag chen lta ba rtogs// de ltar gyur pa'i ri khrod pa// gang na 'dug kyang e ma ho/ 'od gsal phyag chen bya ba 'di// mtha' bral yin par go lags pas// chos sku mngon gyur e ma ho// rang sems sangs rgyas yin pa la// ma rig 'thibs po 'di nyid kyis// bsgribs pa 'di nyid gsal re ran// da yang 'gro drug snying re rje// bde ba'i gnas su drang du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// 'khor ba'i gnas na 'khyam pa rnams// myur du drang bar mdzad du gsol// kye ma ma dag sems can rnams// sangs rgyas kun gyis thugs rje yis// rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa// 'di dag thams cad drang du gsol// de bzhin gshegs pa bcol ldan 'das// 'gro ba'i ston pa thams cad mkhyen// gser mdog can gyi gsung bzhin du// thams cad de ltar bsgrubs na legs// rjes su 'brengs na byang chub thob// thams cad byang chub thob bya'i phyir// bdag nyid ri khrod dgon pa ru/ 'dug cing bsgom par bgyi lags na// byang chub myur tu 'thob lags kyi// de ltar kun kyang bsgrub bar mdzod// lar cis kyang dam pa'i chos mdzod cig shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// da ltar snang ba col chung pas// 'das ma 'ongs gi dran pa stor nas 'gro// de bas ma yengs bsgom par rigs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'di// theg pa'i mthar thug phyag rgya che// snying po don gyi lta ba 'di/ ma yengs nyams su len par rigs// lar 'chi ba rgyun du ma bsams na// mi rtag yud tsam la gtad pa med// lar 'chi ba cis kyang yong ba yin// cis kyang ri khrod dgon pa 'grims// 'di lta'i dbyangs chung dam pa 'di// bsgrub gnas dpal gyi khyung rdzong du// mi rtag dran nas bkod pa yin// de ltar kun gyis mkhyen par mdzod// ces pa 'di bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du gsungs pa'o// shubhaṃ//

༈ na mo rat+na gu ru/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// zhabs kyi rdul la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag 'dra'i las ngan ri khrod pa// a tsa ma na yi re mug /pha bla ma 'gro mgon thugs rje can// sprang chos ma nus la byin gyis brlobs// rje mi mngon dbyings nas byin gyis brlobs// ri khrod dben par sdod pa la// byams dang snying rje'i bla ma de// ma yengs bdag la yong lags kyang*// de ma rtogs pa yi re mug /kye ma bla ma rin po che// byin gyis brlobs cig sprul pa'i sku// gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rje// thugs rjes bzung gcig bla ma rje// dus 'dir bdag cag byin gyis brlobs// 'gro ba ma lus drang du gsol// da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// chos gzhan la bshad kyang nyan mkhan med// kye ma snyigs ma lnga'i dus// 'di 'dra byung yang a tsa ma// pha bla ma 'gro mgon thugs rje can// sems can rnams la byin gyis brlobs// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag 'dra rang byung rdo rje yis// rjes 'jug gang zag slob ma la// 'di ltar gdams pa 'di zer ro// bdag 'dra rnal 'byor 'di nyid ni// bslabs bsgoms shes rab med lags kyang*// gong ma'i gsung la brten byas nas// cung zad byas pa 'di la gson// dang por mi lus thob nas kyang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i gdams ngag dang*// rang gi brtson 'grus chen po dang*// bsgrub pa mtha' ru bton pa na// bdag kyang de la shin tu dga'// de ltar bsgrubs na shin tu legs// bla ma gong ma'i gzhung bzhin du// pha bla ma'i gsung la brten nas ni// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim pa dang*// ri khrod du yang gdams ngag bsgom// thabs lam gnad du bsnus byas na// mi bdag kyang de la shin tu dga'// pha dam pa'i rjes su bsgrub pa dang*// dam pa de la goms byas nas// mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad la// snying rje'i 'du shes bsgom par bya// khe dang grags pa'i bsnyen bkur dag

/spangs la dam pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrub// snyan grags bdud du shes byas la// de dag spangs par gyur pa na// de la bdag yid shin tu dga'// 'di lta bu ru mdzad par zhu/ ༈ bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ snying po yang dag phyag rgya che// don la 'gro 'ong ma mchis kyang*// kun rdzob da ltar snang ba la// bden pa med par ma gtogs par// gzung dang bdag 'dzin dag gis su// yang dag don mchog ma rtogs par// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras snang ba la// rig dang ma rig nyon mongs dang*// shes bsgrib 'thug po dang bcas pa// blun rmongs khyod kyis 'di lta bu// sgribs dang nyon mongs rnam rtog tshogs// bzang ngan rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rgyu// zhen 'dzin chen pos bcings pa rnams// gting nas yang dag gcig nyid min// don dam bla'i spyod yul min// blo ni kun rdzob yin par bshad// 'dzin dang shes bya ngo bo nyid// bzang ngan rnam rtog bsam yas pa// 'khor ba'i blo'i khyad par las// ma byung rang bzhin ye shes rdzogs/ kun gzhi'i bsgrib g.yogs 'thug po 'di// sgrib pa chen pos dus kun tu// ma rig sgrib pa'i log rtog mkhan// yang dag don 'di mi bsgom par/ 'dzin pa sna tshogs dang bcas pas// 'di 'dra'i mtshan nyid ma shes sam// 'di 'dra'i gtan tshigs ma go yang*// 'dzin pa med pa'i sems nyid la// rang dbang dam pa ma thob pa'i// bdag 'dzin dang bcas 'khrul pa dang*// nyon mongs dang bcas 'khrul pa 'di// shes rab chen pos bsal re ran// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// rgyud la de nyid 'byung re ran// e ma ngo mtshar de lta bu// zab mo snyan rgyud brda yis stan// 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag 'di/ skal ldan kun gyis go bar mdzod// bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du gsungs pa'o// shubhāṃ// ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// mtshur phu'i bsgrub gnas chen po khyung rdzong du bzhugs pa'i dus su/

nyin gcig gnas skabs su phyi rol gyi snang ba bden pa med par gzigs nas mgur gsungs pa/ ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba 'dren par byin gyis brlobs// phyi rol snang ba chos kyi sku// bden pa med pa yin lags pas// ma rig sgrib g.yogs 'thug po yis// 'dzin pa'i mngon zhen dam po byung*// sa brlangs mched pa'i sprin bzhin du/ las dang rkyen gyis du mar byung*// gson dang skyes bu skal ldan kun// dbyar dgun dus kyi 'pho 'gyur ltar// ma rig rkyen gyis 'byung ba yi// sna tshogs du mar snang ba 'di// skye ba med par ma shes pa// snang ba sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms/ bden pa'i dngos por ma lta cig zhen med bsgoms cig skal ldan kun// 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'thug po 'di// ro gcig chen po'i ngang du ltos// bden med sgyu ma ma skyes na// tshig gi tshogs kyis ci zhig bya// gson dang skyes bu skal ldan kun// deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// chos brgyad skyong ba'i slob dpon rnams// chos brgyad mgo bo mi 'joms par// byang chub thob la ma re cig /deng sang dus kyi ston pa rnams// rgyal ba'i gsung don ma rtogs par// tha snyad tshig phyir 'brengs pa yi// sgra don rtogs la ma re cig /deng sang dus kyi bsgom chen rnams// gong ma'i mdzad spyod mi mdzad par// skyid du re ba'i ri khrod kyis// sems nyid rtogs la ma re ang*// deng sang dus kyi btsun pa rnams// gzhan don lhur len mi mdzad par// ngo lkog can gyi tshul khrims gyis// mtho ris thob la ma re ang*// deng sang dus kyi sngags pa rnams// rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi bsrungs par// zhe sdang rang sar bsreg pa yis// yi dam grub la ma re ang*/ deng sang dus kyi rnal 'byor tsho// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mi lta bar// rgyal khams phyogs med bskor ba yis// 'khrul pa 'jig la ma re ang*// deng sang dus kyi yon bdag rnams// bsod nams tshogs chen mi bsags par// rang 'chis sdug tshir byed pa tsho// mtho ris thob la ma re ang*/

snyigs ma'i sems can gdul dka' yang*// khyad par can gyi skyes bu rnams// mdzad na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod// bsgom na phyag rgya chen po bsgoms// gtong na sbyin pa phyogs med thong*// rgyun du bla ma dam pa brten// dbyangs 'di gang yin zer tsa na// rgyu 'bras bsten pa'i zur tsam lags// 'thad par 'dug na nyams su long*/ shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlobs// gson dang 'dir bzhugs skal ldan rnams// bdag tshe 'dir thos bsam ma bgyis kyang*// skal pa mang por sbyangs pa bgyis// de phyir tshe 'dir 'bad mi 'tshal// de yang sngon du rgya gar yul// slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub kyi// slob ma dam par gyur pa ni// klu'i byang chub ces byar gyur// de dus chos rnams ma lus bslabs// de'i rjes su rgya gar yul// paṇ+ḍi tar ni gyur nas kyang*// sde snod rnams dang rgyud sde la// shin tu mkhas pa gcig kyang yin// de'i rjes su slob dpon mchog /pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya yi// slob ma rgyal mchog dbyangs su ni// gyur nas rnying ma'i chos rnams dang*// khyad par rdzogs chen rnams la mkhas// de'i don gyis ma bslab shes// de nas yang ni paṇ+ḍi ta// gcig tu gyur nas chos kun la// shin tu mkhas shing yon tan rdzogs// de nas gzhan yang pu to ba// ces bya bar ni gyur pa dang*// kha rag bsgoms chung 'brel ba yod// des na de'i chos la mkhas// de'i rjes su sne zur ba// chen po nyid du gyur pa yin// de nas dpal ldan karma pa// zhes byar gyur te 'gro kun gyi// don rnams thams cad rdzogs par byed// de ltar bdag gis thos bsam dang*// bsgom pa rnams la skye ba rung*// 'bad pa du ma byas pa yis// 'di ru 'bad rtsol mi 'tshal bar/

chos rnams kun shes rtogs par ldan// khyed 'dir bzhugs rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod// nor 'khrul gda' na bzod par gsol// mad kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// dbyangs mchod par bzhes shig 'dir bzhugs kun// sa pho khyi lo ston zla'i tshes brgyad la// mtshur phu'i dben gnas khyung rdzong du tshogs kyi mchod pa mdzad pa'i dus su gsungs pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ rje grub thob rnams la gsol dam 'debs// rnal 'byor bdag la byin gyis brlobs// da ltar gyi snang ba 'di dag kun/ yang dag mtshon pa'i gdam ngag yin// gson dang 'di bzhugs skal ldan kun// tshig 'di la 'dir bzhugs gsan par zhu/ 'di ltar nam mkha'i dkyil shed nas// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba des// mun nag 'thibs po sel bar byed// lo thog rnams kyang smin par byed// don la sbyar na 'di ltar yin// rang byung chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ ye shes nyi ma shar bar byed// rtogs pa mchog ldan bla ma yin// ma rig thibs po sel bar byed/ gdul bya'i dpal du 'gyur bar byed// da yang 'di ltar mtshon par byed// yon tan 'byung bzhi'i ri bo 'di// ljon shing sngo ldom tshogs rnams rgyas par byed/ sems can rnams la dpal du che// 'gro ba rnams la mchog tu phan// rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi bla ma 'di// 'gro ba sems can rnams la phan par byed// bla ma mchog la mi zer ram// 'dab skyes pad tshal skyon med pa// bung ba'i tshogs rnams nyams dang ldan// khyad par 'phags so e ma ho// khyad par mchog gi bla ma de// phyogs bcu'i gdul bya thams cad kyis// nyams myong rtogs pa 'dri ru phyin// 'di ma nor ston pa gal yang che// dbyangs 'di kun gang yin zer tsa na// gnas lugs mtshon pa rdo rje'i glu// dbyangs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod par 'bul/ thugs dgyes par mdzod gcig 'di bzhugs kun// zhes pa'i mgur 'di sa pho phag gi lo dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum la khyung rdzong dpal gyi yang dgon du dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du gsungs pa'o// shubhāṃ//

༈ na mo gu ru/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bka' brgyud rnams// bdag la byin gyis brlab du gsol// dus da res khyod kyi ngo ma chog /bcu phrag bzhi po dbyangs su len/ phyogs med dgon pa bsten dang gcig /na ro'i chos drug bsgom dang gnyis// snod ldan gdul bya de dang gsum// bla ma mtshan ldan de dang bzhi// de tsho 'dzom na bzang ba lags// snying rus dang zhe bcad bsgom sran gsum// ri khrod du 'dzom na bzang ba lags// phyogs cha bsgrubs blo 'di don gsum// zhen log skyes na bzang ba lags// khe grags dang zhe 'dzin gnyen po bzhi// 'ching byed lags so spang bar mdzod// de ru bzhi tshan rnams lnga thal// da yang lnga po bsdus nas len// sku bzhi'i don mtshon ma nor len// rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i ma nor don// don sku bzhi yin no skal ldan kun// rgyud bzhi'i smin grol 'byung ba dang*// don 'bras bu bzhi po thob par shog /de bzhi tshan lnga bsdus lags so ang*// dbyangs tshan bzhi bzhi bcu thal// sho lo ka la nges pa med// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig 'dir zhugs kun// zhes pa 'di phag lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gsum la khyung rdzong du gsungs pa'o// shubhāṃ// ༈ rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor bdag la byin gyis rlobs// dbyangs 'di la 'dir 'tshogs gsan par zhu// don 'di ltar gda' thugs la zhog /rje btsun mi la'i gsung bzhin du// 'di la dang phyi ma bar do gsum// bya long rgyud bzhin gral la 'grigs// skye dang na dang 'chi ba gsum// kha dang lag pa'i tshul du gda'/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum// dpag chen mda' bzhin sngon du sgugs// 'gyur med 'phrang gsum de na gda'// ci las rgyu 'bras zer ba'i ya mtshan can// thams cad mi rtag rgyud la bskyed// 'di ltar shes shing goms byas nas// las mi dge bcu las bzlog pa dang*/

dkar po bcu la 'dun pa dang*// de ltar mdzod la kun rdzob tu// bsod nams tshogs la 'bad pa thon/ don mthar thug 'di ltar nyams su long*// dgung nam mkha'i dbyings la mtha' dbus med// de ltar sems la'ang mtha' dbus bral// chu bo chen po'i gzhung 'di la/ rgyun chad med par gyur pa bzhin// dgag bsgrub med pa'i don de la// rgyun chad med par ma yengs par// ri khrod dgon pa bsten bya zhing*// don mchog bla mas bstan pa ltar// gang la'ang zhen pa bral ba yis// mthar thug don de rtogs par mdzod// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po ni// don gang yang grub pa ma yin pa'i// mthar thug gi lta ba ya mtshan can// snying po'i don mchog phyag rgya che// rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs pa bzhin// nyams su long cig 'dir bzhugs kun// dbyangs 'di kun gang yin zer tsa na// 'di kun dpe don mtshon pa'i dbyangs// dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo bla ma rje// don dam mthar thug rtogs par shog /shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// 'khor 'das snang ba chos kyi sku/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po la// brjod bya bden pa ma mchis kyang*// da res mtshon pa'i dbyangs cig len/ kye ma gson dang chos mdzad kun// bden pa med de spros las 'das// rang bzhin kun rdzob snang ba 'di// rnam rtog dri bral brda yis mtshon// de dbyer med rang byung snying po'i don// rje grub thob rnams kyis rtogs pa ni// chos rnams thams cad mnyam pa nyid// gdod nas dag cing blo las 'das// gzung du med cing brjod du med// mtha' dbus med pa'i don rtogs na// de'i 'bras bu chos kyi sku// don 'di gang gis mkhyen pa dang*// ma nor mngon du 'gyur bar shog /rang bzhin ku re'i tshul du blangs// dbyangs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod par 'bul// zhes pa'i mgur gong 'og 'di gnyis// phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum la yon bdag chos rgyal gyis gtor dbang zhus pa'i tshogs gral du gsungs pa'o/// /

༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// kye ma 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na// gzung 'dzin gyis bcings skye bo rnams// gzung 'dzin dra bas rgyud bcings te// sdug bsngal dpag med gnas su 'khor// ma rig 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog mang*// 'khor ba'i me dong tsha zhing rtsub// gti mug mun pa'i dpag rum 'thims/ skye rgas na 'chi'i chu bo che// nga rgyal brag ri gzar la mtho/ phrag dog rlung dmar dpag med 'khrug /tshig ngan tsher ma bzhin du rno// blo ya nga'i skyes bu mi brtan pas// nga bdag 'khrul pa lam du zhugs// de las bzlog par dka' ba'i phyir// rgyal dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ thugs rje'i sprin phungs dpag med kyang*// deng sang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus// 'gro kun nyon mongs gyis bcings pas// gzung 'dzin grol ba dka' ba gda'// kye ma gson dang chos mdzad kun// 'jig rten chos kyis 'ching 'ching 'dra// da ni skye med lta re ran// zang zing g.yengs bas 'ching 'ching 'dra// da ni yod tshad btang re ran// nor dang rdzas kyis 'ching 'ching 'dra// da ni gang la yang 'du 'dzi spongs// 'tsho rdzas zas kyi 'ching 'ching 'dra// da ni dka' thub nyams su longs// 'khor dang g.yog gis 'ching 'ching 'dra// da ni gcig pur ri khrod 'grims// gnas dang yul gyis 'ching 'ching 'dra// da ni rgyal khams phyogs med bskor/ kun rdzob bden pas slu slu 'dra// da ni don dam bden med ltos// gson dang skyes bu chos mdzad kun// 'di ltar ma rungs snyigs ma'i dus// blo gros ngan pa'i skyes bu kun// gzung 'dzin mngon zhen dam pa'i phyir// yun rings 'khor ba'i 'dam du bcings// de phyir bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams// thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal sras kyis// 'chi ba 'di las bkrol du gsol// gang zhig bdag ni 'ching 'grol yang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag

/thog mar sems bskyed mdzad pa'i tshe// gang zhig sems can gcig nyid kyang*// sdug bsngal bcings las ma grol tshe// sa bcu'i cha lugs 'chang zhes gsungs// bdag kyang de'i rjes 'jug phyir// bdag med mngon du gyur nas kyang*// 'gro rnams 'ching ba las grol tshe// bdag kyang 'gro don spyod par shog /rang byung rdo rjes stag lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga la 'gro phur gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// chos nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i don// rtogs par 'dod na 'dir ltar mdzod// snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin no// med bzhin snang ba'i dngos po 'di// nam mkha'i sprin bzhin shes par gyis// chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi don// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// ci bzhin 'dzin pa med pa'i don// nam mkha' lta bur bsgom par bya// bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin la// tshul bzhin rjes su 'jug 'dod cing*// brtson pas nyams su len byed na// mid la'i mdzad pa ji bzhin mdzod// 'di ltar bshad pa'i don 'di ni// bden gnyis gtan la 'bebs byed pa// bdag gis tshigs su brjod pa 'dis// 'gro rnams bde chen thob par shog /rang byung rdo rjes 'brug lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu la lha steng zhes bya'i ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ chos dbyings rgya mtsho lta bu la// sna tshogs chu'i ri mo bzhin// bden med rnam rtog du mar 'char// de phyir bdag gis nyams su len// gsang sngags zab mo ma rgyud la// bsod nams mthar thug tshogs 'khor lo// gang zag bsod nams spel phyir gsungs// de don bdag gis 'di ltar shes// da ltar gang zag dman pa la// mos pa'i spyod pa'i dus 'di ru// rang lus lha ru gsal btab te/ bza' btung bdud rtsir rab sbyangs te/ phung po rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod// tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes kyang bya// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor pa// grags mnyam yon tan thob pa rnams// bde stong ye shes don dam bsgoms// bza' btung tshogs kyi 'khor lo ldan/

tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes kyang bya// dpa' bo thams cad mngon 'dus pas// dpa' bo'i dga' ston zhes kyang bya// slob dpon gsang sngags tshul shes shing*/ dbang bskur rgyud smin de nyid shes// slob ma dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin brten pa na// tshogs la dngos grub dpag med 'byung*// de ltar min ldan skyes bu rnams// nga rgyal log par spyod gyur na// bar chad 'byung bar rgyal bas gsungs// bdag gis tshogs 'khor ma mthong yang*// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa glu ru blangs// gnad kyi gdam ngag de la mdzod/ yid ches ngo mtshar cher bskyed nas// 'dir bzhugs tshul bzhin bsgrub par mdzod// 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nub mo lha steng dpal gyi dgon pa ru// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gral du rang byung rdo rjes skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gdams pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'di la 'dir 'tshogs gsan par zhu// mtha' bral gnyug ma snying po'i don/ bram ze'i rgyud las byung ba lags// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad// skal ba bzang mo'i brgyud pa lags// bskyed rim lha'i 'khor lo 'di/ lu hi pa nas brgyud pa lags// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i snang ba 'di// bir ba pa nas brgyud pa lags// bka' bzhi brgyud pas byin brlabs nas// ci bzhin rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// tai lo nā ro'i brgyud pa 'dzin/ lho brag mar pa lo ts+tsha dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la mchog de'i rjes 'jug sgam po pa// rgyal ba'i gdung sob dus gsum mkhyen// bka' rgyud 'dzin pa'i ras chen pa// don rgyud 'dzin pa'i spom brag pa// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad rin po che// brtul zhugs spyod mdzad u rgyan pa/ de dag sras gyur rnal 'byor bdag /don mthar thug bsgom par 'dod nas kyang*// lha steng zhes bya 'di ru phyin// brtags shing brtags ni 'di ltar shes// skye 'gro sems can gzung 'dzin dam// 'khrul pa'i snang ba mgo bo rgod// bdag 'dzin sems can bsgribs g.yogs 'thugs// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud rnams// phyin ci ma log rtogs pa de// deng sang nam mkha'i me tog 'dra// ye shes chen po'i snang ba 'di// rtogs dpyod blo'i sgribs pa 'dra// bsgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgya mtshan 'di// phrag dog ba mo'i sad kyis khyer// 'dir bzhugs skyes bu skal ldan rnams/

myur du byang chub thob 'dod na/ dad pa ye shes rta pho la// sems bskyed gsal ba'i sga khra gtad// brtson 'grus myur ba'i lcag brabs nas/ bla ma thar pa'i lam mkhan rjes/ myur du ring par 'gro re ran// go na gnad kyi gdams pa lags// ma go da ltar bre mo mdzod// 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu'i nub mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su rang byung rdo rjes skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gdams pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi/ skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams/ ma yengs dar cig snyan gsan mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug /'jigs pa'i chu bo chen po las/ thar bar byed pa shin tu dka'// gal te thar ba 'dod pa na// dri ma med pa'i mdo rgyud las// gsungs pa'i don rnams ji lta bar// ma yengs gus pas nyams su blangs// bslab gsum dri med gtsang mar gsungs// pha rol phyin pa drug gis don// tshul bzhin nyams su len byas na// myur du 'khor ba'i 'dam las thar// gsang bsngags rgyud sde'i dgongs pa kun// bskyed rdzogs gnyis med pa yi don// bdag med rnams kyis rtogs bya'i phyir// rgyun chad med par nyams su long*// mthar thug dbyer med snying po'i don/ spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yis// chos rnams kun kyi de bzhin nyid// de nyid mngon du gyur par nges/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags nyid// tshul bzhin nyams su blang bya'i chos// cung zad bdag gis brjod pa 'di// tshul bzhin nyams su len par mdzod/ ces pa'i mgur 'di rang byung rdo rjes 'brug lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la lha steng*// zhes bya'i ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi/ thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor dpag med kyis// skal ldan rnams la byin gyis brlabs// da lta ma rig snyigs ma'i dus// bstan pa nyams par gyur pa yis// log pa'i lam la gzhol dus 'dir// gzung 'dzin spongs cig skal ldan kun// dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa ru// rin chen zhal gyi gdams pa rnams// yengs med brtson pas nyams su blangs// myur du 'khor ba las thar 'gyur// gnas skabs nyams kyi yon tan la/

ched 'dzin med par rang grol du// sgyu ma lta bur sbyang par bya// 'di nyid bsgom pa'i mthar thug yin// rgyal bas mdo las gsungs pa yi// bla ma rnams kyis legs bshad pa// gcig tu dril ba'i gdams pa 'di// ma yengs nyams su blang bar mdzod// sbrul lo zla ba bcu pa la lha steng zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du rang byung rdo rjes gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khyab bdag dngos kun rang bzhin can// ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khor byed cing*// rtogs pas de nyid lam bsten pa'i// kun bdag khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can// bye brag phung po lnga yi bdag rdo rje rnam gsum bdag nyid kyi// 'di nyid don la rab brtag pa// ye shes rdo rje ston 'di'o// gang du rta bdun rgyal po dang*// ri bong 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid can// tsha dang bsil zer rab 'phro ba'i/ yon tan sdug bsngal pha rol 'gro// dbyibs dang kha dog bral ba'i rlung*// brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can// dbu mar rab tu zhugs pa'i thabs// de 'dir thabs rnams grub par byed// de 'dir rtsa ba'i bdag nyid can// rnam gsum rnam pa lnga rang bzhin// sum bcu rtsa gnyis rab dbye bas// zla ba nyi ma'i gsal byed do// de 'dir ma rtogs steng 'gro ba'i// dbang po'i lam nas 'jug byed pa// yul la rab tu rgyug pa'i sems// sgra gcan khar ni gzhug par bya// tshangs pa'i gnas ni mthar thug dang*// 'og tu klu dbang 'khyil pa'i bar// nyi zla skar ma'i bdag nyid can// thams cad dbang du 'gyur byed do// bcu drug phyed phyed rang bzhin can// mi 'phrogs bdag nyid ma yi gzugs// dpyid dang thig le rab bshad pa// 'di ni sa gsum bdag nyid do// rgya mtsho'i gting du rnam grol zhing*// ri bo'i rtse ni snang byed pa// glog dang kun dha'i 'od ltar gsal// de'i rin chen gter 'grub bo// 'dis ni ye shes pha rol 'gro// 'dis ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i bdag

/mchog dang thun mong la sogs kun// 'di las 'byung gis gzhan du min/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog gyur pa// te lo shes rab bzang po'i bka' drin gyis// rtogs pa rang byung rdo rjes sbyar// rdo rje theg par 'jug 'dod cing*// shes shing rtogs par 'dod pas kyang*// 'di nyid don la 'jug par bya// gzhan dag phyi rol gyur pa yin// rang byung rdo rje yis sbrul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu la lha steng su mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ rje 'gro ba'i dpal mgon rin po che// bdag gzhan dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gnas// bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'dzam gling snying po bod kyi yul// ri bo byang phyogs rgyud 'di ru/ tshul bzhin nyams su len byed pa// mi la mchog la gsol ba 'debs// de'i rjes 'jug 'dod pa rnams// bsgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams// thog mar bla ma dam pa bsten/ byin brlabs yon tan 'byung bar nges// dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir// yang dag rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// 'jug cing nyams su blangs pa na// rang bzhin don gnyis 'grub par nges// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad// zab don rgyud las gsungs pa ltar// ma nor rtsal sbyongs gnad du bsnun// myur du 'khor ba las thar nges// stong nyid snying rje'i ngo bo nyid// dbyer med gcig tu nyams blangs shing*// mdo rgyud rgyun du goms byas na// theg dman gyi gol sa chod par nges// de dag mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin// phyogs gcig bsdus nas brjod pa lags// 'dir bzhugs kun gyis nyams su long*// nor 'khrul kun gyi bzod par gsol// dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje yis// dben gnas ri khrod lha steng du// sbrul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i// nyi shu lnga'i dus su yang*// smin grol rigs gtad gnang dus gsungs/// /

༈ na mo gu ru// yon tan kun 'byung gzhir gyur pa// bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can rnams// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// tai lo nā ro mar pa dang*// mi la dwags po dus gsum mkhyen// rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de'i rjes su 'jug byed pa// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje ni// tshul bzhin sbyangs pa ma byung yang*// rgyal ba'i byin brlabs zhugs pa yin// zab mo'i mdo rgyud kun gyi don// phyogs med rang grol mkhyen pa rgyas// nyams su len pa'i gnad shes pas// bsgrub pa dang du len pa yin// deng sang bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// dge bshes kun kyang g.yeng bas khyer// chos mdzad kun kyang le lor gyur// de dus brtson 'grus bya re ran// dam chos bya'o snyam lags kyang*// le lo 'khrul pa'i bdud kyis khyer// long yod snyom las mi tshe zad// brtags shing brtags shing 'jigs pa skye// 'di ltar snyigs ma'i dus dag tu// rtse cig nyams su blangs byas na// ma nor gdams pa'i rtsal sbyangs nas// bla ma'i rjes su slob par mdzod// chos tshul bzhin nyams su ma blangs na/ bsod nams che yang dgos pa med// bsod nams bdud kyi g.yab mo yin// mkhas rnams de ltar mkhyen par mdzod// da ltar dal 'byor thob dus 'dir// thar pa'i lam sna ma zin na// mi tshe stong log byed nyan yod// de phyir thams cad brtson 'grus bskyed// bla ma'i gdams ngag seng ge'i zho/ 'chi med bdud rtsi thob dus 'dir// gang zag skal bar ldan pa rnams// rtse cig 'bad pas nyams su long*// 'di ltar mgur du brjod pa 'di// rtse cig nyams su blang ba'i thabs// cung zad ngag du brjod pa lags// de ltar kun gyis mkhyen par mdzod// 'di'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// bla med byang chub thob par shog /'gal dang nor 'khrul gyur pa rnams// bla ma rnams la bzod par gsol// rang byung rdo rjes sbrul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu drug la lha steng du gsungs pa rdzogs so/// /

༈ na mo gu ru/ thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor dpag med cing*// snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kun khyab pas// don gnyis grub pa'i mngon rtogs can// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// e ma 'khor ba'i snang ba 'di// sgyu ma mkhan pos sprul pa ltar// brtags shing brtags nas snying po med// de ltar 'khor ba'i zhen 'dzin spongs// spros bral zab mo'i de nyid ston// rnam par rtogs pas rtogs mi 'gyur// mtha' yas gting dpag dka' ba de// ma nor nges par gtan la phob// deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// rgyal sras rnams kyang mi bzhugs shing*/ dam chos dman pa gyur pa na// le lo ma byed brtson 'grus bskyed// mdo las gsungs pa'i dben gnas kun// rgyal bas shin tu bsngags pa'i phyir// lus dang srog la ltos med pa// brtson 'grus chen pos dang du blangs// 'di ltar ngag tu brjod pa 'di// lha steng zhes bya'i ri khrod du// mang po 'tshogs pa'i khrom bseb du// 'brel med tshig tu brjod pa yin// shubhāṃ// sbrul lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu drug gi nyin par mang skol gong tu chu gtor bsngo ba'i zhor la gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dpal 'bar ba/ 'gran gyi do med spyi gtsug brgyan// bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir// tshul bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// 'jug par 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun// kho bo'i tshig 'di go bar gyis// theg chen yon tan kun gyi gzhi// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma yin// gus pas rgyun du bsten par bya// dngos grub kun gyi gzhi ma lags// tshogs gnyis bsags sbyangs rab 'bad nas// sgrib gnyis bag chags byang byas te// sku gsum yon tan thob byed pa// lam dang 'bras bu'i mthar thug yin// de ltar rgyun du sbyong byed pa// gnas skabs 'bad pa dpag med pas// ma nor gdams pa nyams blangs na// zhen 'dzin rtsa ba chod par nges// 'khrul pa rang sar dag byed pa// nyams su len tshul brjod pa yin// de ltar nyams su len par mdzod// mthar thug bde chen thob par shog

/rin po che rang byung rdo rje yis// sbrul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu drug la sbyar ba rdzogs so// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu ste// med bzhin snang ba'i rang bzhin la/ ma skyes gnyug ma'i ngo bo ru// go zhing rtog na mkhas pa yin/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin du// rang gi sems dang dbyer med par// go zhing rtogs na byin brlabs 'byung*// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad// rgyun chad med pa'i rten 'brel te// rgyun mi 'chad par bsgom gyur na// myur du bag chags sgrib pa sbyong*// bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyi tshogs// rang byung chu'i ri mo bzhin// zhen med lam du gtad lags na/ ngo bo'i gnas lugs mthong bar nges// shubhāṃ/ ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kyi gdams pa thob nas kyang*// tshul bzhin bsgrub par byed pa la// 'dod pa dang gzung 'dzin ma spangs na/ longs spyod bdud kyi khyer ba 'dra// des na sred pa'i zhags pa chod// rang sems kyi rta rgod brtson du bzung*/ sgo lnga'i shes pa rig tur 'di// dran pa ma yengs par yar la skyur// chos kun ngo bo stong pa la// gnyis su rtog pa'i lta ba spongs// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa// rten cing 'brel 'byung gi tho bas chom// ma rig lta ba'i zag pa gnyis// stong nyid snying rje'i g.yang la bskyur// 'dod dang sred pa'i zag pa de// thabs kyis sgyu ma lta bur sbyongs// dug lnga'i rnam rtog rkun bu 'di// ma 'gags ngo bo nyid la ltos// stong zhing gsal ba'i rang sems la// yid dpyod kyi dri ma dngas su chug /rtsa ba kun gzhi'i rnam shes la// rtog pa'i chos kyis slad mi bya// e ma ya mtshan 'di lta bu// chu dang gser dang nam mkha' dang*// rlung dang me tog mi gtsang pa// ri dang me tog me dang ni// sgyu ma smin lam me long dang*// brag chag 'ja' tshon yid bzhin nor// bco lnga po 'di mthong lags sam// 'di rnams mthong bar bya ba'i phyir// dge slong bu chung ro dang gsum// gcig pu rnam par lta bar bya// rang byung rdo rje'i 'khrul gtam yin/

༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can gyis byin gyis brlobs// da ltar snang ba dkar dmar 'di// snang stong sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can// 'di nyid phyogs med rtogs byed pa// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin// yin phyir de la 'bad par bya// 'dzin byed shes pa rig tur 'di// spros bral lam du 'char byed pa// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ yin phyir mtha' la gnas mi bya// da ltar ma rig skye bo'i dus// thabs kyi yan lag sbyong byed pa// ma nor rgyud kyi snying po ltar// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad// rgyun chad med par bskor ba gces// ma nor thar pa'i lam ston pa// dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral bya/ dad pa'i sa bon rab dngas pas// rgyun chad med par gsol ba gdab// de ltar bsgrub pa'i spyod pa ni// bas mtha' dgon par ri dwags bzhin// 'khor bar skrag bcas dang po yin// ya nga med pa seng ge ltar/ 'khor ba skrag bcas gnyis pa yin// bu gcig pa yi ma bzhin du// gnas pa'i rgyal sras spyod pa bzang*// 'di 'dra'i tshul la sbyong byed na// gnas ni bas mtha' dgon pa'ang*/ nags 'dab shing drung brten par bya/ gos ni phyag dar khrod bor ba'i// dbugs bral rjes su mthun par bya// zas ni sna tshogs bya bzhin du// zhen med pa yi tshul du byas// 'di ltar nyams su blangs byas na// mi rtag 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di// sdug bsngal rnams la spong ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur ba snyam// zhes bya ba 'di nyams la shar nas rang byung rdo rje bdag gis bris// shubhāṃ// ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon sbyangs las 'phro ldan pa yi// skyes bu bsgrub la gzhol ba rnams/ nyams len gnad 'di yin pa snyam// dmigs bcas 'bad pa du ma rnams// dmigs med 'od gsal rtogs pa'i thabs// las dang po'i gang zag la/ gnas cha yod kyang gsal cha med// de phyir sgo lnga'i shes pa 'di// ma dag ngo bo nyid la ltos// las dang po'i gang zag la// gsal cha yod kyang bde cha med// des na yul sems snang ba 'di/

bde ba'i rol par khyer cig ang*// las dang po'i gang zag la// bde cha yod kyang stong cha med// des na dga' bzhi'i ngo bo de// skye med stong par rgya yis thob// gsum ka yod pa'i rnal 'byor kyang*// dran pa'i thag pas ma bzung nas// rgyu mthun gyi bag chags mi mdzad pas// yengs ba med par dran pas bzung*// thams cad 'bral med yongs lags kyang*// bsam gtan rtsal sbyong mi byed na// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mi 'char bas// lta stangs kyi bye brag 'bad la sbyongs// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob lags kyang*// thabs mkhas snying rje ma sbyangs nas// gzhan gyi 'phrin las mi 'byung pas// bsdu dngos rnam bzhi phul du byung*// de ltar 'bad nas mthar thug tu// rgyal sras kun gyis rab rtogs pa// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa rnams// brten cing 'brel par 'byung chos can// de la der 'dzin rab dag pa// rtogs pa 'di ni stong zhing bzod/ kun la rgya yis btab pa ni// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o// de 'dra'i don de rab rtogs nas// dus mthar gzhan don bsgrub par bya// bzod pa bstan la 'bebs pa'i glu// rang byung rdo rjes yig ger bkod/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gis nyams su ma myong na// gzhan gyis brjod pa tha snyad yin// bla ma'i byin brlabs ma zhugs na// tshig la mkhas kyang zin med yin// dad pa gting nas ma skyes na// kha spyang che yang sdug skad yin// sred pa rtsad nas ma chod nas// bya bral byas kyang gzugs brnyan yin// snying rje gting nas ma skyes na// gzhan don byed pa zog po yin// 'du byed rtsa ba ma chod na// rkyen rtog chom yang lo ma yin// snang ba sgyu mar ma rtog na// tshor ba bkag kyang gti mug yin// spros bral rgyud la ma khel na// lta ba zer yang kha lta yin// cir snang thad kar ma grol na// bsgom pa bzang yang 'khor ba'i lam// gang byas don du ma 'gyur na// spyod pa'i 'jig rten las ma 'das// zag pa bral bar ma gyur na// 'bras bu zer na yid smon yin// snang ba dpe ru ma shes na// dpe cha mang yang dum bu yin// chos don rgyud la med pa na// bshad lung mang yang 'jog rgyu yin// dbang bskur sems la ma thob na// bka' lung ma yang bum stong yin// bskyed rdzogs brtan pa ma thob na// slob ma bsdu ba gzugs brnyan yin// dbang thob dam tshig mi bsrung na// dmyal bar 'khrid pa'i sna thag yin// thos pa nyams su ma blangs na// sangs rgyas bka' dang 'gal ba na// rdo rje dmyal ba'i sa bon yin// nyams su blangs nas zhen gyur na// lta ngan nang du zhen pa yin// 'dzin pa gang gis bcings gyur kyang*// bdud kyis zhags pas bcings pa yin// des na rang byung rdo rje la// rang gis bskul phyir bris pa yin// mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs nas// mthun pa'i don de bsgrub pa yin// mthun dang mi mthun gnyis ka yang*// zhen pa med par sbyong ba yin// rta'i lo la lha steng du// rtogs pa'i dum bu bris pa yin// shubhaṃ//

༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mchog gi sprul pa rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas mi gzugs can// grub thob rnams kyi byin gyis brlobs// dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnyed zer zhing*/ theg chen chos dang 'jal bar bka'// myur du brtson 'grus bskyed na legs// myur du brtson pa bskyed nas kyang*// mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa dpag med la// the tshom bral bar brjod bya zhing*/ bas mtha' ri khrod dgon pa na// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dang du blang*// de ltar bla ma rnams kyi gsungs// gal te brtson 'grus ma bskyed na// tshe mi rtag rtsa kha'i zil pa 'dra/ myur du g.yo zhing 'gro ba'i phyir// yengs med brtson 'grus bgyid kyang 'tshal// 'di ltar brtson pas nyams blangs na// rang gzhan 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir// yengs ba med par bsgrub par bya// rta lo zla ba bcu cig pa'i nyi shu la lha stengs kyi ri khrod du rang byung rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// phyi rol snang ba sna tshogs 'di// chos kun mtshon pa'i brda ru go /theg pa chen po'i sa gzhi la/ pha rol phyin pa'i sdong po skyes// shar phyogs sbyin pa'i sdong po de// chags pa med pa'i gzhi la skyes// lho phyogs tshul khrims sdong po de// nyes skyon med pa'i gzhi la skyes// nub phyogs bzod pa'i sdong po de// khong khro med pa'i rtsa ba can// byang phyogs brtson grus kyi sdong po de// le lo med pa'i gzhi la skyes// mtshams bzhi bsam gtan gyi sdong po de// g.yeng ba med pa'i rtsa ba can// dbus shes rab rnam dag gi sdong po 'di// 'chal pa med pa'i gzhi la skyes// grogs byang chub sems kyi sdong po 'di/ snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can// de ltar thabs kyi sdong po bdun// rten cing 'brel 'byung gi yan lag can// longs spyod chen po'i lo 'dab ste// sbyin pa'i sdong po las skyes pa lags// bde 'gro thob pa'i lo 'dab de// tshul khrims kyi sdong po las skyes pa lags// mtshan dang dpe byad lo 'dab de// bzod pa'i sdong po las skyes pa lags// thogs med grub pa'i lo 'dab de// brtson 'grub kyi sdong po las skyes pa lags// g.yeng ba spangs pa'i lo 'dab de// bsam gtan gyi sdong po las skyes pa lags// thar pa thob pa'i lo 'dab de// shes rab kyi sdong po las skyes pa lags/

gzhan don bsgrub pa'i lo 'dab de// snying rje'i sdong po las skyes pa lags// de ltar phun sum tshogs pa las// sa lam rdzogs pa'i me tog can// rtsal sbyangs 'bad pa'i rkyen gyis ni/ don gnyis grub pa'i 'bras bu smin// de ltar mdo la gsungs pa can// ljon pa'i dpe dang sbyar ba 'di// sprang po rnal 'byor rdo rje yis// spangs kra'i gnas su blangs pa lags/ ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyi brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'dzam gling byang phyogs bod kyi yul// ri bo gangs can shar gyi phyogs// sa khol du byung ba'i skang chung du// khyad par kol ti'i gtsug lag 'dir// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje'i yis// gzhan yi rgyud tshod mi shes kyang*// dus ngan bstan pa'i mar 'grib kyi// byed pa cung zad 'di ltar mthong*// chen por 'dod pa'i dge bshes rnams// bag med le lo'i dbang du gyur// khe dang grags pa'i 'dab du bying*// sha dang chang gi ro la chags// bstan la gnod par mi 'gyur ram// rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa yi// rab tu byung bar 'dod pa rnams// tshul chos ngos lkog byed pa mthong*// ngan song gi sa bon ma byas sam// bsgom par 'dod pa'i bsgom chen rnams// nyin par zang zing gi g.yeng bas khyer// mtshan mo gti mug gi gnyid du song*// nang nub 'dod yon zas phyir 'brengs// de ltar g.yengs bar gyur pa yis/ rang rgyud grol bar cang 'gyur ram// nus par brlob pa'i sngags pa rnams// tho co snying khams la brten cing*/ gzhan la gnod par byed pa rnams// rang rgyud bsreg par mi 'gyur ram// khe grags 'dod pa'i yon bdag rnams// dad pa'i dad pa mi bskyed par// mi dge'i spyod pa bsgrub pa rnams// ngan song gsum du mi ltung ngam// de ltar ngag tu brjod pa 'di// skye ba'i yid kyis rab bskul nas// gzhan dag nyan par mi 'gyur yang*/

nam mkha' stong pa khyod la smras// da ni rnam pa thams cad du// zang zing g.yeng ba mi bskyed cing*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams pa ltar// rtse cig nyams su blang bar byang*// mgur 'di rang byung rdo rjes ngo khro'i nang 'khrug bsdums pa'i dus su// kol ti'i gtsug lag khang du lug lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu brgyad la yi ger bkod pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma rje// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon rin po che// 'gran gyi do med gtsug gi rgyan// pha bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'di la 'dir bzhugs gsan par zhu// sngon tshe rgyal bas gsungs pa yi// mdo rgyud lung dang bstan chos kyi// dgongs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa// gdul bya rnams kyi don du gsungs// de'i rjes 'jug skyes bu la// gsal bar ston mdzad bka' brgyud rnams// rin chen 'od kyi dra ba can// phreng ba rgyus pa lta bur snang*// de'i rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pa// dpal brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dgongs pa ltar// tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yin// phyogs med mkhyen pa'i blo gros 'dis// kun shes kun rig mngon du gyur// phyi nang gol grib sems la chod// mkhas pa min kyang bzod pa tsam// phyogs med rgyal khams ma 'grims kyang*/ thams cad bsam gtan cig tu shar// g.yeng ba mi spong grogs su chod// bsgom chen min yang bzod pa tsam// phyi nang gzhan gsum de bzhin nyid// mkha' la 'dza' tshon snang ba bzhin// gsal stong snang ba lam me tsam// sngags pa min kyang bzod pa tsam/ gcig shes kun grol shes pa 'di// rnam pa kun mkhyen rtogs pa ltar// gsal 'grib med par rgyun du gnas// mngon shes med kyang bzod pa tsam// phyogs med ri khrod ma 'grims te// rang lus dgon pa dben par rtogs// gang snang tshogs drug rtogs par shar// gcig tu sdad kyang bzod pa tsam// rang sems skye med mnyam pa nyid// g.yo med nam mkha'i dkyil du tshud// rnam rtog rol pa sgyu mar rtogs// phyogs med phyin yang bzod pa tsam// tha mal shes pa gnyug ma 'di// rnam rtog skyon gyis gos pa med// 'dzin med chos sku'i ngo bor snang*// kun rdzob zhen yang mi 'ching tsam// sems byung rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di// sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing du shar// dag snang gzhan du mi 'tshol bas// thams cad mngon dgar 'gyur ram snyam// byung tshor rtogs pa thams cad kyang*// mkha' la bya'i rjes bzhin du// dmigs su med pas bde ba che// bde ba can dang tha dad med// 'di ltar ngag tu brjod pa 'di// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yis// rnam rtog phreng ba ngag tu brjod// cung zad thal na bzod par gsol// ces pa'i mgur 'di rang byung rdo rjes mtshur phu'i ri khrod phug mo cher khyi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum gyi mchod pa'i dus su bkod pa'o// shubhaṃ//

༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na/ gnas pa'i 'gro rnams thugs rjes bzung*// dus ngan bstan pa'i snyigs dus su// rgyal ba bstan pa mar 'grib tshe// chos tshul bzhin byed pa brgya la 'ga'// phal cher bdud kyi dbang du gyur// rgyal ba'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar// bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs rnams kyang*// phal cher zang zing rjes su 'brangs// ri khrod dgon par sdod pa nyung*// bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa ltar// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i gang zag med/ gzhan don dgongs pa mdzad rnams kyang*// mi bzhugs yongs su mya ngan 'das// de ltar gyur pa'i dus 'di ru// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// myur du thar bar 'dod pa rnams// bla ma rnams kyi bka' bzhin bsgrubs// rgyal ba'i gsungs la nan tan bskyed// dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa brten// 'jig rten zang zing 'khri ba chod// ma nor gdams pa nyams su long*// chos kun sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms// bdag med spros bral rgya yis thob// de ltar nyams su blangs byas nas// bla med byang chub ring por min// de ltar ngag tu brjod pa 'di// dben gnas jo mo'i gangs 'gul du// nyams la shar nas blangs pa yin// phag lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la yi ger bkod/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyi rlabs par mdzad du gsol// phyi'i yul la phar bltas pas// rmi lam shes pa tur gyis dran// nang 'dzin pa sems la tshur ltas pas// rang gis rang gsal tur gyis dran// chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid// de don rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// bla ma rnams kyi mdzad pa ltar// rtse cig nyams su blang bar bya// de ltar nyams su len pa la// sems byung rnam par rtog pa 'di// 'du 'dzi'i rjes su 'brengs pa 'phangs// dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa der// dang po nyams su blang blangs nas// bar bar stong par bzhag pas phangs// des nas tshul bzhin nyams su long*/

phag lo zla ba brgyad pa la// gangs dkar kyi mgul mar me phug par rang byung rdo rjes sbyar/// / ༈ rje bla ma dam pa chos kyi sku// lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid// bde chen rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol pa 'di// mngon du rtogs par byin gyis brlobs// e ma ngo mtshar snying po'i don// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rdo rje yis// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i chos mdzad la// rnam rtog phreng ba'i 'phrin gcig zhu// ma yengs legs par dgongs mdzod la// nyan shes ldan pa'i snyan du skyol// bdag thog ma med pa'i bag chags la// mngon zhen 'khri ba btang lags pas// da lta dngos 'dzin 'ching ba zhig /gzhi shes kyi nga rgyal bdag la med/ 'di go ba can gyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis/ bdag ma rig khang pa rab spangs shing*// 'dod sred nor rdzas rgyang du 'phangs// sred pa'i khyim nas thon lags pas// da lta bde chen gnas su slob/ 'di zhen 'dzin can gyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// bdag sbyin pa phyogs med btang yang*/ bde sdug yul la mngon zhen spangs// chos kyi longs spyod rtsol med 'dus// byang chub sems kyi 'phrin las 'di// mi nor 'dod rnams kyi snyan du skyol/ rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrub lags pas// rang 'dod bsgrub pa'i bsam pa stor// bsam pa nyes pa'i dri ma dag /tshul khrims mthar thug yin par nges// 'di btsun pa rnams kyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// gzhan gyi brnyas pa ma byung yang*// zhi bde'i 'dod pa ring du byas// gzhan don sgyu ma'i rol par spyod// 'di bzod pa mchog tu gyur bar go /'di gzugs brnyan rnams kyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// bdag tsab tsub sdug gzer ma byas kyang*// spyod lam rnam bzhi'i rol pa rnams// thar pa'i grogs su chod par nges// le lo'i dri ma dag par go

/'di brtson 'grus can gyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// bdag bgrod dka'i ri sul ma 'grims kyang*// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i gzugs// mngon sum rtog bral ngang du 'dres/ 'di srid rtse gcod pa'i bsam gtan yin// 'di bsgom chen rnams kyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// bdag gnas lnga rig par ma gyur kyang*// thos pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs chod/ chos kun rten 'brel gcig tu gyur// 'khrul rtog dag pa'i shes rab yin// 'di mkhas pa rnams kyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// bdag brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ma spyad kyang*// phung po'i zhen pa lha ru snang*// sbyang gzhi'i rtog pa dbyings su thim// 'dzag med ye shes mngon gyur pa// 'di sngags pa rnams kyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// bdag rnam mkhyen kyi sa la ma phyin kyang*// zhi bde'i 'bras bu 'dod pa med/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes lags pas// gnyis 'dzin gyi re dogs bdag la med// 'di rgyal sras rnams kyi snyan du skyol/ rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// de ltar rgyal bas gsungs bzhin du// phyogs med kyi sprang po kun tu rgyus// snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo la// phan par bsams nas tshig tu sdebs// 'di skal ldan rnams kyi snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// skal med rmongs pa'i sems can rnams// 'di ltar bstan yang mi go zhing*// mngon sum gyur kyang the tshom pas// log lta can gyi skyes bu rnams// thar pa'i rigs chad gang zag zhes// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis/ khe grags byed pa'i yon bdag dang*// sdom pa med pa'i 'dul 'dzin dang*// lo 'dod can gyi ston pa dang*// blun bsgom byed pa'i bsgom chen de// 'bad kyang don go med do zhes// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// the tshom byed pa'i zhig po dang*// dam tshig med pa'i bsngags pa dang*// chad par lta ba'i rtogs ldan dang*// mtshams med spyod pa'i gang zag rnams// thug med gting du lhung ngo zhes// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// e ma yang dag lam chen dang*// lam min khyad par bstan pa 'di// rgyal ba'i bka' dang mi 'gal bar// tsa ri'i zhol du blangs pa 'di// phyogs med rnams kyis snyan du skyol// rang byung rdo rjes zer ro gyis// rgyal khams yongs la 'phrin skyel ba'i mgur 'di// grub thob chen po rtsangs pa rgya'i 'phrin skyel la rten nas// byi ba lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu dgu la// rang byung rdo rjes glang gong du sbyar ba'o/// /

༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// bla ma mchog gis byin gyis brlobs// rgyal ba'i gsungs rabs dri med la// sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor 'di skad lo/ lus 'di rdo rje'i gnas lugs la// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum// sems nyid gnad dang rnam pa bzhi// don rnams gcig tu ma sbyangs na// gnas lugs yon tan shes pa dka'// de la gdams pa 'di skad lo/ thog mar lus 'di grub pa'i tshe/ dkar dmar nyi zla'i bdag nyid dang*// rlung dang bar do'i rnam par shes// ma rig rkyen gyis mtshams sbyar nas// mngon byang lnga'i lus su grub// rdo rje'i gnas lugs dang po lags/ 'bum phrag bzhi po 'das nas ni// zhag re nyis brgya rtsa chags pas// zla ba bcu gnyis bar dag la// stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis byung*// brgya las nyi shu lhag pa dang*// sum cu rtsa gnyis bdag nyid 'di// rtsa'i gnas lugs gnyis pa lags/ thog mar nam mkha'i rlung las ni// lnga lnga'i bdag nyid nyi shu lnga// nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya la// drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga'i// rnam par dag pa'i ye shes lnga// rlung gi gnas lugs gsum pa lags// khu khrag dkar dmar ye shes kyi// kun rdzob don dam dbye ba yis// steng dang 'og dang 'byung 'jug cing*// dbu mar rab tu gnas pa dag /'gro ba'i rnam shes rten pa 'di// thig le'i gnas lugs bzhi pa lags// rtsa ba kun gzhi'i rnam par shes// phung po khams dang skye mched kyi// rtsa ba sa bon thams cad pa// rnam rtog brgya bcu'i shes pa nyid// lhan cig skyes pa rab sbyor ba// sems kyi gnas lugs lnga pa lags/ gnas lugs lnga'i bsdus pa 'di/ ma khyab pa ni rdul tsam med/ des na rdo rje'i theg pa la// zhugs shing bsgrub par 'dod pas kyang*// 'di dag lam du blang bar bya// de ltar rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// thog mar bla ma'i drin thob nas// smin byed dbang bzhi thob nas kyang*// bskyed rdzogs lam la legs sbyangs zhing*// nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu 'byung*// de las khyad par rdzogs rim kyis/

'chi med gnad kyi man ngag 'di// steng du gnas pa'i gza' lnga po// brtan par bcings pas rtsa dag cing*// 'og tu 'gro ba'i sgo gnyis po// rnam par sbyangs pas las su rung*// rtsa sbyang gnas lugs bsdus pa lags// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bcings pa yis// yan lag rlung lnga brtan par 'gyur// steng gi sbyor bas 'og bcings la// 'og gi sbyor ba steng du bcings// dbu mar rab tu sbyor ba las// dus me las su rung bar byed// sgra gcan ye shes mi 'gyur bde// rlung gi sbyor ba bsdus pa lags// thur du 'gro ba'i zla ba dag /steng gi sbyor bas gsal bar 'dzin// steng du gnas pa'i zla ba yang*// sa 'og me yis bsreg par byed// dngul chu'i sgra ni me yin zhing*// khams kyi sgra ni bha ga zhes// spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal nas gsungs// thur sel gnas su brtan gyur pas// dbu mar tshes kyi rim par 'pho// rdo rje 'bebs pa rmad byung pas/ steng gi bram ze sgo ru 'thon// sgra gcan zla ba g.yo med pa// dus me nyi mas rab sbyangs pas// rjes su dran pa bcu drug go /dag cing ldan par gyur pa'i tshe// thig le'i sbyangs pa rdzogs pa yin// da ltar ma rig 'khrul rtog tshogs// bzang po'i yul la 'dod chags shing*// ngan pa'i yul la zhe sdang dang*// bar ma btang snyoms gti mug rnams// dag cing rtogs par gyur pa yis// rnam rtog ye shes rol pa rgyu// tshogs drug rang sar sbyangs pa las// gzugs sku'i 'phrin las mngon gyur zhing*// sems kyi rdo rje rab dag pas// chos sku'i 'phrin las phun sum tshogs// ye shes rnam par dag pa yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// rgyal sras rnams kyi rtog pa dang*// bla ma rnams kyi gdams ngag dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams myong rnams// gcig tu rtogs nas bshad pa yin// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbus na yang*// de las lhag pa gzhan na med// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i glu/

rang byung rdo rje'i ming can gyis// zab don ngag tu brjod pa 'di// mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol// 'di brjod pa'i bsod nams kyis// rdo rje'i gnas lugs mngon gyur shog mgur 'di rang byung rdo rjes byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum la tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo gnas sgo dpal gyi glang gong du sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba 'dren par byin gyis brlobs// 'dir 'tshogs skyes bu skal ldan rnams// ma yengs dar gcig snyan gsan mdzod// 'dzam gling byang phyogs bod kyi yul// khyad par gnas mchog chen po 'di// kun gyis bgrod pa rab dka' bas// rdo rje brag ri'i tshogs kyis bskor// chu klong sna tshogs phyogs med 'bab// ljon shing me tog tshogs kyis gang*// lha dang lha min mi'am ci// 'byung po kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas// phyi ni dkyil 'khor rnam pa can// nang ni rang byung lha'i tshogs// ngo mtshar can gyi grub gnas na// 'di don rnal 'byor rnams kyis kyang*// nang don rtogs na dngos grub 'byung*// de phyir mdo tsam bshad par bya// spyir rang gi phung po'i lus 'di yang*// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i don// ma rtogs dbang gis dngos por snang*// rtogs na rtsa rlung byang chub sems// dbyer med a ba dhū ti la// khyad par 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus// rang gi lhan cig skyes pa'i rten// byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun 'bab// yan lag nying lag thams cad kun// rtsa gnas ljon pa'i tshogs kyi brgyan// dbang po'i me tog 'bras bur bcas// phyi ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba 'dis// shin tu dam par bskor ba'o// nang na lhan cig skyes pa'i don// rang sems 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas// de don mngon du zhal gzigs nas// rang byung tsa ri mthong bar nges// khyad par gzhi mnyam gnas mchog na// lhan cig skyes pa'i bla ma yang*// e baṃ bzhi'i rang bzhin du// mchod rten mngon du rtogs pa yang*// lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba che// rang sems rdo rje mthong ba yin// nang dang phyi rol dbyer med pa// rang sems gnas lugs mtshon pa 'di// 'dir bzhugs rnams kyi snyan du phul// rgyas par slad kyi mkhyen par mdzod// ces pa'i mgur 'di byi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum la gnas mchog chen po dpal gyi tsa ri tra'i dben gnas chen po bkra shis ljongs su tshogs kyi mchod pa'i dus su rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// shubham̐/// /

༈ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bka' drin can// yid bzhin nor bu sprul pa'i sku// kho bo'i spyi gtsug brgyan du bzhugs// gzhan snang dag par byin gyis brlobs// dben gnas bgrod pa'i bsgom chen rnams// rang lus dben par ma shes na// phyi'i dben pas dgos pa chung*// rang sems bla mar ma shes na// tha snyad kyi bla mas dgos pa chung*// snang ba dpe char ma shes na// yig nag po tis dgos pa chung*// nyon mongs kyi dgra las ma rgyal na// khe grags kyi dgra rgyal dgos pa chung*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba ma spangs na// tshul 'chos chos kyis dgos pa chung*// thams cad sems su ma shes na// phyi snang ba'i yul gyis dgos pa chung*// zas zhim mngar gyi zhen pa ma bral na// don med kyi tshogs 'khor dgos pa chung*// blo dang chos su ma 'dres na// don med sdom pas dgos pa chung*// don chos dang mthun par ma byung na// mgur ma'i dbyangs kyis dgos pa chung*// thams cad don la ma g.yos na// de kho na nyid du rtogs pa na// rgyal ba'i thugs dang nye ba lags// don bstan bcu'i dbyangs chung 'di// skal ldan rnams gyi go bar mdzod// mgur ma 'di ni byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum la// tsa ri tra'i ljongs zhes bya bar mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ /bla ma dam pa rin po che// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// ma rig rmugs pa dngas pa na// phyi'i na bun 'thibs kyang bzod// ye shes nyi ma shar ba na// phyi'i nyi ma nub kyang bzod// rnam rtog char pa zad pa na// phyi'i char pa bab kyang bzod// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa rtogs pa na// phyi'i cong rong gzar yang bzod// zhe sdang gi tsher ma med pa na// phyi'i tsher ma rtsub kyang bzod// sred pa'i chu bo skam pa na// phyi'i chu bo 'brub kyang bzod// nga rgyal ri bo non pa na/ phyi'i ri bo mtho yang bzod// ting 'dzin zas kyi ro myong na// zas kyi rnam pa med kyang bzod// nyon mongs shing rong med gyur na// phyi'i shing rong 'thibs kyang bzod// bzod pa brgyad kyi dbyangs chung 'di// skal ldan rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod// ces pa'i mgur 'di rang byung rdo rjes pad phug tu 'gro ba'i lam du sbyar ba'o/// /

༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad chos kyi rje// snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'dzam gling brgyan// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bzhugs skal ldan skyes bu rnams/ ma yengs dar cig gsan par zhu// phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa rnams// rang lus dben par ma rtogs shing*// khyad par gnas mchog tsa ri tra// bsam gtan gyi grogs su ma shes shing*// sdug bsngal sgrib sbyong du ma shes na// za 'dod glo lam bgrod pa 'dra// yi mug thang chad dpag med 'byung*// sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing rnams// bsam gtan sems kyis ma sbyangs na// don med cong rong tsher mar mthong*// de phyir rang snang dag par sbyong*// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog rkun ma 'di// dben gnas chen por 'bros kyang 'ong*// zhen med sems dang ma phrad na// gang du sdad kyang khyad par med// rang sems rnam dag lhan cig skyes// bsam gtan dag pa'i lha tshogs rnams// gzung 'dzin rkyen gyis ma sgribs na// mngon tu rtogs par gyur pa na// phyi'i ri khrod bas mtha' rnams// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror gyur// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnams// thams cad chos kyi phung por 'char// de phyir rang snang dag kyang 'tshal/ gzung 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa na// de ltar rtogs par 'gyur ba yin// dben gnas bgrod pa'i bsgom chen rnams// sdug bsngal sdig pa'i phyags ma yin// bar chod dngos grub 'gyur ba dang*// snang ba lha'i rnam par 'gyur// rang sems dri ma dag pa na// 'bras bu'i mchog tu 'gyur ba yin// de go bar gda'am 'dir bzhugs rnams// rnam rtog phreng ba'i dum bu 'di// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// thams cad de la dgyes par mdzod// mthar thug mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'i mgur 'di// rang byung rdo rjes byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun la gnas mchog chen po dpal gyi tsa ri g.yu mtsho 'gram du gsungs pa'o/// /

༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri trar// bde chen nyams myong dbyangs su len// 'dir bzhugs ma yengs snyan gsan zhu// bde chen sems la ma rtogs na// tshig kha la brjod kyang dgos pa med// gdar sha sems la ma chod na// tshig tha snyad mkhas kyang dgos pa med// rnal 'byor mngon sum ma mthong na// rjes dpag bsgom la dgos pa med// rang lus dben par ma shes na// dben gnas bgrod pas dgos pa med// rnam rtog dben par ma shes na// dben pa bsten yang dgos pa med// gcig shes kun grol ma shes na// tha snyad mkhas kyang dgos pa med// rnam rtog chos skur ma shes na// bzang por 'dod kyang dgos pa med// rtsa ba sems su ma shes na// 'khrul pa'i rtog pas dgos pa med// dbyangs 'di gang yin zer tsa na// dgos med brgyad kyi chos dbyangs lags// 'khrul pa gda' na bzod par gsol// ces pa'i mgur 'di rang byung rdo rjes byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu gnyis la tsa ri bkra shis ljongs su sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ 'og min gnas mchog dam pa na/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// gsol 'debs byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byin brlabs sems la zhugs pa na// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char// shri na ga ra dza'i dgon pa na// rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa// tai lo pa la gsol ba 'debs// la sogs pa gong ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o// pu la ha ri'i gnas mchog na// bka' ba spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nā ro pa la/ lho shing lo 'tshal gyi dgon pa na// gsang sngags don rtog rnal 'byor pa// rje lho brag pa la gsol ba 'debs// gangs kha ba can gyi gnas mchog na// rlung sems gnyis kyi de nyid rig /rje mi la mchog la// shar dwags lha dpal gyi gnas mchog na// rgyal bas lung bstan sprul pa'i sku// rje dwags po lha rje la// kam po gangs ri'i gnas mchog na/

tshad med thugs rje'i rang bzhin can// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la// 'og min kar ma'i gnas mchog na// smin grol dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// rje ras chen pa la// shar phyogs spungs ri'i gnas mchog na/ bka' rgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// rje pu n+ya badz+ra la /stod lung mtshur phu'i gnas mchog na// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad rin po che// rje karma pa la// bde chen rgyal ba'i gnas mchog na// brtul zhugs mchog gi rtsal rdzogs pa// rje u rgyan pa la// gsol 'debs byin gyis brlab du gsol// byin rlabs sems la zhugs pa na// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char// ces pa'i gsol 'debs bro brdung ma 'di ni// rang byung rdo rjes byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyi shu gnyis la tsa ri bkra shis ljongs su mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ dkar po'i yon tan rab rdzogs shing*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho// 'gro blo'i ma rig sel mdzad pa// sku drin can gyi zhabs la 'dud// bdag 'dra glu len mi rigs kyang*// gsang bsngags kun spyod gnas skabs su// rgyal ba'i snang ba thob pa'i phyir// re shig ma yengs gsan par zhu// kye ma bstan pa snyigs dus su/ chos tshul bzhin shes pa shin tu dkon// bsgrub pa byed pa brgya la 'ga'// mngon rtogs thon pa nyin skar tsam// gzhan don bsgrub pa'i skyes mchog rnams/ sangs rgyas zhing khams gzhan du bzhud// kye ma brtson 'grus bskyed re ren// theg chen bla ma dang 'jal nas// de'i rjes su mi slob pa// bdud kyi zhags pas zin pa lags// des na bla ma'i bka' bzhin du// chos tshul bzhin nyams su blang bya zhing*// ri khrod bas mtha' bsten par bya// 'jig rten gzung 'dzin khri ba chod// gdams ngag kun gyi rtsa ba yin// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos kun gyi// gnas lugs snang stong zung du 'jug /gsal dag sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul// bden min rdzun min gnyis ka min// blo 'das chos nyid rol pa'i ngang*// lta ba'i gnas lugs yin par nges// lta ba bzhed rnams 'gyes par mdzod// zung 'jug brjod pa'i spros bral yang*// thogs med bag chags sbyang ba'i phyir// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i nyams// gcig tu 'dres pa'i dbyings nyid nas// bsam dag rjen pa rig pa'i ngar// ma yengs dran pas zin pa de/

bsgom pa'i gnas lugs bsdus pa lags// bsgom pa bzhed rnams thugs dgyes mdzod// bcos ma tho cos ma slad cing*// rgyal ba'i gsungs dang mi 'gal bar// gzhan gyi snang bar mdzes pa de// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i spyod 'gros ltar/ shugs 'byung rang dgar skyong shes pa// goms pas rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub// spyod pa'i mthar thug yin pa'i phyir// spyod pa bzhed rnams thugs dgyes mdzod// lhan cig skyes pa'i rig pa 'di// sgrib pa kun dang bral ba'i tshe// gsal dag yid bzhin nor bu yin// sangs rgyas yon tan rdzogs pa de// byas pa ma yin rang byung yin// sku gsum ye shes rdzogs pa'i phyir// 'bras bu'i mthar thug yin par go /'bras bu bzhed rnams thugs dgyes mdzod// lta bsgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i glu// rgyal ba'i bka' dang mi 'gal bar// rang sems steng du dril ba 'di// rnal 'byor min yang rnal 'byor tshul// bdag gis ngag tu brjod pa yin// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig skal ldan kun// bkra shis pa'i chos dbyangs de la mdzod// ces pa'i mgur 'di/ rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rjes/ byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyi shu gsum gyi nub mo/ bkra shis ljongs su tshogs gral du gsungs pa'o/// /shubhāṃ/// // / ༈ gnas bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid du bzhugs// gsol 'debs byin gyis brlab du gsol// byin brlabs sems la zhugs pa des// bde ba can du 'gro ba lags// gnas lho nub srin po'i grong khyer na// gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// u rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas bzhugs/ gsol 'debs sogs gong gis 'gre// yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas na// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i mgon// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo bzhugs// gsol// rgya gar ging babs kyi dgon pa na// na ro mai tri thugs kyi sras// te pu chen po la gsol ba 'debs// shar phyogs gangs ri'i gnas mchog na// mi la ras pa'i thugs kyi sras// ras chung pa la gsol ba 'debs/

gsol/ zang ri dpal gyi gnas mchog na// gsang sngags don gyi de nyid gzigs// zang ri ras pa la// gsol/ shar phyogs kar ma'i gdan sa na// phyogs med 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// 'gro mgon ras chen pa la gsol ba 'debs// dag snang chos sku'i gzhal yas nas// bka' rgyud rnams kyi che ba ston// spom brag pa la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal khams yangs pa'i dben gnas na// spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid du byin// karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan stengs na// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug chos kyi mdzod// bde chen 'gro don dpag med mdzad// gsol 'debs byin gyi rlabs du gsol// byin brlabs sems la zhugs pa des// bde ba can du 'gro ba lags// rtsa ba rgyud par bcas pa la// mos pa'i dbang gis gsol btab na// sangs rgyas zhing du sleb pa lags// sangs rgyas zhing khams rnam dag gi /gnas der ngan song ming yang med// rin chen sna tshogs 'od 'bar zhing*// me tog sna tshogs lhag par brgyan// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag med 'bab// bde ba can du 'gro ba lags// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang*// bde ba can gyi bsngags pa brjod// gnas de sangs rgyas zhing khams lags// de na thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bzhugs// spyan ras gzigs dbang dran pas ni// bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur// bka' brgyud kyi gsol 'debs chen mo 'di ni/ bla ma rang byung rdo rje'i byi ba lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyi shu bdun la gnas tsa ri'i bkra shis ljongs su gsungs pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ rtsod ldan dus kyi sprul pa'i sku// 'gran gyi do med 'dzam gling brgyan// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis brlobs// gson dang 'dir bzhugs skyes bu rnams/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yis// dang po chung ngu'i dus nas kyang*// rgyal ba'i bstan la shin du dad// 'gro ba yongs la snying rje bskyed// bla ma rje yis thugs la btags// gzhan don phyogs med mi grub kyang*/

'gro la snying rje ci nus bsgom// thos bsam gyi shes rab mi che yang*// mdo rgyud gnyis la blo sbyang byas// ri khrod 'grim pa ma byung yang*// ci nus rang sems dben pa bsten// 'dul bzhin btsun por ma bsgrubs kyang*// chad du bcas pa'i khyad mi bsad// gsang sngags kyi spyod pa ma bsgrubs kyang*// lus ngag sems la bying ba med// gzhan don phyogs med ma bsgrubs kyang*// rang don 'grub pa'i sems dpa' med// de phyir rnal 'byor rdo rje 'di/ shi yang rung la gson yang rung*// de gcig tsa ri tra ru phyin// ngo mtshar cho 'phrul mang po mthong*// skye 'gro kun la brtse ba'i sems// snying rje chen po rgyud la skyes// sprul sku sangs rgyas gnyis pa bzhin// dam pa rnams la nges shes thob// de nas yar la 'ongs ba'i tshe// thogs med bag chags rgyu lus kyis// dkrugs pa'i lus 'di mi bder 'gyur// nub gcig nyams kyi snang ba la// gnas chen gyis phyogs thams cad kyang*// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// sgrib pa med par gsal bar shes// sna tshogs sems can khams rgyud rnams// ji bzhin gsal bar mngon du byung*// de ltar gsal zhing snang ba'i tshe/ deng sang snyigs mar bab pa'i phyir// gsang sngags dar la ma smin pas// ma go ba'i bdud rigs mang ba'i phyir// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen 'di// bod kyi gangs chen rgyud 'di na// ring por mi thogs 'jig 'gyur snyams// rang gi lus kyi gnas lugs kyi// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum// de kho na'i gnas lugs cig tu rtogs// rnal 'byor 'chi yang bzang ngo snyams// rnam rtog kha la nyan pa med// gzhan snang sna tshogs bzod do snyams/ 'dir bzhugs rnams la zhus pa lags// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rang byung ste// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin bsgrub pa thang*// nyon mongs ye shes gnyis med pa// rtse gcig steng du 'dres lags pas// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol pa bzhin// spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs ston// ngag kyang rnam pa sna tshogs smra// sems sgyu ma'i rol pa cig tu 'dres// de ltar snang ste dus ngan gyi// skye bo rnams kyis de mi shes// gzhan phan 'bras bu med gyur na// rnam dag zhing du 'gro yang snyams// de ltar rnal 'byor gzugs can rang byung gis// lus sems mi bde dbang gis su// dus 'dir de skad zhus pa lags// dag pa'i gdul bya sna tshogs pas// 'dul zhing phan par gyur pa na// 'khor ba ci srid gnas kyang ran// des kyang ngag tu brjod pa yin// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang*// bde chen sa la 'god par shog

/khyad par bdag dang 'brel ba rnams/ bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces pa 'di g.yor po gung gsal lhun grub sgang gi dgon par tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gral du'o// shubhaṃ/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyi brlab par mdzad du gsol// rang sems rmu rgod gyong po 'di// thul bar byin gyis brlab du gsol// rgyal ba'i bstan pa snyigs dus la// chos tshul bzhin byed pa shin tu dkon// 'on kyang 'di ltar snyigs ma'i dus// rnal 'byor bdag gis 'di skad lo// theg chen bla ma dang 'jal nas// dad gus rgyun 'chad mi bgyid 'tshal// dam chos rin chen thos nas kyang*// le lo tshod yod mi bgyid 'tshal// da ltar snyigs ma'i dus la bab// sdod kyang long yod mi bgyid 'tshal// bla mas gdam ngag ster dus su// da bzod zhu snyam mi bgyid 'tshal// dben gnas ri khrod 'grim dus su// 'du 'dzi'i gseb du mi sdod 'tshal// bla mas thugs la 'dogs dus su// zab mo'i man ngag blang yang 'tshal// bcud len zas la bsten dus su// zhim mngar gyi sred pa skyur yang 'tshal// gtum mo rtse cig bsgom dus su// gos dro legs sred pa bcad yang 'tshal/ mi rtag rgyud la brten dus su// rtag 'dzin gyi zhen pa btang yang 'tshal// sang 'chi gnang 'chi mi shes pas// yun ring sdod tshis mi bgyid 'tshal// lus 'di bsob kyang 'dor dgos pas// lus kyi mngon zhen spang yang 'tshal// yun ring sdod pa'i nges med pas// bstan gyi 'khar lan mi bgyid 'tshal// thams cad bzhag nas 'gro dgos pas// de bas sred pa skyur yang 'tshal/ byams pa'i nye 'brel thams cad kyang*// mgron po'i tshogs dang mtshungs pa yin// nye 'brel gnyen la sred pa spongs/ rgyun gyi gtan grogs yin pa'i phyir// tshogs gnyis bsogs la gces spras gyis/ dad dpon gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas su mos pa bskyed kyang 'tshal// thar pa'i lam la 'khod dus su/

bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub kyang 'tshal// rgyun du nye bas phan 'dogs phyir// theg chen grogs dang 'grogs kyang 'tshal/ kun gyi grogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rgyun du brtson 'grus bskyed kyang 'tshal// yon tan kun gyi gzhi yin phyir/ rtag tu rang sems gus kyang 'tshal// bla med byang chub rjes mtshon phyir// dam chos gcig tu 'dun yang 'tshal// 'khor bar 'ching ba'i gzhi yin phyir// sems kyi kun rtogs spang yang 'tshal// kun gyi rtsa ba gal che'i phyir// rang sems rig pa lta yang 'tshal/ de ltar bstan pa'i gnad de ni// lhun grub sgang gi dgon pa ru// rang byung rdo rjes brjod pa lags// go ba rnam kyis gdam ngag mdzod// ma go ba rnam nyams dga' mdzod// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang*/ bde chen lam la 'khod par shog /shubhāṃ// ces pa'i mgur ma 'di ni/ rin po che rang byung rdo rjes byi ba lo zla ba bcu gnyis tshes brgyad la lhun grub sgang gi dgon par tshogs gral du gsungs pa lags so/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs bod kyi yul// khyad par dpal gyi gangs dkar ru// dus kyi tha mar byung ba yi// rang byung rdo rjes 'di skad lo// gson dang phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad rnams/ rang gi sems nyid ma rtogs shing*/ grol cha nang nas ma shar na// sgra dang tshad ma phyi pas shes// rlung gi rtsol ba 'phyi bas shes// brag phug yun ring gla bas bzungs// dka' thub yun ring bram zes byed// rtogs pa'i 'gro ldog ma shes na// gang ltar byas kyang thar pa med// des na bdag rjes 'jug pa rnams// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'tshol 'dod na// yul gyi snang ba sgyu ma 'dra// bden par ma zhen dngos 'dzin thong*// tshor ba'i rnam rtog me lce 'dra// 'dod pa'i yul gyis ngoms pa med// 'khrul pa'i shes pa na bun 'dra// snying po med de don la ltos// rnam par rtog pa dug dang 'dra// bden par zhen na 'ching bar byed// de phyir yul dang yul can gyi// gnyis 'dzin shig la mnyam par zhog

/tshe 'di la gtad pa mi bdog gi /phyi ma'i dgos pa gtso bor bsgrubs// lar thams cad bden par mi 'dug gi /bden med gnyug ma nyid la ltos// tshig la zad pa mi 'dug gis// mtha' drug don gyi steng du zhog /de phyir tsab tsub ma mang par// bla ma'i gdams pa nyams su long*/ shubhāṃ// ces pa 'di glang lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la/ chos rjes rang byung rdo rjes jo mo gangs su gsungs pa lags so/// / ༈ rje 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bka' drin can// bde chen rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis brlob// 'dzam gling byang phyogs bod kyi yul// khyad par dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mtshams// gangs mtho 'thing lha sman rgyal mo 'di// rtsa ba rdo rje'i brag ri la// rtse mo dngul dkar mchod brten 'dra/ 'od 'bar rin chen phung po bzhin// rab mdzes gsal ba'i byang shar mtshams// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa// grub thob rnams kyis bzhugs gnas yin// chos 'byung dpal gyi dben gnas su// snyigs ma'i dus kyi ri khrod pa// rdo rje'i ming can 'di skad lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa snyigs ma la// chos tshul bzhin byed pa shin tu nyung*// bsam gtan bsgom pa brgya la 'ga'// grub rtags thon pa nyin skar tsam// de phyir skal ldan skyes bu rnams// myur du brtson 'grus bskyed re ran// theg chen bla ma brnyed par dka'// de phyir tshul bzhin gus pas brten// bla med dam chos rtogs pa dka'// de phyir chos la phyogs ris spongs// zhen pas 'khor bar 'ching bar byed// de phyir ri khrod dgon pa 'grims// yul snang gang yang bden pa med// de phyir sgyu ma lta bur sbyongs// phyi rol dgra la zad pa med// de phyir rnam rtog dgra bo thul// gti mug gnyid la rgyu mtshan med// de phyir snang ba'i rtsal sbyong gyis// phyi rol yul snang 'khrul pa yin// de phyir sgyu ma lta bur sbyongs// 'dzin pa'i sems ni bden pa med// de phyir rang gsal ngo bo ltos// gzung 'dzin don la med pa'i phyir// de phyir gnyis 'dzin shes pa shig

/gnas lugs spros dang bral bas na// de phyir thams cad phyag rgya che// gnas lugs don la thug med kyang*// gzhan la bskul phyir brjod pa yin// chos 'byung dpal gyi dben gnas su// bzhed pa'i don du blangs pa lags// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// 'gal ba gda' na bzod par gsol// shubhāṃ// gzhan la bskul 'debs kyi mgur 'di/ rang byung rdo rjes/ glang lo bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu la/ chos 'byung dpal gyi dben gnas su gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye ma dus mtha'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa/ gangs can rgyud du byung ba 'di// bka' rgyud rnams kyi gshegs shul du// brtson pa chung yang 'di skad lo// yong deng sang dus kyi chos mdzad rnams// chos tshul bzhin nyams su mi len par// lo 'dod g.yeng ba'i rjes su 'brangs// 'di cung zad bya ba nor ba lags// 'dod sred pha yul spangs nas kyang*// bstan pa'i spyi don bsgrub po zhes// gzhan gyi yul du chags sdang sogs// 'di yang 'khrul pa'i spyod pa lags// pha zhing gi so nam gshol nas kyang*// mthun rkyen gyi ldum bu byed do zhes// cung zad tsam la ma byin len// 'di yang log pa'i spyod pa lags// gnyen gyi gseb nas bros nas kyang*// mched grogs kyi zhen pa byed do zhes// don med kyi chags sdang dang du len// 'di yang 'khrul pa'i spyod pa lags// rgyal ba'i bstan la 'jug go zhes// tshul khrims kyi bslab pa blangs nas kyang*// 'di ni gong ma'i bka' yin zhes// log par spyod pa shin tu rmongs// dben par bsam gtan bsgrub po zhes// dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dor nas kyang*// lung stong du tsab tsub mang ba de// rnam rtog dgra yis g.yengs ba lags// rang sems kyi rtsa bdar mi gcod par// mkhas pa'i bag chags 'jog go zhes// yig nag gi rjes su 'brengs pa de// log pa'i lam du khrid pa lags// mnyam nyid kyi snying rje ma skyes par// sems bskyed kyi bslab bya yin no zhes/

zhen pas snying rje bsgom pa de// 'dod sred kyi 'dam du bying ba lags// rgyal ba'i bka' la mi sbyor bar// nga mkhas nga che 'dod pa'i phyir// log lta dang zur za smra ba de// ngan 'gror 'khrid pa'i sna thag lags// mnyam nyid snying rje ma thob par// bla med byang chub bsgrub po zhes// brtson 'grus 'bad pa brgya byas nas// rgyal ba'i sras las byung ba lags// rang sems kyi rtsa bdar ma chod par// yid dpyod kyi stong nyid bsgoms lags kyang*// gnas lugs kyi don la reg par dka'// de phyir thar pa thob pa nyung*// snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// rdo rje'i ming can de skad lo// gzhan la ngan brjod ma yin te// rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub kha 'dir// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa rgyal lo snyam// de phyir tshig tu 'di skad brjod// don sems la zhog cig skal ldan kun/ 'gal ba dang gda' na bzod par gsol/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi skye rab brgya rtsa gcig brtsams pa tshar ba'i dus/ stag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la bkra shis gsar mar gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye ma khams gsum 'khor ba 'dir// rang sems ma rtogs sems can kun// sred pas 'khor bar 'khrid byed cing*// len pas skye ba'i gnas su khrid// tshor ba'i nad kyis rab tu gzir// thar pa med pa yi re mug /sems gyi rtsa ba rtogs lags na/ rang sems sangs rgyas ngo bo yin// dag pa'i nam mkha' ngo bo 'dra// rkyen gyi shes pa me long mtshungs// tshogs drug rang ngo ye shes yin// de ngo shes pa a re mtshar// de ltar ma rtogs byis pa rnams// nga med cig la nga ru zhen// gzhan med gcig la yul du rmongs// gnyis med cig la gnyis su bzung*// bag chags rtogs pa'i shes sgrib dang*// blang dor rtog pa'i nyon mongs lags// ma rtog shar ba'i bsgom chen kyang*/ da rung 'du byed phugs ma chod// rang ngo shes par 'dod rnams kyang*// da rung rtog pa'i gnad ma go

/stong nyid rtogs pa'i bsgom chen yang*/ da rung mi 'dzin sgrog du tshud// rtags bcu rdzogs pa'i bsam gtan pa// da rung smig sgyu ded pa 'dra// rdzogs chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor kun// da rung rgyu 'bras don ma go /lto gos 'khri ba ma chod par// bden med kha lta'i bdud la zhen// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bsgom chen rnams// da rung 'dre la bden par 'dzin// rang ngo nang nas mi shes par// yig nag dpe la shes su re// lar thams cad rnam par rtog pa ste// 'khor ba'i gnyis 'dzin spang bya yin// phyi nang gnyis 'dzin chod lags na/ 'khor bar snang yang a'u rtsi// gang yang spang blang mi byed na// rtogs pa med kyang de gas chog /rnam rtog goms pa'i bag chags la// las kyi rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med// shes rab bral ba'i rtogs dpyod de/ 'jig rten pa rnams rab tu mang*// thabs kyis ma zin dge ba yis// 'dod khams lha'i bde ba bsgrub// bde gsal ldan pa'i bsam gtan yang*// gzugs khams lha las 'gro sa med// 'du shes bkag pa'i mi rtog pas// tshe ring po'i lha ru gol// chos kun mkha' ltar rtogs lags kyang*// nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched yin// sems nyid mkha' ltar rtogs lags kyang*// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su gol// nga med ci yang med pa de/ yod min med min srid pa'i rtse/ kye ma khams gsum yo lang la// mkhas rnams bden pa ma re mdzod// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ci bzhin du// nyams su len par 'dod pa na/ thabs kyi rtsal sbyongs gnad du bsnun// nyams kyi tshogs la bden ma 'dzin// dran ldan bsam gtan sbyangs nas kyang*/ dbyer med don dang ma bral bar// zhi lhag 'brel par nyams su long*// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul 'dod lags na// rnam gnas yid la byed pas sbyongs// 'khor ba'i 'dam la rgal 'dod na// bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed// thabs kyi gzhan don byed pa na// sgyu ma lta bur snying rje sbyongs// lar thams cad rnam rtog 'di yin te// rtogs na ye shes rol pa che// ma rtogs 'khor ba 'di yis 'jug
