/'di la sbyongs gcig skal ldan kun// zhes pa 'di snyigs ma'i bsam gtan pa dang*/ nyan bshad pa rnams kyis rtog pa'i gnad mi go bar 'dug pas bris pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ 'khor 'das rang grol mnyam pa nyid// mngon du rtogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi'i yul la phar bltas pas// rang gsal 'dzin med ngo bo mthong*// nang gi sems la tshur ltas pas// rang rig rang gsal ngo bo stong*// sna tshogs rkyen la phar ltas pas// 'ja' tshon rang gi ri mo mthong*// 'du byed rkyen la tshur ltas pas// rang grol chu'i ri mo 'dra// rnam rtog byed pa mthong tsa na/ sgyu ma mkhan po'i rnam 'gyur mthong*// sna tshogs chos kun sems kyi gnad// sems kyang rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*// rgyal dang de sras sems dpa'i tshogs// lha tshogs mdzad pa mthar phyin cing*// med bzhin snang la dbang thob pas// ma rig sgyu 'dra'i sems can 'dren// de'i rjes su zhugs nas kyang*// rtse cig nyams su blang bar bya// ngang chung bde chen yang dben du// 'brel med glu ru blangs pa yin/ shubhāṃ// yul dang sems kyi mtshang rig pa'i mgur/ mtshur phur ngang chung gi ri khar/ mkhan po sa nag pas gdan drangs pa'i tshogs gral du gsungs so/// / ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dbyangs 'di la 'dir bzhugs gsan par zhu// dgos ched 'di ltar thugs la zhog /dal 'byor mi lus thob nas kyang*// rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'jal byas nas// theg chen bla ma dang 'jal ba// chos mdzad yongs kyi rten po lags// yang dgos dbang po yang rab kun// chos gcig shes kun grol rtogs byas shing*// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// rang gi 'khri ba rab btang te// gzhan la phan par lhur len pa// rgyal ba kun gyi rab tu bsngags// dbang po rab kyi mdzad spyod lags// brtson 'grus chen po rab bskyed de// gdams pa zab mo nyams len cing*// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim pa de// grub thob kun gyis rab tu bsngags// dbang po 'bring gi mdzad spyod lags// rtse cig gi bsgrub pa ma nus kyang*// tshul khrims dag pa bsrung bya zhing*// zab mo'i bka' la thos bsam dang*// ci yod bsod nams tshogs sog pa/

dbang po tha ma'i chos lugs la/ de las log pa'i sems can rnams/ 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyam byed cing*/ sna tshogs sdug bsngal myong bar byed/ don 'di la som la lha chos mdzad// dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi gnas lugs kyi mgur 'di rgyal gyi mdor rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/// /shubhaṃ// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ ma rtogs sems can 'khor ba pas// sdug bsngal gyi khres po rgyab du khur// nyon mongs kyi thang la rtag tu 'khyam// de las log pa'i bsgom she khyod// tshul khrims dag pa'i gos gyon cing*// chos spyod dag pa'i rgyan gyis spras// tshogs gnyis kyi khres po rgyab tu khur// thar par 'gro ba'i lam rgyags byed/ khres po che yang don dang ldan// 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyal ba dang*// myur du 'jal ba'i thabs rten nas// shes rab chen pos 'dzin par 'gyur/ ces pa 'di rang byung rdo rjes rgyal gyi bsgom shes la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ rang sems chos skur ston mdzad pa// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// 'di la 'dir bzhugs snyan gsan mdzod// dgos 'dod rtogs la nyams su long*// kun gzhi 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// ma rtogs dus na 'khor ba ste// rtogs na de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs// kun gzhi'i ngo bo brjod pa la// dper na me long g.ya' dag la// gzugs brnyan 'char ba ci lta bar// rang sems dri med dbyings nyid la// sna tshogs bag chags ldang zhing 'gag// yul dang yul can gnyis 'dzin 'di// rang gi dbyings las snang ldang phyir// 'khor 'das gnyis med ngo bor gcig /ma rtogs 'khrul zhing rtogs na grol// rtogs bya rtogs byed gnyis kyang med// gnyis su bzung bas 'khor ba'i gzhi// gnyis med ngo bo mthong ba na/ rgyal ba'i snying po mngon du gyur// kun gzhi gtan la 'bebs pa'i glu// dben pa'i gnas su blangs pa lags// kun gzhi'i sgrib pa kun bsal nas// rang sems dri med rtogs par shog

/rgyal gyi mdor bsgom chen dar ma dpon g.yog la gdams pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ rten cing 'brel pa'i de nyid rig /thabs rnams sna tshogs ston mdzad pa// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs sems kyi 'char tshul la// phyi rol yul gyi gzung bar snang*// khyad par ljon pa'i me tog tshogs/ sa la skyes shing 'gag par snang*// 'di la rten pa'i dbyangs gcig len// don dgos pa gda' na thugs la zhog /kho shing mchog dang po skye ba'i tshe// rgyu rkyen drug gis rnam par dbye// sna tshogs yal 'dab du mar rgyas// gzhan la dgos pa'i shing zhes bya// nang du rang sems rgyu rkyen gyis// rnam rtog khams gsum ljon shing skyes// dbang yul sna tshogs yal 'dab rgyas/ khams gsum zhes kyang ming du grags// phyi rol shing de bcad pa'i tshe// yal 'dab mang po shugs la skams// me'i rkyen gyis sbar byas nas// thal ba'ang med par 'gyur ba ltar// nang du rnam rtog ljon shing yang*/ shes rab rnon po'i mtshon gyis bcad// 'khor ba'i lo 'dab rtsad nas skams// ye shes me lce rab 'bar bas// myang 'das kyi rtsa ba yang mi gda' lags// ljon shing skyes pa'i skye 'gag dpe las drang*// slad kyis byang chub bsgrub pa rnams// snang ba dpe ru shes par mdzod// dpe ljon pa la dpe blangs ba'i mgur ma 'di/ stod lung rgyal gyi ri khrod du/ chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gsungs pa lags so//shubhaṃ// ༈ /sna tshogs rig pa'i 'char tshul mkhyen// bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// phyi'i sa dang chu las kyang*// skyes bu'i lag pa'i 'du byed kyis// rdza'i snod du byas nas kyang*/ 'dus byas yin pas chag gyur pa// nang du bcud kyang mi 'chags 'gyur// thabs mkhas skyes bu dam pa yis// ma nyams sngar bzhin byas nas kyang*// zas kyi snod du gyur pa 'di// phyi rol dpe ru bstan pa yin// de nyid don la sbyar ba na// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi sa chu de// rnam rtog 'du byed kyi lag pa yis// khams gsum gyi lus su bzos nas kyang*// sred pa'i snod du gyur pa na// rtag 'dzin byas kyang mi rtag pas/

yang yang skyes shing 'chi bar 'gyur// yon tan snod du ma gyur pas// thabs mkhas bla ma dam pa yis// rang lus lha sku'i rdza ma de// gnyug ma'i rkyen gyis thabs kyis sbyar// zhabs rdol lta bu'i skal med kyang*// ting nge 'dzin gyis legs par sbyar// zag med bcud kyi snod du gyur// gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub// slad kyis nyams su len pa rnams// gzung 'dzin gyi snod la ma chags par// skal bzang ting 'dzin snod du shog /shubhāṃ// ces pa 'di ni rdza ma la dpe sbyar ba/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i stod lung mtshur phu'i rgyal gyi mdor gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ chos kun mnyam pa nyid gzigs shing*/ rnam par dag pa'i thugs rje can// zung 'jug mngon du gyur pa'i mchog /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam gling byang phyogs bod kyi yul// dag pa'i chu bo 'bab pa'i ngos// kha rag shar gyi dben gnas su// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor 'di skad lo// dal 'byor rin chen legs thob cing*/ theg chen bla ma dang 'jal nas// tshul bzhin gdams pa thob pa'i tshe// rtse cig nyams su blang bar bya// phyi rol snang ba sna tshogs 'di// sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa'i phyir// rmi lam dus kyi snang ba ltar// mngon zhen med par mnyam par zhog /nang gi rnam par rtog pa 'di// 'gyu ba rang gsal ngo bo nyid// 'khor 'das cho 'phrul de las byung*// 'gag med rang grol mnyam par zhog /gnyis snang shes pas ma slad cing*// gsal la mi rtog ngo bo nyid// rang sems sangs rgyas snying po ste// de nyid ngo bo rtogs par mdzod// zung 'jug gtan la 'bebs pa'i glu// 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal du shes// dge bas sems can thams cad kyis// rang sems snying po rtog par shog /kha rag shar gyi phyogs su blangs/ shubhaṃ// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// brtse ba chen pos rab gzigs shing*// kun nas skyob pa'i thugs rje can// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// kye ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// thog med dus kyi bag chags kyis// ma rig sgrib pa'i dbang song ste// rgyal ba dpag tu med pas kyang*// thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma zin cing*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor rab ldongs nas// skye rgas na 'chi'i rba la g.yengs// ma dag sdug bsngal tshor ba myong*// thar pa'i rin chen srog dang bral// kye ma sems can snying re rje// da yong bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// dkon pa'i mi lus thob dus 'dir// brtson grus 'bad pa ma byas na// ngan song sdug bsngal shin tu 'jigs// yul gyi snang ba brid re mkhas// rnam par rtog pa 'tshang re che// gti mug rgya mtsho ting re zab// gnyis su 'dzin pa 'grogs yun rings// 'khor bar thugs med 'khyam nyen gda'// de phyir 'bad pa du ma yis// theg chen bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs// mi rtag rgyud la rgyun du rten// thos bsam bsgom la 'bad pa thon// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin// mi rtag bskul ma 'debs pa'i glu// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// kha rag lho'i phyogs su blangs// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog// /

༈ na mo gu ru// sna tshogs snang ba'i phyogs rnams kun// sgyu ma lta bur rab gzigs shing*// chos rnams kun gyis de nyid mkhyen// bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor rin chen thob par dka'// rgyal ba'i bstan la myur du zhugs// theg chen bla ma rnyed par dka'/ brtson 'grus chen pos brkyang zhing bsgrub// ma nor chos dang 'phrad pa dka'// dri med theg chen lam la 'bad// yang dag lta ba rnyed pa dka'// snang stong dbyer med ngang la zhog /ma nor bsam gtan byed pa dka'// zhen pa med par mnyam par zhog /gos pa med pa'i spyod pa dka'// rang bzhin don dang mthun par mdzod// re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu dka'// rang sems gsal ba'i ngang la zhog /gzhan don phyogs med bsgrub pa dka'// snying rjes sems can rjes su bzung*// lta bsgom 'bral med brjod pa 'di// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// kha rag nub kyi phyogs su blangs// 'gro rnams theg chen don rtogs shog// / ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam gling chu gter chen po'i dbus// sna tshogs gangs ri'i pad tshal la// 'bab chu'i zil mngar rab 'phro zhing*// skye rgu'i yid kyi ro myang byed// khyad par gangs can bod kyi dbus// bsil ba'i chu bo dpag shu'i ngos// rin chen brag ri'i tshogs 'dus pas// bsam gtan can gyi dben gnas yin// sna tshogs brag ri spungs pa 'di// rdo rje rin chen rnams spel ba// sna tshogs g.yeng bas mi rdzi zhing*// 'jigs med bsam gtan grogs su bzang*/ mnyam zhing mdzes pa'i spang ljongs la// sna tshogs me tog 'bar ba bzhin// ting nge 'dzin gyi yid 'phrog cing*// bsam gtan brgyan gyis mdzes byed pa// sna tshogs 'bab chu'i sgra snyan ldan// bskom pa'i tsha gdung sel bar byed// chos kyi sgra snyan gsal ba 'dis// nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba 'dra// dkar gsal gangs ri mdzes pa la// nyi zla'i sgron me rnam par 'bar/

rab dkar snying rje'i 'od zer gyis// gdul bya'i pad tshal dga' byed bzhin// mdzes pa'i nam mkha' kun khyab cing*// rgyu skar phreng ba'i longs spyod ldan// stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// 'gro kun khyab par rgyan pa snyam// grub pa rnams kyis legs brten cing*// lha dang lha min dri za'i ngag /sna tshogs rtogs pa'i 'du byed kyi// phyogs kun khyab par bsgrogs par byed// 'di ni dben gnas kha rag gis// phyi nang spel ma'i zlos gar dbyangs// rang byung rdo rje'i ming can gyis/ kha rag byang gi phyogs su blangs// 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen thob shog shubhāṃ// jo mo kha rag gi shar du zung 'jug gtan la 'bebs pa'i mgur/ lho ru mi rtag pa bskul ma 'debs pa/ nub tu lta bsgom 'brel ba brjod pa/ byang du phyi nang spel ba'i zlos gar gyi mgur dang de ltar du bzhi gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ ri khrod dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// bla ma rnams phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen steng gi ri khrod na// bzhugs ba'i bsam gtan pa rnams gson// dang po mi lus rnyed dka' thob// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri med rnyed// bla ma rje dang 'jal dus na// rtse cig nyams su blang yang 'tshal// da res 'bad pa ma byas na// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab// sdug bsngal chu srin mi zad ldan// 'di las thon pa rab tu dka'// snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag med kyang*// bdag cag ma rig mun par 'khyams// da rung nyams nga'i khrod du lus// da res mi lus rin po che// phun tshogs 'byor pa 'dzom pa'i tshe// brtson 'grus rta la zhon nas kyang*// rtse cig bsam gtan zas za zhing*// tshul khrims dag pa'i rgyan gyis rgyan// shes rab lam ldan bla ma yis// khrid dus le lo spangs nas kyang*// myur du byang chub bsgrub par bya// 'di la 'bad pa ma byas na// rnam rtog rig pa col chung 'di// sna tshogs yul la rtag tu rgyug

/sred pa'i bde ba mgo bskor mkhas// ma rig bdud kyi 'phrang bsgugs dam// skye rga na 'chi chu bo che// bstan pa'i nyi ma nub tu nye// yang ni thug med 'khyam dogs gda'// da ni rang byung ye shes 'di// rang gi sems nyid lags mod kyang*// da rung gnyis 'dzin sprin gyis bsgribs// shes rab rlung gis stor kyang 'tshal// rnam par rtog pa g.yo ba 'di/ bsam tan bde la bcings nas kyang*// zhen pa'i 'khrul pa phra'u de// ye shes mtshon gyis bcad nas kyang*// da ltar rang dbang yod pa la// rtse cig nyams su blangs byas na// mi lus thob pa don yod cing*// rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa lags// thar pa'i rin chen gling du nye// yon tan rgya chen myur du thob// 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod shugs las 'byung*// de phyir rtse cig bsgrub par mdzod// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yis/ rtse cig snying rjes bskul nas kyang*// bskul ba tshig tu brjod pa 'di// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces bya ba 'di bde chen steng du gsungs so/// / ༈ rje bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dang por dben pa brten nas kyang*// bla mas gdams ngag btab pa'i tshe// 'di ltar nyams su blang yang 'tshal// rnam rtog 'du byed g.yo ba 'di// rang gi sems su thag bcad nas// lta ba'i go yul bstan par bya// des kyang rnam rtog mi gnas pas// ma yengs rtse cig yid btad nas// gnas pa yid la bskyed par bya// de nas yul snang kun la brtag /rgyu 'bras so sor dpyad nas kyang*/ dga' bde nang du bskyed pa yin// de nas rtog pa nub pa yin// dpyod pa'i rgyu ldan bsam gtan skye// de bzhin rtogs spyod nub nas kyang*// 'du byed g.yo ba rlung ldan pa// mthong nas ngo mtshar nang du skye// g.yo ba de yang nub nas kyang*// gsal la mi rtog ngo bo nyid// bde sdug rtogs dpyod dga' mi dga'// g.yo ba'i skyon bral lhang nge mchar// de la bsam gtan ngo bo zer// blun po kha cig phyag rgya cher// 'khrul nas ro myong mchog 'dzin na// phyir zhing mi khom nang du lhung*// de phyir de mthong mi zhen par// 'di yang rang sems kyis byas snang*// chos kun 'du byed kun rtog gis// bskyed byas rten cing 'brel 'byung mthong*// thos dang bsam dang bsgom 'byung gis// shes rab de la rten nas skye// gnyis snang gang la zhen yang 'ching*// gnyis med ma zhen de bas blun// zhen bya gnas bya ma zhen blo// thams cad rang gi sems nyid la// rgyu 'bras mthong na mkhas pa yin// der 'dzin zad pa phyag rgya che// blang dor rang gis zhig nas kyang*// bsam gtan de brten mngon shes dang*// rdzu 'phrul du ma skye ba yin// de tshe rgyal ba rnams mchod cing*// snying rjes sems can thams cad 'dzin// stong par rtogs kyang dngos po la// rgyu 'bras mi 'dor blang dor mkhas// dag pa'i sa rnams de nas bgrod// gang tshe rang sems gshis lnga la// ngo bo stong pa chos sku te// rang bzhin gsal ldan longs spyod rdzogs// mtshan nyid 'gag med sprul pa'i sku// kun la khyab pa ngo bo nyid// mtshan dpe bral ba de bzhin nyid// rtogs pas 'khor 'das ro mnyam du// rkya gyur pa de la 'bras bu zer// zhi lhag 'bras bu dang bcas pa// rtogs par bya phyir rang byung gi// bde chen steng gi gnas su blangs// bsam gtan skyon rnams zad nas kyang*// lhan cig skyes pa mngon gyur shog

༈ rnam rtog rgya mtsho chen po 'di// sred pa rlan dang rab tu ldan// gnyis 'dzin brlabs kyis phreng ba mang*// tshor ba'i lbu ba rnam par g.yo// nyon mongs rba klong du ma 'khyil// ngag gis sgra drag chil chil sgrogs// kye ma 'di la pha mtha' med// 'di 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma lags sam// gal te 'di las thar 'dod na// log rtog ring du spangs nas kyang*// bla ma rin chen gyi mnyan pa de// theg chen gdams pa'i gru chen 'dzin// mos gus chen pos gdung ba bskyed// lus dang longs spyod gru blar phul// gsungs pa'i yang dag gdams pa nyan// thar pa'i skam sa yid la gyis// brtson 'grus skya ba 'bad la gyis// myur du pha rol phyin te mchi// zhes bya ba 'di gru dang mthun par gsungs pa lags so/// / ༈ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub lags na// byin brlabs sems la 'jug lags kyang*// deng sang bsgrub pa nyung ba gda'// 'jig rten 'khri ba bcad lags na// skyid kyi mgo ma zin lags kyang*// deng sang 'jig rten bya ba la// thams cad sus thob byed cing gda'// ci yod sbyin par btang lags na// longs spyod dpag med 'byung lags kyang*/ deng sang ser sna'i zhen pa yis// rku 'phrog slong gsum byed cing gda'// dben pa'i ri khrod rten lags na// so bsod mdun ma legs lags pas/ deng sang grong yul 'du 'dzi la// thams cad 'bad pa byed cing gda'/ zhen med thos bsam byas lags na// rang la phan par 'byung lags te// deng sang nga mkhas nga rgyal gyis// rang rgyud bsreg par byed cing gda'// rnam dag tshul khrims bsrungs lags na// phyi ma bde 'gro thob lags te// deng sang don med 'khrul pa yis// mngon lkog nyes spyod byed cing gda'// ma zhen bsam ga tan bsgoms lags na// bla med byang chub nye lags te// deng sang bsam gtan byed pa rnams// bde gsal ro la zhen cing gda'// kye ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// rang gis rang la ngan byed cing*// dbang med ngan 'gro'i nang du 'khyam// 'khor ba thug med gting du bying*// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// thugs rje chen pos gzigs nas kyang*// 'khor ba'i sems can nyon mongs rnams// myur du byang chub 'khod par mdzod// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yis// snying rje'i dbang gis bskul nas kyang*// dbang med tshig tu bris pa yin// kun kyang byang chub thob par shog

/shubhāṃ// ces pa 'di bde chen steng du gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo bhu dha ya/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ sems nyid 'khrul pa ma rtogs pas// da lta bar du yang dang yang*// rnam rtog yul gyi rjes su 'brengs// phyi rol bden snang gis bcings nas// 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'di// yang yang slus kyang da rung du/ yul snang tshor la blang dor byas// kye ma sgyu ma mkhan khyod kyang*// rang gi sprul pa'i snang ba la/ zhen pas 'chings pa ma thang na// mkhas pa rgyal sras mchog rnams kyis// bzhed pa'i gnas su ma gyur ram/ kun gzhi khyed lung ma bstan cing*// rtog pa'i bag chags du mas kyang*/ ma gang nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu// rtogs pa'i brlabs kyis kun bskyed nas// 'phel 'grib med pa rgya mtsho bzhin// bde sdug yul rnams lhun thug kyang*// sred pa'i mdun pa nyung ba bzhin// blang dor rtog pa me lce 'dra// g.yos shing zad med yang yang ldan// rnam rtog 'du byed rlung dang 'dra// bden med yul la dam zhen nas// gzung bas shin tu brtan gyur pa// phung sogs bsten pa sa gzhi bzhin// rang gis rang la gnod byed pa// rnam rtog khyod ni smyon pa bzhin// rang la zhen pas mi 'gro ba// khyod ni srin gyi kha chu bzhin// rang la bltas na bden med pas/ khyod ni dri za'i grong khyer bzhin// brtags shing brtags shing stong pas na// khyod ni chu'i chu bur bzhin// phye na snying po med pas na// khyod ni chu'i snying po bzhin// gsal kyang gzung du med pas na// rtog pa khyod ni chu zla 'dra// skad cig mi rtag zil pa bzhin// g.yo yang bzung med smig sgyu 'dra// legs kyang slu bas 'ja' tshon bzhin// rkyen las byung bas brag cha 'dra// gsob du 'dug pa gzugs snyan bzhin// phugs na sprul pa ltar snang ste// ya mtshan can gyi rnam rtog khyod// ma 'gyu sngar gyi de kas chog

/'gyu yang rang ngo dran pas bzung*// bden rtog zhen pa khyod ma byed// bden med du yang log ma rtog /gnyis 'dzin ma byed khyod la gnod// gnyis ka ma btang khyod rang yin// rgyal sras bla ma khyod rtog rnams// ngo mtshar che bas bka' la nyon// skad cig dus kyi rtog yin kyang*// khyod la rgyun ring 'dus byas med// snang ba kun gyi rtsa ba khyod// stong pa gzhan na mi gda'o// bden zhen byas pas de kar zhig /khyod la blo gtad mi gda'o// ji ltar nang bzhin phyi na snang*// khyod la rten nas 'ching ba 'di// khyod shes grol bar gyur pa yin// khyod mthong blang dor rtog pa zhig /mthong bas spangs ba mi zer ram// da rung nyon mongs skye bar snang*// goms nas 'du mi byed pa'i tshe// bsgom pas spangs ba ma lags sam// spangs kyang khyod rang bcings kyang khyod// khyod ni rgyal sras kun gyis kyang*// ma btang ma bzung ngo mtshar che// kye ma rnam rtog byung tshor rnams// rang byung rang bzhin rang dag tu// rang byung rdo rje bris pa yin// don med kun rtog zhi ba dang*/ don yod rtogs pa rgyas nas kyang*// blang dor med par 'gyur bar shog /ces bya ba 'di rang gi rnam rtog la rgod bro nas bde chen steng du bris pa'o/// / ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rje yis byin gyi rlobs// gson dang chos mdzad bsgom chen kun// bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo rgyud dang*// bla ma rnams kyis gsungs pa ltar// deng sang snyigs ma lnga yi dus// sangs rgyas bstan pa mar 'grib 'dir/ chos mdzad rnams kyang phrag dog che// thos pa ldan pa'i dge bshes dkon// bsgrub blo yod pa'i skyes bu nyung*// ri khrod dben par gnas 'dod rnams// dus 'dir g.yeng ba'i sad kyis khyer// ma rungs snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// mthar thug ma nor snying po'i don// nyams su len na 'di bzhin long*// 'jig rten mngon zhen dam po 'di// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir// ma chags zhen pa med par mdzod// rgyun du ri khrod dgon pa brten// tshe 'di'i 'jig rten snang ba kun// bden pa med pas dus kun du// rtag tu bde chen thob 'dod na// chos kyi sdug bsngal dang du long*// da lta'i las la zin pa med// de phyir rigs pas dam chos mdzod/

gson dang skyes bu chos mdzad rnams// 'di'i snyan grags bsod nams dag /'chi ba'i tshe na rmi lam 'dra// g.yog 'khor nye bzhi rtsa lag rnams// bzhag nas 'gro ba cha med dam/ mtho btsan nyams dga'i mkhar brtsigs kyang*// 'chi ba'i tshe na 'khri sa med// 'dus byas mtshan ma'i lag rjes kun// bzang yang rjes su yong ba med// de bas bla ma'i gdams ngag ltar// rgyun du bden med lta ba bsgom// 'dzin pa med pa'i don la zhog /mi rtag rjes su dran byas na// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin// mngon zhen 'dzin pa zhig pa'i tshe// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa rnams// ma lus bde ba chen po'i ngang*// nyid du shes par gyur ba'i tshe// rtsol ba'i gnad dang bral ba lags// de dag kun gyi mthar thug ni// gzung 'dzin bdag 'dzin spangs ba dang*// rgyal ba'i gsung ltar nyams su long*/ don mthar thug bsdus na de las med// de phyir 'di ni nyams su long*/ ༈ na mo gu ru// nam mkha' lta bu'i bde gshegs la/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rtog pa yis// sgyu ma lta bu'i rab snang pas// brag cha lta bur phyag 'tshal lo// e ma phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad rnams// rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// bcings pa med pa'i rtog pa 'di// grol bar 'dod na tshig 'di gson// snang ba'i yul gyi slu slu 'dra// blo gtad byas na bden pa med// des na gzung ba'i rnam pa 'di/ skye 'gag med par go ba long*// der 'dzin shes pas slu slu 'dra// rtag par bltas kyang ngo bo stong*// des na nang gi 'gyu ba 'di// rtsod bral yin par go ba long*// phyi rol bla mas slu slu 'dra// mngon par zhen kyang 'ching ba'i rgyu// des na rang rig 'gag med 'di// bla ma yin par go ba long*// 'dus byas chos kyi slu slu 'dra// rtsol bsgrub byas kyang bden pa med// des na zag med de nyid don// chig chod yin par go ba long*// go yul shes pas slu slu 'dra// ji ltar gsal yang rtog pa yin// des na nyams su myong ba yin// rlan dang 'brel bar go ba long*// nyams su myong bas slu slu 'dra// bzang yang zag par bcas pa yin// des na 'khor ba'i gnyen po de// shes rab yin par go ba long*// spang blang rtog pas slu slu 'dra// tha snyad 'dzin pas 'khrul pa yin// des na rang sems lhan cig skyes// sangs rgyas yin par go ba long*// 'dra ltar brjod pas slu slu 'dra// bden no snyam yang brag cha yin// des na nang du sbyor shes par// thag chod gcig tu go ba long*// de ltar ngag tu brjod pa 'di// ri khrod dgon pa dben pa ru// rang byung rdo rje smras pa lags// 'gal bar gda' na bzod par gsol/

zhes pa 'di bde chen du gsungs so// / ༈ sems rnam rtog khyed la mtshar cig yod// phyi rol gyi cong rong cung zad la/ res 'ga' skrag cing zhum par 'gyur// ngan song gi cong rong zab mo la// ltung dogs kyi go zon mi byed par// rgyu mi dge spyod pa khyod re 'khrul// res 'ga' yul med cung zad la// sems rnam rtog spyod pas rjes su 'brengs// khyod de tsam bde la sred pa na// zag med don gyi bde ba la// bsgrub par mi byed phyir phyogs nas// 'khor bar 'jug pa khyod re mtshar// rnam rtog gnyis su snang ba 'di// bden par cung zad ma grub kyang*// khyod zhen pas yul gyis rjes su 'brengs/ rtag par lhan cig skyes pa'i don// rang gsal gcig tu mi sdod par// sems chung khyod la mtshar cig yod// don drug ldan pa brag cha'i sgra// zung sdebs kyi tshig rkang drug drug po// tshogs drug snang ba sgyu ma mkhan/ rtog pa'i ngag tu sdebs pa 'di// brag cha lta bur blangs pa lags// 'gal ba gda' na bzod par gsol/ ces pa 'di ri skor la byon pa'i dus su g.ya' shal dang brag rong la 'khor rnams skrag zer ba'i dus rin po che rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so// / ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor bdag gi gdams pa 'di/ rtag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms// nyin mtshan kun tu gsol ba thob// rang rgyud grol ba dngos grub 'byung*// rgyu 'bras rnams la nges shes bskyed// sems can rnams la snying rje bsgoms// rang dbang med pa'i rtogs pa skye// bya cha'i chos la brtson pa gyis// dam pa'i chos la yid ches bskyed/ gzung 'dzin spongs la ri khrod 'grims// gdams pa rnams la yid ches mdzod// dka' thub nyid la rtag tu 'bad// gtum mo'i gdam ngag bsgoms par mdzod// de ltar kun gyis go bar nyams su long*// shubhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ru/ dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang 'jal ba// 'di 'dra brnyed par dka' ba yin// le lo ma byed brtson 'grus bskyed// theg chen bla ma mchog dang 'jal// mnyes bzhin gdam ngag gang 'dod gnang*// rtse bas thugs la 'dog pa'i tshe// mos gus gdung ba tshul bzhin gyis// 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab dbus nas kyang*// thar pa'i skam sar 'gro ba la// 'jig rten sred pa btang nas ni// tshul khrims gtsang ma bsrung la 'bad// 'jig rten 'di la snying po med// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal 'jigs pa che/

'di la thar pa 'dod pa na// bsam gtan bsgom la 'bad pa thon// chos kun rang gi sems nyid yin// thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// bden med gcig tu sbyangs lags na// myur du lta ba'i don rtogs 'gyur/ 'di ni nyams len rtsa ba yin// de phyir ri khrod dben pa rten// ci yod bsod nams tshogs su thong*// mi rtag bden med rgyun du bsgom// 'di ni rang byung rdo rje yis// gdams pa bskul 'debs bris pa yin// rjes su 'dug par 'dod pa rnams// tshul bzhin nyams su len par zhu// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog //// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor brnyed par dka' ba thob dus 'dir// rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyon med dang 'jal tshe// tshe cig dam chos bsgrub pa brtson par bya// yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba bla ma dang*// lus ngag longs spyod dag pas zhabs thog bya// ma yengs gus pas rgyun du gsol ba gdab// longs spyod snying po med pas snying po blang*// lan la re ba med pas sbyin pa btang*// mtho ris thems skas ting 'dzin rgyu yin phyir// nyes spyod gos pa med pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs// yon tan bsgrub la bzod pa'i go cha gyon// myur du brtson 'grus skyo dub med pa brtsam// bsam gtan yon tan myur du 'thob bya'i phyir// bla ma'i gdams pa rtse cig rgyun du bsgom// shes rab kun gyi mchog gyur yin pa'i phyir// chos kun stong nyid zhi ba'i don la blta// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis dgag bya'i phyir// stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rtag tu bsgom// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pa'i phyir// rgyun du bdag med snying po'i don la blta// thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par yin pa'i phyir// bsngo ba smon lam stobs kyis zin par bya// nam mkha'i mthar gtugs sems can thams cad kyi/ don du rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ci bzhin bya// de ltar ma yengs nyams su blang byas na// myur du rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur// 'di ni gus ldan slob ma la phan phyir// rang byung rdo rjes bde chen steng du byas/

'gro kun bla med byang chub thob par shog ༈ thog med dus kyi bag chags 'dis// ting 'dzin stobs kyis ma sbyangs na// rnam rtog yul dang 'brel gyur pas/ zhen pa thongs pa dka' bar mchi// drug pa yid kyi shes pa 'dis// skad cig gcig tu ma rtogs na// yid shes rtsa ba ma chod pas// gnas lugs rtogs pa dka' bar mchi// sems dang sems 'byung thams cad kyi/ rang rig gsal la mi rtog gang*/ mtshungs ldan yid du go gyur na// grub mtha' ngan pas 'ching bar mchi/ nga zhes kun tu rtog pa'i yid// sems dang 'brel ba'i nyon mongs can// bdag med don gyis ma bcos pa// bdag rtog choms par dkar bar mchi// 'di ltar rtogs na mkhas pa lags// nyams su len pa bsgom chen lags// don med kha la 'khyer byed pa// sangs rgyas thob pa dka' bar mchi// gnas lugs spros bral phyag rgya chen po ni// rnam rtog spros pa'i mtshan ma kun gyis stong*// gsal la 'dzin med dag pa'i rang bzhin te// dam tshig de don ma rtogs ma rig 'du byed kyi// blang dor byas pas 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba ste/ blang dor med cing rang sar grol ba na// myur du sems kyi ye shes rtogs par 'gyur// des na rgyun du bla ma dam pa la// mos gus ldan pas gsol gdab man ngag zhu// dam tshig sdom ldan rtag tu brtson 'grus bya/ bskyed rdzogs dbyer med gcig tu nyams su blang*// rtsa rlung byang chub sems rnams gcig tu snun// bde gsal mi rtog nyams la zhen pa spang*// rnam rtog rtsal sbyang mi rtog ting 'dzin bsgom// mthar thug spros bral rang grol rgya yis gdab// lus ngag yid kyi dge ba dpag med sbyang*// gzhan gyi don du bsngo ba smon lam bya// nyams len gnad kun bsdus pa de nyid yin// de ltar nyams len kun gyis brtson par mdzod/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa 'gro ba'i mgon// thugs rje'i 'phrin las dpag med kyi// skal ldan blo'i mun pa sel// 'gro ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// shun pa dang bcas 'od dang mdog

/mi snang byi dor byas pa'i tshe// rang gi yon tan snang bar byed// sems nyid nor bu rin chen la// gzung 'dzin shun bcas sangs rgyas gyi// yon tan mi snang de sbyangs la// rgyal ba'i yon tan rdzogs par 'char// phyi rol nam mkha' stong pa la// sprin dang na bun rang bzhin 'byung*// rlung gi rkyen gyis dag byas te// 'gag pa med par rang sar dengs// chos dbyings spros dang bral ba la// rtog pa'i 'du byed rang bzhin byung*// shes rab rtogs pas de sbyangs pas// gnyis snang 'gag med ngang du dag /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rtog med par// dkyil 'khor kun tu spros nas kyang*// mun sel pa yi steng du bab// 'on kyang sa dang 'dres pa med// rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rtog med pa// nam mkha' khyab par spros nas kyang*// 'gro blo'i mun sel sems can smin// sems can 'khrul dang bsres pa med// ji ltar shing gnyis drud pa'i me/ 'bar bas gnyis ga bsregs nas kyang*// bsreg bya sreg byed gnyis med par// nam mkha'i ngang du thim pa ltar// spang bya'i nyon mongs rtog pa yang*// gnyen po'i shes pas drud pa las// gnyis ka'i mtshan ma dag nas kyang*// spros bral shes rab ngang du thim/ ji ltar sa bon myu gu la// 'bras bu smin pa ma dmigs kyang*// chu lud rgyu rkyen 'dzom pa yis// phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// tha mal shes pa'i rang ngo la// da ltar ye shes ma dmigs kyang*/ spros bral shes rab ngang du thim// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis/ sku gsum 'bras bu phun tshogs thob// de ltar dpe don rnam pa bcu// 'gag med tshig tu brjod pa yis// 'gal ba 'dug na bzod par mdzod// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /sho lo ka bcu gnyis pa dge bshes bsam gtan pa rnams la rdzogs chen bshad dus blangs pa'o/// / ༈ bla ma dang dpal mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir// bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal nas kyang*// rtse cig nyams len byed pa la// le lo g.yeng ba 'di bdud du che// rgyal ba'i gsung rabs rab 'byams dang*// mjal nas brtson par byed pa'i tshe// nyan bsam rgyud la sbyong ba'i dus// chog shes phyogs ris 'di bdud du che// dben pas sangs rgyas thob pa la// ri khrod bas mtha' brten pa'i tshe/

brtson 'grus rtsom par byed pa la// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba 'di bdud du che// 'khor ba sgyu ma 'dra ba la// bden pa med par sbyong ba'i dus// zhen pa med par btang rgyu la// grogs mngon zhen can de bdud du che// bstan pa'i bya ba 'khor ba spongs// che thabs lo 'dod bskyur ba la// 'bad pas rang sems sbyong ba'i tshe// rang 'dod che ba bdud du che// nang du yang dag 'jog pa yi// ting nge 'dzin la mtshon dus na// rnam rtog du ma spro spro nas// sems mi gnas pa de bdud du che// rjes thob ye shes sbyong ba la// rgyu 'bras rtogs par byed pa'i tshe// blo'i gsal snang mi skye bar// nang du 'khyil pa bdud du che// lar 'dus byas chos la bden pa med/ 'dus ma byas la rtog pa bral// gnyis med don cig ma rtogs na// byas tshad 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin// blo zhen pa thong cig rnal 'byor pa// gzung 'dzin ma byed rang sar zhog /kye ma 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog 'di// ye shes nyid du grol bar shog ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlobs// rang rgyud grol bar mdzad du gsol// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab// rnam par rtog pa 'phro 'du mang*// rang rig gsal ba yul la shor// der 'dzin shes pa slu brid mkhas// nyon mongs jag pa dgra thabs mkhas// 'dod yon ro 'di myangs shing sred// gnyis 'dzin rtog pa 'brel ba che// bsam gtan mthu 'di shin tu chung*/ cung zad yod kyang 'khor ba'i khrod// snang med bsam gtan 'jig pa'i rgyu// mthar 'dzin bdud 'di nus pa che// nga bdag 'gong po phugs na dam// bden med 'dod pa bden par che// bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// thugs rje'i rtsal kha chung ba 'dra// rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams// mi bzhugs zhing khams dag par gshegs// ma dag 'gro bas sa steng gang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa gdugs la nye// kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus// 'di dus brtson 'grus byed re ran// rjes 'jug bsam gtan byed pa rnams// nyin mtshan med par mnyam par zhog

/le lo ma byed brtson 'grus bskyed// rtag tu srog rtsol rlung la 'bad// spros bral nam mkha' lta bu la/ blang dor bshig la mnyam par zhog /'dod yon spongs la nyams su long*/ zhes chos rje rin po ches gsungs/// / ༈ /bla ma dam pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi kun rtog bcas pa'i 'khor ba'i rgyu// bag chags bstan pa'i gzhi ni rgya mtsho 'dra// g.yo ba 'du byed rkyen ni rlung dang mtshungs// yul la mtshan 'dzin 'du byed chu zla bzhin// tshogs drug 'tshams sbyor ldan pa sgyu ma bzhin// tshor ba rnam gsum shing la me 'bar mtshungs// sred pa'i rnam rtog tsha chu 'thung ba ltar// rgyu dang rkyen des 'khor bar 'grub pa yin// de don shes nas zhi lhag rtsal sbyangs nas// rgyal sras rnams kyi gdam ngag thob pa yin/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti maṃgha laṃ bha wan+tu// dkar phyogs mkha' la dkar zlum ni// dkar po'i zer 'phro dkar po'i gnyen// nyin mor byed pa'i rjes mthun pa// thub pa rnams kyis bsngags pa yin// gzung 'dzin rdo rje'i ri bo la// thos bsam tshig gi bzong btsug shing*// rigs pa'i tho bas brdungs gyur kyang*// 'dzug pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// ting 'dzin rtags kyi 'khrul 'khor kyis// rnam rtog dmigs pa'i rdo blangs te// rgyab kyang ma phed tshur la gas// phyag rgya che dang dbu ma che// nam mkha'i rlung ni 'ar 'ur gyis// phog kyang 'jig pa dka' bar gda'// rdzogs chen sems klong man ngag gi /me lce 'ar 'ur gyis bsregs kyang*// gzung 'dzin 'a tshig par mi gda' na/ ngar 'dzin rdo rje pha lam 'di// sngar yang skal pa bgrangs pa yin// da yang skal pa du 'gro lta// rang rig gzung 'dzin byed pa yin/ dgra bo nang nas ma phyung na// mtshan dang dpe byad 'od 'bar ba'i// sangs rgyas stong gi dmag drangs kyang*// nga la gnod pa rdul tsam med// ma rig gos 'di ma phud na// chos char skal pa brgya phab kyang*// bangs kyi mi dgos e ma ho// gzung 'dzin rdo rje'i chos dbyangs 'di// nyams dga' la re nas blangs pa lags/// /

༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rang sems rtogs par byin gyis brlobs// tshig 'di la 'dir bzhugs gsan par zhu// rang sems spros dang bral ba la// gnyis snang gi shes pas ma slad par// rang grol lhan cig skyes pa 'di// mtha' bral gyi lta ba zer ba yin// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med cing*// ma yengs rgyun gyi dran pa can// dmigs pa'i mtshan mas ma bcings pa// rang grol bsgom pa'i gnas lugs lags// rang gzhan kun gyis don grub cing*// mtha' gnyis phyogs su mi lhung par// bcos pa'i spyod pa ma slad pa// shugs 'byung spyod pa'i gnas lugs lags// gzhi dang 'bras bu dbyer med cing*// ma spangs sgrib pa kun dang bral// thob rgyu med pa'i yon tan rdzogs// 'bras bu zung 'jug gi ngo bo lags// lta bsgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi/ spangs blang med pa sems la rdzogs// brtags na rgyal ba'i dgongs dang mthun// 'thad par gda' na nyams su long*/ ༈ rje bla ma dam pa bka' drin can// dpal rdo rje 'chang dang tha dad med// zab don mngon du ston pa po// rje sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma nor nyams su len pa la// 'di don gnad du bsnun par mdzod// thog mar theg chen gyi bla ma bsten// mos gus rnam dag gi sems dang bsres// 'jig rten 'khri ba rtsad nas chod// dben gnas ri khrod bas mtha' brten// rtsa rlung thabs lam gnad du bsnun// ma yengs rgyun du bsam gtan mdzod// don de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe// thog med kyi bag chags rmu rgod 'di// gnyis 'dzin snang ba byung nas kyang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang kun slong gis// spong len re dogs rtog pa 'byung*// ma rig bag chags sgrib pa 'dis// bying zhing rmungs pa'i sa bon byed// bla med lam gyi bar du gcod// gegs kyi 'byung ba'i rgyu ru bshad// gegs sel gnad kyi man ngag ni// gnyen po ye shes kyi rtog pa 'di// brtson 'grus rta la zhon nas kyang*// bsam ga

tan zag med zas dang bcas// bzod pa'i snying rus kyi go gon nas// shes rab rnon po'i mtshon cha yis// bying rgod dgra bo 'dul bar nges// mdor bstan dpe dang sbyar ba lags// da ni rgyas bshad bstan lags na// sems bying na yul snang steng du spros/ yul de snang stong gi ngo bo ltos// rmugs na rnam rtog yan par thong*/ btang sa ru ma yengs dran pas bzung*// nyams rgyal na snang ba rlung dang bsres// 'gro 'ong mkha' dang cig tu bsres// 'thor na rnam rtog dran pas bzung*// gang gsal de'i steng du zhog /nan tar 'phro na 'phro sar thong*// 'gro sa ma rnyed glod la zhog /rgod na gnyen po'i shes pa de// sdug tsir ma byed glod la zhog /rtog med btang snyoms bsgom pa'i mchog /sems kyi gegs sel bsdus lags na// rtsa steng 'og bar gsum khang pa 'dra// rlung steng 'og bar gsum mi dang mtshungs// khams dwangs snyig sems gsum nor dang 'dra// de gsum ma nor bsgrigs pa ces// bying ba'i gegs rnams rlung gis gtor// rlung sems steng du mda' ltar 'phongs// rgod pa'i bgegs rnams 'og tu non// thur sel sa dang cig tu bsres// grang zhing 'dar na gtum mo spor// rlung sna nas khug la me la bsnun// tsha zhing brtse na chu dang bsres// rlung kha nas sgra bcas drag tu byung*// rtsa ba'i srog rlung rengs pa gsum// lus la rengs na phyi ru gzhil// rtsa la rengs na gcig tu dul/ sems la rengs na dbu ma'i sgor// nyi zla me gsum gcig tu bsres// sems dang bde stong gcig tu bya// skyon las grol bar the tshom med// thig le'i dngas ma gnyis po 'di// lus kun khyab par gnad du bsnun// 'og tu dkar cha gnas pa med// dmar cha steng du bstan pa med// go bzlog 'dzin pa shes lags na// rgyal po brtson du bzung dang mtshungs// yan lag snyigs ma nyi shu bzhis// 'thums na dbyung pas phyung la thong*// 'dren na thams cad rlung gis gtor// stong na rang rang ngo bos gsol// rtsa rlung gegs se

la de las med// rten dang rten pa rnam pa gnyis// dper na bya'i gshog pa 'dra// thabs shes gnad du bsnun shes na// bde chen mkha' spyod kyi lam la 'gro// dpal rdo rje 'chang gi 'bras bu 'thob// zag med myang 'das gnas su sleb// bla ma'i man ngag brgya shes kyang*/ ngas ni de las mthong ba med/ zhes chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so/// / ༈ yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i dpal// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di la 'dir bzhugs snyan gsan mdzod// bdag med don la rab mos shing*// rgyu 'bras khyad du mi bsod pa// rgyal ba tshad mar lta ba de// 'jig rten gyi yang dag blta ba lags// dkon mchog gsum la mos pa bsgom// sbyin dang tshul khrims nyams su len// bsam gtan don la mnyam par 'jog /'jig rten pa yi bsgom pa lags// mtho dman kun la snyoms par byed// mi dge nag po rgyab du bskyur/ dkar po dge ba dang du long*// khrel yod 'jig rten spyod pa yin// gnas skabs bde 'gro lha yi 'thob// thon mong srid las rnam grol 'thob// mthar thug rgyal ba'i lam stegs yin// 'jig rten pa'i 'bras bu lags/ thun mong theg pa'i lta ba dang*// bsgom dang spyod dang 'bras bu bzhi// dang po'i las can dang mthun par// rang byung rdo rje mgur du blangs/// / ༈ rang sems mkha' dbyings brdal ba la// snang stong kun bzang rnam 'phrul shar// rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa la// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i ye shes mngon sum la// mtha' dbus med pa nam mkhar 'phyo// sgrib byed bral ba'i mig gis blta/ 'khrul med ngo bo'i lta ba lags// lus ni seng ge drang srong mtshungs// ngag ni g.yo med lkugs pa bzhin// sems ni dran med ro dang mtshungs// chos nyid rang gi bsgom pa yin// dkar nag spyod pas mi sgrib cing*/ rten med nam mkha'i dkyil du spyod// 'gag med gong 'phel snang ba 'char// rig pa dwangs pa'i spyod pa lags// 'khor 'das re dogs med pa la// mngon sum snang ba lam du byed// mthar thug chos rnams zad sar skyol// bla med theg pa 'bras bu lags// lta bsgom spyod 'bras bzhi po 'di// thun mong theg pa'i spyod yul min// 'on kyang rang byung ming can gyis// 'gag med ngang nas blangs pa lags/// /

༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnal 'byor bdag la byin gyis brlobs// rgyal ba'i bstan pa snyigs ma la// byang phyogs gangs ri'i zhol 'dir ni// rtsod ldan sems can nang du skyes// rnam rtog las la zhen pas lan// da rung rtog la bden 'dzin na// thug med 'khor bar 'khyam dogs yod// kye ma dus mtha'i ri khrod pa// nang bsam gtan tshul bzhin bsgom pa la// rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi ma spangs na// nyon mongs dgra bo rlung tshub ldang*/ dben par gnyen po rtsal chen sbyongs// de ltar ma nus rang la smod// lhag mthong shes rab ye shes kyi// snang ba gong du spel ba 'di// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rje las byung*// 'on kyang thog med kun rtog gis/ btang snyoms le lo byas gyur cing*// brtson 'grus sbyang la ma 'bad pas// des kyang rang gi sems ma mthong*/ bla med byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ 'gro ba kun la bu bzhin blta/ rang sems snying rje ma 'byongs shing*/ nyon mongs zhe sdang skyon gyis 'khyer/ byang sems mngon du ma 'byongs pas/ des kyang rang gi sems ma bcos// chos rnams rmi lam sgyu 'dra la// stong pa rgyud la ma rtogs shing*/ yod rtog bdag 'dzin 'ching bas bcings/ dngos med dngos por 'dzin pa yis// sems kyi 'khor ba'i rmang rdo byas// de bas rang sems rang gis khrel// rang skyon mthong nas sgrib pa 'di// gzhan la 'dzug mo 'dzugs pa min// slad kyis bstan la 'jug pa rnams/ sems nang du khug la nang du gzhol// don med 'khrul pa bskyur la thong*// shes yi rgyal la nye ba lags/ zhes chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so/// / ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye ma bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// rgyal ba thugs rje'i mnga' bdag gi 'phrin las nyi ma nub khar phyin// 'bad pa du ma byas lags kyang*// ma rig bdud kyi mthu che zhing*// chags pa'i dga' mo g.yo sgyu che// sred ma myos dang dga' byed ma// myur mgyogs che zhing rtag tu 'breng*// yul gyi mda' lnga rab tu rno// kun rtog gzhu 'di nus pa che// des rkyen g.yeng dang slu ba dang*// 'khrug dang rmong byed pho nya bzhi/

mthu ldan sems la lhan cig byung*// ngag dang lus kyi lam rgyud nas// mi dge bcu'i dpung tshogs bsdus// dug gsum go cha rab bgos nas// rgyal ba'i bstan la gnod pa byed// dge sems bsam sbyor 'joms byed pa// 'di 'dra kye ma nyon re mongs// 'gro drug sems can snying re rje// 'di dus rang byung rdo rje yi// rgyal ba kun la bskyel mar bos// sems dpa' che kun mos pas bskul// dam chos 'dzin pa'i dgra thabs slabs// rang rig lta ba'i skyes bu la// snying rje chen po'i go cha bkon// bzod pa'i nan tan go bsgos nas// bsam gtan chen po'i gzhu thogs nas// dmigs pa rtse cig mda' dang sbyar// shes rab ral gri rnon po dang*// thabs mkhas bsdu dngos kyis brid cing*// dran dang ting 'dzin yid brtan pas// shes bzhin ldan pa pho nyar bskul// dge bcu'i dpung chen bsdus nas kyang*// nyon mongs bdud dang 'thab snyam pas// phal cher snyigs ma'i skyes bu rnams// kha yar kho bos thob lags pas// phal cher ma rig bdud la shor// khro sogs bdud kyis skyed pa la// la la thar kyang sred ma sogs// yul gyi bde 'dod gyis bcings khrid// la la de las khros byed kyang*// ma rig don med yul du 'khyam// kye ma sems can snying re rje// bdag rang rnal 'byor gcig pu 'di// rnam rtog bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal// rgyab na snying rje'i zla ba shar// mdun na ye shes nyi 'od 'khyil// dga' byed bsam gtan ngang du thim// sred ma 'khor 'das ngang du dengs// myos ma zag med lha ru gyur// khro dang g.yeng sogs bzhi po dang*/ srid du chod nas mel tse byed/ g.yeng byed rtog pa g.yo ba yin// dge la rtsol yang a'u tsi// 'khrul byed bzod pa'i go char gyur// ngar 'dzin med par gcig tu bor// rmugs byed mi rtog dran par song*/ gnyis snang zad kyang de ka yin// 'thab byed ye shes mtshon thogs te// bdag 'dzin 'joms par byed par 'gyur// mi nga'i rjes su slob pa kun// de ltar gyis la rnam rtog gi

/mi dge bdud las rgyal bar mdzod/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ thugs rje chen po'i dpung bskyed la// bdag rjes 'jug pa'i skal ldan rnams// bsam gtan bde ba'i zas mchog dang*// thar pa'i rin chen khang bzang du// rnam g.yeng bdud kyi ma phrogs par// nyams dga'i dga' ston byed par mdzod// srid zhi gnyis 'dzin bral nas ni// thub dbang khyed dang mtshungs gyur cig ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po dad pa brtan po de/ phyi rol rkyen gyis mi 'gyur bas// rtse gcig brtan na yon tan 'byung*// rang sems dran pa'i so pa de// le lo'i sad kyis ma khyer bar// rtse cig bsam gtan bsgom pa la// rgyun du bsten na mkhas pa yin// rang sems dag pa'i me long la// bag chags ngan pa'i g.yas g.yogs pa// phyis shing shes par gsal btab na// dkar po'i yon tan 'byung ba yin// rang sems rtsa gdar ma chod na// sgra tshig rjes su brtsal lags kyang*// gnyug ma'i ngo bo mi mthong pas// rang sems rang grol gsal ba de nyid ltos// nges shes nang nas ma skyes par// kha 'khyal tshig gi rjes 'brangs kyang*// gdar sha sems la mi chod pas// sems dwangs su chug la mnyam par zhog /sems nang du bkug pas 'phros pa na// phar la thong la rang ngo ltos// phyi yul la zhen pa skyes pa na// yul de rang gi sems su ltos// rnam rtog don med 'tshub pa na// rlung gis gtor la lhod kyis glod// bde gsal ro la zhen pa na// bden med stong pa'i rgya yis thob// dge med sdig med nyams skyes na// rgyu 'bras kyi tshul la nan tan gyis// spang blang med par mngon gyur cing*// thabs mkhas kyis rgyu 'bras mi 'dor na// rgyal ba'i gsung dang mthun pa dang*// ma nor lam mchog 'phrad pa yin// spros pa chod la mnyam par zhog /de ltar nyams len rtse cig gyis// ces pa 'di phag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga la bde chen du bkod pa'o// shubhāṃ//

༈ gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i khrims yig bzhugs pa lags so// oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ bla ma dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan thub dbang thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyis// bstan pa rin chen 'gro ba'i dpal du shar// snyigs dus rang gzhan rgyud la phan bya'i phyir// de dang rjes mthun phyogs tsam bsgrub pa'i phyir// yon tan 'phel phyir khrims su bya ba brjod// re shig rgyal ba'i thugs rje chen po'i rmad byung yang*// snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa la bab cing*// thog ma med pa'i kun tu rtogs pas/ rgyud dkrugs pa'i skye bos sa stengs gang zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i rtags tsam 'dzin pa la nye ba'i dbang gis bstan pa'i don spyod pa las ring du gyur te// dad pa'i blo dang ldan zhing chos kyi rjes su 'breng pa/ rang byung rdo rje zhes grags pa bdag kyang*/ de lta bu rnams kyis grib kyis phog cing lus dang sems la bar du gcod pa'i ltas du ma byung bas 'di snyam du gyur to// kye ma bdag ni rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs// rgyal ba rnams kyis rjes su bzung gyur kyang*// byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/*/ring 'gyur bdud kyi bar gcod stobs ldan zhing*// gzhan la phan par byed pa dka' ba 'dra// theg mchog spyod pa 'dor ba ma yin kyang*/ rang nyid gcig pu brtson pa bskyed pa dang*// dag pa'i zhing du skyes na dga' ba snyam// snyigs dus gzhan la phan pa shin tu dka'// longs spyod bzung na log par spyod pa mang*// ma bzung gyur na bya ba spangs rnams kyang*// bsdu ba med ces chos min char ka gtong*// 'dul bzhin bsdams par byas na bslab 'chal kyang*// bshags par byed la bskul na dgra bzhin sems// bsdam par ma byas skye bos khrel 'gyur ba'i// ma rabs spyod la phal cher gzhol bar byed// sde dang phyogs ris longs spyod ma chags pas// dam tshig sdom pa snying rje kun bor nas// rdo rje'i spun kyang bsod par spyod pa mang*// chos bstan mnar med ltung ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur// chos ma bstan na gti mug mun pa ru// de bas 'khyam 'gyur mi khom gnas bzhin 'gro// yang dag lta ba rnam dag bstan gyur kyang*// yid ma ches shing lta ngan gzhol bar byed// 'di la ji ltar bya ba rigs pa snyam// rgyal sras rnams kyang bskul bar mi mdzad dam// de ltar kun rtog pa la zhugs shing dben pa la gnas pa// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis thugs rje chen pos bskul bar gyur pas yang dag pa'i rtog pa rnyed cing dran pa ma nyams pas bskyed pa 'di ltar byung ngo*// kye ma mi lus rin chen thob par dka'// ngan 'gro'i sa la bltas na glen lkugs kyis// mir gyur pa yang nyin skar bzhin du dkon// dran ldan dbang po ma nyams smos ci dgos// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'byung bar rab tu dkon// 'di'i 'og tu skal pa sum cu dang*// 'di 'og skal pa drug cu tham par yang*// sangs rgyas sgra yang rna bar mi thos 'gyur// kye ma bar skabs skal pa bzang po la// rgyal ba stong gi bzhi pa'i bstan pa la// snyigs dus gyur kyang bag chags bzhag byas pas// de kun skal pa 'di la grol gyur zhes// thugs rje che ldan rgyal ba nyid kyi gsungs// de bas rang gzhan don gnyis grub byed pa// bskul zhing spyad pa cung zad don ldan bya// de ltar rtogs pa bskyed nas da phyin chad bdag bsrung ba yang don dang ldan mod kyi// re zhig gzhan thog ma med pa nas 'brel ba'i sems can rnams snying rje chen po dang smon lam gyis bsdu bar bya snyam mod kyang*// don chen po mang pos bskul te drung du 'ongs pa dag bskul bar rig pas 'di skad du// 'di ltar bdag la yon tan ldan no zhes/

grags pa'i rjes 'brengs drung du 'ongs pa dag /sems la re shig nang du rtog pa mdzod// 'di 'ongs dbang med sus kyang byas pa min// longs spyod skyabs dang bza' ba 'dod phyir min/ thar pa'i lam 'dod mos pas 'dus gyur pa// de phyir bdag gis bsgos bzhin spyad par mdzod// rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur// de bas thog mar dge bsnyen dang dge tshul dang dge slong gi bslab pa rgyud la yang dag par mnos nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las ji ltar bstan pa thams cad bsgrub ma nus kyang phyogs mthun par bya'o// dge slong rnams kyang deng sang gi dus na bslab pa thams cad 'dzin par ma lcogs kyang*// bstan pa'i tha ma rtags tsam 'dzin pa yin no zhes bshad pa la// rtags thams cad kyi nang nas mu stegs pa dang*// khyim pa'i rtags spong zhing*// dge sbyong gi rtags su byed pa ni// chos gos snam sbyar yin pas bsgrub po// de mi 'byor bar gyur pas kyang snam sbyar gyi snod dang rgyu byin gyis brlabs pas bzungs te// nam grub pa na bya'o// dge tshul rnams kyis kyang chos gos dang mtha' gos bya'o// las dang po pa shes rab chung ba rnams kyis kyang*/ dge tshul gyis ni ka ri ka lnga bcu pa dang*// dge slong gis ni sdom tshig blo la bya'o// nyes pa rnams kyis ma gos shing rgyud gtsang ba la 'bad par bya'o// rang gis ltung ba tshor na bsdam par bya'o// bshags par bya'o// bslab pa la gus pa'i yan lag yin pas// drung du gnyug mar gnas pa'i 'dus pa rnams grib tshod ltar ma grub kyang dge slong gi gral gyi mgor dge tshul rnams mi bsdad de/ logs su bkur dgos pa'i dge tshul yang gral mgo gzhan bya'o// phyogs nas gsar du lhags pa yang gral sogs gcig tu bya'o// ma lcogs pa dang*/ sngags kyi spyod pa kun tu spyod pa dang*/ dge 'dun spyi'i las dang*/ rang nyid sbyin pa'i gnas skabs las gzhan pa dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyis lcogs bzhin du me dang*/

lag bde dang rtsa shing la sogs gcod pa dge slong gis mi rung pa rnams dran pas bzung ste gcol bar mi bya'o// mdor bsdus na ci ltar nus pas bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi nyes pas ma gos par bslab bo// de nas byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa mnos pas ni sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa bzung bar bya'o// rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i bya ba la rtog cing ci grub tu nan tan bya'o// zas kyi dus dang nang nub phung po gsum pa'i mdo kha thon du bya'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gdab bo// so sor thar pa'i dge slong pas kyang chos bag yod par bya'o// sngags kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas ni// tha mas kyang mngon rtogs shes par byas la bsgom mo// dbang thob pa la snyad btags nas dus ma yin pa'i kha zas za ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs par ma byas pa dang*/ tha mal pa dang ma gus pa yod pa'i sa phyogs su mchod par bya ba ma yin pa myos byed 'thung ba rnams mi bya'o// theg pa gsum kar bkag pa'i phyir rang gi gsod du bcug pa dang mtshungs pa'i bsngos pa'i sha dang*/ gsod pa mthong ba dang*/ gsod pa'i rkyen byas pa'i sha mi za'o// rang gi las kyis shi ba dang*/ tshong 'dus lan gnyis 'phar ba la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi rkyen dang ldan pas bza' bar bya'o// chos skyong spyi dang*/ cha bcu dang*/ yi dwags kyi gtor ma dang*/ chu sbyin pa la sogs pa gtor ma la brtson par bya'o// de rnams ni sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i spyod pa yin no// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin bya ba ni las dang po pa so so thar pa rkyang pa dang ldan pas ni/ phyag dang bskor ba dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ maṇ+ḍal rnams bya'o// mi rtag pa'i khrid blo sbyong la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o// sems bskyed dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni snying rje'i khrid dang stong pa nyid kyi khrid kyi rim pa'o// dbang bskur ba thob pa thams cad bsgom du rung ba mod kyi/

'on kyang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dbang bskur ba ma thob par rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi khrid bsgom du mi rung ngo*// de ltar bsgom pa'i rkyen du dben pa brten dgos pas// sa gcig tu sdod pa dang*/ kun tu 'gro yang rung te/ dbyar dang dgun gyi dus su dbyar bzhugs dang dgun bzhugs ma chag par bya'o// der yang dben pa'i khrims su bya ba gang yin pa bya ste bsam gtan bya'o// gsum pa shes rab kyi bslab pa la thog mar yi ge mi shes pa rnams kyang bslab pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi don la 'jug pa rnams bshad pa ma chag pa dang*/ nyan pa la brtson par bya'o// de'i yan lag tu mkhas par gyur pa rnams bkur bar bya'o// shes pa rnams la phrag dog med par bstod par bya'o// rnyed pa dang bkur sti lhag par bya zhing brnyas pa mi bya ba dang*/ rang gi rgyud la bsam pa dang ldan par bya'o// de ltar bslab pa gsum gyi yan lag tu bya ba byed pa rnams la bcas khrims su bya ba ni// zhal ta byed pa rgan pas bkod pa'i// dge 'dun gyi thab ka byed pa dang*/ longs spyod gnyer byed pa dang*/ 'dzo rta dang chu shing la sogs pa rnams la rang gi sdig sbyong ba'i phyir dad pa langs byed pa la gtogs pa// phal pa la thos pa dang bsgom pa tshul bzhin du mi nus kyang*/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog pa rnams kyang*/ thog ma nus mi nus dris te/ legs par brtags shing*// dpang po dang ldan par bya'o// de dag gis kyang gus pa dang ldan par bya zhing*// bla ma dang dge 'dun gyi dngos po rnams la rang nyid bzhin du gces par bya ste/ gzhan mi dad par byed pa dang*/ chud gzon par mi bya'o// grogs chos byed pa rnams la gus par bya'o// gral kyang logs su bya ba dang*/ cha lugs sna tshogs mi bya ste/ dge bsnyen ma gtogs pa rnams kyis hor gos dang*/ zhwa dkar ma dag pa'i cha lugs mi bya'o// longs spyod 'dod pa dang sbyin mkhan bsod nams mnyan pa'i phyir gzhan gyis tshogs bsog pa'i phyag bde gus par bya'o// gral ma 'dres pa dang po so sor byas kyang mnyam par sbyin par bya'o// bya ba byed pas gal te ma lcog na// nye bar 'dug pas kyang tshul bzhin du rogs bya'o// gzhan yang gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad kyis lhag pa'i bsam pa dag par bya te/

chos dang mi mthun pa'i 'thab dkrol dang spyod pa ma dag pa mi bya'o// gal te byed pa mthong na lan gcig la go byar byas te kha ta bya'o// des lan gnyis su byed na chad pa byas te bshags su gzhug go /de la yang mi nyan par lan gsum du byed na tshogs pa gzhan du 'gror gzhug go /'di ltar spyod pa'i tshul rnam par dag par byas na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don du 'gyur ro// bsam gtan dang thos pa la brtson pa dang*/ chos khrims rtog par byed pa'i zhal ta bkos te/ de'i ngag bzhin du bsgrub po/ zhal ta byed pas kyang ci 'di chos dang mthun nam mi mthun zhes legs par brtags te bya'o// dgon pa dang ri khrod du gnas pa'i dus dang*/ phan tshun 'gro ba na yang*/ 'gro ba gzhan 'dus par la sogs par mi dad par 'gyur ba'i spyod pa ni/ sdom pa gsum ka'i bslab bya las bkag pas na// spyod pa rnam par dag pa la 'bad do// mchod rten dang bde bar gshegs pa'i lha khang dang*/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams la mos par bya'o// ci nus kyi gso ba la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa thams cad kyis phyogs gcig tu brtson par bya'o// mdor bsdus na chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba bya zhing*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi mi dge ba 'phel ba'i spyod pa thams cad spang ba la 'bad par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ 'jig rten 'dir skyes don dang ldan bya'i phyir// bslab pa gsum dang mthun par spyad par bya'o// sdom gsum so so'i yon tan ldan pa yis// spyod la legs brtags snying po blang ba dang*// longs spyod g.yo ba'i snying po med pa ni/ chu me dgra dang rgyal po dang thun mong*// rang la yod pa sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yin// de bas dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin par bya// tshul khrims rkyen ni nyes par spyod pa yi// lus ngag bsdam zhing rnam dag spyod pa yin// de bas grogs ngan log par spyod pa dag /thabs kyis bsrings te yon tan ldan pa bsten// bzod pa bstan byed rang byung rtogs pa ste// bstan pa rin chen snod dang mi snod pa// legs brtags zhe sdang spang zhing go cha ldan// yon tan yar ldan rgyud la bsten par bya/

lus ngag brtson pas rtsa ba sems yin pas// ma zhum mi 'khrug chog mi shes pa yin// thos stong ting 'dzin dam pa rgyud la bya// log pa'i brtson 'grus spangs te btang snyoms bzhag /bsam gtan rkyen ni dben pa yin pas na// dbyar dgun bya ba gal chen ci yod kyang*// dor la 'tshams dang smra bcad bsten pa dang*// ri khrod bas mtha'i gnas la dga' bar bya// shes rab rgyu ni thos dang sems pa ste// des na nyan dang 'chad dang bri ba sogs// bla med theg pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la// phyogs ris spangs la chos spyod bcu po spyad// gzhan don rtsa ba byang chub sems yin pas// byams dang snying rje'i spyod pa phun tshogs dang*// gzhan la gnod par byed pa kun dor te// mthar thug phyi ma'i don du 'gyur bar bya// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs mchog rnam thar ni// bstan pa'i tshul dang mthun par slab dgos na// rgyal dang bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa ltar// spyod pa'i bca' khrims tshul bzhin spyad par bya// de ltar gzhan dag spyod cing 'jug pa la// chos 'dod pa la chos kun sbyin bya zhing*// rgyu rkyen zas dang gos dang sman rnams kyis// thun mongs spyad cing sbyin par dam bcas so// snyan smra don mthun don spyod dang 'brel bas/ 'di dang phyi ma'i don la zhugs pa yin// 'di ltar bshad kyang ngag la mi nyan cing*// 'tshe dang rku dang 'dod log spyod pa dang*// chos dang dbang bskur dmyal bar 'gro ba yi// rgyu byed cis kyang gso bar mi rung pa'i// mi rnams kyis ni sa steng gang gyur na// rang nyid brtson pa'i stobs kyis bskul byas te/ lus srog longs spyod ltos pa kun bor te// rtse cig bsgrub la nan tan bskyed bya ste// rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin brtson par byar zad mod// kye ma deng sang bstan pa'i snyigs mar bab// rnam rtog gis g.yengs yul la sred pa dam// 'dod lha'i 'khor dang nag po'i mthu rtsal bskyed// chos bzhin spyod la rma babs snying rje'i yul// de ltar snang yang rang byung rdo rje yis// cung zad sems la go cha bskyed nas kyang*// rang dag gzhan la phan par bsam nas ni// dam bcas bzhin du bca' khrims ldan pa yi// sems kyi kun rtog yig ger bris pa 'di// rgya ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang*// dkar phyogs mthu ldan chos skyong bsrungs ma yis// rang gzhan kun gyi dam bca' brtan pa yi// byin brlabs sdong grogs legs par mdzad du gsol// lha dang bcas pas 'di la yid rang mdzod// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog

/rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i dam bca' ba phyogs 'ga' zhig bris pa'o// thub pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas shing yun ring du brtan par gyur cig ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun kyi ngo bo nyid// srid dang zhi ba kun gyi dpal gyur pa// thugs rje dpag med dus ring gzigs pa po// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa nyams su len pa la// dad ldan theg pa chen po'i bshes gnyen bsten/ thams cad rtsa ba'i bla mar shes par bya// chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid de/ la la dmigs bcas sems 'dzin bsgom pa yin/ la la rtog pa'i rang bzhin bsgom pa yin// la la stong nyid dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin te// la la thabs mkhas gnad kyi man ngag bsgom// de kun thabs lam khyad par yin pa las// phyogs 'dzin byas na lam du mi 'gro ste// phyogs med sbyangs na 'bras bu thob pa yin// kun gyi gzhi ma stong nyid snying rje yin/ stong pa de yang go yul ma lus par// chos kun rgyu 'bras rten 'brel tshul shes nas// rang gi ngo bo skye dang 'gag med par// mtshan ma thams cad bral na gnas lugs yin// de ltar rtogs na nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i// sems can rnams la snying rje phyogs med pa// bskyed cing de'i tshul la zhugs par bya// srid zhi mnyam par rtogs na snying rje yin// de ltar stong nyid snying rje'i gzhi brten nas// kun gyi byed po rnam par rtog pa 'di// bsam gtan stobs kyis rtse cig bzung ba dang*// shes rab stobs kyis gang shar ngo bo sbyangs// ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ngan rtog byung ba'i tshe// sgyu ma lta bu'i gnyen pos gzhom par bya// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin bzang po dang*/ mngon zhen byas na bar chod rgyur 'gyur bas// zhen pa med par ting 'dzin lam du sbyangs// de ltar goms shing gnad du bsnun byas pas// gegs sel gzhan nas mi dgos 'di rang yin// de ltar nyams su len pa'i spyod pa yang*// rang rgyud nyon mongs zhi bar byed pa dang*/

gzhan la phan pa snying rje'i spyod pa yis// mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i lam la brten bya zhing*/ sems bskyed bsngo bas rtag tu zin pa dang*/ thabs mkhas ldan pas nyams su blangs pa yin/ rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i 'bras bu 'thob// 'di dag rgyas par man ngag tshig bsdus su// bkod nas yod pas de la gzigs par mdzod// kho bo'i 'das dang da ltar spyod pa dang*/ ma 'ongs dus na sems pa ji lta bar// rnam thar nang du rgyas par yod pas na// de ru bltas pas legs par rtogs par 'gyur// 'di ltar tshigs su bcad pa bsdus pa 'di// legs par gzigs la nyams su blang bar mdzod/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus su// theg mchog bla ma dam pa brten pa dang*/ rang gi gnyen po dang mthun tshul khrims bsrung*// longs spyod ci yod sbyin par btang bya zhing*// bla ma'i gdams ngag legs par thob nas kyang*// rtag tu 'du 'dzi dang bral ri khrod brten/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtag tu bsgom bya zhing*// gsol ba gdab cing rang gi sems dang bsre/ chos kun rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur blta// rnam rtog rtse cig ting nge 'dzin gyis bzung*// sems kyi gnas lugs stong zhing spros bral ba// phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la rgyun du bsgoms// sems can rnams la snying rje rgya chen bya// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi dge rtsa kun// gzhan don bsngo ba'i rgya yis thebs par bya// ma yengs rgyun du shes bzhin dran pa brten// 'di ni chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin// de ltar ma yengs rtse cig rgyun du bsgoms/// / ༈ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor mi lus thob par gyur pa'i tshe// bla ma dam pa rtag tu brten par bya// mos pas rtag tu gsol ba gdab bya zhing*/

'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin te// snang dang stong pa gnyis su med pa la/ gzung 'dzin zhes pa'i mtshan ma rab spangs nas/ stong dang snying rje gnyis su med par bsgom/ thabs kyi yan lag rtsal sbyang du ma yis// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu la 'bad// lus dang longs spyod gzhan don rgyu'i phyir// sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs bsod nams tshogs// dmigs med bsngo ba'i smon lam gyis zin bya/ bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor rtse cig bsgom pa dang*/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs la 'bad pas bsgom/ sems bskyed smon lam gyis ni yongs zin bya/ chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas na// de ltar kun gyis nyams su blang bar mdzod/// / ༈ bla ma

yig 'bru mi gsal/ phyag 'tshal dris pa'i lan de mdor bsdus brjod// rnam rtog skye ba dang ni 'gag pa yi// byed pa de nyid las kyi ngo bo yin// dbye ba dkar nag mi g.yo'i las gsum te// sog pa zhes bya kun gzhir bsags pa yin// de la myong dang mi myong mu bzhis te/ lus ngag yid gsum las gang spyad pa yi/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang zhing rgyun la zhugs// nges par 'bras bu 'byin pa'i las yin te// las byas 'gyod cing gnyen pos bcom pa de// byas kyang myong bar mi 'gyur las zhes bya/ lus dang ngag gis dngos su ma byas kyang*// 'dun dang yid rang ldan par gyur pa'i las// ma byas 'bras bu 'byin pa'i las zhes bya/ rgyu yang ma byas rtsol ba med pa de/ rgyu med 'bras bu med pa'i las su gsungs// zhe sdang lta bu'i 'dzin pa bcom byas kyang*// ma bde ba de bag chags lhag ma ste// gnas ngan len zhes yongs su grags pa yin// gnyid ni kun tu 'gro ba zhes bya ste/ dge ba'i rgyu ldan dge ba'i gnyid yin te/ mi dges 'phangs pa mi dge'i gnyid yin no// lung ma bstan par rmugs pa lung ma bstan// de phyir gnyid ka'i 'dun pa gtso bo yin// nyin par rjes shes med mnyam byed pa de// ngo ma shes pa'i yid gcig g.yo ba med// de phyir rmi lam nang du 'khrul pa yin// bar do de la 'khrul par shin tu 'byung*// 'di dag rnam dbye rnam shes brtag pa yi// bstan bcos kho bos byas par zhib tu ltos// dmigs med snying rje chen po zhes bya ba/ dag pa'i sa lam 'thob la 'byung ba ste// de rgyu chos rnams la dmigs snying rje yin// de yang ma dag sa bdun la yod do// de rgyu sems can dmigs pa'i snying rje ste/ de'i skye tshul 'di ltar shes par bya// sems can kun la sangs rgyas snying po yod// 'di ma rtogs pa 'khor bar 'khyam pa ste// de phyir rtog pa'i dri ma sel ba la// bdag gis 'khor ba ji srid gzhan don bya// snyam nas rgyal sras bslab pa spyod pa'o// de yis bsam gtan ting 'dzin shes rab thob// mthong bas spangs bya'i nyon mongs dag nas ni// sgyu ma lta bur chos dang sems can kun// rtogs nas nus pa rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// spyod pa chos la dmigs pa thob pa yin// yul dang nus pa thob la rnam mi rtog

/yid 'dzin rnam rtog gnas gyur thob nas kyang*// bsgom pas spang bya'i nyon mongs gtan dag cing*// smon lam stobs dang ye shes mthar phyin pa// dmigs med snying rje thugs rje che zhes bya// de phyir khyed kyi dri ba dang po de// sems can la dmigs snying rje'i rgyu ru 'gro// 'khor gsum gang la dmigs pa med pa de// stong pa'ang ma yin snying rje'ang ma yin te// yul dang yul can 'gog pa'i ting 'dzin te// 'di la so sor brtan 'gog zhes su brjod// stong pa zhes bya gang gang des dben pa'i// de med pa la stong pa'i tha snyad byas// snying rje zhes bya thams cad sgyu ma ltar// med kyang snang la 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas yin// dbyer med ngo bo dbye ba med pa dang*/ lam la mnyam par dbyer med sbyong ba dang*// 'bras bu 'bad med yid bzhin nor bu ltar// mi rtog dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dbyer med gsum// bzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs ming gsum mo// de phyir nyams su len par byed pa na// ji srid rtog pa yod kyi bar du ni// res 'jog blo yis nges par snying rje dang*// rang bzhin med la mnyam par bya dgos so// 'dres nas gzhan gyi don dang mthun spyod kyang*// ting 'dzin nyams pa med par 'gyur ba yin// de ni zung 'jug zhes bya'i rnam grangs so// lan 'dis kun mkhyen shes rab skye gyur cig ༈ na mo bhud dha ye/ yang dag pa'i shes rab tshol bar 'dod pa dag gis// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la brtag par bya ste/ de'i yan lag bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ ma rig pa 'du byed rnam par shes pa/ ming dang gzugs/ skye mched drug reg pa/ tshor ba/ sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi ste/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung*/ 'di skyes na ni 'di skye/ 'di 'gags na ni 'di 'gag /ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so// de yang las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gsum du 'dus ste/

dang po brgyad pa kun nyon mongs// gnyis dang bcu pa las yin te/ lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal yin/ gsum po dag las gnyis byung zhing*/ gnyis las bdun byung bdun las kyang*/ gsum byung srid pa'i 'khor lo 'di/ nyid ni yang dang yang du 'khor// 'di ni 'khor ba rang bzhin te// ma rigs 'gags shing skye med na// 'gag pa nyid kyang mi dmigs na// yang dag mya ngan 'das pa zhes// yang dag gzigs pa mchog gis gsungs so// rten cing 'brel pa 'byung shes shing*/ de'i don skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa rtogs na rnam par grol ba yin pas// skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis bris shig /rtog shig bsgoms shig /khong du chud pa dang rgya cher yongs su brten cig ༈ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyis mchod/ srid zhi gnyis med don la mnyam par bzhag /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa// rgyal dang bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya gshis kyi gnas snang sna tshogs 'di// du ma ro cig rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor te// snang dang stong pa rang bzhin gnyis med pa// gang rtogs de nyid chos nyid snying po yin// sna tshogs snang ba sgyu ma lta bu ste/ gang yang bden pa med pa'i rang bzhin yin// bden par 'dzin na brdzun pa'i nang du che// bden med rtogs na chos sku'i ngo bo yin// ci ltar snang ba nam mkha'i smig sgyu 'dra// bden par 'dzin pa byis pa'i 'khrul pa te// bden med rtogs na rang gi ngo bos stong*// stong dang mi stong bden med ngo bo ni// de nyid ngo bo dgag bsgrub mi bya rang sor zhog /spong len med par rtogs par gyur pa'i tshe// rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs pa'i snying po yin// gang zhig rmongs pa'i byis pa thams cad kun// 'khor ba'i gzung 'dzin mngon par zhen pa ni// rmi lam bde la rjes su chags dang mtshungs// de la spang blang ma byed glod la zhog /'dzin par byed na smig rgyu zhen pa bzhin// med pa gzung bas sdug bsngal dpag tu med// de ni 'gro drug 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid yin// des na gang la blang dang dor med par// chos dbyings rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyi don// mtshan nyid rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs pa yin// 'gro ba kun gyi 'di don rtogs par shog

༈ khyab bdag sangs rgyas kun kyis bdag /'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa'i dpal// de bzhin gshegs dang dbyer med pa// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin la// 'khrul pa'i thag pas mi bcing zhing*// gzung 'dzin zhen pa bcad par bya// nang gi rtog pa'i gnyis 'dzin rnams// nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin du lta// bden pa med pa'i rang ngo la// dgag bsgrub med par lhod kyis glod// mtha' dbus med par nam mkha' ltar// spros med chos kyi dbyings nyid la// mnyam par bzhag pas de nyid don// mtshan 'dzin dang bral de nyid de/ de don gshis kyi gnas lugs la// mtshan 'dzin med par lhod kyis glod// gshis kyi steng du mnyam par zhog /de la 'dzin par mi bya zhing*// yul du bden par rtog mi bya// gnyis 'dzin zhen pas ma slad par/ 'ching grol med par ngang nyid du// gnas pa rgyal ba'i snying po yin// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dgongs pa'i don de bla na med// 'di don gang gis ma rtogs par// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa rnams// rang gis rang la slus pa ste// dar gyi srin bu bzhin du 'khing*// des na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi// gnas lugs yin par rtogs par mdzod// 'di brtsams dge ba ci yod pa/ rigs drug sems can ma lus pa// de bzhin nyid don mngon sum du// ma nor gsal bar rnyed gyur cig ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya'i gnas lugs sna tshogs 'di// snang yang bden pa med pa ste// bden par 'dzin pa 'khrul pa'i rgyu// de bas chos rnams thams cad kyi// rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i don// nang gi blo la nges par bya// gang zhig dngos po'i snang ba la// zhen pa thams cad dor byas te// mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa kun/ rang sor phrol las mnyam par zhog /blang dang dor bar ma byed par// gshis kyi gnas lugs ci bzhin du// 'ching grol med pa'i ngo bo ru// rang grol mnyam pa nyid du zhog

blta ba kun gyi mthar thug yin/ gang zhig 'di don nyams len na/ lus ni bsam gtan gnas bcas te// rnam rtog gzhan du mi g.yeng par// rtse cig mi g.yo brtan byas te// yul dang yul can gnyis med la/ rang gsal gcig tu bzhag par bya/ gang tshe bsgoms 'dzin byung ba'i tshe// de nyid byung bar shes byas la// rang grol nyid du mnyam par zhog /mnyam par 'jog mkhan sems nyid de// de yang rang grol rang gi sems// de ltar rtogs par gyur pa yi// ma rtogs the tshom mi bya ste// bcos ma'i tshul 'chos byed pa yang*// mtha' gnyis bral ba'i spyod pa mchog /yang dag dbu ma'i lam du 'gro// yang dag de'i 'bras bu ni// srid zhi spangs pa'i sangs rgyas te// bsam bya med cing gnas bya med// spang pa med cing thob pa med// rang gi 'bras bu mthar thug go /'di ni sems can thams cad kyis// mngon sum nyid du mthong bar shog ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye ma deng sang bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// nges par dam chos mdzad la gzhol ba rnams// rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'jal ba dka' bar soms// skal pa bye ba mang la res 'ga' 'byung*// dal 'byor skyon med dbang po ldan pa sogs// sngon sbyangs bsod nams du ma bsags las byung*// mtshan ldan bla ma mkhas grub 'dzom pa dkon// rnyed nas de'i gsung ltar bsgrub pa gces// log mtsho tshe 'di don du gnyer ba mang*// de 'dra rnams dang 'phrad na thabs kyis byol// yul ngan gnas dgon chags sdang sogs pa mang*// de 'dra rnams la sdug zhen cha yis spongs// mi nag phal cher tshe 'di 'dod pa mang*// de 'dra'i khyim 'dris ngo bsrung byed pa po/ grogs po phal cher rang don tshe 'di bsgrub// kha la mi nyan de'i dbang mi 'gro// rnam rtog 'di ni bag chags ngan pas g.yengs// rtag tu rang la dran pas bzung ba gces/ dbang po lnga la bde bas chog shes med// tshor ba mi rtag chu zla lta bur soms/

gzugs sogs yul snang sgyu mas brid pa 'dra// yul phyir mi 'brang rmi lam lta bur ltos// sdug kyang dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa bsten// mi dge'i yul la bags kyis srab par 'gyur// rnyed pa che yang sdig ltos nor ma bsog /sngar gyi bsod nams zad nas ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sgro bskur btab kyang 'gyod med tshul khrims bsrungs// rang gi so nam rang la drin du che/ zhe sdang skyes kyang bzod pa'i go cha gyon// shing gnyis drud na rang tshig pham kha 'ongs// dge ba ci byas 'gro ba'i don du bsngos/ zad med bskyed du btang bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur// rang phyir byas na dbul po'i phag nor mtshungs// rang gi drod rtags kha sgor smra mi bya// bdud kyis mi tshugs myur du yon tan 'phel// dngos ngan rgyal mtshan rtse la phyar gyur na// chom rkun yod par nor ngom byed dang mtshungs// dam pa rnams kyi skyon la brtag mi bya// ral gri'i so la bsnun na rang lus chod// blo mi shong ba'i chos la 'phya ba spangs// phyi dus thar pa'i rtsa ba stor ba srid// rang gi nyon mongs gang skyes myur du spang*/ dug sbrul rten na myur du 'chi// rkyen 'di ni phyed 'khor zhes bya ba yin// lus lha sku bsgoms mnyam du bcings// ngag sngags gsung cig rjes ma nas// yid bsgom thugs rje cig la brten// gsum pa cig la du mar 'brel// mnyam nyid che rtsol bsgom cig zhes// bzhag byed bzhag bya med pa su// yin zhes bya bral mnyam nyid brjod// ngan byung na sngon gyi las su bsgom// gang byung de la gnyen pos thog 'gel bya// sdug bsngal byung tshad sgrib pa'i chags mar blta// sems can kun gyi sgrib pa dag par bsgom// bde ba gang byung sangs rgyas bka' drin yin// dkar po'i chos kun de yis bstan pa'i phyir// bla ma rgyal sras kun la mos pa bskyed// chu bo che la sgrol mkhan gzhan na med// dam chos bsgrub dus lus la gces spras bya// 'khor ba'i chu la gru zam gzhan na med/

mi dge sog pa'i lus kyi tshis mi bya// sdig med shi ba'ang de la 'gyod pa med// thar pa'i lam la 'gro ru mi nyan par// slob ma sdom med nyag nyog 'khor mi brkyang*/ rang gi rkang pa 'khor ba'i 'dam tshud 'gyur/ de bas bag yod theg chen gdams pa bsgom// 'di ltar rgyal dang bla ma'i bka' srol te// ring por mi thogs byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/// / ༈ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor shes nas kyang*// lus sgo gsum gus pas skyo med par// rten na bla ma'i byin brlabs 'byung*// sdom gsum gyi bslab pa thob par kyang*// gong 'og dang yon tan khyad par la// nyin mtshan du bsams shing nyams su blangs na// 'chug med rgyal sras gral du sleb// rlung srog rtsol gnad du bsnun pa la// rtsa stong gzugs 'khrul 'khor byang bar bya// snyigs ma sgo dgu phyi ru ded// bar steng 'og snyoms shes dka' ba med/ khams dwangs ma sbyong bar byed pa na// hūṃ ring thung steng 'og phul shes shing*/ phyi nang dngas snyigs 'byed shes na// bde stong lus sems la rgyun mi 'chad// khams dngul chu gser du 'gyur 'dod na// dag pa gsum ldan gyi me thab tu/ rlung ga'u kha sbyor ldang tsher gyi// ro bcud dang legs sbyar gser du 'gyur// rnam rtog de lam du byed pa la// dran pa'i shes pas rang ngo bzung*// kho gang skyes bltas la mnye btul bya// kho rang stong cig tu shar nas 'ong*/ zas cig gis sems can kun 'gyed na// rang 'dod pa med par zo las zhog /rtogs pa ye shes su bsgyur ba la// chos rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba bsgom// dus grangs med gsum gyi sa lam de// lo zla yis bsgrod par 'dod pa na// thabs shes rab bsngo ba smon lam gyis// rtogs pa la brgya yis thob la zhog ༈ rtog pa'i khyi'u spun gnyis kyi lo rgyus zhes bya/ mkhas pa rnams gson cig

/'jig rten la chags pa'i khye'u sred pa dpag med dang*// 'jig rten snying po len par rtog pa'i khye'u dag pa gnyis ga cig la ga cig 'di skad smra'o// dang po na re// kye ma mi lus bzang po thob// dbang po sgo lnga skyon med ldan// pha ma nye du bzang po yod/ khang khyim bzang la bde dang ldan// bza' btung zhim po bza' bar byed/ 'jig rten 'di ni bde ba yin// zhes so// gnyis pa na re// mi lus thob la don go dgos/ dbang po lnga po ci la blta// pha ma rtag tu sdod pa min// khang khyim 'dzom yang myur du 'jig /bza' btung myur du mi rtag 'gyur// 'bras bu gang yin shes sam ci/ zhes smras pa dang*/ yang dang po na re/ mi lus bsod nams 'bras bu ste// don go bde bar spyod pa ste// gzugs mdzes lta zhing sgra rnyan nyan// dri zhim snom zhing ro mchog bza'// reg bya 'jam gon dbang po'i don// pha ma khang khyim mi rtag kyang*/ rang gis brtson par bsgrub pas chog /zas gos 'dzom dang grags dang snyan// rang dga' gzhan mgu 'bras yin snyam// yang gnyis pa na re/ khyod ni tha shal blun pos ste// mi lus bsod nams 'bras yin na// da ltar spel ba khyod re blun// de la chags nas snga ma zad// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ma mthong ngam// yul lnga dbang po myangs byas kyang*// mi la shing bzhin chog mi shes/ sbyin dang tshul khrims ma bsrungs na// bde 'dod khyod la sdug bsngal 'byung*// pha ma nye du rtsa lag kyis// khyod spangs srid gzhan 'gro ba na// rog med gos zas mi 'brang bas/ log pa'i brtson 'grus zhe sdang dang*// khe bskyed log mtsho byas pa yis// gshin rje ma rungs brtse med pas/ khyod lus tsher ma'i khrod du bskyur// bya khyis 'drad cing dum bur gtor// mdza' rogs ngu zhing 'bod gyur kyang*/ yi mug rang gzhan gnyis la 'byung*// khe grags snyan grags yal nas 'gro/ khyod ni spyang po don med cig

/mkhas pa kun gyis khrel du rungs// de skad ces smras pa dang*/ yang khye'u dang po na re/ 'o na khyod mi lus thob pa la bde ba ci yod pa shod cig /bde dang 'jig rten khe dang grags// de las gzhan pa gang zhig yin// zhes dris pa dang*/ khye'u 'jig rten snying po med rtogs na re/ pha ma drin chen 'khor bar 'khyams// de la lan du bde ba sbyin// dbang po lnga po yul la chags// khang khyim longs spyod sgyu ma ltar// snying po med pas chags zhen spongs// lus la phyi ma'i don grub na// legs par sogs la phangs par gyis// don med dmyal bar 'khrid pa yi// las la dga' na myur du bzlog /chags shing sred na blo yis thong*// gzugs rnams mi rtag 'ja' tshon 'dra// bden 'dzin ma byed rang sar zhog /sgra la brag cha'i gnyer las med/ rjes su ma 'breng bden ma 'dzin/ dri la gtad med smig sgyu 'dra// ma snom rang sar rtse ne zhog /ro la gtad med yug gcig yin// lto 'grangs tsam la chog shes bzung*/ reg bya bden med chu bur 'dra// snang ba bden par khyed ma 'dzin// mkhas pa sangs rgyas rjes su snyogs/ ces smras pa la/ yang khye'us bsams nas smras pa// mkhas pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'brang ba la ci ltar bya mi shes so// de la smras pa de bden no// ngas bstan gyi nyon cig /tshul khrims ldan cing chog shes la// bla ma mkhas pa'i rjes 'brengs te// de dben par bde ba'i bsam gtan bsgom// mi rtag rgyud la brten par bya// thos dang bsod nams 'bras bu bsgrub/ 'di ni thams cad rtsa ba yin/ yang smras pa/ dben pa bsten par byed pa'i gnas na/ bzung ba dang btung ba la sogs pa'i khyad par med pa/ 'jigs pa dang bcas pa ma yin nam/ lan du smras pa/ rnam g.yeng chags dang zhe sdang dang*// srid pa 'phel ba ma yin pa// ca co sgra dang bral ba dang*// gnod med dben pa'i gnas mchog yin// nags tshal ri dang ljon pa rnams// me tog 'bras bu du mas gang*// rlung gis bskyod pa'i gar mdzes byed// mdzes pa'i ri dwags tshogs kyis gang*// bai ḍūr+ya ltar mdzes pa'i sa// chu bran lhung lhung sgra sgrogs pa// brag ri sna tshogs rin chen phreng*// spang ljongs sna tshogs sha zhong la// ne sing mdzes pa'i dar la bzhin/
