bung ba mdzes pa gar byed pa// mthong na yid rab dwangs byed pa// dus kyi rkyen gyi bsgyur ba yi// kha dog sna tshogs bkram pa 'dra// bya rnams snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin// rtsa ba lo ma 'bras bu rnams// bza' ba sna tshogs sbyar ba 'dra// nyin par 'du 'dzi zang zing med// mtshan mo sgra'i rnam g.yeng bral// lha'i dga' tshal dri med bzhin// thub pa drang srong rab tu dgyes// dri za ba rnams rtse rung pa// mi 'am ci rnams glu len pa// nyi zla 'od gsal dkar po'i 'od// bdud kyi rtsa lag rnams sel ba// brten na zhi ba'i bsam gtan 'phel// 'jig rten mi gtsang dong lta bu// su zhig dga' bas 'dod par byed// ces smras so// lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa 'phro ba'i dris lan rdzogs so/// / ༈ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// drag po mthar byed mgrin gsum lha'i lha// zhi ba dpal ldan mig gsum las lhag rab zhi ba/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma 'jig rten las 'das gang*/ srid zhi'i 'dren pa bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog mtshan ma rab zhi ba// zhi ba'i lam mchog tshul ldan pa// rten byed mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can// de'i tshul 'di brjod par bya// dang po rgyal ba'i bstan la mos// bar du dge ba'i bshes kyis zin// tha mar dben pa'i zhi lhag bsgoms// 'di 'dra bsod nams phul du byung*// nags ljongs 'bab chu ldan pa dang*/ gangs ri spang gis mdzes par byas/ mtsho chen brlabs kyi phreng ba can/ dben pa'i gtso bor gyur pa yin// 'jig rten 'khri ba chod pa dang*/ dge ba'i grogs kyis zin pa dang*/ rang rgyud las su rung ba rnams/ rgyu ni phun gsum 'tshogs pa yin/ rgyal ba'i bsod nams lta ba dang*/ rgyud sde'i snying po mthong ba dang*/ man ngag dpag med ldan pa des/ rkyen gyi gtso zhes bya ba yin// bsam gtan bzhi'i gnas la mkhas// shes rab rgyu 'bras rnam par 'byed/

snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed pa// dri med lam gyi rtsa ba yin// brtson 'grus legs par brtsom pa dang*// bzod ldan drang zhing bden par byed// dran pas dbang bsgyur mkhas pa de// grogs gyi mchog te bla na med// rtag tu zhing khams dag pa sbyongs// dngos kun sgyu ma lta bur shes// 'dun dang sems la dbang byed pa// 'bras bu mchog gi rgyu'i gtso// shin tu rgyal ba'i mdo ltar mos// yid gcod phyogs su ma lhung bar// rang gis bla na med 'jug pa// rgyal ba'i thabs mchog rtogs ces bya// dran pa'i blo 'di dran med pa// dga' yul sred pa gcod pa zhes// rgyal chen la sred srid pa'i bde chen spyod pa zhes bya yul ma yin// kha dog yon tan med pa'i kha dog ro gcig byed pa rdzun ma yin// bden med zhes bya bden pa dam pa gang gis 'khor ba'i pha rol phyin// kye ma'o rang byung ming can gyi ni don med bris la bzod mdzod/// / ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhi hūṃ// /bla ma dam pa'i gdams pa legs thob na// zhi gnas lhag mthong goms par byed pa la// rtog pa'i rgyu ba gsal stong rtse gcig tu// g.yo med gnas pa zhi gnas ngo bo yin// gzugs sogs yul rnams rang gi sems kyis dngos/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur snang ba ste// 'dzin med rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug po// rang gi ngo bo gsal stong skye med du// rtogs pa stong pa'i rang ngo mthong ba ste// 'gag med rigs pa'i rtsal shar ba yi/ dkar nag rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'gag med par// blang dor tshul shes de yang spros bral du// rtogs shing ma rtogs kun la snying rje bskyed// de nyid lhag mthong zhes su rgyal bas gsungs// de gnyis dbyer med gcig tu nyams len pa// theg chen lam gyi gzhung du bshad pa yin// de don rtogs pa'i bogs 'don gegs sel ni// nyon mongs gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i gegs yin te// zhi lhag yon tan mngon shes ting 'dzin la// dga' zhing mtshan mar 'dzin na de'ang gegs// rgyu 'bras bla dor bden 'dzin gegs yin te/

bden med stong par 'dzin na de bas 'khrul// de phyir rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba dang*// yon tan gang la'ang ma zhen rtsol med sbyang*// snying rje chen pos sems can don byed cing*// dge ba kun spel smon lam rgya chen gdab// sangs rgyas chos kun shes shing rtogs par 'dod// de yang gzhan gyi don du yongs su bsngo// de dag kun kyang chu zla lta bu ru// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun gyis brten byas nas// dngos dang dngos med bdud kyis tshugs mi 'gyur// sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs rnams rab tu 'phel// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyis bsngags 'gyur zhing*// ring por mi thogs 'bras bu thob 'gyur pa// 'di ltar bsgrub la mngon par brtson par mdzod/ bsgom sde ras pa la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snang ba tsam la brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa'o// gzugs 'di snang yang bden dngos su// brtags na ma dmigs gi phyir// bum pa mthong zhes gang brjod pa// dbyibs ltar snang ba'i rtog pa yis// sgro btags gang mthong mi bden te// rab rib can gyi skra shad bzhin// rags pa'i rtsom gzhi rdul phran ni// yod ces zhen pas gang smra ba// dbang po'i mngon sum ma dmigs phyir// mi brten der brtags 'khrul pa'i blo// bdag 'dzin can gyi bdag brtags mtshungs// gang tshe blo yis sgro btags pa// bden pa'i rjes su rtog na ko// ri bong ra ni dkar zlum pa// ci'i phyir na 'grub mi 'gyur// rdzas med bden par mi snang ste// ma mthong lag na rdzas yod ces// 'dod na brlan dang bsregs pa yi// khams ldan rdzas ces ci phyir smra// de ni mngon sum rdzas zhe na/ thag pa las ni sbrul 'dzin du// mngon snang shes pa ci phyir 'khrul// thag pa las ni sbrul med cing*// brtags na thag pa'ang spu'i tshogs// ril bu'i rdzas med cha shas ste// cha shas brtags na rdul phran nyid// bden par 'ga' yang grub med na// byis pa tha snyad rjes 'brangs pas/

sbrul snang shes pas rdzun pa ste// thag pa snang ba bden yin zhes// log pa'i tha snyad 'dzin par byed// de bzhin 'khor dang mya ngan 'das// thams cad de nyid mtshungs pa ste// ji ltar snang ba de tsam bden// ji ltar brtags na bden pa med// snang dang bden med rang bzhin ni// skyed med 'gag pa med pa ste// snang de skye zin bden mi dgos// snang ba de nyid ma 'gags phyir// de bzhin stong pa'ang skye 'gag med// snang stong 'gal min mi 'gal min// gcig min tha dad rnam bral bas// chos sku skye 'gags med do zhes// 'phags mchog rnams kyis bstan pa yin/ 'di mthong srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog ༈ snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshigs bcad bstan pa zhes bya ba// 'khor ba'i srid 'di ka ra lta bur mngar// de la sred pas kha na ma tho med// grang ba'i nad la ga pur 'thung ba bzhin// phyin ci log tu nga bdag 'phel bas rmongs// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ca co ma mthong par// 'khor ba'i mi gtsang cha shas la rten pas// 'dod pa'i lcags kyu ja sogs ro yis bcings/ ngan 'gro'i mtsho la nya ltar kun tu 'khor// yon tan mi 'phel ta la'i mgo bcad bzhin// dge bcu'i 'bras med tha rgod bzhin du rengs// thogs med dus nas da rung ngan 'gror bcings// skye dang rgas dang na 'chis nyon re mongs/ mtshan mo 'jigs pa'i pa sangs mtshan ma bzhin// dkar po'i lam chad pha rol mu stegs gzugs// blun pa'i rang bzhin ba glang rgod lta bu// nyams nga'i gnas der ma rabs thams cad 'khyam// dge ba'i lam chad tsa dra'i rang bzhin ltar// 'dod la sred pa tsha chu 'thungs ba bzhin// log pa'i las kyis dza brdungs dbang med byas// sdug bsngal gang la wa bzhin zin par 'gyur// sdug bsngal 'bras bu zha rengs 'khums pa dang*// gsod dang 'chi dang za rgyu med pa yi// sdug bsngal gyis mnar 'a sgra'i sdug skad 'don// log pa 'di las ya rabs rnams bzlog la/

bzang po'i gser dang ra gan ma snyoms par// lus ngan dor la la la'i lugs bzang long*// don med sred pa'i sha chang la ma chags// 'phags lam la brten sa lam 'khri shing bzhin/ don med spyod pa ha cang mi bya zhes/ rgyal ba'i gsung la a la la zhes bsam// rang gi yon tan ta k+ṣa ka'i brgyan// yig ge'i phyi mor spel te brjod pa yin/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus ngan bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub la nye// rab byung chos bzhin mi byed par/ 'dod dang log pa'i mtsho ba bsgrub// chos gos rnams gsum mi gon pa'i// ser gzugs rgyab ser ber ka can// khyi dang bu tsha khyim pa rnams/ skrog cing zas la khyi ltar 'khyam// chos min spyod cing thob tshad za/ cung zad longs spyod yod pa yang*// log pa'i spyod pa du ma byed// gzhan gyis bkur ba dge sbyong rnams// chos ldan snyoms chung chad pas gcod/ brdzun dang sdig spyod bya ka ster// che tshul bzung ba'i rab byung 'ga'// shan pa ma rungs ri dwags bsod// chang 'thungs dran pa nyams byed cing*// bu smad gso zhing 'dod log spyod/ rgyal po chos bzhin mi spyod par// log lta can gyi dbang du gyur// blon po chen por gyur pa rnams// jag rkun rnams kyi dpon byed cing*// bden pa rnams la chad pa 'bebs// rkun ma rnams kyis sa steng khyab/ lha khang mchod rten 'jig byed cing*/ sku gzugs bcom zhing za ba dang*// chos kyi po ti ma rungs byed// de'i rkyen gyi lha 'dre rnams// 'khrugs ste nad kyi rgyal khams gang*// char mi 'bab cing lo nyes byung*// cung zad skyes par gyur pa rnams// sad dang ser bas 'khyer byed cing*// 'phrog dang 'joms pa'i mi rnams kun// mug ges nyams thag kyi hud 'bod// phal cher lam du 'gyel cing 'chi// la la gcig sha gcig gis za/ kha cig bkres pas chu ru 'chong*// nyin mtshan med par cho nge 'byin// rus mgo lpags pas btums tsam na// kha gcig tshal zhing bsregs pa bzhin// yi dwags mngon du gyur pa bzhin// bsod dang 'ching dang brdeg pas gang*// 'dze dang phol 'bras rnag khrag 'dzag

/dmyal ba mngon du 'ongs pa bzhin// blun zhing dkar po'i lam chad pas// dud 'gro mngon sum dbye ba med// mi lus ngan song sdug bsngal can// kye ma 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal gyur// kyi hud sems can snying re rje// bod khams stod kyi sa 'di ru// rgyal sras thugs kyi ma dgongs sam// gangs can rgyud 'dir de 'dra bas// myur du ma rungs gyur gyi dogs/ shubhaṃ// ༈ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku mtha' bral bde ba chen po la// longs sku 'gag med mtshan gyis rab tu rgyan// sprul sku thugs rje'i rtsal snang phyogs bcur khyab// sku gsum dbyer mi phyed la phyag 'tshal lo// dad ldan skyes mchog bsod nams ldan// dal 'byor tshul bzhin thob cing bstan la 'jal// theg chen bla mas rjes su bzung gyur cing*// ma smin smin pa'i dbang rnams thob nas kyang*// lam gyi gnas lugs dpag tu med gyur kyang*// byams dang snying rje'i khrid la blo sbyangs nas// theg dman gol sa chod par nyams su blang*// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad rnams kun// ma nor gnad du bsnun pas lus sbyang bya// spros pa gcod pa'i sgrol ma gnad la dbab// 'byung bzhi bsdus pa'i snang yul sbyong ba yin// de nas lus kyi rus shan gnad la bor// 'khor ba'i lus kyi 'dzin pa dag par bya// ngag gi lam rnams ca co'i mtshan ma bral// yid ni 'jig rten zhen pa log par byed// de ltar byas pas mya ngan 'das la nye// 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin zhen pa bral byas nas// de nas khreg chod chen po'i don la sbyang*// 'khor 'das thams cad chos dbyings spros bral la// dbyings zhes bya ste thams cad de'i ngang du// rang gi sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// ngan 'gro la sogs sems can kun kyang gcig /skad cig shes pa snang stong bar na gnas// snga ma 'gags shing phyi ma ma skyes pa// gsal stong 'dzin med rig pa'i ngo bo ste// 'di ni rdzogs chen sems klong thams cad dang*// sems tsam dbu ma kun nas gsungs pa yi/

dbyings rig yin te thun mong theg par bstan// da ni khyad par bla na med pa yi// thod rgal lhag mthong dbyings rig bstan par bya// dbyings la phyi nang gnyis te phyi'i dbyings// nam mkha' stong pa yin te snang ba'i yul// nang dbyings rnam dag sgron ma zhes bya ba// sna tshogs nam mkha'i 'dra 'gyu ba yi// thig le 'od zer du ma'i bdag nyid can// zhing khams rgyal ba'i zhing khams du 'char ba yin// rig pa zhes bya rnam dbye lnga po ste// gzhi gnas rig pa'i ngo bo rang bzhin dang*// thugs rje gsum ste rgyal ba'i snying po la// sku gsum rang chas bzhugs par bshad pa yin// gzhi 'dzin rig pa rtog pa du mas sbags// sems can rgyud sde kun bzhi'i rnam shes yin// mtshan nyid 'dzin pa rig pa zhes bya ba// rnam rtog rig rig gya gyu byed pa ste// rtog pa zhes bya chos rnams spyi'i skad yin// lhag par rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud// bla mas ngo sprad skal ldan mig gi yul// rang dag thig le'i snying po can zhes bya// de'i cha shas sku dang thig le dang*// sna tshogs snang ste 'khor ba'i 'khrul pa 'joms// rang snang rang shar 'gag med phyogs bcur 'char// spyan lnga rnam dag ye shes rang 'od gsal// shes bya kun gyi phyogs mthong kun dang bral// rdzu 'phrul chen po'i mig 'phrul lta bu la// sa 'drar snang yang rdul phran ma yin la// chu ltar 'gyu yang rlan cing gsher dang bral// me ltar gsal yang tsha zhing bsreg pa med// rlung ltar g.yo yang rlung dang bral ba yin// mkhar ltar snang yang nam mkha'i mtshan nyid min// sku rnams 'char yang rdos bcas gzugs sku min// sgra kun snang yang ngag gi 'du byed min// dri kun snom yang sbyar kun gyur dang bral// ro dang ldan yang ro drug snom pa min// reg dang ldan yang lus las skyes pa min// 'gyu yang rtog pa'i 'a gyu ba dang bral bya/ bsam gtan ldan kyang shes rab zab mo'i don// shes rab yin kyang thos bsam bral ba la// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku chen po/

dang po'i dus ni smig sgyu lta bur 'char// bar du gong 'phel ye she sa snang ba yis// lam ston 'khrul pa'i dri ma spel ba ste/ tha ma'i dus na rig pa tshad phebs dus// rigs lnga'i zhing du thams cad lam mer snang*// chos kun zad pas yul dang yul can bral// rang rig rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sku// sgra tshad kun gyi gtan la mi phebs te// mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi tas kyang brtag bya min// bstan na blun po ba glang rdzis kyang mthong*// rtogs par gyur tshe rdo rje sems dpar snang*// 'di 'dra theg pa kun las khyad 'phags pa// bla med rdzogs chen snying gis theg pa yi// dbyings rig gnas lugs mdor bsdus brjod pa yin// nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis// lus kyi gnad gsum bcun pas dal ba brten// ngag gi smra bcad tshig kun chos la sbyang*/ yid ni bsam rgyun bcad nas kyang*// dbyings kyi nang du lug gu rgyud bcug la// lta stangs gsum gyis gtad pa'i dben la gtad// snang ba'i zhen pa bcad cing rtag tu gzir// rdzu 'phrul yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i tshe/ rang lus zad pa'i sa ru phyin pa dang*// 'pho ba chen mo'i lus la dbang thob nas// sems can kun don spyod pa 'bras bu'i mchog /'di don de ltar skal ldan kun la bstan/ 'di ni don med bri bar mi rigs kyang*/ rtogs ldan mdzes pa'i mtshan ldan gyis bskul nas// rdzogs chen gnas lugs phyogs tsam bstan pa 'di// rang byung zhes bya bhi ma la mi tra/ rjes su slob pas brjod par gyur pa la// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzod par mdzod cig kye// dge bas nyams len byed pa'i sems can kun// kun tu bzang po'i yon tan mngon 'gyur shog ༈ na mo tshe ring de bzhin nad med dang*// gzugs dang skal bzang nyid dang rigs// nor dang shes rab de bdun ni// thob rgyu gsungs pa rtogs par bya// gsod pa chud par btang ba dang*// de bzhin srog la phan btags dang*// srog chags 'tshe ba dag las bzlog

/tshe ring ba ni thob par 'gyur// nad pa'i rim 'gro byas pa dang*// sman dang sman pa byin pa dang*// srog chags bong ba dbyig sogs kyis// 'tshe ba med pa nad med nyid// khro ba med pa brten pa dang*// brgya byin pa yis gzugs bzang nyid// phrag dog med pa'i 'bras bus 'dir// bskal pa bzang por yongs su grags// nga rgyal spangs te dam pa rnams// mchod cing bskur bas rigs bzang 'gyur// sbyin byed rku ba las bzlog pas/ longs spyod phun tshogs thob par 'gyur// dge dang sdig pa gang yin zhen// yang dag dri la yongs ngal dang*// chos kyi bstan chos byin pa yis// blo gros rgya chen thob par 'gyur// de ltar yon tan rnam pa bdun/ bsdu ba byas nas bdag gis ni/ dge ba gang zhig thob pa des// skye bo yon tan can gyur cig /slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis bsdus pa las byung ba'o// 'khor ba na bde ba 'dod na bsgrub pa gal che'o/// / ༈ rtag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms// sems can kun la snying rje bskyed/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsgom// ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la spyod// gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol// thun tshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya// sbyin sogs dge la rab 'bad cing*// bsngo ba smon lam brgya yis btab/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag med thugs rje'i stobs mnga' zhing*// blo gros rgya chen gting dpag dka' gyur cing*// 'gro ba mtha' yas dus ring gzigs pa po// rgyal ba shākya'i rgya po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis zhabs la lha dag mi dbang dregs pa'i gtsug gis zhum zhing btud// srid rtse'i 'og min chus skyes gdugs mdzes pad mo'i gdan ltar gnas gyur kyang*// 'og 'gro'i mthar thug mnar med pa'ang gtsug tu khur byed snyam pa gang*// rgyal ba'i sras po nam mkha'i khyon gyis dpag mi nus pa e ma mtshar/ gang gis snyigs dus mun pa la// gsal byed rgyal ba'i nyi ma shar// dam chos 'od stong gsal ba gang*// skye 'gro kun gyis dpal yin mod// 'on kyang rang gi rtog pa las// chos spong byed pa gang dag la// 'byung po'i bya bzhin mig 'grib byed// lus skyes sprin bzhin sdug bsngal rgyu// kye ma mtshar bcas ma rig pa'i// 'gro la bdag gis ji ltar gdams// gang gis smon lam mthu yis dmyal ba'i me// zhi byed rgyal ba'i sras po spyan ras gzigs// ma rig gti mug thibs po rab sel ba// shes rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs// skal pa grangs med rtse ba'i rgyun ldan pa// byams pa zhes grags rgyal tshab gang bzhugs pa/

snyigs dus 'gro la thugs rjes snyel lam ci// kye ma 'khor ba ma rig bzhi la 'dud byed mu khyud gyis bskor ba'i// las dang nyon mongs rgya mtsho chen po'i rba brlabs rab tu g.yo zhing 'khyil// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi ni rtag 'bab thug pa med pa gang*// tshor ba'i chu srin nya dang srin po lcigs lcigs rab tu g.yo bas khengs/ phung po khams sogs ri gling brtan snang bskyed byed mi rtag lbu ba can// 'di 'dra skems byed rgyal dang de sras ngo mtshar rmad du byung*/ gang zhig dus mthar 'gro ba'i rgya mtshor ye shes nyi ma 'char gyur cig phung po khams sogs sgrib pa sreg pa'i snga ltas chu bo rab skems la// dran pa nyer bzhag 'od kyi 'og mar sngon du byed pa'i mthu 'phro'o// gnyis par mi dge chu bo bzhi skems yang dag spong ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char// gsum par rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i nyi mas 'dod pa'i ma dros skams pa yin// bzhi par dbang po'i 'od stong 'char bas tshor ba'i rgya mtsho mthar byed la// lnga par stobs kyi tsha zer byed pas khams gsum brlan dang bral byed cing*// drug par byang chub yan lag 'od kyis mthong spangs nyon mongs ri gling bsreg /bdun par 'phags lam tsha zer byed pa'i stobs kyis 'du byed stong gsum bsreg /rnam dag chos dbyings nam mkha'i khams ni rgyal ba'i snying po rab dag bya// slar yang thugs rje'i 'od zer phrin las dag pa'i zhing khams rab spros nas// sna tshogs sprul sku'i char rgyun 'gro ba'i nyer spyod 'gyur zhes gang gsungs pa// kye ma ngo mtshar 'on kyang de'i dus la bab pa shin tu nyams// rgyal bas snyigs dus gang gsungs pa// 'du 'dzir gnas pa spangs pa dang*// dben par sems dben brten pa dang*// gzhan gyi 'khrul pa mi 'tshol zhing*// rang rgyud 'grub pa spong bar byed// sred dang khyim 'dris mi byed cing*// chog shes mang du thos pa dang*// dad dang shes rab snying rje la// rab rten kun la dag snang bsgoms// shes rab thos dang ting 'dzin la// chog shes nga rgyal mi bya zhing*// le lo g.yeng ba rgyun bcad la// brtson 'grus rab skyed dus la bab/

zas dang nor dang gos la sogs/ snying po med par chog shes pa// 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad kyang*// skad cig skye 'gag byed pa'i phyir// thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i// rnam rig mi rtag g.yo ba yin// khams gsum sems dang sems byung dang*// thams cad rnam par rig pa tsam// skad cig zhes su rgyal bas gsungs// de nyid kun rdzob bden pa ste// snang yang bden med chu zla tsam// stong pa tsam du yang dmigs pa med/ chos can la rten chos nyid ni// bco brgyad rnam par dbye ba kun// don dam bden pa zhes grags te// tha mal sems kyi gnas lugs ni// bden gnyis dbyer med ngo bos te// rgyal bas rtag tu bsngags par mdzad// kye ma 'di don 'dzom par bsgrub par 'dod pa rnams// 'di dang phyi mar sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i bzhin// char rlung chu dang ba mo yi reg pas kos thag cing*// dbyar dus rab tsha nyi zer gyis gdungs ngal bzhin du// 'dod pa'i rnam g.yeng shugs 'byin ngal dub spyod pa dag /cong rong ri dang tshang tshing gis khrer bas mtha' ru// kha zas longs spyod bde 'dod sdug bsngal gyis bcings nas// tshe 'dir sdug bsngal phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas rnams su// 'gro ba'i rgyur gyur don med rtsol ba rnam par spongs// rang gi yul dang 'tsho ba'i longs spyod du ma dang*// pha ma gnyen dag brtse bcas sred pa'i 'chi rgyun can// sdug bsngal rtsa lag de dag mngon par spangs gyur cing*// thub pa'i bstan la 'jug par byed pa skal bar ldan// zhugs nas tshul bzhin thos dang bsam pa legs bsten pa// thar pa'i lam la mngon phyogs 'dug pa kye ma mtshar// der yang bag med chom rkun gyis// rnam par bcom nas nyams pa'i blos// kun rtog rlung gis sbar ba yis// yul gyi bud shing dang 'phrad me// lus dang longs spyod don tsam du// spel bar byed pa ma rungs nyams// de rkyen kun rig gis kun rtog gi

/rlung gis khro sogs me sbar nas// dge ba'i nags tshal rab bsregs bcings// bslab pa'i 'tshams las 'das nas kyang*// pham dang ltung byas chos spong gis// las bsags bdud kyi dbang 'gro ba// kye ma sems can nyon re mongs// gal lte de ltar ltung bar gyur nas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dar drag pa// ral gri chu gri shag ti mdung thung mda' dang spu gri rab 'bar bas// yang dang yang du dum bur byed dang sog le sta ris lus gshog byed/ lcags kyi dra bas steng du g.yogs shing bsdus gzhom ri yis kun tu gzir// lcags bsregs 'bar dkris ngu 'bod dang ldan 'bar ba'i gcong rong sgra chen 'byin/ me 'dag spu gri'i rlung gis rab bsregs rab tshar 'bar ba'i sdug bsngal ldan// me ma mur dang ro dmyags 'dam bying spu gri mtshon cha'i tshal du rgyug /gshed pos dbang med ro nye bdud bcings lus bsregs lhag lhag sgra 'byin pa// sna tshogs mnar med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong tshe sgra chen 'byin// de las thar yang yi dwags gshin rje'i sdug bsngal rnam pa du ma dang*// dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal kla klo mi khoms 'jigs su rung ba rnam bsal nas// bag yod brtan pas rtog ngan tshar gcad rtag tu don chen bsams na legs// de ltar 'jigs rung rgyu'i sems bzlog cing*/ thos bsam ldan pas bsgrub la brtson byed gang*// rab tu dben pa'i bas mtha'i ri khrod brten// lhun po legs tshal phreng ba legs mdzes pas// yal ga rnam mdzes me tog spud kyis dud// rnam pa sgra 'byin ri dwags kyis gang pa/ mdzes pa'i chu phran steng ka du mas gang*/ sna tshogs dri bsrung bzang pos dbugs 'byin byed// ro mchog brgyad ldan 'bras bu rtsa bas gang*// rnam g.yeng bral ba'i nags khrod zhi ba der// lang tsho'i bde la ma chags legs gnas shing*// bsam tan tshad med sems dpa' dpal dang ldan// yang na sna tshogs brag ris legs bskor zhing*// ne sing sngon po rma bya'i mgrin par mtshungs// gtsang ba'i chu bran lhung lhung sgra snyan 'byin// mdzes pa'i me tog bung bas gar byed pa/

de 'dra'i gnas su sems can kun rtog gi /g.yo ba 'dzin par byed pa dpa' ba yin// gzhan yang gangs ri dpal dang ldan gyur pa// ku mud ltar dkar nyi zla'i 'od gsal zhing*/ mtsho chen i dha rnyil gyi 'od ldan pa// lbu ba'i phreng mdzes brlabs kyis rab g.yo ba// bde ba'i chu rlabs chil chil sgrogs pa'i gnas// de 'drar rtog bral bsam gtan gyi gnas pa/ srid pa'i bde spang skye bu dam pa yin// de ltar thos bsam bsgom la brtson byed pa// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs spangs bde 'gro bde ba'i lam// dkar phyogs lha rnams kyis bstod chos dkar 'dzin// rgyal sras rnams kyis rab bsngags rgyal sras mchog bdud rnams kun las rab rgyal sems dpa' che// ring por mi thogs thams cad mkhyen pa thob// des na snyigs dus 'gro ba la// brtser ldan brtson pa'i stobs chung ba// chos la mi dga' chos can dang*// rnam g.yo ri spong snying rje g.yo// rang byung min kyang rang byung gis// bstan la dad ldan rdo rje zhes// ming bral ming du brjod pa yi// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i spyod mthong nas// rang la bskul phyir brjod pa 'di// mkhas mchog rnams la bzod par mdzod/// / ༈ byang chub sems dpa' sa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa'i smon lam chen po 'di dag mngon par bsgrubs te/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ma lus pa lhag ma med pa mtha' dag la mchod cing rim 'gro bya ba'i phyir/ rnam pa'i mchog thabs dang ldan pa mos pa rgya chen pos rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa rgya che ba nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa'i phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa bskal pa grangs med pa thams cad du sangs rgyas skye ba grangs med pa la rim 'gro dang mchod pa chen po bya ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub po// gnyis pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsungs pa'i chos kyi gzung ba dang*/

byang chub bslang pa dang*/ bstan pa yang dag par bsrung ba'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub po/ gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten khams 'byams klas pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa thams cad kyi drung du 'gro ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub bo// bzhi pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa tshad med pa gdams pa dang*/ sa'i yongs su sbyong ba thams cad nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub po/ lnga pa ni/ sems can du rtogs pa ji snyed thams cad smon par bya ba dang*/ chos la gzud pa dang*/ yongs su smin par bya ba rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub bo// drug pa ni nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad zhing dag par sbyong ba'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub po/ bdun pa ni/ zhing thams cad gcig tu gzhol ba dang*/ 'od kyis brgyan pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang ldan pa dang*/ dag pa'i sems can gyis gang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can rnams la bstan pa'i zhing dag pa'i las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub po/ brgyad pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bsam sbyor dang dge ba'i rtsa ba dang dmigs pa mnyam zhing rtag tu mi bral ba dang*/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ci dgar bstan pa dang*/ rang gi sems ba skyed pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul dang mthu ye shes khong du chud par bya ba dang*/ ma nyams shing rjes su 'brang ba'i mngon shes thob par bya ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyis khams thams cad du rnam par rgyu ba dang*/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gzugs rnyan byung ba yang dag par bstan pa dang*/ skye ba'i skyes gnas thams cad du rang gi lus rjes su 'gro bar bya ba dang*/ theg pa chen pos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir// phyi ma'i mthar thug pa'i bar smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub po/

dgu pa ni phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i spyod pas mthong ma thag du sangs rgyas kyi chos thos pa dang*/ dbyangs brjod ma thag tu ye shes khong du chud pa dang*/ dad par gyur ma thag tu nyon mongs pa phyir la ldog pa dang*/ bsam pa sman gyi rgyal po lta bu dang*/ lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub po/ bcu pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas dang*// skra yi sbubs gcig dang tha mi dad par skra'i rtse mo thams cad du'ang*/ byang chub chen po'i rol pa kun tu ston par bya ba dang*/ sems kyis skad cig skad cig la sems can gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i chos kyi sku'i phrin las dang bcas pa'i phrol bstan pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal pa bgrang ba thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes chen po rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub bo// smon lam 'di bcu la sogs pa'i smon lam brgya stong grangs med pa phrag bcu tshang pa dag byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba la mngon par bsgrub bo// smon lam de dag kyang mthar thug pa'i gnas bcus mngon par bsgrub thob ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sems can gyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi mthar thug pa dang*/ nam mkha' khams kyi mthar thugs pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mthar thug pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dang*/ sems kyi dmigs pa'i mthar thug pa dang*// ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang*// 'jig rten gyi rgyud dang ye shes kyi rgyud kyi mthar thug pa dag go

/rang byung rdo rjes mdo sde phal po che las btus pa'o/// / ༈ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' dpag med cing*// sna tshogs nor bu'i tshogs kyis rab tu ltams// dpag med 'gro ba rnams kyi nyer mtsho'i gnas// bla med yon tan ldan pa phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma'i dus kyi rnal 'byor ri khrod pas// shes bya'i gnas la tshad med legs gtogs shing*// snyigs dus rgyal ba'i gsung la mkhas pa'i mchog /skyes bu dam pa'i snyan du tshig 'di 'bul// bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor nub kyi ri rtser phyin// lung rtog 'od zer snang ba bsgribs dus 'dir// mkhas mchog rnams kyang le lo'i dbang gyur tam// gzhan rkyen chu 'dzin 'thug por gyur ram ci// gdul bya'i tshogs rnams skal ba dman gyur tam// de bas khyed kyis brtson pa'i mthu bskyed nas// 'gro ba mi shes mun pas sgribs rnams la// lung dang rtogs pa'i 'od zer bkye mdzod la// dag pa'i zhing bzhin gdul bya dag par mdzod// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa dang*// theg mchog 'bras bu rgya cher spel du gsol// slad kyis theg chen chos kyi 'brel ba'i gtam// dga' ston rgya cher spel cing 'jal bar bgyi// ces pa 'di rang byung rdo rjes mkhas pa chen po rgya maṃgha laṃ ke tu la bskur ba'o/// / ༈ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nyer zhi zhing*// spros ldan rnams la thugs rjes 'phrin las kyi// 'khor bar mtha' med 'jug pa'i sems can la// 'phrin las mtha' yas ston la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa'i bstan pa mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ theg mchog zab yangs chu 'dzin snying po las/ yan lag brgyad ldan 'phags pa'i chos char 'phro/ zab yangs dri med gsung gi sgra dbyangs can// ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer rab 'gyed cing*// dad ldan gzhi la theg mchog myu gu'i tshal// rgyas mdzad rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rmad du byung*// deng sang bstan pa'i snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus// theg mchog chos kyi snod gyur shin tu nyung*// blo gros ldan rnams nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// bshes gnyen bzang po'i rjes su 'jug byed pa/

dad dang brtson 'grus ldan pa dkon mod kyang*// theg mchog gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bye brag rnams// thos nas thar pa'i sa bon 'gyur ba'i phyir// re shig dris pa'i lan de brjod par bya/ sems can rnams kyi thog mar 'khrul pa'i tshul// rang sems rgyal ba'i snying po dri med las// rang ngo spros bral stong pa'i rang bzhin dang*// rang bzhin ma 'dres yongs su gsal ba las// 'gag med rol par kun tu 'byung ba ste// mar me dang ni mar me'i 'od bzhin du// de nyid dang ni gzhan du brjod med kyang*// rang snang gsal ba'i cha las yul du gyur// rang rig 'gyu ba yul du ma gnas pas// tha dad ltar snang yang dag mi rtog gis// dkrugs pas nang du nga dang bdag du rtog /yul drug snang ba nga yi zhes su 'dzin// de ltar yul dang dmigs pa'i rkyen las ni// sems kyi nus pa dbang por snang ba yis// bdag rkyen 'tshogs pa'i skad cig byas// tha dad snang ba'i rnam shes drug po bskyed// de'i khyad par sems las byung ba las// dkar nag mi g.yo las rnams 'du byed pas// kun bzhi'i rnam par shes pa bskyed pa yin// de ni rgyu'i rkyen zhes grags pa ste// de ni ma sgribs lung ma bstan pa'i phyir/ khams gsum las kyi 'bras bu nye bar bsgrubs// de ma gtogs pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis su// ma rtogs zo chu'i khyud mo bzhin du 'khyam// 'di ni 'khor ba'i sems can gnas lugs yin// 'khrul pa'i snang ba de ltar ma shes nas// lus ngag yid kyi mi dge'i las rnams kun// 'dus byas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong*// gnyen po'i dge bcu'i las la 'bad pa yis// 'dod pa'i khams kyi 'gro ba thob 'gyur zhing*/ byis pa'i nyer spyod bsam gtan bsgoms pa yis// gzugs khams lha'i bde ba nyams su myong*// snang dang stong pa bkag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ gzugs med khams kyi 'bras bu 'grub pa byed// sems dang sems byung khams gsum 'khor ba 'di/

rtsa ba yang dag ma yin rtogs las byung*// khams gsum gzung dang 'dzin pa'i gnyen po ru// rgyal bas zab don chos tshul dpag med gsungs// theg gsum sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis na// lam dang 'bras bu'i tha dad du mar snang*// lam yang dri med theg pa'i mchog la ni// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung don rgya chen rnam/ bstan phyir bdag nyid chen po byams pas bshad// khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i nang gi don// gsang ba'i bdag pos legs par bstan gyur pa// bsdus pa'i tshul du spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// mchog tu mi 'gyur 'grub pa'i mdor bsdus su// bstan zhing de'i don rnam mdor bsdus na// sbyangs ldan dbang bskur legs par thob pa dang*// bskyed rdzogs tshul bzhin nyams su len pa de// tshogs kyi lam du nges par son pa'i rtags// bde bsal mi rtog ting 'dzin nyams blangs shing*// bsam gtan la brten mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob// sbyor ba'i lam la nges par son pa yin// 'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi tshul shes shing*/ gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par dben pa dang*// chos kun rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab dang*// skyon brgyad med pa'i bsam ga tan bzhi pa 'dres// yang dag brtson 'grus ting nge 'dzin ni// dag dang shin tu sbyangs pa'i yon tan rdzogs/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog thob nas kyang*// de nyid ngang nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sems can gyi// khams dang dbang po gsal bar snang ba dang*// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis snang 'gyur zhing*// rtog pa med pa'i rgyal ba'i sras gyur pa// 'di ni rtsa gnas dang po dag pa dang*/ brgya phrag bco brgyad las rlung dag pa yis// 'dzag med lhan skyes thig le bstan pa las// mthong lam mngon du gyur pa zhes su grags// de nas bzungs te 'khor lo drug po la// nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya'i rlung dag cing*// rjes su dran pa'i byang chub sems brtan pas// sa bcu'i yon tan rim gyis mthong 'gyur zhing*// zhing brgya mthong dang grangs med mthar thug pa// yon tan gong nas gong du rdzogs gyur cing*// sangs rgyas zhing sbyong sems can thams cad sgrol// rjes su dran pa bcu drug rdzogs pa yis// spyan lnga gzungs dang ting 'dzin yon tan rnams// dpag tu med pa yongs su rdzogs gyur cing*/

dga' ba bcu drug snying rje bcu drug dang*// stong pa bcu drug yongs su rtogs pa yis// skad cig gcig la mngon par byang chub 'gyur// de'i yon tan bshad kyis lang pa min// 'di dag rdo rje theg pa'i dbang gi don// sbyang ba bcu pa'i sbyong byed kyis sbyangs pas// dbang bdun rnams kyis sa bdun legs thob cing*/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyis// dag pa'i sa gsum mngon du byed 'gyur zhing*// phyag rgya chen po bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas// rdo rje slob dpon rgyal ba kun bdag nyid// sku bzhi'i dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs 'gyur zhing*// 'di dag rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dbang du ni// tshogs sbyor so sor bsdud dang dbang du bsre// srog rtsol bsgrubs nas 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// mthong ba'i lam du nges par 'jug par byed/ rjes dran ting 'dzin bsgoms pa'i rim pa yis// bsgom pa'i lam dang mi mthun bsgrod 'gyur te// 'di dag rnams su spyod pa'i khyad par yang*// mos pa'i lam la theg gsum spyi dang mthun// kun bzang spyod dang ting 'dzin spyod pa yang*// sbyor ba'i lam du nges par byed pa yin// spros med spyod pa shin tu spros med kyang*// mthong ba'i lam du nges par sbyor bar byed/ phyogs las rnam rgyal tshogs kyi spyod pa yis// bsgom pa'i lam dang gzhan don bya ba yis// 'di dag zab lam rgyud sde'i snying po las// ci ltar gsungs pa bdag gis bris pa yin// kye ma deng sang bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin shin tu bsgrub pa nyung*// de phyir dad ldan rjes su 'jug pa la// phan phyir phyi rol nyan thos spyod pa bsten// nang du stong pa'i snying rje zung 'jug gis// yang dag snying po zab lam gnad du bsnun// dad pa chung zhing shes rab dman pa dang*// btang snyoms le lo'i dbang du song ba rnams// snyigs dus rang la gnod par byed pa'i phyir// snying rje bskyed la bsdu ba yongs mi bya// dad dang shes rab brtson 'grus ldan pa dang*/

'chi ba rjes dran theg pa'i mchog la mos// skal ldan rnams la gdams pa sbyin bya zhing*// rjes su 'jug dang rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub// de phyir blang dor legs par shes pa yis/ rang gzhan bla med gnyis su 'grub pa bya// 'di ltar bsdus par ngag tu brjod pa bya// mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum legs par sbyangs// bka' ba rgyud grub pa'i rjes la legs par zhugs// tshe 'di'i 'jig rten bya ba rnam gral zhing*// bla med chen po'i rjes zhugs lan du bris// dge bas mkha' khyab sems can ma lus pa// bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul ril gyi don du gdams pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba'i chos tshul dpag med gsungs// kun kyang rang gi rtog pa yin// des na gdam ngag rtsa ba ni// rang gi sems la lta ba yin// de don ston pa'i bla ma la// rtag tu mos pa rgya chen bsgom// tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba la// rang snang rang grol rgya yis thob// nang gi sems de sems byung rnams/ rang gi ngo bo lhug par zhog /bar du 'gyu ba ngo yis bzung*// lta ba'i ngo bo rtogs nas 'chi// de stengs brtson 'grus drag po yis/ sems can kun la snying rje dang*// 'brel bar bsam gtan bsgom la 'bad// mtha' gnyis bral ba'i spyod pa yis/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsres// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa yi/ 'bras bu rgyal bas gsungs pa yin/// / ༈ thub dbang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das// rgyal sras rgyal ba'i ye shes rtogs rnams dang*// rgyud na rgyud du dngos grub brnyes pa yis// dpal ldan mchog sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye ma 'di ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// mi lus mchog thob rgyal bas rjes bzung tshe// rab byung 'ga' dang 'ga' zhig tshul mthong bas// yid byung rang gi sems la gros 'debs bri// rgyal dang sras bcas thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams// dus 'dir rtse bas bdag la rjes bzung gsol// skyes chen skyes bu'i tshogs rnams 'di la gson// chos sku spros bral nam mkha' lta bu la// gzugs sku nyi ma'i bdag nyid 'od zer can// nam mkha'i mthas khyab sems can kun la shar// khyad par zhing 'dir dam chos mdo sde'i bcud// gsal bar gsungs mod rjes su mi slob tshe// zhing 'dir skyes pa'i don gyis ci zhig mnyam// dul dang sdom dang dam tshig mi 'dzin cing*// khe grags rnyed dang bkur sti'i ro la chags// rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs smras kyang log par 'dzin// 'di 'dra mthong tshe bdag yid rnam par chad// 'dul las khyad 'phags gsang sngags rgyud sde'i don/

ji bzhin bshad pa nyon mongs kun gyi gnyen// rjes su bsgoms nas bde chen rtogs pa'i dpal// kha don zos gyur 'di la bdag yid byung*// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i cha lugs mdzes gyur cing*// slu med gang las rnyed gyur ma gnang yang*// rnyed dang bkur sti dpag med la sogs pa'i// skyes bu 'di dag mthong bas bdag yid chad// rgyal bas gsungs pa theg pa'i don rnams ni/ ma nor rtogs na 'gro ba'i dpal yin la// rang bzo nga rgyal dbang gis nga ru 'dzin/ 'di 'dra rgyal ba'i thugs kyis mi khrel tam// dam chos zab mo bskal par bshad gyur kyang*// skye bo log 'dzin dbang gis don ma rtogs// chos la bskul kyang log par zhen mthong na// bdag nyid gcig tu mi snang gyur na'ang snyam// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa zab yangs nam mkha' yi// chu gter dpag med 'di las skye bo yis// zil pa tsam gcig ma thob 'di mthong tshe// zhing khams kun tu thog med sbyangs na'ang*// sems rnams grol ba'i don la rab gzhol ba/ nus mthu chung ba yang na smon lam zad// ci'i phyir na sems can ngan 'gror lhung*// 'di'i dus su skyes bu mchog nyid rnams// cung zad 'gro ba'i don la sems bskongs shig /yang na 'du 'dzi spangs la dben pa sten// sangs rgyas zhing khams sbyong ba'i don bsgom shig /bdag nyid 'di ltar cung zad bsams pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten 'di'i sdug bsngal mi bzod na// ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par 'dod pa rnams// yang na 'khrul lam yang na sems dpa' yin/ ci phyir 'di la bsams shing 'di nyid ni/ gsungs mchog ma nor yig ge'i rtsal sbyongs shig /kye ma 'di 'dra'i skye bo sdig can rnams// sems can sems dpa'i lam la mi 'dren nam// yang na bdag kyang mi snang gyur na ci// 'dren pa'i bshes gnyen 'dren pa'i gtso bo che// thub pa'i dbang po thugs rje'i mnga' bdag nyid// sras kyi mchog rnams sras su nyer dgongs cig

ting 'dzin zas kyis bdag nyid 'tshor gyur mang*/ tha mal zas kyis bsod nams rdzogs pa'i phyir// dpag med zas kyis 'gro la dga' ston gyis// dbul gyur zas kyis bskyangs na yon tan 'thob// bdag nyid zas mchog skye med bsgom pa dang*// dam chos zas kyi gdul bya smin gyis cig /bdag nyid lta ba bdag med skyes na yang*/ 'gro ba gzhan la bdag med bskyed pa'i phyir/ lta ba ma nor don la skye ba ru// kun nas kun tu skye ba med par shog /yon tan mchog gyur dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ bdud rtsi'i mchog gyur dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ bltas ste skye med mchog 'di ma rtogs par// lta ba bdag med mchog la legs pa ltos// bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ skye med mchog rtogs skye bral bla ma la/ skye ba kun tu skye med mchog bsgom zhing*/ skye na'ang skye med ngang du shog /'khor ba la yid nges par byung bas rang la gros 'debs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du/ rang byung rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa'o/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir// bla mas rjes bzung bdag med bsgrub byed tshe// gdams pa'i mthar thug 'di bzhin bsgom par bya/ pha rol phyin lnga byang chub yon tan rnams// bdag med shes rab mchog gis rgyas gdab cing*// rgyud sde'i mthar thug bcud kyi nying khu 'di// gsal stong 'dzin med rig pa de nyid ltos// kun gyi mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i don// 'gyur med rang gsal ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang*// ji bzhin 'gyur med rang byung lta ba'i gdeng*// mtha' brgyad bral bas 'phags pa'i dgongs pa nyid// rnam rtog zad pa'i skyol ba dbu ma'i lam// rtag chad bying rgod bral ba de nyid don// te lo na ro'i dgongs pa mtha' bzhi bral// de na ci yang yid la ma byed cig /skyon dang yon tan rnams blta rtog pa'i sgra// yin gyi spros pa gang du'ang ma lta cig

/thams cad de nyid ngang du glod la zhog ༈ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma bya bral ba la gdams pa ni/ thog med 'brel pa'i mos pa yis// dus 'dir bla ma rnams dang mjal// khyad par nged la mos pa yis// yang yang mjal ba ngo mtshar che/ chos kun bla ma brten las byung*// de yang mos pa nyid la rten// rang gi sems dang dbyer med pa// bsgoms pas rgyud la rtogs pa 'char// gzhan don rtsa ba snying rjes ste// de yang dmigs pa med dang 'brel// lus ngag yid gsum dag pa yis// mkha' mnyam byang chub thob par bsngo// sna tshogs snang ba rmi lam 'dra// de yang rang gi sems dang 'brel/ ma yengs dran pa dang ldan pas// snang stong dbyer med gcig tu sbyongs// rang gi rnam par rtog pa kun// grol na rang byung ye shes ste// ma grol 'khor ba de nyid yin// gnyis 'dzin rang grol ngang du sbyongs// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud dang*// bla ma rnams kyi gdams ngag kun// bsdus kyang 'di las nga ma mthong*// de ltar nyams su len par zhu// bla ma bya bral ba gdams pa// bde chen du bris pa'o/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ rnam dag smon lam stobs las legs 'khrung sku/ yon tan mtha' yas bsod nams mtshan gyis brgyan// bde ldan zhing du mngon par byang chub pa/ tshe dang ye shes dpag med phyag 'tshal lo// srid bzhi'i skyon bral rnam dag phun tshogs mnga'// khyad 'phags zhing mchog kun gyis bstod pa'i gnas// dri med rgyal ba'i 'od la sgrib mi mnga'/ bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas phyag 'tshal lo// nub phyogs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla med zhing*// gtsang yangs mdzes dang dri zhim bde ba dang*// yid 'ong rin chen sna tshogs ljon pas brgyan// 'dren pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// bde ldan zhing gi brgyan dang yon tan dang*// bkod pa sku tshe'i 'od ni dpag med de// rgyal de chos rje nyid las gzhan ma mchis/

drang srong 'od dpag med zhabs spyi bos 'dud// rin chen sna tshogs las grub bde gshegs sku// phyi nang rten dang mchod pa'i bye brag sogs// 'dis mtshon bsod nams phung po bde ldan du// pad ma las skyes dge slong gyur nas kyang*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa mthong 'gyur zhing*// myur du byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /'od dpag med la bstod pa zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba rang byung rdo rjes bkod pa'o/// /
